# Appendix B. Error Codes

> Source: [GOLDILOCKS 26c.1 User Manual (en)](https://manual.sunjesoft.co.kr/goldilocks/26c_1/manual/en/4f0d98b11f1e6ab4)  
> Tag: `26c.1_0_tag`

[← Appendix A. SQLSTATE](appendix-01-appendix-a-sqlstate.md) · [Table of contents](../README.md) · [Appendix C. Wait Event →](appendix-03-appendix-c-wait-event.md)

GOLDILOCKS provides user error codes as follows. The error messages can be viewed with [V$ERROR_CODE](../part-02-administration-manual/9-database-information.md#6a1e88c1b0cd159e).

This chapter describes the cause and action of the error in the following form.

**ErrorCode (SQLSTATE): Message**  
• ErrorCode: GOLDILOCKS-specific error code  
• SQLSTATE: SQL standard state code  
• Message: Error message

<a id="9adf87d76ffa4df4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>It is the cause of an error.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>It is the action.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="ed68c8ff1be3bc42"></a>
## OS Related Error

> **11000 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid argument**

<a id="bdc4cd0d77ab4da4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">An invalid argument was used.<br><br>% glsnr --test<br>ERR-HY000(11000): Invalid argument</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use a valid argument when executing the command.<br><br>% glsnr --stop<br>Listener is stopped.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11001 (SQLSTATE: HY000): The operation was incomplete although some processing was performed and the results are partially valid**

<a id="b93b46d54acfe1b2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Failed to retrieve some of the requested file information.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Verify that the requested file is a regular file,&nbsp;&nbsp;as certain information may not be provided for special files or virtual file systems.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11002 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Permission denied '%s'**

<a id="c2ae5b6eaee2b9ec"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Insufficient privilege to access the file or directory.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Use the chown or chmod command to change the access privileges.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11003 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Standard Layer has encountered the end of the file**

<a id="0ec649e8cefa1b62"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error corresponds to EOF and is an error code used within the server.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11004 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to duplicate a file**

<a id="b2a2a161dea966d4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The file replication has failed.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the file privileges, available disk space, and whether the target path is valid.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11005 (SQLSTATE: HY000): File Lock Error**

<a id="7e612700bd968d65"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>File locking has failed.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check for other processes using the file and try again after a short wait.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11006 (SQLSTATE: HY000): File Unlock Error**

<a id="eb6e377017585594"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Failed to unlock the file.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the file lock status and unlock the file with appropriate privileges.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11007 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to open the file '%s'**

<a id="7fde48d40b888b87"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The file may not exist, access privilege is lacking, or the file is locked by another process.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the file path and privileges, and verify if another process is using the file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11008 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to close the file**

<a id="2636d4e4036a8add"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The file descriptor is invalid or an I/O error has occurred.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Verify that the file has been opened correctly and check the condition of the disk.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11009 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to remove the file**

<a id="e2e5eee9fcc2e8d7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The file may not exist, delete privilege is lacking, or the file may be in use by another process.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Verify the file’s existence and privileges, terminate any processes using the file, and then retry.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11010 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to link the file**

<a id="bac70df673fa0d94"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Failed to create the file link. This may be due to insufficient privileges or lack of support from the file system.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Verify the file privileges and confirm whether the file system supports this feature.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11011 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to read the file**

<a id="24736ba0a13f4e6d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The file may lack read privileges, there may be a disk I/O error, or the file may be corrupted.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Verify the file privileges and disk status, and perform a file integrity check.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11012 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to write the file**

<a id="f6424f9c651caaa9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The file may lack write privileges, disk space may be insufficient, or a disk I/O error may have occurred.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Verify the file privileges and available disk space, and check the disk status.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11013 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to sync the file**

<a id="3f0b0ca83134239f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The file system synchronization failed, or a disk I/O error has occurred.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Verify the disk status and perform a file system integrity check.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11014 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to seek the file**

<a id="193297bdfc8db11f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">An attempt was made to move to an invalid file position, or a file descriptor error occurred.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Verify the file size and the target position, and check the validity of the file descriptor.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11015 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to truncate the file**

<a id="91d90702d764aeb7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">There may be a lack of privilege to modify the file size, or the disk space may be insufficient.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Verify the file privileges and the available disk space.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11016 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to get the status of the file**

<a id="09f721fcd34a0fd0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The file does not exist, or the privilege to retrieve its status has not been granted.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Verify the file path and privileges.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11017 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to create a pipe**

<a id="965bd2064a7b76ae"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Failed to create a pipe due to insufficient system resources.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check system resource usage and terminate unnecessary processes.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11018 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to wait for the given process**

<a id="0f0b628a490f329a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Failed to wait for the child process because no child process exists.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the process relationships and inspect the signal handling status.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11019 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Insufficient resource**

<a id="0fd778e9d9432067"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>System resources are insufficient.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check system resource usage and terminate unnecessary processes.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11020 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to send signal to given process**

<a id="fe27c93fb6e6c227"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The attempt to send a signal failed because the target process does not exist.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Verify that the target process exists and check signal privileges.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11021 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to set a signal handler**

<a id="5d3a73cac4014411"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Failed to set signal handler.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check whether the system supports signals.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11022 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to block a signal**

<a id="a2c4d1ac2c8874f6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Failed to block the signal.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the signal mask settings and verify that the system supports the signal.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11023 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to set thread attribute**

<a id="bfd997ec1f9ef5ed"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Failed to set thread attributes.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the thread attribute values and verify the system's thread limits.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11024 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to create a thread**

<a id="62132d9733789447"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Failed to create a thread. The system may be low on resources or may have reached the maximum number of threads.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the system's thread limit settings and verify memory usage.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11025 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to join with a terminated thread**

<a id="a9f5209abd0ec42d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Failed to wait for thread termination due to an invalid thread ID.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the thread status and verify whether a deadlock has occurred.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11026 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to set thread once code**

<a id="6aa25dbc513f2d8a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Failed to set the Thread Once Code.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Review the thread synchronization code.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11027 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Truncation occurred on I/O operation**

<a id="0cce357f6bd53367"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The string was truncated due to insufficient buffer size during the I/O operation.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Ensure the buffer size is sufficiently allocated and verify the length of the input string.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11028 (SQLSTATE: HY000): The given name(%s) is too long**

<a id="989ff126d2cd898e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The given name is too long.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Shorten the name length to comply with system limitations.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11029 (SQLSTATE: HY000): shared memory segment exists**

<a id="f91a08129224d113"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The shared memory segment already exists.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Either release the existing shared memory and recreate it, or reuse the existing segment.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11030 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to allocate a shared memory segment**

<a id="7a78407de4c9db58"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Failed to create shared memory due to insufficient privileges or memory.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the system limits for shared memory and verify the privilege settings.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11031 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to attach the shared memory segment**

<a id="f9962cbe0bb3f078"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Failed to connect to shared memory due to an invalid segment ID.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Verify the shared memory segment ID and check the process privileges.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11032 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to detach the shared memory segment**

<a id="e1124ff82c954391"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The segment has already been released, so the shared memory could not be detached.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the shared memory attachment status.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11033 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to destroy the shared memory segment**

<a id="82f0125a58c69732"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Failed to destroy shared memory due to insufficient privileges.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the ownership privileges of the shared memory.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11034 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to create a semaphore**

<a id="dfd6a0a0e324ec53"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Failed to create semaphore due to insufficient system resources.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the system limits for semaphores and clean up IPC resources.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11035 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to acquire the given semaphore**

<a id="bd016408b9cb047c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>A deadlock occurred due to failure in acquiring a semaphore.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Verify the semaphore usage patterns and implement logic to prevent deadlocks.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11036 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to release the given semaphore**

<a id="e3e12bb52ff1c94b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The semaphore has already been released, so the semaphore release failed.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the semaphore status to prevent duplicate releases.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11037 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to destory the given semaphore**

<a id="452ed1d726ca9951"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Failed to destroy the semaphore due to insufficient privileges.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the ownership privileges of the semaphore.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11038 (SQLSTATE: HY000): The given object was busy**

<a id="720bc1ed5fb522fc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The resource is currently in use.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Wait until the resource is no longer in use, then retry.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11039 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Operation timed out**

<a id="9e4a5ad34855adcb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The operation has timed out.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Adjust the timeout value and check the system performance.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="ae1d2b19f1cf1ba8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The requested object does not exist.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the object name and path.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **11041 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Two objects do not match**

<a id="62f7cc4897cc3abf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The two objects do not match.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Verify if the objects being compared match.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="83293cd2a6b0c2f8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">System memory is insufficient as the memory allocation limit has been reached.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check system memory usage, terminate unnecessary processes, or consider upgrading the memory.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="da0029b89e0ba40e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12001 (SQLSTATE: HYC00): not implemented feature, in a function %s**

<a id="2dd001e16c60b8c6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12002 (SQLSTATE: 22001): byte length of data greater than column length**

<a id="8ab0dbd837cbdf88"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The bytes bigger than the column length were input.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 VARCHAR(3) );<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 'abcd' );<br><br>ERR-22001(12002): byte length of data greater than column length :<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 'abcd' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Input the data which matches the column length as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 'abc' );<br><br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12003 (SQLSTATE: 22001): character length of data greater than column length**

<a id="abc720565b50946d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The characters whose length is longer than the character length of the column was input.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 VARCHAR(2 char) );<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( '두글자' );<br>ERR-22001(12003): character length of data greater than column length :<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( '두글자' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the number of characters allowed for the column.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( '두자' );<br><br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12004 (SQLSTATE: 22001): data converted with truncation of fractional digits**

<a id="56317c6b1844bac0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12005 (SQLSTATE: 22001): conversion of data would result in loss of whole digits**

<a id="64b5b658283cc84d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is the conversion causing data loss.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_NATIVE_BIGINT( '9223372036854775808' ) AS RESULT FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-22001(12005): conversion of data would result in loss of whole digits :<br>SELECT TO_NATIVE_BIGINT( '9223372036854775808' ) AS RESULT FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use an input which does not cause data loss.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_NATIVE_BIGINT( '9223372036854775807' ) AS RESULT FROM DUAL;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RESULT<br>-------------------<br>9223372036854775807<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12006 (SQLSTATE: 22018): data value is not a numeric literal**

<a id="a80939c09f3d3619"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The characters which can not be converted to the number were used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT 1 + 'a' FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-22018(12006): data value is not a numeric literal :<br>SELECT 1 + 'a' FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use characters which can be converted to numbers or use numbers as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT 1 + '2' FROM dual;<br><br>1 + '2'<br>-------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT 1 + 2 FROM dual;<br><br>1 + 2<br>-----<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12007 (SQLSTATE: 22003): data is outside the range of the data type to which the number is being converted**

<a id="3b85c4acf953f693"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The value is out of the data type range when converting.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_NATIVE_SMALLINT( '32768' ) AS RESULT FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-22003(12007): data is outside the range of the data type to which the number is being converted :<br><br>SELECT TO_NATIVE_SMALLINT( '32768' ) AS RESULT FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Input the value that is within the data type range as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_NATIVE_SMALLINT( '32767' ) AS RESULT FROM DUAL;<br><br>RESULT<br>------<br>&nbsp;32767<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12018 (SQLSTATE: 22015): data value is a valid interval value; the value in one of the fields is truncated**

<a id="0fb91601909953ec"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The wrong INTERVAL literal was used.<br><br>SELECT INTERVAL'1-11' YEAR FROM DUAL;<br>ERR-22015(12018): data value is a valid interval value; the value in one of the fields is truncated :<br>SELECT INTERVAL'1-11' YEAR FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the correct INTERVAL literal as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT INTERVAL'1' YEAR FROM DUAL;<br>INTERVAL'1' YEAR<br>----------------<br>+01-00<br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12019 (SQLSTATE: 22018): data value is not a valid interval literal**

<a id="ec4563fee45d2dea"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The INTERVAL literal expression is wrong.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT INTERVAL'1' YEAR TO MONTH FROM DUAL;<br>ERR-22018(12019): data value is not a valid interval literal :<br>SELECT INTERVAL'1' YEAR TO MONTH FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the correct INTERVAL literal expression.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT INTERVAL'1-1' YEAR TO MONTH FROM DUAL;<br>INTERVAL'1-1' YEAR TO MONTH<br>---------------------------<br>+01-01<br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="70479d1aee726234"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The data type combination which can not be executed as a function argument was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT 4 * DATE'2024-01-01' FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-42000(12118): inconsistent datatype of function parameters: NUMBER, DATE :<br>SELECT 4 * DATE'2024-01-01' FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the data type which can be used as a function argument.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT 4 + DATE'2024-01-01' FROM dual;<br><br>4 + DATE'2024-01-01'<br>--------------------<br>2024-01-05<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12119 (SQLSTATE: 42000): comparison is not applicable: %s and %s**

<a id="72ed0c32296d39b0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The data type combination which can not be compared was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT 'OK' FROM dual WHERE 100 = DATE'2024-01-01';<br><br>ERR-42000(12119): comparison is not applicable: NUMBER and DATE :<br>SELECT 'OK' FROM dual WHERE 100 = DATE'2024-01-01'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the data type combination which can be compared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT 'OK' FROM dual WHERE 100 = INTERVAL '10' YEAR;<br><br>no rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12120 (SQLSTATE: 42000): conversion is not applicable: from %s to %s**

<a id="54e195ddefee0e18"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is the data type which can not be converted.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT CAST( 100 AS BOOLEAN ) FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-42000(12120): conversion is not applicable: from NUMBER to BOOLEAN :<br>SELECT CAST( 100 AS BOOLEAN ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the convertible data type.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT CAST( 'TRUE' AS BOOLEAN ) FROM dual;<br><br>CAST( 'TRUE' AS BOOLEAN )<br>-------------------------<br>TRUE<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="d4fa872369b31f6d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is required to check if the character belongs to the specified character set, which does not apply.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check if the character belongs to the specified character set.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12122 (SQLSTATE: 22012): divisor is equal to zero**

<a id="c7e7eee5785febbc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The value 0 was used as the denominator.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT 5 / 0 FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-22012(12122): divisor is equal to zero :<br>SELECT 5 / 0 FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Do not use 0 as the denominator when executing division operation.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12123 (SQLSTATE: 22018): data is not boolean literal**

<a id="bf998d1b14058d2a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is the string which can not be converted to boolean type.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT CAST( 'a' AS BOOLEAN ) FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-22018(12123): data is not boolean literal :<br>SELECT CAST( 'a' AS BOOLEAN ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the string that can be converted to boolean type such as TRUE, FALSE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT CAST( 'TRUE' AS BOOLEAN ) FROM dual;<br><br>CAST( 'TRUE' AS BOOLEAN )<br>-------------------------<br>TRUE<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12124 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid argument for factorial function**

<a id="747fc64d4cf87708"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is the value that can not be used as an argument for FACTORIAL() function.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT factorial(0.6) FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12124): invalid argument for factorial function :<br>SELECT factorial(0.6) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use an integer value as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT factorial(5) FROM dual;<br><br>FACTORIAL(5)<br>------------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;120<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12125 (SQLSTATE: 22027): trim set should have only one character**

<a id="8ba2364d8aee162e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Only one character is allowed for the trim set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TRIM( BOTH 'ab' FROM 'abca' ) FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-22027(12125): trim set should have only one character :<br>SELECT TRIM( BOTH 'ab' FROM 'abca' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Describe only one character in the trim set as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TRIM( BOTH 'a' FROM 'abca' ) FROM dual;<br><br>TRIM( BOTH 'a' FROM 'abca' )<br>----------------------------<br>bc<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12126 (SQLSTATE: 22008): datetime field overflow**

<a id="1848b53651cf2c7b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is out of datetime value range.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT DATEADD( YEAR, 7999, DATE'2001-01-01' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-22008(12126): datetime field overflow :<br>SELECT DATEADD( YEAR, 7999, DATE'2001-01-01' ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The operation must not exceed the datetime value range.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT DATEADD( YEAR, 7998, DATE'2001-01-01' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>DATEADD( YEAR, 7998, DATE'2001-01-01' )<br>---------------------------------------<br>9999-01-01<br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12127 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid ROWID**

<a id="c1608733d918c776"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>ROWID which can not exist was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 ROWID );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO T1 VALUES ( '*-ADuwAAAAAAACAAAAAiAAC' );<br><br>ERR-HY000(12127): invalid ROWID :<br>INSERT INTO T1 VALUES ( '*-ADuwAAAAAAACAAAAAiAAC' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Input ROWID value that exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 SELECT t2.ROWID FROM t2;<br><br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12128 (SQLSTATE: 22019): invalid escape character**

<a id="c6ab9510b421bfbf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The escape is wrongly used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 WHERE c1 LIKE '____%' ESCAPE '__';<br><br>ERR-22019(12128): invalid escape character :<br>SELECT c1 FROM t1 WHERE c1 LIKE '____%' ESCAPE '__'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 WHERE c1 LIKE '____%' ESCAPE '_';<br><br>C1<br>---------<br>____%____<br>____A____<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12129 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid character set identifier**

<a id="ceabb46e9ce7cc53"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>When specifying the character set or the host variable related to the language while creating DB, the character set that was not supported was specified by the server.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The server supports the character set such as SQL_ASCII, UTF8, UHC, GB18030.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12130 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid extract field for extract source**

<a id="2c26f79c3cebe569"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The field to extract does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1, EXTRACT( YEAR FROM c1 ) FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12130): invalid extract field for extract source :<br>SELECT c1, EXTRACT( YEAR FROM c1 ) FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the field which can be extracted as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1, EXTRACT( HOUR FROM c1 ) FROM t1;<br><br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXTRACT( HOUR FROM C1 )<br>--------------- -----------------------<br>18:18:25.868024&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;18<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12131 (SQLSTATE: 42000): inconsistent datatypes: argument[%d] expected %s**

<a id="172365260fced04f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>A non-comparable data type was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT GREATEST( DATE'2024-03-31', 8080 ) FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-42000(12131): inconsistent datatypes: argument[2] expected DATE :<br>SELECT GREATEST( DATE'2024-03-31', 8080 ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the identical data type as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT GREATEST( DATE'2024-03-31', DATE'2024-04-01' ) FROM dual;<br><br>GREATEST( DATE'2024-03-31', DATE'2024-04-01' )<br>----------------------------------------------<br>2024-04-01<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12132 (SQLSTATE: HY000): date format value exceeds maximum length (%d)**

<a id="891d947ebdb50235"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It exceeded the maximum length of the date format.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT TO_CHAR( DATE'1999-01-01'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, 'YYYY/1234567890123456789012345678901234567890/MM/1234567890123456789012345678901234567890/DD' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12132): date format value exceeds maximum length (80) :<br>SELECT TO_CHAR( DATE'1999-01-01'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Decrease the length of the date format as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT TO_CHAR( DATE'1999-01-01'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, 'YYYY / MM / DD' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM DUAL;<br><br>TO_CHAR( DATE'1999-01-01'<br>-------------------------<br>1999 / 01 / 01<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12133 (SQLSTATE: HY000): date format not recognized**

<a id="6786bf9c4385d50f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>An invalid date format was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT TO_CHAR( DATE'1999-01-01', 'YYYY/FF/DD' ) FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12133): date format not recognized :<br>SELECT TO_CHAR( DATE'1999-01-01', 'YYYY/FF/DD' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the valid date format as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT TO_CHAR( DATE'1999-01-01', 'YYYY/MM/DD' ) FROM dual;<br><br>TO_CHAR( DATE'1999-01-01', 'YYYY/MM/DD' )<br>-----------------------------------------<br>1999/01/01<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12134 (SQLSTATE: HY000): format code appears twice**

<a id="c47bbbdb2d7628de"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The identical format code was used twice.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT TO_DATE( '1999-01-01', 'YYYY-DD-DD' ) FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12134): format code appears twice :<br>SELECT TO_DATE( '1999-01-01', 'YYYY-DD-DD' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the valid date format as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT TO_DATE( '1999-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) FROM dual;<br><br>TO_DATE( '1999-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD' )<br>-------------------------------------<br>1999-01-01<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12135 (SQLSTATE: HY000): %s conflicts with %s**

<a id="de575a3123eda730"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The date information about the input string is wrong.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE( '2024-02-28 SUNDAY', 'YYYY-MM-DD DAY' ) FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12135): day of week conflicts with Julian date :<br>SELECT TO_DATE( '2024-02-28 SUNDAY', 'YYYY-MM-DD DAY' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Describe the input string about the correct date information.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE( '2024-02-28 WEDNESDAY', 'YYYY-MM-DD DAY' ) FROM dual;<br><br>TO_DATE( '2024-02-28 wednesday', 'yyyy-mm-dd day' )<br>---------------------------------------------------<br>2024-02-28<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12136 (SQLSTATE: HY000): literal does not match format string**

<a id="ec488c5a2d520868"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The string is not appropriate for the format string.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT DATE'2024' FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12136): literal does not match format string :<br>SELECT DATE'2024' FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the valid string as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT DATE'2024-02-28' FROM dual;<br><br>DATE'2024-02-28'<br>----------------<br>2024-02-28<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12137 (SQLSTATE: HY000): input value not long enough for date format**

<a id="14957a632f66c46a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The length of the input value is smaller than the date format.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT CAST( '2024' AS DATE ) AS result FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12137): input value not long enough for date format :<br>SELECT CAST( '2024' AS DATE ) AS result FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the input value that is appropriate for the date format as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT CAST( '2024-03-01' AS DATE ) AS result FROM dual;<br><br>RESULT<br>----------<br>2024-03-01<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12138 (SQLSTATE: HY000): date format picture ends before converting entire input string**

<a id="23c32cac799c7f1f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The date format is smaller than the input value.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE ( '2000', 'YYY' ) FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12138): date format picture ends before converting entire input string :<br>SELECT TO_DATE ( '2000', 'YYY' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the date format which can interpret the input value as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE ( '2000', 'YYYY' ) FROM dual;<br><br>TO_DATE ( '2000', 'YYYY' )<br>--------------------------<br>2000-01-01<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12139 (SQLSTATE: HY000): year must be between %s and %s, and not be 0**

<a id="07a4dd022453fae0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The year does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE ( '0', 'YYYY' ) FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12139): year must be between 4714 BC and 9999 AD, and not be 0 :<br>SELECT TO_DATE ( '0', 'YYYY' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the year within the valid range.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE ( '1', 'YYYY' ) FROM dual;<br><br>TO_DATE ( '1', 'YYYY' )<br>-----------------------<br>0001-01-01<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12140 (SQLSTATE: 2200C): missing or illegal character following the escape character**

<a id="83b7b80eada6bc6e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>'_' or '%' must be described after the escape character.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 WHERE c1 LIKE '_A%' ESCAPE '_';<br><br>ERR-2200C(12140): missing or illegal character following the escape character :<br>SELECT c1 FROM t1 WHERE c1 LIKE '_A%' ESCAPE '_'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Describe the specified escape character before '_' or '%' of the pattern.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 WHERE c1 LIKE '__A%' ESCAPE '_';<br><br>C1<br>----<br>_ABC<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12141 (SQLSTATE: HY000): not a valid month**

<a id="445c409b5943f6d2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The input value does not correspond to a month.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE( '13', 'MM' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12141): not a valid month :<br>SELECT TO_DATE( '13', 'MM' ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the valid value corresponding to a month.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE( '12', 'MM' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>TO_DATE( '12', 'MM' )<br>---------------------<br>2024-12-01<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12142 (SQLSTATE: HY000): a non-numeric character was found where a numeric was expected**

<a id="6b4bc01ecc1db86f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The character which can not be converted to numbers was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT CAST( 'ABC' AS DATE ) FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12142): a non-numeric character was found where a numeric was expected :<br>SELECT CAST( 'ABC' AS DATE ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the string consisting of numbers that are appropriate for the data type as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT CAST( '2024-01-01' AS DATE ) FROM dual;<br><br>CAST( '2024-01-01' AS DATE )<br>----------------------------<br>2024-01-01<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12143 (SQLSTATE: HY000): day of month must be between 1 and last day of month**

<a id="a40d02bea5d3adea"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The value which can not be used as a date was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( '2024-02-00' );<br><br>ERR-HY000(12143): day of month must be between 1 and last day of month :<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( '2024-02-00' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Input the valid day of the month as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( '2024-02-01' );<br><br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12144 (SQLSTATE: HY000): not a valid day of the week**

<a id="dbe43cff89c15552"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The input day of the week value is wrong.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT NEXT_DAY( DATE'2017-05-31', '3' ) FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12144): not a valid day of the week :<br>SELECT NEXT_DAY( DATE'2017-05-31', '3' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Describe the day of the week as follows, or use numbers.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT NEXT_DAY( DATE'2017-05-31', 'TUESDAY' ) FROM dual;<br><br>NEXT_DAY( DATE'2017-05-31', 'TUESDAY' )<br>---------------------------------------<br>2017-06-06<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT NEXT_DAY( DATE'2017-05-31', 3 ) FROM dual;<br><br>NEXT_DAY( DATE'2017-05-31', 3 )<br>-------------------------------<br>2017-06-06<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12145 (SQLSTATE: HY000): day of year must be between 1 and 365 (366 for leap year)**

<a id="496f39284bf30f11"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The number of the days value exceeding the range of the year was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE( '2024 367', 'YYYY DDD' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12145): day of year must be between 1 and 365 (366 for leap year) :<br>SELECT TO_DATE( '2024 367', 'YYYY DDD' ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the number of the days value within the range of the year.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE( '2024 365', 'YYYY DDD' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>TO_DATE( '2024 365', 'YYYY DDD' )<br>---------------------------------<br>2024-12-30<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12146 (SQLSTATE: HY000): format code cannot appear in date input format**

<a id="19a6eadec6dc8206"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The format element which was not allowed for to_datetime function was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE( '1999-01-01', 'CC' ) FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12146): format code cannot appear in date input format :<br>SELECT TO_DATE( '1999-01-01', 'CC' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the format element which is allowed for to_datetime function.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE( '2000-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) FROM dual;<br><br>TO_DATE( '2000-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD' )<br>------------------------------------<br>2000-01-01<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br><ul><li>Get the value for the format element by using to_char function.</li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1, TO_CHAR( c1, 'CC' ) FROM t1;<br><br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TO_CHAR( C1, 'CC' )<br>--------------&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;-------------------<br>2000-01-01&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;20<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12147 (SQLSTATE: HY000): BC/B.C. or AD/A.D. required**

<a id="979a9455dc0bf044"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The input string is not same as BC/B.C. or AD/A.D. format element.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE( '2000-01-01 A', 'YYYY-MM-DD AD' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12147): BC/B.C. or AD/A.D. required :<br>SELECT TO_DATE( '2000-01-01 A', 'YYYY-MM-DD AD' ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Describe the input string which is same as BC/B.C. or AD/A.D. format element<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE( '2000-01-01 AD', 'YYYY-MM-DD AD' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>TO_DATE( '2000-01-01 AD', 'YYYY-MM-DD AD' )<br>-------------------------------------------<br>2000-01-01<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12148 (SQLSTATE: HY000): julian date must be between 0 and 5373484**

<a id="856921ae0622d922"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is not a valid date which can be expressed in format element J.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE( ' 5373485 ', 'J' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12148): julian date must be between 0 and 5373484 :<br>SELECT TO_DATE( ' 5373485 ', 'J' ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Specify the valid value that can be expressed in format element J.<br>( BC 4714-11-24 ( 0 ) ~ 9999-12-31 ( 5373484 ) )<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE( ' 5373484 ', 'J' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>TO_DATE( ' 5373484 ', 'J' )<br>---------------------------<br>9999-12-31<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12149 (SQLSTATE: HY000): %s may only be specified once**

<a id="89f6f11288e882be"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The identical hour format code was used twice.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_TIME( '11:22:33', 'HH:MI:HH24' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12149): hour may only be specified once :<br>SELECT TO_TIME( '11:22:33', 'HH:MI:HH24' ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the correct format code as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_TIME( '11:22:33', 'HH:MI:SS' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>TO_TIME( '11:22:33', 'HH:MI:SS' )<br>---------------------------------<br>11:22:33.000000<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12150 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Julian date precludes use of day of year**

<a id="cc2cb7eff551e19f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>J and DDD can not be used together as a format element.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE( '2456653 360', 'J DDD' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12150): Julian date precludes use of day of year :<br>SELECT TO_DATE( '2456653 360', 'J DDD' ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Delete J or DDD from the format element.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE( '2456653', 'J' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>TO_DATE( '2456653', 'J' )<br>-------------------------<br>2013-12-26<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE( '360', 'DDD' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>TO_DATE( '360', 'DDD' )<br>-----------------------<br>2024-12-25<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12151 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Not enough format info buffer**

<a id="89021e647d6b5792"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This is an error code used within the server.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12152 (SQLSTATE: HY000): hour must be between %d and %d**

<a id="910e1fc07bf1ef2b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The time value should be between 0 ~ 23.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TIME '25:10:10.000000' FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12152): hour must be between 0 and 23 :<br>SELECT TIME '25:10:10.000000' FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the value between 0 ~ 23 as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TIME '23:10:10.000000' FROM DUAL;<br><br>TIME '23:10:10.000000'<br>----------------------<br>23:10:10.000000<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12153 (SQLSTATE: HY000): minute must be between 0 and 59**

<a id="1e44fc49cf910676"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The minute value should be between 0 ~ 59.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TIME '10:60:00.000000' FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12153): minute must be between 0 and 59 :<br>SELECT TIME '10:60:00.000000' FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the value between 0 ~ 59 as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TIME '11:00:00.000000' FROM DUAL;<br><br>TIME '11:00:00.000000'<br>----------------------<br>11:00:00.000000<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12154 (SQLSTATE: HY000): second must be between 0 and 59**

<a id="6e0879610e568c00"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The second value should be between 0 ~ 59.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TIME '10:00:60.000000' FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12154): second must be between 0 and 59 :<br>SELECT TIME '10:00:60.000000' FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the value between 0 ~ 59 as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TIME '10:01:00.000000' FROM DUAL;<br><br>TIME '10:01:00.000000'<br>----------------------<br>10:01:00.000000<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12155 (SQLSTATE: HY000): the fractional seconds must be between 0 and 999999**

<a id="fa47e580777a9843"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This is an error code used within the server.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12156 (SQLSTATE: HY000): time zone hour must be between -14 and 14**

<a id="045fcdec5565a6ce"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The time value of the time zone should be between -14 ~ 14.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TIME WITH TIME ZONE '12:23:34.567 +24:00' FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12156): time zone hour must be between -14 and 14 :<br>SELECT TIME WITH TIME ZONE '12:23:34.567 +24:00' FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the value between -14 ~ 14 as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TIME WITH TIME ZONE '12:23:34.567 +09:00' FROM DUAL;<br><br>TIME WITH TIME ZONE '12:23:34.567 +09:00'<br>-----------------------------------------<br>12:23:34.567000 +09:00<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12157 (SQLSTATE: HY000): time zone minute must be between 0 and 59**

<a id="ef25283b1ab27339"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The minute value of the time zone should be between 0 ~ 59.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TIME WITH TIME ZONE '12:23:34.567 +09:99' FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12157): time zone minute must be between 0 and 59 :<br>SELECT TIME WITH TIME ZONE '12:23:34.567 +09:99' FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use the value between 0 ~ 59 as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TIME WITH TIME ZONE '12:23:34.567 +09:00' FROM DUAL;<br><br>TIME WITH TIME ZONE '12:23:34.567 +09:00'<br>-----------------------------------------<br>12:23:34.567000 +09:00<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12158 (SQLSTATE: HY000): seconds in day must be between 0 and 86399**

<a id="18c9aafda1ebc074"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The second value in a day should be between 0 ~ 86399.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_TIME( '86400', 'SSSSS' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12158): seconds in day must be between 0 and 86399 :<br>SELECT TO_TIME( '86400', 'SSSSS' ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the value between 0 ~ 86399 as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_TIME( '3600', 'SSSSS' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>TO_TIME( '3600', 'SSSSS' )<br>--------------------------<br>01:00:00.000000<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12159 (SQLSTATE: HY000): AM/A.M. or PM/P.M. required**

<a id="000ee3ad0ed247d3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is not the input string which is same as AM/A.M. or PM/P.M. format element.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP( '2014-07-10 10:00:00 A.M.', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH12:MI:SS AM' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12159): AM/A.M. or PM/P.M. required :<br>SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP( '2014-07-10 10:00:00 A.M.', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH12:MI:SS AM' ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Describe the input string which is&nbsp;&nbsp;same as AM/A.M. or PM/P.M. format element.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP( '2014-07-10 10:00:00 AM', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH12:MI:SS AM' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>TO_TIMESTAMP( '2014-07-10 10:00:00 AM', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH12:MI:SS AM' )<br>--------------------------------------------------------------------<br>2014-07-10 10:00:00.000000<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12160 (SQLSTATE: HY000): HH24 precludes use of meridian indicator**

<a id="b60e24d3be52fb9e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>HH24 and (AM/PM) can not be used together.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_TIME( '12:59:59.999999 AM', 'HH24:MI:SS.FF6 AM' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12160): HH24 precludes use of meridian indicator :<br>SELECT TO_TIME( '12:59:59.999999 AM', 'HH24:MI:SS.FF6 AM' ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br><br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Do not use (AM/PM) as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_TIME( '12:59:59.999999', 'HH24:MI:SS.FF6' ) FROM DUAL<br><br>TO_TIME( '12:59:59.999999', 'HH24:MI:SS.FF6' )<br>----------------------------------------------<br>12:59:59.999999<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12161 (SQLSTATE: HY000): %s conflicts with use of %s**

<a id="2260a9249af06e13"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The datetime format elements can not be mixed.<br>For example, AM/PM and A.M./P.M. can not be used together.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP( '2000-01-01 11:22:33 A.M. AM', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS A.M. AM' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12161): AM/PM conflicts with use of A.M./P.M. :<br>SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP( '2000-01-01 11:22:33 A.M. AM', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS A.M. AM' ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the valid datetime format as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP( '2000-01-01 11:22:33 A.M.', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS A.M.' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>TO_TIMESTAMP( '2000-01-01 11:22:33 A.M.', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS A.M.' )<br>----------------------------------------------------------------------<br>2000-01-01 11:22:33.000000<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12162 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid XID string**

<a id="0fbb4da489c9aa1e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>xid of the target xa transaction to execute in-doubt commit/rollback is invalid..<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT FORCE '0.';<br><br>ERR-HY000(16259): the XID string is not valid:<br>COMMIT FORCE '0.'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERR-HY000(12162): invalid XID string<br><br>gSQL&gt; ROLLBACK FORCE '0.';<br><br>ERR-HY000(16259): the XID string is not valid:<br>ROLLBACK FORCE '0.'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br><br>ERR-HY000(12162): invalid XID string</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check xa transaction to execute commit/rollback by viewing V$XA_TRANSACTION (<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/9-database-information.md#4118536ea4d51717">V$XA_TRANSACTION</a>).</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12163 (SQLSTATE: HY000): date not valid for month specified**

<a id="7b8d76398f9c3f58"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The date which can not exist in November was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE( '2011-11-31' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12163): date not valid for month specified :<br>SELECT TO_DATE( '2011-11-31' ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br><br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the date which exists in the corresponding month.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE( '2011-11-30' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>TO_DATE( '2011-11-30' )<br>-----------------------<br>2011-11-30<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12164 (SQLSTATE: HY000): signed year precludes use of BC/AD**

<a id="66784ef2325e24db"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>SYYYY and BC/AD can not be used together.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE( '2013-09-24 AD', 'SYYYY-MM-DD AD' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12164): signed year precludes use of BC/AD :<br>SELECT TO_DATE( '2013-09-24 AD', 'SYYYY-MM-DD AD' ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Do not use SYYYY and BC/AD together as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_DATE( '2013-09-24', 'SYYYY-MM-DD' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>TO_DATE( '2013-09-24', 'SYYYY-MM-DD' )<br>--------------------------------------<br>2013-09-24<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12165 (SQLSTATE: HY000): number format value exceeds maximum length (%d)**

<a id="2ead1b5ada6a2ba4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The format string length exceeds the maximum length.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_CHAR( c1, 'FM99999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999' ) FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12165): number format value exceeds maximum length (64) :<br>SELECT TO_CHAR( c1, 'FM99999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999' ) FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Set the format string length within the maximum length.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_CHAR( c1, 'FM999999' ) FROM t1;<br><br>TO_CHAR( C1, 'FM999999' )<br>-------------------------<br>123<br>99999<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12166 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid number format model**

<a id="8f7a88a34a503cdd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The format which can not be converted to a number was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_NUMBER( '12345 ', '99999 ' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12166): invalid number format model :<br>SELECT TO_NUMBER( '12345 ', '99999 ' ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br><br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Remove the white space as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_NUMBER( '12345', '99999' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>TO_NUMBER( '12345', '99999' )<br>-----------------------------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;12345<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12167 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot use %s twice**

<a id="36452a28935d892e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12168 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot use %s and %s together**

<a id="d5d8b34a96b6ff4c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Some number format elements can not be mixed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_CHAR( -12, 'S999MI' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12168): cannot use MI and S PR together :<br>SELECT TO_CHAR( -12, 'S999MI' ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Describe the number format element independently.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_CHAR( -12, 'S999' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>TO_CHAR( -12, 'S999' )<br>----------------------<br>&nbsp;-12<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_CHAR( -12, '999MI' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>TO_CHAR( -12, '999MI' )<br>-----------------------<br>&nbsp;12-<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12169 (SQLSTATE: 22001): string data, right truncation**

<a id="8af8f7ad287059ed"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12170 (SQLSTATE: HY000): argument '%d' is out of range**

<a id="f5b2d9dd0fce46e0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The argument value of INSTR() function is wrong.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT INSTR( 'AB AB AB AB', 'AB', 1, -1 ) FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12170): argument '-1' is out of range :<br>SELECT INSTR( 'AB AB AB AB', 'AB', 1, -1 ) FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The fourth argument of INSTR() function should be an integer 1 or bigger.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT INSTR( 'AB AB AB AB', 'AB', 1, 3 ) FROM t1;<br><br>INSTR( 'AB AB AB AB', 'AB', 1, 3 )<br>----------------------------------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;7<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12171 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid datepart for data type %s**

<a id="eee1088bb9282b7f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>datepart (DAY) which can not be applied to the data type was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT DATEADD( DAY, 1, TIME'11:22:33.123456' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(12171): invalid datepart for data type TIME WITHOUT TIME ZONE :<br>SELECT DATEADD( DAY, 1, TIME'11:22:33.123456' ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use datepart (HOUR) which can be applied to the data type as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT DATEADD( HOUR, 1, TIME'11:22:33.123456' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>DATEADD( HOUR, 1, TIME'11:22:33.123456' )<br>-----------------------------------------<br>12:22:33.123456<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The type which can not be used together was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT 'A' FROM dual<br>UNION ALL<br>SELECT 1 FROM dual<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(12185): CHAR and NUMBER cannot be matched :<br><br>SELECT 'A' FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the type which can be used together as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT 'A' FROM dual<br>UNION ALL<br>SELECT '1' FROM dual<br>;<br><br>'A'<br>---<br>A<br>1<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12186 (SQLSTATE: 0A000): not supported function %s**

<a id="b6b552f61a87dd00"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Number can not be used as an argument of HEX() function.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT HEX( 123 ) FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-0A000(12186): not supported function argument numeric types : Use to_char(num, 'XXXX') instead of hex(num) :<br>SELECT HEX( 123 ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use TO_CHAR( number, 'XXXX' ) function.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TO_CHAR( 123, 'XXXX' ) FROM dual;<br><br>TO_CHAR( 123, 'XXXX' )<br>----------------------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;7B<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12187 (SQLSTATE: 39000): failed to open customer built-in function library (%s)**

<a id="ffcdf737f8c4e2f8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>--# result: failed to open library<br>SELECT MOJ_MATCH_FP( X'111111', X'AABBCCDDEEFF' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-39000(12187): failed to open customer built-in function library ($GOLDILOCKS_HOME/lib/libMojMatchFP.so) :<br>SELECT MOJ_MATCH_FP( X'111111', X'AABBCCDDEEFF' ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>The function can be performed only when a specific library exists.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12188 (SQLSTATE: 42000): window frame offset must not be null**

<a id="8c696e02c9dff3c1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>NULL value can not be used as a window frame offset.<br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT c1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, MIN(c1) OVER ( ORDER BY c1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RANGE NULL PRECEDING ) min_value<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-42000(12188): window frame offset must not be null :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RANGE NULL PRECEDING )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use numbers such as RANGE 2 PRECEDING as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT c1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, MIN(c1) OVER ( ORDER BY c1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RANGE 2 PRECEDING ) min_value<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1;<br><br>C1 MIN_VALUE<br>-----------<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2<br>&nbsp;5&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3<br><br>5 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **12189 (SQLSTATE: 42000): window frame offset must not be negative**

<a id="01bb44ef65e40c68"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>A negative number can not be used as a window frame offset.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT c1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, MIN(c1) OVER ( ORDER BY c1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RANGE -2 PRECEDING ) min_value<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-42000(12189): window frame offset must not be negative :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RANGE -2 PRECEDING ) min_value<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use positive numbers such as RANGE 2 PRECEDING as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT c1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, MIN(c1) OVER ( ORDER BY c1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RANGE 2 PRECEDING ) min_value<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1;<br><br>C1 MIN_VALUE<br>------------<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2<br>&nbsp;5&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3<br><br>5 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The memory allocation limit has been exceeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT REGEXP_COUNT( RPAD( CAST( 'A' AS LONG VARCHAR ), 10000000, 'A' ) || 'B', 'A+B' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-HY000(13011): Unable to extend memory: [MAX: 104857600, TOTAL: 100973408, USED: 93656504, ALLOC: 8388824, REQUESTOR: 81] DESC: private static area :<br>SELECT REGEXP_COUNT( RPAD( CAST( 'A' AS LONG VARCHAR ), 10000000, 'A' ) || 'B', 'A+B' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Modify the query or increase the relevant memory-related property values.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="338fe8c469de19d1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">An invalid (non-existent) property name was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SESSION SET inavalid_property = ON;<br>ERR-HY000(13013): Property(INAVALID_PROPERTY) does not exist :<br>ALTER SESSION SET inavalid_property = ON<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Specify the correct property name.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SESSION SET HINT_ERROR = ON;<br>Session altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **13014 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unable to change property at this startup phase.(%s)**

<a id="7e38f29c57eedeb5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The property cannot be modified during the current startup phase.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM SET CONTROL_FILE_COUNT = 2 SCOPE = BOTH;<br><br>ERR-HY000(13014): Unable to change property at this startup phase.(CONTROL_FILE_COUNT)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check which startup phase allows this property to be modified.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **13015 (SQLSTATE: 0U000): Unable to change read-only property.(%s)**

<a id="049075294bb45589"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Read-only properties cannot be modified.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SESSION SET CHARACTER_SET = 'UTF8';<br><br>ERR-0U000(13015): Unable to change permanent property.(CHARACTER_SET)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Verify whether the property is writable.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **13016 (SQLSTATE: 22000): Invalid property value.(%s)**

<a id="457cec625a338cc5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">An invalid property value was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SESSION SET BLOCK_READ_COUNT = -1;<br><br>ERR-22000(13016): Invalid property value.(BLOCK_READ_COUNT) : (check min/max value)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use a valid property value.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SESSION SET BLOCK_READ_COUNT = -1;<br><br>ERR-22000(13016): Invalid property value.(BLOCK_READ_COUNT) : (check min/max value)</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **13017 (SQLSTATE: 0U000): Specified property cannot be modified.(%s)**

<a id="ec4a41efb4d2a73c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">An incorrect syntax was used to modify the property.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SESSION SET TRACE_LOGIN = OFF;<br><br>ERR-0U000(13017): Specified property cannot be modified using ALTER SESSION.(TRACE_LOGIN)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the correct syntax for modifying the property.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM SET TRACE_LOGIN = OFF;<br>System altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **13018 (SQLSTATE: 22000): Specified property cannot be modified with this SCOPE option.(%s)**

<a id="3e6b7f8b0c03db29"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>An invalid SCOPE parameter was used.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Use a valid SCOPE parameter (MEMORY / SPFILE / BOTH) for the property.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **13019 (SQLSTATE: 22000): Specified property cannot be modified.(%s)**

<a id="1c3c9e680eed3b99"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The ALTER SYSTEM modification attribute for the property was not specified.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM SET BLOCK_READ_COUNT = 20;<br>ERR-22000(13019): Invalid property modify mode.(BLOCK_READ_COUNT)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the ALTER SYSTEM modification attribute for the property.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM SET BLOCK_READ_COUNT = 20 DEFERRED;<br>System altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **13046 (SQLSTATE: HY000): session cannot be killed now**

<a id="63bee8f12df871e2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when attempting to clean up a session belonging to a process that has not yet terminated.<br><br>gSQL&gt; select id, serial from x$session where id = session_id();<br><br>ID SERIAL<br>-- ------<br>&nbsp;4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; alter system kill session 4, 1;<br><br>ERR-HY000(13046): session cannot be killed now : process still alive</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#6d1a0bf8b32c9260">ALTER SYSTEM KILL SESSION</a>&nbsp;command can be executed only on sessions whose processes have already terminated.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **13047 (SQLSTATE: 22003): data is outside the range of the data type to which the number is being converted**

<a id="fac8e39a6657d4f8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The aggregation result exceeded the range of the data type.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 NATIVE_BIGINT );<br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 9223372036854775807 );<br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 9223372036854775807 );<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT SUM(c1) FROM t1;<br>ERR-22003(13047): data is outside the range of the data type to which the number is being converted</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Change the column's data type to one that supports a wider range, such as NUMBER.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 NUMBER );<br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 9223372036854775807 );<br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 9223372036854775807 );<br>gSQL&gt; SELECT SUM(c1) FROM t1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SUM(C1)<br>--------------------<br>18446744073709551614<br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **13048 (SQLSTATE: 22015): one or more fields of data value were truncated during conversion**

<a id="deb6386a31af3921"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The aggregation result exceeded the valid value range.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTERVAL YEAR( 6 ) TO MONTH );<br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( '999999-11' );<br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( '999999-11' );<br>gSQL&gt; SELECT SUM(c1) FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-22015(13048): one or more fields of data value were truncated during conversion</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use data that does not cause the aggregation result to exceed the valid range.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTERVAL YEAR( 6 ) TO MONTH );<br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( '3-11' );<br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( '5-11' );<br>gSQL&gt; SELECT SUM(c1) FROM t1;<br><br>SUM(C1)<br>----------<br>+000009-10<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="543a2598254f34b0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when the value of the NUMA_MAP property is invalid.<br>If startup is performed with the property configured as shown below, this error will occur.<br><br>NUMA = YES<br>NUMA_MAP = '0:d'<br><br>gSQL&gt; \startup<br><br>ERR-42000(13054): invalid numa map (d)<br>ERR-HY000(11074): given string is not number</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Set the NUMA_MAP property to a valid value and then retry the operation.<br>Refer to<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#1839f4a94d18e514">NUMA_MAP</a>&nbsp;for more information about how to configure the property.</td></tr></tbody></table>

It may also occur when file-related DDL operations are performed concurrently in two or more sessions.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Change the file name and then retry the operation.</td></tr></tbody></table>
