(This is an error code used within the server.)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **13063 (SQLSTATE: 42000): output value too large (maximum: %ld %s)**

<a id="e97164b3e1e1ce44"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The JSON result exceeded the maximum size of the output data type. (Default value: VARCHAR(4000))<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 VARCHAR(1500)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, c2 VARCHAR(1500)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, c3 VARCHAR(1500) );<br><br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( RPAD( 'A', 1500, '_' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, RPAD( 'B', 1500, '_' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, RPAD( 'C', 1500, '_' ) );<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT JSON_OBJECT( 'key1' VALUE c1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, 'key2' VALUE c2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, 'key3' VALUE c3 ) AS json_string<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-42000(13063): output value too large (maximum: 4000 OCTETS) :<br>SELECT JSON_OBJECT( 'key1' VALUE c1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use the RETURNING LONG VARCHAR option.<br><br>--# result: {"key1":"A___....____","key2":"B___....____","key3":"C___....____"}<br>gSQL&gt; SELECT JSON_OBJECT( 'key1' VALUE c1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, 'key2' VALUE c2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, 'key3' VALUE c3<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURNING LONG VARCHAR ) AS json_string<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1;<br><br>JSON_STRING<br>----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------<br>{"key1":"A__________________________________________________________________<br>...<br>...<br>Ellipsis<br>...<br>...<br>_____________________________"}<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **13064 (SQLSTATE: 42000): name input to JSON generation function cannot be null**

<a id="7e9249e8669f995c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">A null value exists in the JSON name of a JSON_OBJECT family function.<br><br>CREATE TABLE test ( k_col VARCHAR(20), v_col INTEGER );<br>INSERT INTO test VALUES ( null, 1 );<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT JSON_OBJECT( k_col VALUE v_col ) AS result<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM test;<br><br>ERR-42000(13064): name input to JSON generation function cannot be null :<br>SELECT JSON_OBJECT( k_col VALUE v_col ) AS result<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use an expression for the JSON name that is not null and can be represented as an SQL string.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT JSON_OBJECT( NVL( k_col, 'N/A' ) VALUE v_col ) AS result<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM test;<br><br>RESULT<br>---------<br>{"N/A":1}</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **13065 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate key names '%s' in JSON object**

<a id="e62a0971e2dbc102"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>A JSON object that does not allow duplicate key names contains duplicate key names.<br><br>CREATE TABLE test ( k_col VARCHAR(20), v_col INTEGER );<br>INSERT INTO test VALUES ( 'k1', 1 );<br>INSERT INTO test VALUES ( 'k2', 1 );<br>INSERT INTO test VALUES ( 'k1', 2 );<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT JSON_OBJECTAGG( k_col VALUE v_col WITH UNIQUE KEYS ) AS result<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM test;<br><br>ERR-42000(13065): duplicate key names 'k1' in JSON object</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Either set the JSON key uniqueness constraint option to WITHOUT UNIQUE KEYS or remove the rows with duplicate key names.<br><br>-------------------------------------------------------<br>--# Use WITHOUT UNIQUE KEYS<br>gSQL&gt; SELECT JSON_OBJECTAGG( k_col VALUE v_col WITHOUT UNIQUE KEYS ) AS result<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM test;<br><br>RESULT<br>----------------------<br>{"k1":1,"k2":1,"k1":2}<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>-------------------------------------------------------<br>--# Remove rows with duplicate key names<br>gSQL&gt; DELETE FROM test WHERE k_col = 'k1' AND v_col = 2;<br><br>1 row deleted.<br><br>gSQL&gt;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT JSON_OBJECTAGG( k_col VALUE v_col WITH UNIQUE KEYS ) AS result<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM test;<br><br>RESULT<br>---------------<br>{"k1":1,"k2":1}<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="c761d5f819d51649"></a>
## Storage Management Related Error

> **14000 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Failed to initialize storage manager layer**

<a id="fa30df17fa045d68"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14001 (SQLSTATE: HY000): storage manager layer is not initialized yet**

<a id="5731f60a19cb1f8a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14002 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Tablespace(%d) exceed datafile limit**

<a id="7e632b0a3ecf687e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs if the number of datafiles to add to a tasblespace exceeds the limit.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">The datafile can not be created more than the maximum number (1024) due to GOLDILOCKS constraint.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14003 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Tablespace(%d) is full**

<a id="f6b80d0020a42680"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The system has reached the limit of file descriptors.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Increase the system’s file descriptor limit.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14004 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Tablespace(%d) is already dropped**

<a id="6d8757f24214714b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14005 (SQLSTATE: HY000): System Tablespace exists**

<a id="bdf2310c897be15a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14006 (SQLSTATE: 42000): Table is mutating, trigger/function may not see it**

<a id="e81752c15242addb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if another operation is operated for the same table while the database function is changing the table.<br><br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION FUNC1( A1 INTEGER, A2 VARCHAR(10) )<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;INSERT INTO T1 VALUES( A1, A2 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN A1;<br>END;<br><br>INSERT INTO T1 VALUES( FUNC1( 1, 'ZZZ' ), 'ZZZ' );<br>ERR-42000(14006): Table is mutating, trigger/function may not see it :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;INSERT INTO T1 VALUES( A1, A2 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 5:<br>ERROR at FUNCTION("FUNC1")</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Modify the query not to change the same table simultaneously in a statement.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14007 (SQLSTATE: RD000): deadlock detected**

<a id="0bda384aac45253e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the transaction reaches a deadlock while waiting for the resource.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Modify the transaction to guarantee the lock sequence of the object within the transaction.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14008 (SQLSTATE: 24000): fetch out of sequence**

<a id="1b3bf236f3810aa0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if a cursor is closed during the fetch.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Do not execute the statement which closes the cursor during the fetch.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14009 (SQLSTATE: 2200H): sequence generator limit exceeded**

<a id="89436dd7a2159a5f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the sequence is out of the range.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Modify MINVALUE or MAXVALUE of the sequence by using ALTER SEQUENCE statement, or shift NO CYCLE to CYCLE.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14010 (SQLSTATE: 22023): MAXVALUE cannot be made to be less than the current value**

<a id="ff0b38e1812c4cdd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when trying to modify MAXVALUE to the value smaller than the current sequence value.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Modify MAXVALUE to the value bigger than or equal to the current sequence value.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14011 (SQLSTATE: 22023): MINVALUE cannot be made to exceed the current value**

<a id="e82a04cd2519f373"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when trying to modify MINVALUE to the value bigger than the current sequence value.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Modify MINVALUE to the value smaller than or equal to the current sequence value.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14012 (SQLSTATE: 22023): cannot be made to be less than the current value**

<a id="946178a5830051b7"></a>

> **14014 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Fail to extend datafile(%u) of tablespace(%u) in Transaction(%ld)**

<a id="2a0ac9202ab4d4be"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14015 (SQLSTATE: HY000): there is no extendible datafile in tablespace '%s'**

<a id="c408229094cf9596"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>If the tablespace is full, it searches for the auto extend datafile and extends the datafile. This error occurs if the datafile reaches to the maxsize so that it can not be extended or if the auto extend datafile does not exist.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Add datafile or memory, or activate auto extend option as follows. Auto extend can be used only within the datafile.<br><br>------------------------------------------------<br><br>&nbsp;--# Add datafile<br><br>&nbsp;gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TBS_NAME ADD DATAFILE 'TBS_NAME.dbf' SIZE 10M;<br><br>&nbsp;Tablespace altered.<br><br>------------------------------------------------<br><br>&nbsp;--# Add memory<br><br>&nbsp;gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TEMP_TBS ADD MEMORY 'TEST_TEMP_TBS' SIZE 10M;<br><br>&nbsp;Tablespace altered.<br><br>------------------------------------------------<br><br>&nbsp;--# Activate AUTOEXTEND<br><br>&nbsp;gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE DATAFILE 'TBS_NAME.dbf' AUTOEXTEND ON;<br><br><br>&nbsp;Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14016 (SQLSTATE: 23001): some rows of base table violate uniqueness of index**

<a id="e05666f592917e6f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the key value is not unique when creating a unique index.<br><br>CREATE TABLE T1 (C1 INTEGER, C2 INTEGER);<br><br>INSERT INTO T1 VALUES(1,1);<br><br>INSERT INTO T1 VALUES(1,2);<br><br>INSERT INTO T1 VALUES(1,3);<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IDX_T1_C1 ON T1(C1);<br><br>ERR-23001(14016): some rows of base table violate uniqueness of index</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Set the unique value as a key.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14021 (SQLSTATE: HY000): log group number string is invalid**

<a id="f0fea860cf3270c5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the log group number which is out of the range or does not exist is entered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE GROUP 2147483648 ('abc.log') SIZE 20M;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14021): log group number string is invalid :<br>ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE GROUP 2147483648 ('abc.log') SIZE 20M<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE DROP LOGFILE GROUP 10;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14021): log group number string is invalid :<br>ALTER DATABASE DROP LOGFILE GROUP 10<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Write the query using the valid log group number.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14022 (SQLSTATE: HY000): log group state must be INACTIVE or UNUSED**

<a id="a403c81b1e84926c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the state of the log group to drop is not inactive, nor is unused.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE DROP LOGFILE GROUP 0;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14022): log group(0) state must be INACTIVE or UNUSED</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Only the inactive or unused log group can be dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT GROUP_ID, STATE FROM X$LOG_GROUP;<br><br>GROUP_ID STATE<br>-------- -------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0 CURRENT<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;10 UNUSED<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 UNUSED<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3 UNUSED<br><br>4 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE DROP LOGFILE GROUP 10;<br><br>Database altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14023 (SQLSTATE: HY000): log group %d already exists**

<a id="1deaaf99c58a05fa"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14024 (SQLSTATE: HY000): log member %s already exists**

<a id="55f260c2a987e864"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the log member file to add already exists.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Add the log member whose file name does not exist.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14025 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid dump option string: %s**

<a id="b43869d407c5e704"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The D$ table feature is not provided to customers.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>The D$ table feature is not provided to customers.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14026 (SQLSTATE: HYT00): resource busy or timeout expired**

<a id="3d88c7cfd69462d6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>If DDL simultaneously occurs for the same object, then lock wait occurs. This error occurs if<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#f7c0066758882150">DDL_LOCK_TIMEOUT</a>&nbsp;is exceeded.<br><br>Transaction A :<br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD COLUMN ( new_column NUMBER );<br><br>Transaction B :<br>gSQL&gt; TRUNCATE TABLE t1;<br><br>ERR-HYT00(14026): resource busy or timeout expired</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Extend DDL_LOCK_TIMEOUT then try again, or try again when the object us unlocked.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM SET DDL_LOCK_TIMEOUT = 10;<br><br>System altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14027 (SQLSTATE: HY000): datafile(%d,%d) is already dropped**

<a id="4a3e1c2815a65237"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14028 (SQLSTATE: HY000): file '%s' already exists**

<a id="29d11628d1edc36a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the existing file name is entered when adding a log file.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE MEMBER 'test.log' TO GROUP 10;<br><br>ERR-42000(16130): file already exists :<br>ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE MEMBER 'test.log' TO GROUP 10<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Add the log file with a non-duplicate name.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14029 (SQLSTATE: HY000): sequence is not yet defined**

<a id="9078284ba4732237"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if CURRVAL is used to get the current sequence value without using NEXTVAL(seq_name) at all in the session.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT SEQ.CURRVAL FROM T1;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14029): sequence is not yet defined</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use NEXTVAL(seq_name) at least once, then use CURRVAL.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq;<br><br>Sequence created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT seq.NEXTVAL FROM dual;<br><br>SEQ.NEXTVAL<br>-----------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14030 (SQLSTATE: RD000): maximum index depth(%d) exceeded**

<a id="260f4f395eed84f2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the maximum index depth is exceeded.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>N/A</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14031 (SQLSTATE: HY000): maximum key length(%d) exceeds**

<a id="70dc60136fcd9eca"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the index key size exceeds the maximum size (1200).</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>The index key size should not exceed the maximum size (1200).</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14032 (SQLSTATE: 42000): can't serialize access for this transaction**

<a id="9e2895b189783bf9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if two or more transactions simultaneously try to modify the same data.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Try again after a transaction is completed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14033 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unable to checkpoint in cds mode**

<a id="3b0c55945fb7cd6f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if checkpoint is performed in CDS mode.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>The checkpoint can not be performed in CDS mode.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14034 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unable to recover database in cds mode**

<a id="67a0d5de47876170"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs if the recovery is performed in other mode than TDS mode.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">If it was operated in TDS mode before CDS mode, then the recovery is available only when TDS mode was normally shutdown.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14035 (SQLSTATE: 42000): some rows of base table violate not null constraint**

<a id="e57774ccbf8e4fb8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if null value exists in the column when trying to add the primary key constraint to the table.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Only the column which does not have NULL value can be set as the primary key.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14036 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid ROWID**

<a id="01d2ebb288f818a8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if INVALID ROWID is entered.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Enter the correct ROWID value.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14037 (SQLSTATE: 42000): Database is READ ONLY - deprecated**

<a id="a2c535ff6519de43"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14038 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unable to recover database in READ ONLY mode - deprecated**

<a id="a365c753018b0ade"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14039 (SQLSTATE: HY000): exceed segment MAXSIZE(%ld)**

<a id="2acdb7c5942fd26a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if maxsize is exceeded because the segment space to store the index is insufficient.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER INDEX T1X STORAGE( MAXSIZE 512K );<br><br>Index altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO T1 SELECT * FROM T1;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14039): exceed segment MAXSIZE(524288)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Increase the maxsize of the segment to store the index.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER INDEX T1X STORAGE( MAXSIZE 100M );<br><br>Index altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO T1 SELECT * FROM T1;<br><br>64 rows created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14040 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Target object of dump table is mutating**

<a id="a598a1a112c4ac42"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the object to dump is currently being changed.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Try to dump it again after the data modification of the object is completed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14041 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot access the OFFLINE tablespace '%s'**

<a id="1ea34e58157bd8cb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the tablespace is not accessible because it is offline.<br><br>CREATE TABLE T1 ( I1 INTEGER ) TABLESPACE TEST_TBS;<br><br>ERR-42000(14041): cannot access the OFFLINE tablespace 'TEST_TBS'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Shift the tablespace to online, then try the operation again.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TBS_TB ONLINE;<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14042 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot find the row (%ld)**

<a id="5d7719cb20635c18"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14043 (SQLSTATE: 42000): file is already used in database '%s'**

<a id="b89fdc6d3cd4b463"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the file is already used as the datafile of the tablespace.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE DATA TABLESPACE TEST_TBS1 DATAFILE 'TEST_DATAFILE.dbf' SIZE 10M;<br><br>Tablespace created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE DATA TABLESPACE TEST_TBS2 DATAFILE 'TEST_DATAFILE.dbf' SIZE 10M REUSE;<br><br>ERR-42000(14043): file is already used in database :<br><br>CREATE DATA TABLESPACE TEST_TBS2 DATAFILE 'TEST_DATAFILEE.dbf' SIZE 10M REUSE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the datafile which is not used in the existing tablespace, or specify the new datafile as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE DATA TABLESPACE TEST_TBS2 DATAFILE 'TEST_DATAFILE2.dbf' SIZE 10M REUSE;<br><br>Tablespace created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14044 (SQLSTATE: 42000): datafile not empty**

<a id="8178174fea55c99d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the datafile which was used at least once is dropped.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Only the tablespace datafile which never has been used since it was created can be dropped. Once it was used the datafile can not be dropped even when all data is dropped.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14045 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot drop datafile of OFFLINE tablespace '%s'**

<a id="258d2b6148aac445"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The datafile of the offline tablespace can not be dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TBS_NAME DROP DATAFILE 'DATAFILE_NAME.dbf';<br><br>ERR-42000(16145): cannot drop datafile of OFFLINE tablespace :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE TBS_NAME DROP DATAFILE 'DATAFILE_NAME.dbf'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Shift the tablespace to online, then drop it.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TBS_NAME ONLINE;<br><br>Tablespace altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TBS_NAME DROP DATAFILE 'DATAFILE_NAME.dbf';<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14046 (SQLSTATE: 42000): file does not exist - '%s'**

<a id="ec12153c94a3df75"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the file does not exist.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check if the file exists, or if the path is correct.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14047 (SQLSTATE: 42000): file is READ ONLY - '%s'**

<a id="88b45b8a5669d21c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the file privilege is read only.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Modify the file privilege so that it allows writing.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14048 (SQLSTATE: 42000): file is invalid or old version - '%s'**

<a id="c3aa505d04912eae"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the datafile is invalid or an old version.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Use the valid datafile.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14049 (SQLSTATE: 42000): tablespace is not online - '%s'**

<a id="1ace04439bfa0f7b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if trying to shift the tablespace to offline when the tablespace is already offline.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>N/A</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14050 (SQLSTATE: 42000): tablespace is not offline - '%s'**

<a id="df3177a55b38cbda"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if trying to shift the tablespace to online when the tablespace is already online.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>N/A</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14051 (SQLSTATE: 42000): media recovery required - '%s'**

<a id="fede18bdc4eb549d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the recovery is required when shifting the tablespace to online.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS ONLINE;<br><br>ERR-42000(14051): media recovery required - 'TEST_TBS'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Recover the tablespace.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RECOVER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS;<br><br>Database altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14052 (SQLSTATE: 42000): segment is unusable ( physical id : %ld )**

<a id="0eb6e16fec9e80b8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if trying to query for the unrecoverable segment.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Drop the table where the unusable segment exists, then try again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14053 (SQLSTATE: RD000): insufficient resource for sort**

<a id="a2d4bbfd51af4b1e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14054 (SQLSTATE: HY000): internal error ( %s, %d )**

<a id="0a50ab7d2e299ee6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This is an error code used within the server.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14055 (SQLSTATE: HY000): segment is corrupted ( physical id : %ld )**

<a id="471b40290918077e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the segment is corrupted.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14056 (SQLSTATE: HY000): failed to apply redo log ( lsn : %ld, lpsn : %d, physical id : %ld )**

<a id="4d8837a9595fe7ed"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if redo fails.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14057 (SQLSTATE: HY000): dropping log group makes total log group count less than minimum log group count(%d)**

<a id="35e60698c69a2324"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The minimum number of log groups should exist.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>N/A</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14058 (SQLSTATE: 42000): log member does not exist - '%s'**

<a id="21479f7d74d0525b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the log member does not exists when dropping the log member.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>N/A</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14059 (SQLSTATE: 42000): log member is already used - '%s'**

<a id="c06d63e5709b4f36"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the log member name to change already exists.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>N/A</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14060 (SQLSTATE: HY000): CURRENT logfile is empty - '%s'**

<a id="228adad70300c8d9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if trying to switch the logfile which never has been used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; alter system switch logfile;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14060): CURRENT logfile is empty - ''</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The logfile which never has been used can not be switched.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14061 (SQLSTATE: HY000): next logfile to switch should be INACTIVE or UNUSED - '%s'**

<a id="73ca3e155f646421"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the next logfile is not inactive nor is unused when switching the logfile.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM SWITCH LOGFILE;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14061): next logfile to switch should be INACTIVE or UNUSED</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The active logfile is periodically switched to inactive state by the archive log thread. Perform checkpoint, then try again.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM CHECKPOINT;<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM SWITCH LOGFILE;</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14062 (SQLSTATE: 42000): INITRANS must be less equal than MAXTRANS**

<a id="8bb071ab28f3536d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if INITRANS value is bigger than MAXTRANS value.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER INDEX idx1 INITRANS 32 MAXTRANS 4;<br><br>ERR-42000(16083): INITRANS must be less equal than MAXTRANS :<br><br>ALTER INDEX idx1 INITRANS 32 MAXTRANS 4<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>INITRANS value should be smaller than or equal to MAXTRANS value.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14063 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot be added log member to exceed maximum log member count(%d)**

<a id="43cb5e067d7c320f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The log member can not be added any more because the maximum number of log members to be added is exceeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE MEMBER 'test1.log', 'test2.log', 'test3.log', 'test4.log', 'test5.log', 'test6.log' TO GROUP 10;<br><br>ERR-42000(14063): cannot be added log member to exceed maximum log member count(5)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>N/A</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14064 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the operation is disallowed at %s phase**

<a id="3953783905c95823"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the operation is disallowed at the PHASE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE MEMBER 'test.log' TO GROUP 1;<br><br>ERR-42000(14064): the operation is disallowed at MOUNT phase</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Alter it to the allowed PHASE, then execute the operation again.<br><br>--# Alter NO MOUNT -&gt; MOUNT PHASE.<br>gSQL&gt;alter system mount database;<br><br>--# Alter MOUNT -&gt; OPEN PHASE.<br>gSQL&gt; alter system open database;</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14065 (SQLSTATE: RD000): row size(%d) of the instant table is too large**

<a id="6994f456441a3565"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the total size of columns is too big when using the instant sort table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM T1 ORDER BY A1, A2, ...... , A2998, A2999;<br><br>ERR-RD000(14065): row size(24009) of the instant table is too large</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Increase<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#b88cb19b3df8ec64">INST_TABLE_PAGE_SIZE</a>&nbsp;property value, then try again.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SESSION SET INST_TABLE_PAGE_SIZE = 32K;<br><br>Session altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14066 (SQLSTATE: RD000): key size(%d) of the instant index exceeds the limit(%d)**

<a id="4fe9409a4fa2501a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the key size exceeds the limit when using the instant b-tree index.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT /*+ USE_GROUP_SORT */ A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, A9, A10, A11, A12<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM T1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;GROUP BY A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, A9, A10, A11, A12;<br>ERR-RD000(14066): key size(48033) of the instant index exceeds the limit(16000)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Decrease<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#58a8930e680eb3f9">INSTANT_INDEX_REFERENCE_COLUMN_THRESHOLD</a>&nbsp;property value so that more columns can become reference columns.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SESSION SET INSTANT_INDEX_REFERENCE_COLUMN_THRESHOLD = 64;<br><br>Session altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14067 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot media recover; archivelog mode not enabled**

<a id="7b264f438d5f8687"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14068 (SQLSTATE: HY000): logfile does not exist - '%s'**

<a id="1702ea5fc4cac041"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the logfile does not exist during the recovery.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Execute<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/7-backup-and-recovery-of-goldilocks-database.md#a7a4cbac95de9e6c">incomplete recovery</a>&nbsp;to the part which can be recovered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14069 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot support ARCHIVELOG in cds mode**

<a id="a95e1e4c612dd664"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>ARCHIVELOG is not supported in CDS mode.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14069): cannot support ARCHIVELOG in cds mode</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>N/A</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14070 (SQLSTATE: HY000): control file is not recent; do media recovery with USING BACKUP CONTROLFILE option**

<a id="5d5b6390cf06df1d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14071 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot BACKUP; tablespace(%s) is offline**

<a id="4818349a065e8bce"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the tablespace is offline when the tablespace backup.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS BEGIN BACKUP;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14071): cannot backup; tablespace(TEST_TBS) is offline</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Shift the tablespace state to online, then proceed with backup.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS ONLINE;<br><br>Tablespace altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS BEGIN BACKUP;<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14072 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot BACKUP; tablespace(%s) is temporary**

<a id="c9677716fe1829a8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the tablespace to backup is a temporary tablespace.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>The temporary tablespace can not be backed up.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14073 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot BACKUP; tablespace is dropped**

<a id="0d83f672ddca5754"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the tablespace to backup is a dropped tablespace.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>The dropped tablespace can not be backed up.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14074 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot BACKUP; tablespace(%s) is already in backup**

<a id="9fe6a9569cd4d31b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the tablespace to backup is already in progress.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>The tablespace in progress can not be backed up.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14075 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot execute; tablespace(%s) backup is in progress**

<a id="307fff2209d43fc6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if trying to shift the tablespace state to offline when the tablespace bakup is in progress.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The tablespace state can be shifted to offline after the backup is completed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14076 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot END BACKUP; tablespace(%s) is not in backup**

<a id="4246f7d81896ab7b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if trying to perform the end tablespace backup when the begin tablespace backup has not been performed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE DICTIONARY_TBS END BACKUP;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14076): cannot end backup; tablespace(DICTIONARY_TBS) is not in backup</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Perform the end tablespace backup after the begin tablespace backup is performed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14077 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot END BACKUP; none of the tablespaces are in backup**

<a id="1535c5b806c35e73"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if all tablespaces which tried backup fail.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE END BACKUP;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14077): cannot end backup; none of the tablespaces are in backup</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Try backup again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14078 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot BACKUP; tablespace(%s) is proceeding other operation '%s'**

<a id="8be3a600fbbec896"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the tablespace to backup is executing the following operations.<br><br><ul><li>SHUTDOWN</li><li>CHANGE TRACKING { ENABLE / DISABLE }</li><li>CHECKPOINT</li><li>ONLINE TABLESPACE</li><li>OFFLINE TABLESPACE</li><li>DROP TABLESPACE</li><li>ADD DATAFILE</li><li>DROP DATAFILE</li><li>TABLESPACE BEGIN BACKUP</li></ul></td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Try backup again after the operation is completed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14079 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot BACKUP; database is already in backup**

<a id="4260a11b929c3828"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if trying to backup the database when the database backup is in progress.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Try backup again after the backup is completed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14080 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot END BACKUP; database is not in backup**

<a id="b4453fc074d983ed"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if trying to perform the database end backup when the database begin backup has not been performed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE END BACKUP;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14080): cannot end backup; database is not in backup</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Perform the database end backup after the database begin backup is performed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14081 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot BACKUP; database is going shutdown**

<a id="edd3520687566a3d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14082 (SQLSTATE: HY000): (%s) is not an appropriate logfile to recover**

<a id="7867deaf7cb5391c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the logfile is inappropriate for the recovery when executing the interactive incomplete recovery.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Try again by entering the logfile which is appropriate for the recovery.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14083 (SQLSTATE: HY000): must use RESETLOGS option for database open**

<a id="53cfcd3a7fc3ef06"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if performing startup with NORESETLOGS option after performing the incomplete recovery.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Perform startup with RESETLOGS option after performing the incomplete recovery.<br>Refer to<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/7-backup-and-recovery-of-goldilocks-database.md#78c3b4283d7a03cf">Restarting Database after Incomplete Recovery</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14084 (SQLSTATE: HY000): must use NORESETLOGS option for database open**

<a id="50df4af30ff78207"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the startup is impossible with RESETLOGS option.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The startup is possible with RESETLOGS option only when the incomplete recovery was performed just before the operation.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14085 (SQLSTATE: HY000): (%s) was not a sufficiently old backup**

<a id="b69f951aaac6f472"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14086 (SQLSTATE: HY000): media recovery canceled**

<a id="eb89cc5f02a4acb4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14087 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot SHUTDOWN; backup in progress**

<a id="83f0413d0e8038cb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if trying to shutdown during the backup.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Shutdown can not be performed during the backup.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14088 (SQLSTATE: HY000): control file is corrupted**

<a id="2480c798586592f6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if all control files are corrupted.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Restart after performing the incomplete recovery for the database by using the backup control file.<br>Refer to<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/7-backup-and-recovery-of-goldilocks-database.md#1686a4a1b0748280">Corrupted Control File</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14089 (SQLSTATE: HY000): LEVEL 0 INCREMENTAL BACKUP does not exist**

<a id="a43a6d84d939f57a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if trying to perform the incremental backup of level 1 or above without performing level 0 incremental backup.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS BACKUP INCREMENTAL LEVEL 1;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14089): level 0 incremental backup does not exist</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Backup the datafiles of the entire database at level 0 beforehand when performing the incremental backup.<br>Refer to<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/7-backup-and-recovery-of-goldilocks-database.md#344b476004f41f7d">Incremental Backup</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14090 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot flush logs; disabled log flushing**

<a id="0ad54ab84458f6d3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error is managed internally by the server, so it is not visible to the client.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14091 (SQLSTATE: HY000): (%s) is not valid logfile**

<a id="09d2d3484d770424"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the log file is invalid.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Use the valid log file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14092 (SQLSTATE: HY000): not exist incremental backup**

<a id="be88dabc148e418b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the incremental backup file which is used when restoring does not exist.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>N/A</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14093 (SQLSTATE: HY000): not exist valid incremental backup for tablespace(%s)**

<a id="7f10bd08c06f0c4d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the incremental backup file which is used when restoring is invalid.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>N/A</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14094 (SQLSTATE: HY000): datafile recovery required - datafile(%s) of tablespace(%s) corrupted**

<a id="46e5e319716452b3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if some pages in the data file are corrupted.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Recover the data file by using the backup data file. Refer to<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#91d87d0b29aa6323">ALTER DATABASE RECOVER</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14095 (SQLSTATE: HY000): backup file(%s) is corrupted**

<a id="43bf0eacae8da2e7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the backup file is corrupted.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Recover the previous backup file by referring to<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/7-backup-and-recovery-of-goldilocks-database.md#5e4432c7d1c84fce">Recovery Using Backup</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14096 (SQLSTATE: 23001): fail to build index ( %ld )**

<a id="51de700efaa168b1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The no logging index is rebuilt during the startup, and this warning appears if the rebuilding fails.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the error message which is output together with this error message, and respond to it. ID and the error code of failed indexes are found in the trace log (system.trc).</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14097 (SQLSTATE: HY000): control file is corrupted - '%s'**

<a id="e55cb9dffc390c11"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the control file is corrupted.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Restart after<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/7-backup-and-recovery-of-goldilocks-database.md#a7a4cbac95de9e6c">the Incomplete Recovery</a>&nbsp;of the database by using the backup control file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14098 (SQLSTATE: HY000): maximum record length(%d) exceeds**

<a id="e5c06209166d4c18"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the size of the temporary space to be used while processing the query is bigger than the page size of the instant table.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Set<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#b88cb19b3df8ec64">INST_TABLE_PAGE_SIZE</a>&nbsp;property bigger than the exceeded record size.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14099 (SQLSTATE: HY000): log member state must be UNUSED or INACTIVE**

<a id="bcf1cfa11cea2d86"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14100 (SQLSTATE: HY000): dropping log member makes log member count of group(%d) less than minimum log member count(%d)**

<a id="3b58504181c43bbf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">dpCause</td><td>This error occurs if the number of the remaining log files is smaller than the minimum log files for the log group when dropping log files.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Maintain the number of log files bigger than or equal to the minimum number of&nbsp;&nbsp;log files.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14101 (SQLSTATE: HY000): log group id does not exist - '%d'**

<a id="43c2b5b741223080"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if entering the invalid log group ID when adding/dropping the log file.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Enter the valid log group ID.<br>Valid log group ID is found in<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/9-database-information.md#ac91d40945ae98ef">V$LOGFILE</a>&nbsp;as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT GROUP_ID, GROUP_STATE FROM V$LOGFILE;<br>GROUP_ID GROUP_STATE<br>-------- -----------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0 CURRENT<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 UNUSED<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 UNUSED<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3 UNUSED<br><br>4 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14102 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot execute; recovery is in progress**

<a id="7971e14a3e370fc3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if trying to perform the following operation during the recovery is in progress.<br><br><ul><li>Restore the dropped data file.</li><li>Rename the data file.</li><li>Offline the tablespace.</li><li>Alter AUTOEXTEND property of the data file.</li><li>Add the data file.</li></ul></td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Try again after the recovery is completed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14103 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: media recovery needs a logfile including log (Lsn %ld)**

<a id="450a29fa70feccc0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the log file including the checkpoint log is not found.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Recover it through the archive log corresponding to the suggested LSN. Refer to<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/7-backup-and-recovery-of-goldilocks-database.md#a7a4cbac95de9e6c">Incomplete Recovery</a>&nbsp;and<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/7-backup-and-recovery-of-goldilocks-database.md#c18425c2797ea284">Recovery Examples</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14104 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: suggestion '%s'**

<a id="17f3c89857645594"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the log file which includes the checkpoint log is not found.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Recover it through the suggested archive log file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14105 (SQLSTATE: HY000): control file '%s' is inconsistent with primary**

<a id="8302288ba7635a02"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the information of the main control file is not same as the information of other control files.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Copy the appropriate control files to other control files, then execute startup.<br>Refer to<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/7-backup-and-recovery-of-goldilocks-database.md#bfd0b806833bf9dd">Corrupted Control File</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14106 (SQLSTATE: HY000): tablespace (%s) is taken offline as the result of a write error**

<a id="a67e78df97eecb20"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the abnormal writing fails in the data file of the tablespace. This OFFLINE the tablespace.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Recover the tablespace by referring to<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#91d87d0b29aa6323">ALTER DATABASE RECOVER</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14107 (SQLSTATE: HY000): given LOG_BLOCK_SIZE(%d) is not a suitable value for a size of log block; LOG_BLOCK_SIZE should be one of 512, 1024, 2048 or 4096.**

<a id="a0a2df3ee2f87629"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the property value set in<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#4fb5ce095be99e73">LOG_BLOCK_SIZE</a>&nbsp;property is not suitable.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Set<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#4fb5ce095be99e73">LOG_BLOCK_SIZE</a>&nbsp;property value to one of 512, 1024, 2048, 4096.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14108 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot disable archivelog - exist tablespace needed media recovery.**

<a id="6fdcc54fa305bfe9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if offline tablespace exists when shifting archive mode to NOARCHIVELOG.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Try again after make offline tablespaces ONLINE. Refer to to<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/6-structure-and-storage-structure-of-goldilocks-database.md#843cc7f4d6019de3">Managing Tablespace State</a>&nbsp;and<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#f690c33a6dde5c14">ALTER TABLESPACE name [ONLINE|OFFLINE] to ONLINE</a>&nbsp;tablespaces.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14109 (SQLSTATE: HY000): OFFLINE NORMAL disallowed; cannot be taken offline consistently.**

<a id="d8d38ce47c02bc70"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>OFFLINE NORMAL is not allowed for the tablespace on MOUNT phase after the abnormal termination.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Only OFFLINE IMMEDIATE is allowed. Refer to<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#f690c33a6dde5c14">ALTER TABLESPACE name [ONLINE|OFFLINE]</a>.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs OFFLINE;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14109): OFFLINE NORMAL disallowed; cannot be taken offline consistently.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS OFFLINE IMMEDIATE;<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14110 (SQLSTATE: HY000): OFFLINE IMMEDIATE disallowed; noarchivelog mode**

<a id="5b609ff984417e67"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>OFFLINE IMMEDIATE is not allowed on the noarchivelog mode if the recovery is required to shift the tablespace to online.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Execute offline normal for the tablespace, or execute offline immediate on the archive log mode.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS OFFLINE IMMEDIATE;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14110): OFFLINE IMMEDIATE disallowed; noarchivelog mode<br><br>ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS OFFLINE NORMAL;<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14111 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot create COLUMNAR TABLE; given MIN ROW COUNT is too big to put into one page**

<a id="dd798d349c251139"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14112 (SQLSTATE: HY000): record size is too large for columnar table**

<a id="129160c0b7854981"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14113 (SQLSTATE: HY000): datafile '%s' is corrupted**

<a id="6683b672bdd3d404"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the data file is corrupted.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Recover the data file by referring to<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/7-backup-and-recovery-of-goldilocks-database.md#6bae1c03ebaaf940">Corrupted Data File</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14114 (SQLSTATE: HY000): datafile '%s' is more recent than redo logfile**

<a id="61d4942a9d45346b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the data more recent than the last log used for the recovery exists in the database.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Recover it by using the earlier backup or using the more recent log file. Refer to<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/7-backup-and-recovery-of-goldilocks-database.md#796b862593cbe1a3">More Recent Datafile Than Log</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14115 (SQLSTATE: HY000): transaction undo limit exceeded**

<a id="5faf17ac7b717f75"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the number of undo pages used while processing the transaction is bigger than<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#aa925eab1a72b511">TRANSACTION_MAXIMUM_UNDO_PAGE_COUNT</a>&nbsp;property value.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Try again after adjusting<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#aa925eab1a72b511">TRANSACTION_MAXIMUM_UNDO_PAGE_COUNT</a>&nbsp;property value.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14116 (SQLSTATE: HY000): unable to access incomplete journal log**

<a id="49969b176a8c3582"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>If INDEX REBUILD, REBALANCE are executed on ONLINE mode, then journal logs for DML are created. This error occurs if the operation related to the journal log fails.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The error appears in the clause after<em>caused by</em>&nbsp;is the cause of an incomplete journal log. Try again after resolving this error.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SYNCHRONIZE;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14116): unable to access incomplete journal log :<br>Caused by : ERR-HY000(14125): exceed maximum journal file size</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14117 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot end incomplete recovery; incomplete recovery never been begun**

<a id="443f6156bb8efb92"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if trying<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#b0b43677d8053eca">END INCOMPLETE RECOVERY</a>&nbsp;though the incomplete recovery has not been started.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>N/A</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14118 (SQLSTATE: HY000): property TRANSACTION_TABLE_SIZE value must be equal to or greater than '%d'**

<a id="330ccc003e980916"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#c44799be03ce68e7">TRANSACTION_TABLE_SIZE</a>&nbsp;property is smaller than the number of transactions required for the operation after the recovery.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Set<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#c44799be03ce68e7">TRANSACTION_TABLE_SIZE</a>&nbsp;property bigger than or equal to the value output in the error message.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14119 (SQLSTATE: HY000): property UNDO_RELATION_COUNT value must be equal to or greater than '%ld'**

<a id="69498eb645627640"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the number of new undo relations is smaller then the number of existing undo relations during the recovery.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Set<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#1fec08573d402977">UNDO_RELATION_COUNT</a>&nbsp;property bigger than or equal to the value output in the error message.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14120 (SQLSTATE: HY000): sequence is dropped**

<a id="eb8405583202cdfa"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if sync or DDL is performed while dropping the sequence.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>N/A</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14121 (SQLSTATE: HY000): file '%s' does not match with database - file signature '%s', database signature '%s'**

<a id="3972d5e3b8d2c4e1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if inappropriate file is used when recovering through the backup file.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Try recovery by using the backup file having the signature of the same database. The signature of the backup file is found as follows through<a href="../part-06-utility-manual/46-gdump.md#6f1448c2ab6a0329">gdump</a>.<br><br>$ gdump BACKUP filename -h | grep signature<br><br>Database signature&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 28E278E40CE011EF9BD45323C4EAD45D</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14122 (SQLSTATE: HY000): there is a possibility that a deadlock occurs**

<a id="82424f3699602b18"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14123 (SQLSTATE: 22023): INCREMENTBY sign cannot be changed in the cluster system**

<a id="d07aa1ca6697aeec"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the sign (+/-) of INCREMENT BY option value is switched when performing<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#59da3d9f8e5621cf">ALTER SEQUENCE</a>&nbsp;in cluster environment.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>If the sign should be switched, then create the sequence again after dropping the sequence.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14124 (SQLSTATE: HY000): RESTORE in progress**

<a id="3026b2cc45b2ce72"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if trying to drop the backup file while it is being restored.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Try again after it is completely recovered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14125 (SQLSTATE: HY000): exceed maximum journal file size**

<a id="252ebb5f5a41b386"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the journal file bigger than<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#4253602dfd6b92fe">MAX_JOURNAL_FILE_SIZE</a>&nbsp;property value is required.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Set<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#4253602dfd6b92fe">MAX_JOURNAL_FILE_SIZE</a>&nbsp;property value big enough.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14126 (SQLSTATE: HY000): there must be at least one recoverable member in the group**

<a id="bbdd52c64336fb66"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if all members of the group can become irrecoverable when executing<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#18dcad89aa3a6231">ALTER SYSTEM IRRECOVERABLE CLUSTER MEMBER</a>.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check if one or more recoverable members exist in the group. The state of the member is found through<a href="../part-06-utility-manual/46-gdump.md#6f1448c2ab6a0329">gdump</a>&nbsp;as follows.<br><br>$ gdump CONTROL control_0.ctl&nbsp;&nbsp;-h<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;[CLUSTER MEMBER #0]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;MEMBER NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: G1N1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;MEMBER TYPE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: LOCAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;MEMBER STATUS&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: RECOVERABLE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;GROUP ID&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;GROUP NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: G1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;MEMBER ID&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;MEMBER POSITION : 0<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;[CLUSTER MEMBER #1]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;MEMBER NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: G1N2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;MEMBER TYPE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: REMOTE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;MEMBER STATUS&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: IRRECOVERABLE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;GROUP ID&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;GROUP NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: G1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;MEMBER ID&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;MEMBER POSITION : 1</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14127 (SQLSTATE: HY000): object no longer exists**

<a id="718bdf568269ecdf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if trying to use the dropped global temporary table.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>N/A</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14128 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid remote view scn**

<a id="0ee51c53deb3eeff"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14129 (SQLSTATE: HYT00): transaction allocation time exceeded**

<a id="2f6c656c845a9932"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the transaction is not allocated for the time longer than<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#9dfab130bafa0432">TRANSACTION_ALLOCATION_TIMEOUT</a>&nbsp;property value.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Set<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#9dfab130bafa0432">TRANSACTION_ALLOCATION_TIMEOUT</a>&nbsp;property value bigger, or set<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#c44799be03ce68e7">TRANSACTION_TABLE_SIZE</a>&nbsp;value bigger if<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#c44799be03ce68e7">TRANSACTION_TABLE_SIZE</a>&nbsp;&nbsp;value is too small.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14130 (SQLSTATE: HYT00): undo relation allocation time exceeded**

<a id="30291a50efe14b70"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the undo relation is not allocated for the time longer than<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#2cdc1a019f1093c3">UNDO_RELATION_ALLOCATION_TIMEOUT</a>&nbsp;property value.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Set<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#2cdc1a019f1093c3">UNDO_RELATION_ALLOCATION_TIMEOUT</a>&nbsp;property value bigger, or set<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#1fec08573d402977">UNDO_RELATION_COUNT</a>&nbsp;value bigger if<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#1fec08573d402977">UNDO_RELATION_COUNT</a>&nbsp;value is too small.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14131 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unable to enable change tracking in cds mode**

<a id="82a469528a8f3bee"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the change tracking is changed in CDS mode.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>It can be changed when it is operated in TDS mode.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14132 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unable to enable change tracking in noarchivelog mode**

<a id="33dbe8fc652a3186"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the change tracking is enabled in NOARCHIVELOG mode.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>The change tracking can be enabled only in ARCHIVELOG mode.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14133 (SQLSTATE: HY000): change tracking is already enabled**

<a id="9c7fee4c81bf401e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if trying to enable the change tracking when it is already enabled.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>N/A</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14134 (SQLSTATE: HY000): change tracking is not enabled**

<a id="cc0bc6676805be88"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if trying to disable the change tracking when it is already disabled.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>N/A</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14135 (SQLSTATE: HY000): change tracking file is corrupted - '%s'**

<a id="df296816f2bd8670"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This warning occurs if the corrupted change tracking file is found during the startup process.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>N/A</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14136 (SQLSTATE: HY000): failed to backup incremental because change tracking is being altered**

<a id="65dc987d5f4db4ed"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14137 (SQLSTATE: HY000): failed to disable change tracking because incremental backup is in progress**

<a id="96223a30840be2a1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if trying to disable the change tracking while the incremental backup is in progress.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Try again after the incremental backup is completed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14138 (SQLSTATE: HY000): exceed maximum insertable records ( %lu ) by transaction**

<a id="a7fa09872ea9b8e1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14139 (SQLSTATE: HY000): transaction(%ld) is timed out for waiting to resolve cluster deadlock**

<a id="c799682eec0bde30"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14140 (SQLSTATE: HY000): the value of MAXTRANS to be changed must be equal to or greater than the current MAXTRANS '%d'**

<a id="227a97f0de507d98"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if trying to change the index MAXTRANS value to a smaller value.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#2c9ae90a7a32ddcf">INDEX REBUILD</a>&nbsp;is required to set MAXTRANS value to a smaller value.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14141 (SQLSTATE: HY000): shard '%d' exceeds maximum shard sequence**

<a id="07adc1aab301fe12"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the shard sequence of the index exceeds the limit when altering the shad.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#2c9ae90a7a32ddcf">REBUILD</a>&nbsp;or<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#5333ab1d309d9a83">COALESCE</a>&nbsp;the index related to the shard.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14142 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot recover; database is going shutdown**

<a id="cea4cf8a6a091a47"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if trying to recover while the database is being shutdown.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>It can not be recovered during the shutdown.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14143 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot backup; database is proceeding other operation '%s'**

<a id="7713662caf4e39ac"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if trying to backup while the following operation is in progress.<br><br><ul><li>CHECKPOINT,</li><li>SHUTDOWN,</li><li>CHANGE TRACKING,</li><li>OFFLINE TBS,</li><li>ONLINE TBS,</li><li>DROP TBS,</li><li>ADD DATAFILE,</li><li>DROP DATAFILE</li></ul></td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Retry after the preceding operation is complete.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14144 (SQLSTATE: HY000): file is not in use for global transaction log - '%s'**

<a id="0400fd0b3c71e12d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the global transaction logfile to alter its name is not found.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the name of the global transaction logfile, then try again. The path of the global transaction logfile is found as follows through<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/9-database-information.md#fb6ad7c2392262e2">V$DB_FILE</a>.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT FILE_NAME FROM V$DB_FILE WHERE FILE_TYPE = 'Global Transaction Log File';<br><br>FILE_NAME<br><br>-------------------------------------------------------------------<br><br>/path/to/wal/commit_0.log<br><br>/path/to/wal/commit_1.log<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14145 (SQLSTATE: HY000): file is already in use for global transaction log - '%s'**

<a id="48a1d3904c374241"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the name of the global transaction logfile is already in use.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the name of the global transaction logfile in use, then try again. The path of the global transaction logfile is found as follows through<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/9-database-information.md#fb6ad7c2392262e2">V$DB_FILE</a>.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT FILE_NAME FROM V$DB_FILE WHERE FILE_TYPE = 'Global Transaction Log File';<br><br>FILE_NAME<br><br>-------------------------------------------------------------------<br><br>/path/to/wal/commit_0.log<br><br>/path/to/wal/commit_1.log<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14146 (SQLSTATE: 01000): shard(%d) of index(%ld) used all shard sequences**

<a id="7102e2f75dc8515a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#5333ab1d309d9a83">INDEX COALESCE</a>&nbsp;is used to clean up old shard keys in the index, but no spare shard sequences are secured. In this case, if there are no spare shard sequences available, shard modification operations such as<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#b53aef713ebb21be">MOVE SHARD</a>,<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#3e44ba1eb05987de">MERGE SHARDS</a>, and<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#4188b035bc0f32d0">SPLIT SHARD</a>&nbsp;cannot be performed.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#2c9ae90a7a32ddcf">INDEX REBUILD</a>&nbsp;to clean up invalid shard keys.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14147 (SQLSTATE: HY000): incomplete recovery is possible up to '%s'**

<a id="3d23ada940b3f227"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The log is not sufficient to complete the incomplete recovery.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RECOVER UNTIL TIME '2023-04-11 12:50:00.000000';<br>ERR-HY000(14147): incomplete recovery is possible up to - 'TIME : 2023-04-11 12:46:47.663201'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Restore the log files (archive log, redo log) required to complete the recovery then execute the recovery again, or execute the recovery again only to the allowed point.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RECOVER UNTIL TIME '2023-04-11 12:46:47.663201';</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14148 (SQLSTATE: HY000): exceed the maximum log size allowed to one statement**

<a id="af2de6ec37da91bc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The number of logs recorded when inserting, updating, or deleting a record exceeds the maximum value that can be handled internally. It occurs if the sum of the number of columns and the number of unique indexes exceed 15 million when recording the supplemental log for the replication (cyclone).</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Reduce the sum of the number of the columns and the number of unique indexes in the target table which records the supplemental log to 15 million or less.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14149 (SQLSTATE: HY000): file name is too long ( < %d )**

<a id="a080e21390421832"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The name of the incremental backup file exceeds 128 characters.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Reduce the name of the incremental backup file to 128 characters or less.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14150 (SQLSTATE: 01000): incremental backup succeeded, but automatic backup of control files failed**

<a id="9a1b2127cb0a8bf1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">It is a warning message which appears when the incremental backup succeeds but the automatic backup of the control file fails.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check whether the control file to be backed up exists.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14151 (SQLSTATE: 01000): incremental backup succeeded, but automatic removal of the obsolete backup list failed**

<a id="3a06108bf1633695"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">It is a warning message which appears when the incremental backup succeeds but the automatic deletion of the backup list fails.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check whether the control file exists.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14152 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot create tablespace because all tablespace identifiers are exhausted (maximum: %d)**

<a id="67d9eb0352a7ce39"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The maximum representable range of tablespace IDs (65534) has been reached, so new tablespaces cannot be created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>N/A</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14153 (SQLSTATE: HY000): given GLOBAL_TRANSACTION_LOG_BLOCK_SIZE(%ld) is not a suitable value for a size of log block; GLOBAL_TRANSACTION_LOG_BLOCK_SIZE should be one of 512, 1024, 2048, or 4096.**

<a id="0399aa63312da7ea"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">It is a warning message which appears when<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#66a67ed16a51a315">GLOBAL_TRANSACTION_LOG_BLOCK_SIZE</a>&nbsp;&nbsp;value is not set as one of 512, 1024, 2048, 4096.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Select one of 512, 1024, 2048, 4096 as<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#66a67ed16a51a315">GLOBAL_TRANSACTION_LOG_BLOCK_SIZE</a>&nbsp;&nbsp;value.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14154 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot add datafile; tablespace(%s) is offline**

<a id="78fd95a3ca993d95"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">It is a warning message which appears when adding the datafile to the offline tablespace.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Add the datafile after shifting the offline tablespace to online.<br>Refer to<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#f690c33a6dde5c14">ALTER TABLESPACE name [ONLINE|OFFLINE]</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14155 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot add datafile; tablespace is dropped**

<a id="d5a0c8d6550e313a"></a>
