<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">It is a warning message which appears when adding the datafile to the dropped tablespace.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>N/A</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14156 (SQLSTATE: HY000): unable to create database in cds mode**

<a id="72276c249c2fc3b2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Databases cannot be created in CDS mode.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Databases must be created in TDS mode.<br>To switch to TDS mode, set the DATA_STORE_MODE property to 2.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14157 (SQLSTATE: HY000): transaction '%ld' exceeds the maximum TCN (transaction change number)**

<a id="718f525f6e1733ec"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error message occurs when the maximum number of statements (4,294,967,294) that can be created within a transaction is exceeded.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Divide the statements into multiple transactions and process them accordingly.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14158 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot read table after modification in parallel**

<a id="b07c0fdf1ef0c66c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error message occurs when performing a full scan on a table on which an append insert was executed using the PARALLEL option in the session.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE T1 ( I1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND PARALLEL */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM T1;<br><br>ERR-42000(14158): cannot read table after modification in parallel</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Perform the full scan after completing the transaction that executed the append insert.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14159 (SQLSTATE: 40000): cannot perform index scan due to ongoing inserts with the deferred index maintenance option**

<a id="756d428bc2fd7798"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error message occurs when attempting an index scan on a table on which an append insert was executed using the deferred index maintenance option in the session.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE T1 ( I1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE INDEX T1X ON T1 ( I1 );<br><br>Index created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND DEFERRED_INDEX_MAINTENANCE */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM T1 WHERE I1 &gt; 0;<br><br>ERR-42000(14159): cannot perform index scan due to ongoing inserts with the deferred index maintenance option</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a table scan hint, or perform the index scan after completing the transaction that executed the append insert.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT /*+ FULL(T1) */ * FROM T1 WHERE I1 &gt; 0;<br><br>I1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14160 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the sequence operation was canceled because the driver member is inactive**

<a id="7e50f57fb59642f6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error is internally controlled in the server.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14161 (SQLSTATE: 42000): incomplete or corrupted database creation detected**

<a id="e1d105d688cdaa95"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This is an error that occurs when the server is restarted with an incomplete or corrupted database.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>In this case, create a new database and try again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14162 (SQLSTATE: 42000): visible conflict**

<a id="f4b49e5733ad0d53"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This is an error code used within the server.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14163 (SQLSTATE: HY000): needs more recovery to be consistent - %s**

<a id="04e0db59abbd35a5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when performing incomplete recovery using backup data files and the latest control file, and there are tablespaces whose consistency between the database and the control file is compromised.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>To recover tablespaces with compromised consistency, perform incomplete recovery again using a control file backed up prior to the recovery point.<br>If the tablespace is to be discarded, perform incomplete recovery again using a point after the tablespace was deleted.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14164 (SQLSTATE: HY000): RECOVER succeeded, but OPEN RESETLOGS will fail**

<a id="db6370e7ed0e2950"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when incomplete recovery has been completed, but the database cannot be opened using the RESETLOGS option.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Either re-perform the incomplete recovery at a more recent point, or perform recovery using a control file backed up prior to the incomplete recovery point.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14165 (SQLSTATE: HY000): the allocated space (%ld) has already exceeded MAXSIZE**

<a id="92f7a44005b028d3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when MAXSIZE is specified to a value smaller than the current allocation.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Specify a MAXSIZE value greater than the current allocation.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14166 (SQLSTATE: HY000): storage option INITIAL must be less than MAXSIZE**

<a id="75915c9155231528"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when the INITIAL size exceeds MAXSIZE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1( c1 INTEGER ) STORAGE( INITIAL 2M MAXSIZE 1M&nbsp;&nbsp;);<br><br>ERR-HY000(14166): storage option INITIAL must be less than MAXSIZE :<br>CREATE TABLE t1( c1 INTEGER ) STORAGE( INITIAL 2M MAXSIZE 1M&nbsp;&nbsp;)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Either decrease the INITIAL value or increase MAXSIZE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1( c1 INTEGER ) STORAGE( INITIAL 1M MAXSIZE 2M&nbsp;&nbsp;);<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14167 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid anchor transaction (%ld)**

<a id="4aff5fb0462ca596"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This is an error code used within the server.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14168 (SQLSTATE: 40000): transaction rollback: asynchronous I/O failure**

<a id="980de1aa3d27db53"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>An asynchronous disk I/O request failed while executing the<em>append insert</em>&nbsp;with the STATEMENT_NOFORCE option.<br>The transaction is forcibly rolled back.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Resolve the cause indicated in the error message, and then retry the operation.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14169 (SQLSTATE: HY000): '%s' is not current copy - a recovery requires logs up to at least lsn '%ld' to complete, but it contains only logs up to lsn '%ld'**

<a id="7a498ce5d2aa2626"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs because the log file is not up to date and the recovery cannot be completed. It occurs when recovery is attempted using a log file that is older than the control file.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14169): '/test/wal/redo_1_0.log' is not current copy - a recovery requires logs up to at least lsn '3997290' to complete, but it contains only logs up to lsn '3997283'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Retry the recovery using a log file that contains the minimum LSN required for recovery indicated in the error message.<br>If the log file containing the required logs is corrupted or unavailable, perform<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/7-backup-and-recovery-of-goldilocks-database.md#a7a4cbac95de9e6c">incomplete recovery</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14170 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Logical corruption detected -recovery failed for nologged pages due to missing redo logs**

<a id="a196c9ba7eee0996"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when attempting to recover nologged pages during tablespace or datafile recovery.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RECOVER TABLESPACE mem_test_tbs;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14056): failed to apply redo log ( lsn : 247091, lpsn : 0, physical id : 35944581300225 )<br>ERR-HY000(14170): logical corruption detected - Recovery failed for nologged pages due to missing redo log</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Perform the recovery again using a backup taken after the execution of nologging DML or DDL operations.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14171 (SQLSTATE: HY000): %d segments have become unusable**

<a id="52b8a0d635716098"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This warning message occurs when segments become unusable after executing the following statements:<br><ul><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#3a13c91fdabdaa04">ALTER SYSTEM { OPEN | OPEN LOCAL } DATABASE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#91d87d0b29aa6323">ALTER DATABASE RECOVER</a></li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14171): 2 segments have become unusable<br>System altered.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The usability of segments can be checked using the following syntax:<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT name, physical_id FROM v$relation WHERE USABLE = false;<br><br>NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PHYSICAL_ID<br>---- --------------<br>T1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;35944581300233<br>T2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;35948876267529<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14172 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Cannot execute; startup is in progress**

<a id="c89cfb96417a2b7b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>A shutdown, startup, or database recovery command is executed from another session while the startup process is in progress.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14172): cannot execute; startup is in progress</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Retry the operation after the startup process has completed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14173 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Cannot execute; shutdown is in progress**

<a id="f03ed511b1e8c3ff"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>a shutdown, startup, or database recovery command is executed from another session while the shutdown process is in progress.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14173): cannot execute; shutdown is in progress</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Retry the operation after the shutdown process has completed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14174 (SQLSTATE: HY000): failed to log Page Image Log**

<a id="9dab0abf0355852f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>During the checkpoint process, when the IO slave writes modified pages to the datafile, a PIL (Page Image Log) is recorded in the log if a full backup is in progress. This error occurs when there is insufficient space in the log file.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM CHECKPOINT;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14174): failed to log Page Image Log</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Execute the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#a9f4f713f7a7547c">ALTER DATABASE END BACKUP</a>&nbsp;statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE END BACKUP;<br><br>Database altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14175 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot execute; database backup is in progress**

<a id="3aaa62c29a21a000"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when attempting to create a tablespace or change a tablespace status to online while a full backup is in progress on the database.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Terminate the full backup and try again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14176 (SQLSTATE: HY000): the change tracking file '%s' is inconsistent**

<a id="7b46769872c09ad3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>An error occurs during startup in the following cases:<br><ul><li>The database signature differs from the signature stored in the change tracking file.</li><li>The database's last checkpoint LSN differs from the checkpoint LSN stored in the change tracking file.</li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; alter system open database;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14176): the change tracking file '/db/gl_change_tracking_file.ctf' is inconsistent : the change tracking file signature(8A802748744111F1B7547DCB04412231) does not match the database signature(373BB782744611F19F71CF68EBCB0533)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>To use a backed-up change tracking file, restart the database using a change tracking file whose database signature matches the current database and whose checkpoint LSN matches the database's last checkpoint LSN.<br><br>If no valid change tracking file is available, disable change tracking as shown below, and then enable it again.<br><br>gSQL&gt; alter database disable change tracking;<br><br>Database altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; alter database enable change tracking;<br><br>Database altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; alter system open database;<br><br>System altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14177 (SQLSTATE: HY000): of the total '%d' unusable segments, '%d' segments have become usable**

<a id="de24316bac607176"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This warning message occurs when some of the segments that were in the UNUSABLE state are changed to the USABLE state during the database open or recovery process.<br>The statement is executed successfully, and the message displays the total number of UNUSABLE segments and the number of segments that have been changed to the USABLE state.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14177): of the total '2' unusable segments, '2' segments have become usable<br>System altered.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>If all UNUSABLE segments have been changed to the usable state, no additional action is required.<br>If the number of segments changed to the usable state is less than the total number of UNUSABLE segments, check the remaining UNUSABLE segments and then execute the recovery, synchronize, or DROP UNUSABLE SEGMENTS statement.<br>To check the tables that contain UNUSABLE segments, check V$RELATION as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT NAME, USABLE FROM V$RELATION WHERE USABLE = FALSE;<br><br>NAME USABLE<br>---- ------<br>T1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14178 (SQLSTATE: 42000): memory '%s' does not exist in tablespace '%s'**

<a id="ed790f056c1c078d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs because the memory to be renamed does not exist in the specified temporary tablespace. If multiple sessions simultaneously rename memory in the same temporary tablespace, a later rename operation may fail to find the target memory because it has already been renamed by an earlier rename operation.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TEMPORARY TABLESPACE temp_tbs MEMORY 'temp_memory1' SIZE 20M;<br><br>Tablespace created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE temp_tbs RENAME MEMORY 'temp_memory1' TO 'temp_memory2';<br><br>ERR-42000(14178): memory 'temp_memory1' does not exist in tablespace 'TEMP_TBS'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use V$DATAFILE to verify that the target memory to be renamed exists in the temporary tablespace, and then try the operation again.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TBS_NAME, DATAFILE_NAME FROM V$DATAFILE WHERE TBS_NAME = 'TEMP_TBS';<br><br>TBS_NAME DATAFILE_NAME<br>-------- -------------<br>TEMP_TBS temp_memory<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE temp_tbs RENAME MEMORY 'temp_memory' TO 'temp_memory2';<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **14179 (SQLSTATE: 42000): datafile '%s' does not exist in tablespace '%s'**

<a id="eb37bf614c73f08b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs because the datafile to be renamed does not exist in the specified tablespace.<br>If multiple sessions simultaneously rename datafiles in the same data tablespace, a later rename operation may fail to find the target datafile because it has already been renamed by an earlier rename operation.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLESPACE test_tbs DATAFILE 'test1.dbf' SIZE 20M;<br><br>Tablespace created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs RENAME DATAFILE 'test1.dbf' TO 'test2.dbf';<br><br>ERR-42000(14179): datafile 'test1.dbf' does not exist in tablespace 'TEST_TBS'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use V$DATAFILE to verify that the target datafile to be renamed exists in the tablespace, and then try the operation again.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TBS_NAME, DATAFILE_NAME FROM V$DATAFILE WHERE TBS_NAME = 'TEST_TBS';<br><br>TBS_NAME DATAFILE_NAME<br>-------- -------------<br>TEST_TBS test.dbf<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs RENAME DATAFILE 'test.dbf' TO 'test2.dbf';<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="022e56e94c67fcb9"></a>
## Dictionary Cash Related Error

> **15000 (SQLSTATE: HY000): failed to initialize execution library layer**

<a id="0c1977f5bd6661ca"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15001 (SQLSTATE: HY000): execution library layer is not initialized yet**

<a id="6c7d0352e890298f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15002 (SQLSTATE: 42000): %s: schema does not exist**

<a id="cfd0e56977318c2b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The schema name which does not exist was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT ANAL_TABLE_PAGE_STRUCT( 'INVALID', 'T1' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-42000(15002): "INVALID": schema does not exist :<br>SELECT ANAL_TABLE_PAGE_STRUCT( 'INVALID', 'T1' ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use a valid schema name.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT ANAL_TABLE_PAGE_STRUCT( 'PUBLIC', 'T1' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ANAL_TABLE_PAGE_STRUCT( 'PUBLIC', 'T1' )<br>----------------------------------------<br>1:0<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15003 (SQLSTATE: 42000): %s: table or view does not exist**

<a id="c9290944bc50df1d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The table name which does not exist was used.<br><br>SELECT ANAL_TABLE_PAGE_STRUCT( 'PUBLIC', 'INVALID' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-42000(15003): "INVALID": table or view does not exist :<br>SELECT ANAL_TABLE_PAGE_STRUCT( 'PUBLIC', 'INVALID' ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use a valid table name.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT ANAL_TABLE_PAGE_STRUCT( 'PUBLIC', 'T1' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ANAL_TABLE_PAGE_STRUCT( 'PUBLIC', 'T1' )<br>----------------------------------------<br>1:0<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15004 (SQLSTATE: 42000): %s: index does not exist**

<a id="a298d3e825798365"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The index name which does not exist was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT ANAL_INDEX_PAGE_STRUCT( 'PUBLIC', 'INVALID' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-42000(15004): "INVALID": index does not exist :<br>SELECT ANAL_INDEX_PAGE_STRUCT( 'PUBLIC', 'INVALID' ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use a valid index name.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT ANAL_INDEX_PAGE_STRUCT( 'PUBLIC', 'T1_C1_IDX' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ANAL_INDEX_PAGE_STRUCT( 'PUBLIC', 'T1_C1_IDX' )<br>-----------------------------------------------<br>1:1:1:100<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15005 (SQLSTATE: 42000): %s: column does not exist**

<a id="5b206c9e24bcf81e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15006 (SQLSTATE: 23000): %s: dictionary integrity constraint violation by concurrent DDL execution**

<a id="f67aa8875396e809"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">It violated the dictionary integrity by simultaneously creating the identical name objects<br><br>session 1&gt; CREATE TABLESPACE TEST_TBS DATAFILE 'TEST_TBS.dbf' SIZE 10M;<br><br>Tablespace created.<br><br>session 2&gt; CREATE TABLESPACE TEST_TBS DATAFILE 'TEST_TBS.dbf' SIZE 10M;<br><br>ERR-23000(15006): "TABLESPACES_UNIQUE_TABLESPACE_NAME": dictionary integrity constraint violation by concurrent DDL execution</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Do not create the identical objects in different sessions.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15007 (SQLSTATE: HY090): not enough stack space to add entries**

<a id="2b8103643c6cd410"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15008 (SQLSTATE: HY000): table related objects are modified while validation**

<a id="df65e367732d3f8d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15009 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid argument**

<a id="029426506df2ab1c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The argument which is not available in the function was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE t1( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT ANAL_TABLE_PAGE_STRUCT( 'PUBLIC', 'T1' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-HY000(15009): Invalid argument :<br>SELECT ANAL_TABLE_PAGE_STRUCT( 'PUBLIC', 'T1' ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">The function allows only a base table as an input argument.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE T1 ( C1 VARCHAR(30) );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>SELECT ANAL_TABLE_PAGE_STRUCT( 'PUBLIC', 'T1' ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ANAL_TABLE_PAGE_STRUCT( 'PUBLIC', 'T1' )<br>----------------------------------------<br>1:0<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15010 (SQLSTATE: 42000): object modified by concurrent DDL execution**

<a id="9804038ef7867afa"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The object was modified because of the concurrent DDL execution.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Do not execute DDL simultaneously for the same object.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15011 (SQLSTATE: HYC00): not implemented feature, in a function %s**

<a id="eecbc95809ad3d50"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15012 (SQLSTATE: 42000): user dropped by other session**

<a id="572e65940f13594a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The user object currently connected was dropped in another session.<br><br>% gsql u1 u1<br><br>Connected to GOLDILOCKS Database.<br><br>gSQL&gt; select * from dual;<br><br>DUMMY<br>-----<br>X<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; select * from dual;<br><br>ERR-42000(15012): user dropped by other session</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Connect again with a valid user.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15013 (SQLSTATE: 42000): user default schema dropped**

<a id="45def9f56e988963"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The schema which was set in a session with SET SCHEMA was dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; create schema s1;<br><br>Schema created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; set schema s1;<br><br>Session set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; drop schema s1;<br><br>Schema dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; select * from dual;<br><br>ERR-42000(15013): user default schema dropped</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Connect again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15014 (SQLSTATE: 42000): user default data tablespace dropped**

<a id="2bd220c8a969883f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15015 (SQLSTATE: 42000): user default temporary tablespace dropped**

<a id="4b1696c294840043"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15016 (SQLSTATE: 0Y002): limit(%d) on the number of named cursor exceeded**

<a id="9bdfd977fcb2617f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The cursor declaration in a session exceeds the number set in MAXIMUM_NAMED_CURSOR_COUNT.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM SET MAXIMUM_NAMED_CURSOR_COUNT = 3 DEFERRED;<br><br>System altered.<br><br>% gsql test test<br><br>Connected to GOLDILOCKS Database.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM t1;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur2 CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM t1;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur3 CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM t1;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur4 CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-0Y002(15016): limit(3) on the number of named cursor exceeded</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Modify the value of MAXIMUM_NAMED_CURSOR_COUNT property.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15017 (SQLSTATE: 42000): DDL not allowed for supplemental log table**

<a id="d6849e9938511934"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">DDL is not executable for the table where the supplemental log is set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD SUPPLEMENTAL LOG DATA ( PRIMARY KEY ) COLUMNS;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SESSION SET DISABLE_DDL_CDC_GIVEUP = ON;<br><br>Session altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP TABLE t1;<br><br>ERR-42000(15017): DDL not allowed for supplemental log table</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Set the DISABLE_DDL_CDC_GIVEUP property value OFF.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15018 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cluster member '%s' has already joined in an other cluster system**

<a id="856b463900e91916"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The cluster member belonging to a specific cluster system can not join another cluster system.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Reset the cluster member with ALTER DATABASE RESET LOCAL CLUSTER MEMBER statement, and then add it to another cluster system.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15019 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the %s of cluster member '%s' is not compatible with the cluster system**

<a id="2a34c925bfd733de"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The cluster member dropped from a cluster system can not join that cluster system again.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16363): the cluster member 'G4N1' failed to join the cluster system<br>ERR-42000(15019): MEMBER(G1N1): the CLUSTER REMOTE MEMBER NAME of cluster member 'G4N1' is not compatible with the cluster system</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Reset the cluster member with ALTER DATABASE RESET LOCAL CLUSTER MEMBER statement, and then add it to the cluster system.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15020 (SQLSTATE: 42000): tablespace '%s' of the cluster system does not exist at cluster member '%s'**

<a id="be5c04d1c6b01b62"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The tablespace the same as the cluster system was not created in the cluster member to add.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE CLUSTER GROUP g4 CLUSTER MEMBER g4n1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 14150;<br><br>ERR-42000(15020): MEMBER(G4N1): tablespace 'TEST_TBS' of the cluster system does not exist at cluster member 'G4N1'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Create the tablespace the same as the cluster system in the cluster member to add.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15021 (SQLSTATE: 42000): tablespace '%s' of the cluster member '%s' does not exist at the cluster system**

<a id="abd9ac1971ef5500"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The cluster member to add has a tablespace which does not exist in the cluster system.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE CLUSTER GROUP g4 CLUSTER MEMBER g4n1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 14150;<br><br>ERR-42000(15021): MEMBER(G4N1): tablespace 'TEMP_TBS' of the cluster member 'G4N1' does not exist at the cluster system</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Drop the tablespace which does not exist in the cluster system from the cluster member to add.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15022 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the %s of the tablespace '%s' at cluster member '%s' is not compatible with the cluster system**

<a id="c159cc56bcbe7f2c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The tablespace whose name is the same as the tablespace in the cluster system but whose type is different exists in the cluster member to add.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE CLUSTER GROUP g4 CLUSTER MEMBER g4n1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 14150;<br><br>ERR-42000(15022): MEMBER(G4N1): the USAGE(data/temporary) TYPE of the tablespace 'TEST_TBS' at cluster member 'G4N1' is not compatible with the cluster system</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Drop the existing tablespace from the cluster member to add, and then create the tablespace whose type is the same as the tablespace in the cluster system.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15023 (SQLSTATE: HY000): limit(%d) on the number of named instant table exceeded**

<a id="58d8d90d4c9206dc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15024 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the cluster member '%s' does not join in a cluster system**

<a id="39bb6cc5ade6b347"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">It tried to join the new cluster member to a cluster system.<br><br>ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16363): the cluster member 'G1N2' failed to join the cluster system<br>ERR-42000(15024): MEMBER(G2N2): the cluster member 'G2N2' does not join in a cluster system</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">A new cluster member must be added to the cluster system instead of joining.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15025 (SQLSTATE: 42000): startup phase of new cluster member should be OPEN**

<a id="8b762ea1344a32a8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">A new cluster member can not be added to the cluster system because its startup phase is not OPEN.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Modify the startup phase of a new cluster member to OPEN, and then add the cluster member.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15026 (SQLSTATE: HY000): internal error, in a function %s**

<a id="b99c3d3ec2768195"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15027 (SQLSTATE: 42000): attempt to create, alter or drop an index on temporary table already in use**

<a id="5add7d137e016f9f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">DDL was executed while using the global temporary table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE TEMP_T1( I1 INTEGER, I2 VARCHAR(10) );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO TEMP_T1 VALUES( 1, 'aaa' );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP TABLE TEMP_T1;<br><br>ERR-42000(15027): attempt to create, alter or drop an index on temporary table already in use</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">DDL is executable only when the global temporary table is not in use.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP TABLE TEMP_T1;<br><br>ERR-42000(15027): attempt to create, alter or drop an index on temporary table already in use<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP TABLE TEMP_T1;<br><br>Table dropped.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15028 (SQLSTATE: 42000): user default index tablespace dropped**

<a id="04005e3b45bfabe6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15029 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): limit(%d) on the number of package instance exceeded**

<a id="a82da1a0740355d1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The number of package instances created in a session exceeds the maximum number.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Modify the value of MAXIMUM_PACKAGE_INSTANCE_COUNT property.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15030 (SQLSTATE: 42000): session default role dropped**

<a id="b86df6ef11e5fc11"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The role which was set in a session with SET ROLE was dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; create role role1;<br><br>Role created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; set role role1;<br><br>Session set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; drop role role1;<br><br>Role dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; select * from dual;<br><br>ERR-42000(15030): session default role dropped</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Connect again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15031 (SQLSTATE: 39000): limit(%d) on the number of loaded library exceeded**

<a id="718bcb4d9d6c146e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The number of user libraries loaded by the process exceeds the maximum number.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Modify the value of MAXIMUM_LOADED_LIBRARY_COUNT property.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15032 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unmatched bracket in regular expression**

<a id="311ca3b55dfd6c43"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The expression for regular expression [ ] is incorrect.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_COUNT( 'abc123', '[abc' ) FROM dual;<br>ERR-42000(15032): unmatched bracket in regular expression :<br>SELECT REGEXP_COUNT( 'abc123', '[abc' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">[ ] operator should be completed by describing ] after '[', character list.<br>Refer to<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/11-sql-elements.md#7abbfdba9d28e093">Regular Expression Operators</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15033 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unmatched parentheses in regular expression**

<a id="a276a1c6a8730224"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The expression for regular expression ( ) is incorrect.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_COUNT( 'abc123', '(abc' ) FROM dual;<br>ERR-42000(15033): unmatched parentheses in regular expression :<br>SELECT REGEXP_COUNT( 'abc123', '(abc' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">The pairs of parentheses must match.<br>Refer to<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/11-sql-elements.md#7abbfdba9d28e093">Regular Expression Operators</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15034 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid interval value in regular expression**

<a id="bd1952d210a2520a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The range specification of the number of repeating the regular expression is incorrect.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'aaaabc', 'a{5,1}' ) FROM dual;<br>ERR-42000(15034): invalid interval value in regular expression :<br>SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'aaaabc', 'a{5,1}' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Specify the range of repetition in a form of {min, max}. e.g. a{1,5}</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15035 (SQLSTATE: 42000): maximum repetition count in regular expression exceeded**

<a id="22a0a76a9dec7a96"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">It exceeds the maximum number of repeating regular expressions.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'x', 'a{1,2147483648}' ) FROM dual;<br>ERR-42000(15035): maximum repetition count in regular expression exceeded :<br>SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'x', 'a{1,2147483648}' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">The maximum number of repetition can be specified up to 2147483647. e.g. a{1,2147483647}</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15036 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid repetition operand in regular expression**

<a id="a066151a4e852533"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The expression of the repetition operator is incorrect.<br>The repetition operator can not be solely described. e.g. '?'<br>The repeating expression can not be consecutively described. e.g. 'a+{1,3}<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'a', 'a+{1,3}' ) from dual;<br>ERR-42000(15036): invalid repetition operand in regular expression :<br>SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'a', 'a+{1,3}' ) from dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Describe the expression before describing the repeating operator.<br>e.g. 'a?', '(a+){1,3}'</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15037 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid character class in regular expression**

<a id="65fb643535c58b88"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The character class which was not defined in the regular expression was described.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'abc123', '[[:alphanumeric:]]' ) FROM dual;<br>ERR-42000(15037): invalid character class in regular expression :<br>SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'abc123', '[[:alphanumeric:]]' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use the defined character class.<br>Refer to<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/11-sql-elements.md#7abbfdba9d28e093">Regular Expression Operators</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15038 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid character range in regular expression**

<a id="a1c5546280a9cbd9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The range specification of the regular expression is incorrect.<br>The range should be specified in a form of [minvalue-maxvalue].<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'x', '[z-a]' ) FROM dual;<br>ERR-42000(15038): invalid character range in regular expression :<br>SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'x', '[z-a]' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Specify the range in a form of [minvalue-maxvalue]. e.g. [a-z]</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15039 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid escape sequence in regular expression**

<a id="9ff25b58b982edb7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The expression of \ (escape character) is incorrect.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( '\', '\' ) from dual;<br>ERR-42000(15039): invalid escape sequence in regular expression :<br>SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( '\', '\' ) from dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Describe the character after describing \ (escape character).<br>e.g. REGEXP_SUBSTR( '\', '\\' )</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15040 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid back reference number in regular expression**

<a id="9a91de93bd9c634f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The back reference which is inappropriate for the regular expression is described.<br>The back reference can refer to the previously described subexpression.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'abcabc', '(abc)\3' ) FROM dual;<br>ERR-42000(15040): invalid back reference number in regular expression :<br>SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'abcabc', '(abc)\3' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">The back reference can refer to the previously described subexpression.<br>e.g. '(ab)(cd)\1\2'<br>Refer to<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/11-sql-elements.md#7abbfdba9d28e093">Regular Expression Operators</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15041 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid regular expression match param %s**

<a id="88bbabdfc0396af1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The matching option which is defined in the regular expression is not described.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'abc', '.+', 1, 1, 'I' ) FROM dual;<br>ERR-42000(15041): invalid regular expression match param I :<br><br>SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR( 'abc', '.+', 1, 1, 'I' ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Describe the matching option, i, c, n, m, x, which is defined in the regular expression according to the purpose.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15042 (SQLSTATE: 42000): regular expression too long**

<a id="67e27c726c15c825"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">It exceeds the maximum length, 512 bytes, allowed for the regular expression.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Describe the regular expression within 512 bytes which is the maximum length allowed for the regular expression.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15043 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid regular expression return_opt %ld**

<a id="073ccbaa76e6b17f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The value other than 0, 1 is described in return_opt which is the related function argument.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_INSTR( 'abc123가나다', '[[:digit:]]{3}', 1, 1, -1 ) from dual;<br>ERR-42000(15043): invalid regular expression return_opt -1 :<br>SELECT REGEXP_INSTR( 'abc123가나다', '[[:digit:]]{3}', 1, 1, -1 ) from dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Specify 0 or 1 according to the purpose of return_opt which is the related function argument.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15044 (SQLSTATE: 42000): string literal too long**

<a id="30e259f290e9484c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The string which exceeds the maximum size of the related type is created or defined as a result of the operation.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE ( varchar_col, 'a', 'bb' ) AS rep_col FROM t1;<br>ERR-42000(15044): string literal too long :<br>SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE ( varchar_col,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Adjust the size to the allowed size for the type, or convert the type to the type which can accept the operation result.<br>e.g. REGEXP_REPLACE ( cast( varchar_col as long varchar ), 'a', 'bb' ) AS rep_col</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15045 (SQLSTATE: 42000): argument '%ld' is out of range**

<a id="bb667f3ceb1fc74c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The value exceeding the allowed range for the argument of the related function is described.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT REGEXP_INSTR( 'abc', '\w', -1 ) FROM dual;<br>ERR-42000(15045): argument '-1' is out of range :<br>SELECT REGEXP_INSTR( 'abc', '\w', -1 ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Describe the value within the allowed range for argument of the related function.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **15046 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the '%s' value must be a number between %ld and %ld**

<a id="e9e6dfaf210322ff"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">A value outside the allowed range has been specified for the parameter of the related function.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT TABLE_PHYSICAL_STATS( T1, 1000 ) FROM DUAL;<br>ERR-42000(15046): the 'sampling ratio' value must be a number between 1 and 100 :<br>SELECT TABLE_PHYSICAL_STATS( T1, 1000 ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Specify a value within the allowed range for the parameter of the related function.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="9395d6e395a778b0"></a>
## SQL Handling Related Error

> **16000 (SQLSTATE: HY000): failed to initialize sql processor layer**

<a id="1d3f57a28df089a0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16001 (SQLSTATE: HYC00): not implemented feature, in a function %s**

<a id="34dbebb2c7f42bb4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It exists in the SQL standard, but is not implemented.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>ALTER TABLE child ADD CONSTRAINT child_fk<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FOREIGN KEY( c_fk ) REFERENCES parent( p_pk ) MATCH PARTIAL;<br>ERR-HYC00(16001): not implemented feature, in a function qlrValidateForeignKeyMatchType() :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FOREIGN KEY( c_fk ) REFERENCES parent( p_pk ) MATCH PARTIAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>This function is not available.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16002 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid function sequence of sql processor layer**

<a id="765760c4c705bb20"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16003 (SQLSTATE: 42000): identifier is too long**

<a id="80014dfeb1d1c160"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The column name exceeds the maximum length.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE T1 ( c234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890 INTEGER&nbsp;&nbsp;);<br><br>ERR-42000(16003): identifier is too long :<br>CREATE TABLE T1 ( c234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890 INTEGER&nbsp;&nbsp;)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The identifier name should be smaller than 128 bytes.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE T1 ( c234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567 INTEGER&nbsp;&nbsp;);<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16004 (SQLSTATE: 28000): invalid username/password; logon denied**

<a id="7ef0fd23b2f23288"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The username or the password is wrong.<br><br>% gsql invalid invalid<br><br>ERR-28000(16004): invalid username/password; logon denied</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Connect with the correct username and password.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16005 (SQLSTATE: 42000): name '%s.%s' is already used by an existing object**

<a id="f8ff599511394922"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The object with the duplicate name exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>ERR-42000(16005): name 'PUBLIC.T1' is already used by an existing object :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the name of the object to create.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16006 (SQLSTATE: 42000): schema '%s' does not exist**

<a id="9dcd74ce4aad4aff"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The corresponding schema does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE invalid.t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>ERR-42000(16006): schema 'INVALID' does not exist :<br>CREATE TABLE invalid.t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the schema name.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16007 (SQLSTATE: 42000): schema '%s' is not writable**

<a id="65b4329c78294d55"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>An object can not be created in the system schema.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE definition_schema.t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>ERR-42000(16007): schema 'DEFINITION_SCHEMA' is not writable :<br>CREATE TABLE definition_schema.t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the available schema.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE public.t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16008 (SQLSTATE: 42000): tablespace '%s' does not exist**

<a id="fe7100d7dd388bd3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The tablespace does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) TABLESPACE invalid;<br><br>ERR-42000(16008): tablespace 'INVALID' does not exist :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) TABLESPACE invalid<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Specify the available tablespace.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16009 (SQLSTATE: 42000): tablespace '%s' is not writable**

<a id="d80cf02d8026d93e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The user object can not be created in the system tablespace.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) TABLESPACE dictionary_tbs;<br><br>ERR-42000(16009): tablespace 'DICTIONARY_TBS' is not writable :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) TABLESPACE dictionary_tbs<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Specify the available tablespace.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16010 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid value for PCTFREE or PCTUSED**

<a id="d51c69d22e91acaa"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>An invalid PCTFREE value was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) PCTFREE 100;<br><br>ERR-42000(16010): invalid value for PCTFREE or PCTUSED :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) PCTFREE 100<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use PCTFREE value in the valid range (0~99) as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) PCTFREE 10;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16011 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid INITRANS option value**

<a id="f4e3ef5155947817"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>An invalid INITRANS value was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 INITRANS 100;<br><br>ERR-42000(16011): invalid INITRANS option value :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 INITRANS 100<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use INITRANS value in the valid range (1~32) as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 INITRANS 4;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16012 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate column name**

<a id="435de567eb0111b8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The duplicate column exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c1 INTEGER );<br><br>ERR-42000(16012): duplicate column name :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Change the column name to a different name.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16013 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid value is prevented in validation step**

<a id="1b09ec224e7cb5fb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16014 (SQLSTATE: 22023): INCREMENT must be a non-zero integer**

<a id="bed19f51bac26174"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>0 can not be used for the increment value of the sequence.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 INCREMENT BY 0;<br><br>ERR-22023(16014): INCREMENT must be a non-zero integer :<br>CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 INCREMENT BY 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use an integer other than 0 as an increment value of the sequence.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 INCREMENT B<br>Y 1;<br><br>Sequence created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16015 (SQLSTATE: 22023): START WITH cannot be less than MINVALUE**

<a id="2ff70bb64cabcca4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The starting value smaller than MINVALUE of the sequence can not be used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 START WITH 10 MINVALUE 20;<br><br>ERR-22023(16015): START WITH cannot be less than MINVALUE :<br>CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 START WITH 10 MINVALUE 20<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the value bigger than or equal to MINVALUE as the starting value of the sequence.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 START WITH 20 MINVALUE 20;<br><br>Sequence created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16016 (SQLSTATE: 22023): START WITH cannot be more than MAXVALUE**

<a id="eb32bedd364e5e05"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The starting value bigger than MAXVALUE of the sequence can not be used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 START WITH 40 MAXVALUE 30;<br><br>ERR-22023(16016): START WITH cannot be more than MAXVALUE :<br>CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 START WITH 40 MAXVALUE 30<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the value smaller than or equal to MAXVALUE as the starting value of the sequence.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 START WITH 1 MAXVALUE 30;<br><br>Sequence created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16017 (SQLSTATE: 22023): the number of values to CACHE must be greater than 1**

<a id="8f0a25d595f45b0b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>CACHE value of the sequence must be bigger than 1.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 CACHE 1;<br><br>ERR-22023(16017): the number of values to CACHE must be greater than 1 :<br>CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 CACHE 1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use CACHE value of the sequence bigger than 1.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 CACHE 20;<br><br>Sequence created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16018 (SQLSTATE: 22023): number to CACHE must be less than one cycle**

<a id="eee35e6216397560"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>CACHE size of the sequence should be smaller than one cycle value (100 in the following example).<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 100 CACHE 1000 CYCLE;<br><br>ERR-22023(16018): number to CACHE must be less than one cycle :<br>CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 100 CACHE 1000 CYCLE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the value smaller than one cycle value (100) as CACHE value of the sequence.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 100 CACHE 20 CYCLE;<br><br>Sequence created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16019 (SQLSTATE: 22023): MINVALUE must be less than MAXVALUE**

<a id="3b517319473f7d87"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>MINVALUE of the sequence is bigger than MAXVALUE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 MINVALUE 100 MAXVALUE 10;<br><br>ERR-22023(16019): MINVALUE must be less than MAXVALUE :<br>CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 MINVALUE 100 MAXVALUE 10<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>MINVALUE of the sequence should be smaller than MAXVALUE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 MINVALUE 10 MAXVALUE 100;<br><br>Sequence created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16020 (SQLSTATE: 22023): INCREMENT must be less than MAXVALUE minus MINVALUE**

<a id="8be75b52c580f0bf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>INCREMENT BY value of the sequence is bigger than (MAXVALUE - MINVALUE) value.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 INCREMENT BY 10 MINVALUE 10 MAXVALUE 15;<br><br>ERR-22023(16020): INCREMENT must be less than MAXVALUE minus MINVALUE :<br>CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 INCREMENT BY 10 MINVALUE 10 MAXVALUE 15<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>INCREMENT BY value of the sequence should be smaller than (MAXVALUE - MINVALUE) value.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 INCREMENT BY 1 MINVALUE 10 MAXVALUE 15;<br><br>Sequence created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16021 (SQLSTATE: 22023): descending sequences that CYCLE must specify MINVALUE**

<a id="567c64b086f78c2a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16022 (SQLSTATE: 22023): ascending sequences that CYCLE must specify MAXVALUE**

<a id="13dca5a6112e3c68"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16023 (SQLSTATE: 22023): duplicate or conflicting CACHE/NO CACHE specifications**

<a id="8477b34fb7e28140"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16024 (SQLSTATE: 42000): numeric precision specifier is out of range( %d to %d )**

<a id="fd45c39edc85c11b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The precision value of NUMERIC type exceeds the range.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 NUMERIC(100) );<br><br>ERR-42000(16024): numeric precision specifier is out of range( 1 to 38 ) :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 NUMERIC(100) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The valid value of NUMERIC type precision is 1 ~ 38.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 NUMERIC(38) );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16025 (SQLSTATE: 42000): numeric scale specifier is out of range( %d to %d )**

<a id="1e02eeaebee9f36b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The scale value of NUMERIC type exceeds the range.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 NUMERIC(38,200) );<br><br>ERR-42000(16025): numeric scale specifier is out of range( -84 to 127 ) :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 NUMERIC(38,200) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The valid value of NUMERIC type scale is -84 ~ 127.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 NUMERIC(38,0) );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16026 (SQLSTATE: 42000): character length specifier is out of range( 1 to %d )**

<a id="7fe4199446e66153"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The length value of CHAR type exceeds the range.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 CHAR(2001) );<br><br>ERR-42000(16026): character length specifier is out of range( 1 to 2000 ) :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 CHAR(2001) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The length value of CHAR type should be 1 ~ 2000.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 CHAR(2000) );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16027 (SQLSTATE: 42000): character varying length specifier is out of range( 1 to %d )**

<a id="4c7647c66be1e355"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The length value of VARCHAR type exceeds the range.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 VARCHAR(4001) );<br><br>ERR-42000(16027): character varying length specifier is out of range( 1 to 4000 ) :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 VARCHAR(4001) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The length value of VARCHAR type should be 1 ~ 4000.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 VARCHAR(4000) );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16028 (SQLSTATE: 42000): binary length specifier is out of range( 1 to %d )**

<a id="41d87995268d6d55"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The length value of BINARY type exceeds the range.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 BINARY(2001) );<br><br>ERR-42000(16028): binary length specifier is out of range( 1 to 2000 ) :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 BINARY(2001) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The length value of BINARY type should be 1 ~ 2000.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 BINARY(2000) );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16029 (SQLSTATE: 42000): binary varying length specifier is out of range( 1 to %d )**

<a id="27a87fc0ed0033f3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The length value of VARBINARY type exceeds the range.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 VARBINARY(4001) );<br><br>ERR-42000(16029): binary varying length specifier is out of range( 1 to 4000 ) :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 VARBINARY(4001) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">The length value of VARBINARY type should be 1 ~ 4000.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 VARBINARY(4000) );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16030 (SQLSTATE: 42000): name already used by an existing constraint**

<a id="024459f58f6a52b0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The identical constraint name exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_same_const NOT NULL,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_same_const NOT NULL );<br><br>ERR-42000(16030): name already used by an existing constraint :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_same_const NOT NULL )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a different constraint name as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_c1_const NOT NULL,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_c2_const NOT NULL );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16031 (SQLSTATE: 42000): auto-generated name already used by an existing constraint, specify unique constraint name**

<a id="03dbcfdc1aa60c4a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Auto-created constraint name already exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_not_null_c2 NOT NULL, c2 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER COLUMN c2 SET NOT NULL;<br><br>ERR-42000(16031): auto-generated name already used by an existing constraint, specify unique constraint name</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Directly describe a new constraint name as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER COLUMN c2 SET CONSTRAINT t1_c2_not_null NOT NULL;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16032 (SQLSTATE: 42000): table can have only one primary key**

<a id="d8afcf76898cab65"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Only one PRIMARY KEY can be created in a table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c2 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY );<br><br>ERR-42000(16032): table can have only one primary key :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c2 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Create only one PRIMARY KEY as follows, or create a PRIMARY KEY by combining multiple columns.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c2 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(c1,c2) );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16033 (SQLSTATE: 42000): such unique or primary key already exists in the table**

<a id="ccbc77b38c5309d1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The identical unique constraint already exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD CONSTRAINT t1_unique UNIQUE(c1);<br><br>ERR-42000(16033): such unique or primary key already exists in the table :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 ADD CONSTRAINT t1_unique UNIQUE(c1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the information about the unique constraint of a table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \desc t1<br><br>COLUMN_NAME TYPE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS_NULLABLE<br>----------- ------------ -----------<br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NUMBER(10,0) TRUE<br>C2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NUMBER(10,0) TRUE<br><br>INDEX_NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TABLESPACE_NAME INDEX_TYPE IS_UNIQUE COLUMNS<br>------------------ --------------- ---------- --------- -------<br>T1_UNIQUE_C1_INDEX MEM_TEMP_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BTREE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TRUE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br><br>CONSTRAINT_NAME CONSTRAINT_TYPE ASSOCIATED_INDEX&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COLUMNS<br>--------------- --------------- ------------------ -------<br>T1_UNIQUE_C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNIQUE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;T1_UNIQUE_C1_INDEX C1</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16034 (SQLSTATE: 42000): name already used by an existing index**

<a id="150b7e428b617ead"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>An index with the identical name exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t2 ( c1 INTEGER UNIQUE INDEX idx1 );<br><br>ERR-42000(16034): name already used by an existing index :<br>CREATE TABLE t2 ( c1 INTEGER UNIQUE INDEX idx1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use an index name which does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t2 ( c1 INTEGER UNIQUE INDEX idx2 );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16035 (SQLSTATE: 42000): auto-generated name already used by an existing index, specify non-duplicate index name**

<a id="5fdef75f08b94ccb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The auto-created index name is already in use.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY INDEX t2_primary_key_index );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t2 ( c1 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY );<br><br>ERR-42000(16035): auto-generated name already used by an existing index, specify non-duplicate index name :<br>CREATE TABLE t2 ( c1 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Give a new index name.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t2 ( c1 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY INDEX new_index_name );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16036 (SQLSTATE: 42000): '%s': invalid identifier**

<a id="e4fb69138369a07b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is a non-existing column.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE invalid = 1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16036): 'INVALID': invalid identifier :<br>SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE invalid = 1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the available column name.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \desc t1<br><br>COLUMN_NAME TYPE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS_NULLABLE<br>----------- ------------ -----------<br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NUMBER(10,0) FALSE</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="f7ce893ae2e1859c"></a>

c10,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c21, c22, c23, c24, c25, c26, c27, c28, c29, c30,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c31, c32, c33, c34, c35 );<br><br>ERR-42000(16037): maximum number of key columns exceeded :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c31, c32, c33, c34, c35 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 4:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The maximum number of key columns is 32.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE INDEX idx1 ON t1 (c01, c02, c03, c04, c05, c06, c07, c08, c09, c10,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c21, c22, c23, c24, c25, c26, c27, created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16038 (SQLSTATE: 23000): integrity constraint violation**

<a id="0330840dbdbc14c2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It can not be converted to IMMEDIATE while violating the deferred constraint.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_pk PRIMARY KEY DEFERRABLE, c2 INTEGER );<br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET CONSTRAINTS t1_pk DEFERRED;<br><br>Constraints set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 2 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET CONSTRAINTS t1_pk IMMEDIATE;<br><br>ERR-23000(16038): integrity constraint violation : T1_PK(1)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Make it not to violate the constraint, then convert it to IMMEDIATE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_pk PRIMARY KEY DEFERRABLE, c2 INTEGER );<br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET CONSTRAINTS t1_pk DEFERRED;<br><br>Constraints set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 2 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DELETE FROM t1 WHERE c2 = 2;<br><br>1 row deleted.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET CONSTRAINTS t1_pk IMMEDIATE;<br><br>Constraints set.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16039 (SQLSTATE: 3B000): savepoint '%s' never established in this session or is invalid**

<a id="0b1306b5db0c2604"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The savepoint which was not set was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SAVEPOINT sp1;<br><br>Savepoint created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT invalid;<br><br>ERR-3B000(16039): savepoint 'INVALID' never established in this session or is invalid</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the valid savepoint name.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT sp1;<br><br>Rollback complete.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16040 (SQLSTATE: 42000): table or view does not exist**

<a id="0f43a6d616bc6db2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>An unexisting table name was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP TABLE invalid;<br><br>ERR-42000(16040): table or view does not exist :<br>DROP TABLE invalid<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a valid table name.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP TABLE t1;<br><br>Table dropped.</td></tr></tbody></table>
