<a id="5c5274b00b5fb3a0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The index which was automatically created for PRIMARY KEY constraint can not be dropped with DROP INDEX.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY INDEX t1_primary_key_index );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \desc t1<br><br>COLUMN_NAME TYPE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS_NULLABLE<br>----------- ------------ -----------<br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NUMBER(10,0) FALSE<br><br>INDEX_NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TABLESPACE_NAME INDEX_TYPE IS_UNIQUE COLUMNS<br>-------------------- --------------- ---------- --------- -------<br>T1_PRIMARY_KEY_INDEX MEM_TEMP_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BTREE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TRUE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br><br>CONSTRAINT_NAME CONSTRAINT_TYPE ASSOCIATED_INDEX&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COLUMNS<br>--------------- --------------- -------------------- -------<br>T1_PRIMARY_KEY&nbsp;&nbsp;PRIMARY KEY&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;T1_PRIMARY_KEY_INDEX C1<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP INDEX t1_primary_key_index;<br><br>ERR-42000(16050): cannot modify index used for enforcement of unique/primary/foreign key :<br>DROP INDEX t1_primary_key_index<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>If PRIMARY KEY constraint is dropped as follows, then drop the related-indexes as well.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 DROP PRIMARY KEY;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \desc t1<br><br>COLUMN_NAME TYPE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS_NULLABLE<br>----------- ------------ -----------<br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NUMBER(10,0) TRUE</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="7620b69c35999f96"></a>

> **16074 (SQLSTATE: 42000): sequence number not allowed here**

<a id="28500c0ddeb59b24"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>SEQUENCE can not be described in WHERE clause.<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br>CREATE SEQUENCE seq1;<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 WHERE c1 = seq1.NEXTVAL;<br><br>ERR-42000(16074): sequence number not allowed here :<br>SELECT c1 FROM t1 WHERE c1 = seq1.NEXTVAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>SEQUENCE can only be used as a final result as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT seq1.NEXTVAL FROM dual;<br><br>NEXTVAL<br>-------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( seq1.NEXTVAL );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE t1 SET c1 = seq1.NEXTVAL WHERE c1 = 2;<br><br>1 row updated.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16075 (SQLSTATE: 42000): inconsistent datatypes : expected %s**

<a id="7136ec899377c1f1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>A data type which can not be used as a function argument was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 BOOLEAN );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( TRUE );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT SUM(c1) FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16075): inconsistent datatypes : expected NUMBER :<br>SELECT SUM(c1) FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the function, and the data type which can be used as a function argument.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT MAX(c1) FROM t1;<br><br>MAX(C1)<br>-------<br>TRUE<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16076 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid DATAFILE clause for alter of %s %s TABLESPACE**

<a id="31dee7d94464c2f1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>ADD DATAFILE clause can not be used for TEMPORARY TABLESPACE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TEMPORARY TABLESPACE test_temp_tbs MEMORY 'test_tbs_1' SIZE 10M;<br><br>Tablespace created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE test_temp_tbs ADD DATAFILE 'test_tbs_2.dbf' SIZE 10M;<br><br>ERR-42000(16076): invalid DATAFILE clause for alter of MEMORY TEMPORARY TABLESPACE :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE test_temp_tbs ADD DATAFILE 'test_tbs_2.dbf' SIZE 10M<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>TEMPORARY TABLESPACE must use ADD MEMORY clause as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE test_temp_tbs ADD MEMORY 'test_tbs_2' SIZE 10M;<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16079 (SQLSTATE: 42000): file path is too long ( < %d )**

<a id="9c253cf00dfc044d"></a>

> **16082 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid MAXTRANS option value**

<a id="2d36cf1155b3b6ed"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It exceeds the range of MAXTRANS value.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER INDEX idx1 MAXTRANS 1000;<br><br>ERR-42000(16082): invalid MAXTRANS option value :<br>ALTER INDEX idx1 MAXTRANS 1000<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a value in the valid range (1~32) of MAXTRANS.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER INDEX idx1 MAXTRANS 32;<br><br>Index altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16083 (SQLSTATE: 42000): INITRANS must be less equal than MAXTRANS**

<a id="e6ff5017f439c3e2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>INITRANS value is bigger than MAXTRANS.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER INDEX idx1 INITRANS 32 MAXTRANS 4;<br><br>ERR-42000(16083): INITRANS must be less equal than MAXTRANS :<br>ALTER INDEX idx1 INITRANS 32 MAXTRANS 4<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>INITRANS value should be smaller than or equal to MAXTRANS.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER INDEX idx1 INITRANS 4 MAXTRANS 32;<br><br>Index altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16084 (SQLSTATE: 42000): result OFFSET must be 0 or positive numeric value**

<a id="28221ff2e1840600"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>OFFSET value is wrong.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 OFFSET -1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16084): result OFFSET must be 0 or positive numeric value :<br>SELECT c1 FROM t1 OFFSET -1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>OFFSET value should be 0 or a positive number.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 OFFSET 0;<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;2<br>&nbsp;3<br>&nbsp;4<br>&nbsp;5<br><br>5 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16085 (SQLSTATE: 42000): result LIMIT/FETCH must be positive numeric value**

<a id="2583d524feccef09"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>FETCH value is wrong.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 FETCH 0;<br><br>ERR-42000(16085): result LIMIT/FETCH must be positive numeric value :<br>SELECT c1 FROM t1 FETCH 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>FETCH value should be a positive number.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 FETCH 3;<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;2<br>&nbsp;3<br><br>3 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16086 (SQLSTATE: 42000): related objects are modified by concurrent DDL execution**

<a id="a6f9e16d099452a2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DDL occurs in the table referenced by a sensitive cursor.<br><br><ul><li>Declare a sensitive cursor, then execute FETCH.</li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 SENSITIVE CURSOR FOR SELECT c1 FROM t1;<br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br>Cursor is open.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; FETCH cur1 INTO :v1;<br>V1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row fetched.<br><br>gSQL&gt; FETCH cur1 INTO :v1;<br>V1<br>--<br>&nbsp;2<br>1 row fetched.<br><br><ul><li>DDL occurs in the table referenced by a sensitive cursor.</li></ul><br>other_session&gt; drop table t1;<br>Table dropped.<br>other_session&gt; commit;<br>Commit complete.<br><br><ul><li>The sensitive cursor detects that DDL has occurred, then causes an error.</li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; FETCH cur1 INTO :v1;<br>ERR-42000(16086): related objects are modified by concurrent DDL execution</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Detecting DDL by a sensitive cursor is a normal operation.</td></tr></tbody></table>

FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1' USING IN v1, IN v2;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'v1 = ' || v1 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'v2 = ' || v2 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-07006(16098): bind type mismatch of parameter number (1) :<br>SELECT c1, c2 INTO ?, ? FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT c1, c2 INTO ?, ? FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1' USING IN v1, IN v2;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 5:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>SQL statement, SELECT INTO ?, ?, require OUT binding as follow.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 0;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 INTEGER := 0;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT c1, c2 INTO ?, ? FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1' USING OUT v1, OUT v2;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'v1 = ' || v1 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'v2 = ' || v2 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>v1 = 1<br>v2 = 100<br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16099 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the number of elements in the INTO list is mismatch**

<a id="a2bbd6f7d3678034"></a>

> **16100 (SQLSTATE: HY000): single-row subquery returns more than one row**

<a id="c8e0fc292cf37a69"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The number of subquery results is bigger than 1.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE t1.c1 = ( SELECT t2.c1 FROM t2 );<br><br>ERR-HY000(16100): single-row subquery returns more than one row :<br>SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE t1.c1 = ( SELECT t2.c1 FROM t2 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the subquery which can create a single result as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE t1.c1 = ( SELECT MAX(t2.c1) FROM t2 );<br><br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;C2<br>-- ---<br>&nbsp;1 100<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16101 (SQLSTATE: 42000): parallel factor is out of range( 0 to %d )**

<a id="b70c6682c06e78b5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>PARALLEL value exceeds the range.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE INDEX idx1 ON t1(c1) PARALLEL 100;<br><br>ERR-42000(16101): parallel factor is out of range( 0 to 64 ) :<br>CREATE INDEX idx1 ON t1(c1) PARALLEL 100<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the valid value in the range of PARALLEL (0~64) as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE INDEX idx1 ON t1(c1) PARALLEL 8;<br>Index created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16102 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid MEMORY clause for alter of %s %s TABLESPACE**

<a id="e00a27c955368a90"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>ADD MEMORY clause can not be used for MEMORY DATA TABLESPACE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs ADD MEMORY 'test_memory' SIZE 10M;<br><br>ERR-42000(16102): invalid MEMORY clause for alter of MEMORY DATA TABLESPACE :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs ADD MEMORY 'test_memory' SIZE 10M<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use ADD DATAFILE clause for MEMORY DATA TABLESPACE as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs ADD DATAFILE 'test_file' SIZE 10M;<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="8d1e27671ee19070"></a>

> **16104 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid cursor query: '%s'**

<a id="ebb01a9487df9692"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DELETE can not be used as a cursor query.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR DELETE FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16104): invalid cursor query: 'DELETE FROM' :<br>DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR DELETE FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use DELETE RETURN query as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR DELETE FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1 RETURN c2;<br><br>Cursor declared.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16105 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid cursor property**

<a id="0c8912def9e0cb6c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DML query can not be declared as a holdable cursor.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR WITH HOLD FOR DELETE FROM t1 WHERE c1 &gt; 0 RETURN c2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16105): invalid cursor property : holdable cursor should be read only cursor</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Only SELECT statement can be used as a holdable cursor.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR WITH HOLD FOR SELECT c2 FROM t1 WHERE c1 &gt; 0;<br><br>Cursor declared.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16106 (SQLSTATE: 34000): cursor '%s' does not exist**

<a id="90742e51522ea7c5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The cursor name which has not been declared was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT c2 FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN invalid_cursor;<br><br>ERR-34000(16106): cursor 'INVALID_CURSOR' does not exist :<br>OPEN invalid_cursor<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the declared cursor name.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16107 (SQLSTATE: 34000): cursor '%s' is already open**

<a id="76f70fcb1a349dd4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The cursor is already OPEN.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT c2 FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>ERR-34000(16107): cursor 'CUR1' is already open :<br>OPEN cur1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>CLOSE the cursor, then OPEN it again.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CLOSE cur1;<br><br>Cursor closed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16108 (SQLSTATE: 34000): cursor '%s' is not open**

<a id="634ff9067153ee1d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The cursor is not OPEN.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT c2 FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; FETCH cur1 INTO :v1;<br><br>ERR-34000(16108): cursor 'CUR1' is not open</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>OPEN the cursor, then use it.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; FETCH cur1 INTO :v1;<br><br>&nbsp;V1<br>---<br>100<br><br>1 row fetched.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16109 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid use: cursor '%s' is not a declared cursor**

<a id="441a95261c6bff95"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>SQLSetCursorName() function of ODBC, or the cursor name set by using JDBC ResultSet.getCursorName() can not be used together with OPEN, FETCH, CLOSE cursor statements.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Only the cursor declared with SQL statement DECLARE CURSOR can use OPEN, FETCH, CLOSE cursor statements.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16110 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid use: cursor '%s' is not an ODBC/JDBC cursor**

<a id="46c5695d69d9550c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The cursor declared with SQL statement DECLARE CURSOR can not change its name by using ODBC function SQLSetCursorName() function.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Do not use cursor name declared with SQL statement and the cursor name using ODBC / JDBC API together.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16111 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cursor '%s' is not scrollable**

<a id="2d82fed6320dd58e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>FETCH FIRST/LAST/PRIOR/CURRENT statements can be used in a scrollable cursor.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT c1 FROM t1;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; FETCH LAST FROM cur1 INTO :v1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16111): cursor 'CUR1' is not scrollable :<br>FETCH LAST FROM cur1 INTO :v1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use it by declaring a scrollable cursor as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 SCROLL CURSOR FOR SELECT c1 FROM t1;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; FETCH LAST FROM cur1 INTO :v1;<br><br>V1<br>--<br>&nbsp;5<br><br>1 row fetched.<br><br>gSQL&gt; FETCH PRIOR FROM cur1 INTO :v1;<br><br>V1<br>--<br>&nbsp;4<br><br>1 row fetched.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16112 (SQLSTATE: 42000): query expression is not updatable**

<a id="8ec9516cb6fc8103"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The query is not updatable.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(c1) FROM t1 WHERE c1 &gt; 3 FOR UPDATE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16112): query expression is not updatable</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The query result should be a query which can identify each row as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 WHERE c1 &gt; 3 FOR UPDATE;<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;4<br>&nbsp;5<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16113 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid phase(%s): executable phase of '%s' is between %s and %s**

<a id="390a6f2849845376"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is the SQL statement which is not executable on MOUNT phase.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE my_table ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>ERR-42000(16113): invalid phase(MOUNT): executable phase of 'CREATE TABLE' is between OPEN and OPEN</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Execute it after changing to OPEN phase.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE my_table ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16114 (SQLSTATE: 42000): database is already mounted**

<a id="6594d3bf414a8969"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is already on MOUNT phase.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM MOUNT DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16114): database is already mounted</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the current phase and change it to the desired start-up phase.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT status FROM x$instance;<br><br>STATUS<br>-------<br>MOUNTED<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16115 (SQLSTATE: 42000): database is already local opened**

<a id="ac12660aa0e2eff6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The cluster database is already on LOCAL OPEN phase.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN LOCAL DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16115): database is already local opened</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the current phase and change it to the desired start-up phase.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT status FROM x$instance@LOCAL;<br><br>STATUS<br>----------<br>LOCAL OPEN<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN GLOBAL DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16116 (SQLSTATE: 42000): transaction is READ ONLY**

<a id="dd7fd2e525767de8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is READ ONLY transaction state.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY;<br><br>Transaction set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>ERR-42000(18003): Transaction is READ ONLY</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Execute it after changing to READ WRITE state as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET TRANSACTION READ WRITE;<br><br>Transaction set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16117 (SQLSTATE: 42000): database not mounted**

<a id="d5435885a69475c6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The database is not MOUNTed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16117): database is not mounted</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the current state, then raise the start-up phase one by one.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT status FROM x$instance;<br><br>STATUS<br>-------<br>STARTED<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM MOUNT DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16118 (SQLSTATE: 42000): supplemental logging attribute primary key exists**

<a id="ec58300aca6e4b1a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The supplemental logging attribute is already set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD SUPPLEMENTAL LOG DATA ( PRIMARY KEY ) COLUMNS;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD SUPPLEMENTAL LOG DATA ( PRIMARY KEY ) COLUMNS;<br><br>ERR-42000(16118): supplemental logging attribute primary key exists</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check if the supplemental logging of the table is set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM SUPPLEMENTAL_LOG_TABLE_INFO WHERE table_name = 'T1';<br><br>TABLE_SCHEMA TABLE_NAME SUPPLEMENTAL_LOG_DATA_PK DROPPED<br>------------ ---------- ------------------------ -------<br>PUBLIC&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;T1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXPLICIT&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NO<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16119 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot drop nonexistent primary key supplemental logging**

<a id="906e512fb9d62ea7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The supplemental logging attribute is not set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE T1 DROP SUPPLEMENTAL LOG DATA ( PRIMARY KEY ) COLUMNS;<br><br>ERR-42000(16119): cannot drop nonexistent primary key supplemental logging</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check if the supplemental logging of the table is set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM SUPPLEMENTAL_LOG_TABLE_INFO WHERE table_name = 'T1';<br><br>TABLE_SCHEMA TABLE_NAME SUPPLEMENTAL_LOG_DATA_PK DROPPED<br>------------ ---------- ------------------------ -------<br>PUBLIC&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;T1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NO&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NO<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16120 (SQLSTATE: 42000): column referenced by views**

<a id="cb460e7b5b8a8ff8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16121 (SQLSTATE: 42000): column has a check constraint defined**

<a id="297acfe83842b98f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16122 (SQLSTATE: 42000): pseudo column not allowed here**

<a id="8eb2a15164bf57f8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16123 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot select ROWID from not writable table**

<a id="5094dc82339b9cab"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is a fixed table which can not have ROWID.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT ROWID FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-42000(16123): cannot select ROWID from not writable table :<br>SELECT ROWID FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use it for the base table which has ROWID pseudo column.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT ROWID FROM t1 LIMIT 2;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ROWID<br>-----------------------<br>AAAAAAAAYf2AACAAAAEiAAA<br>AAAAAAAAYf2AACAAAAEiAAB<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16124 (SQLSTATE: 42000): table can have only one identity column**

<a id="66e9a81fea31ba95"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>A table can have only one identity column.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, c2 INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY );<br><br>ERR-42000(16124): table can have only one identity column :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, c2 INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Define only one column as an identity column as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, c2 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16125 (SQLSTATE: 42000): column being added already exists in table**

<a id="52153105d9ba1553"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is an existing column.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD COLUMN c1 VARCHAR(32);<br><br>ERR-42000(16125): column being added already exists in table :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 ADD COLUMN c1 VARCHAR(32)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Do not use a duplicate column name.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD COLUMN new_column VARCHAR(32);<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16126 (SQLSTATE: 42000): table must be empty to add mandatory (%s) column ('%s')**

<a id="9fd8f5a070f66214"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The column with data NOT NULL constraint can not be added to the table having the data.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD COLUMN c2 INTEGER NOT NULL;<br><br>ERR-42000(16126): table must be empty to add mandatory (NOT NULL) column ('C2')</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Add the column by giving DEFAULT value as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD COLUMN c2 INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16127 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot modify INITIAL storage option**

<a id="ac135b41183ba624"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>INITIAL storage option can not be modified.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 STORAGE ( INITIAL 10M );<br><br>ERR-42000(16127): cannot modify INITIAL storage option :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 STORAGE ( INITIAL 10M )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Set it at the time of creating the table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) STORAGE ( INITIAL 10M );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16128 (SQLSTATE: 42000): name '%s' is already used by an existing tablespace**

<a id="acb0ca7a6c7d367d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The tablespace already exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs DATAFILE 'test_file' SIZE 100M;<br><br>ERR-42000(16128): name 'MEM_DATA_TBS' is already used by an existing tablespace :<br>CREATE TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs DATAFILE 'test_file' SIZE 100M<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a new tablespace name.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLESPACE new_data_tbs DATAFILE 'test_file' SIZE 100M;<br><br>Tablespace created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16129 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate datafile name**

<a id="3168ca35c4835fc6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The duplicate filename was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs ADD DATAFILE 'file1.dbf' SIZE 10M,<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'file2.dbf' SIZE 10M,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'file1.dbf' SIZE 10M;<br><br>ERR-42000(16129): duplicate datafile name :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'file1.dbf' SIZE 10M<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use different filenames.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs ADD DATAFILE 'file1.dbf' SIZE 10M,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'file2.dbf' SIZE 10M,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'file3.dbf' SIZE 10M;<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16130 (SQLSTATE: 42000): File already exists - '%s'**

<a id="f37a92582de0276b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The datafile already exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs ADD DATAFILE 'test_file' SIZE 100M;<br><br>ERR-42000(16130): file already exists - '/xxx/xxx/db/test_file' :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs ADD DATAFILE 'test_file' SIZE 100M<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a new filename.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs ADD DATAFILE 'new_test_file' SIZE 100M;<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16131 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot rename the built-in tablespace**

<a id="5f0f4a6fb43a0992"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The built-in tablespace can not be renamed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs RENAME TO new_tbs;<br><br>ERR-42000(16131): cannot rename the built-in tablespace :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs RENAME TO new_tbs<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>The built-in tablespace can not be renamed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16132 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot rename the OFFLINE tablespace**

<a id="d54500b166827875"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>OFFLINE TABLESPACE can not be renamed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs OFFLINE;<br>Tablespace altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs RENAME TO new_tbs;<br><br>ERR-42000(16132): cannot rename the OFFLINE tablespace :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs RENAME TO new_tbs<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Shift it to ONLINE, then rename it.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs ONLINE;<br>Tablespace altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs RENAME TO new_tbs;<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16133 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot drop tablespace: %s**

<a id="05ae1a1b0bc539e7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>TABLESPACE can not be dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs;<br><br>ERR-42000(16133): cannot drop tablespace: "MEM_DATA_TBS" is built-in tablespace :<br>DROP TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>The built-in TABLESPACE can not be dropped.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16134 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot drop constraint - nonexistent constraint**

<a id="4cb3d12caa30b6e0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The constraint does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 DROP CONSTRAINT invalid_constraint;<br><br>ERR-42000(16134): cannot drop constraint - nonexistent constraint :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 DROP CONSTRAINT invalid_constraint<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check existing constraint names.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 DROP CONSTRAINT t1_unique;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16135 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot drop constraint - nonexistent primary key**

<a id="c48c1b81b8e13313"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>PRIMARY KEY does not exist in the table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 DROP PRIMARY KEY;<br><br>ERR-42000(16135): cannot drop constraint - nonexistent primary key :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 DROP PRIMARY KEY<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check if PRIMARY KEY exists in the table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \desc t1<br><br>COLUMN_NAME TYPE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS_NULLABLE<br>----------- ------------ -----------<br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NUMBER(10,0) TRUE</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16136 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot drop constraint - nonexistent unique key**

<a id="0612bb8ef7ebcdf0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>UNIQUE constraint does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 DROP UNIQUE(c1);<br><br>ERR-42000(16136): cannot drop constraint - nonexistent unique key :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 DROP UNIQUE(c1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check UNIQUE constraint of the table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \desc t1<br><br>COLUMN_NAME TYPE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS_NULLABLE<br>----------- ------------ -----------<br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NUMBER(10,0) TRUE<br>C2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NUMBER(10,0) TRUE<br><br>INDEX_NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TABLESPACE_NAME INDEX_TYPE IS_UNIQUE COLUMNS<br>------------------ --------------- ---------- --------- -------<br>T1_UNIQUE_C2_INDEX MEM_TEMP_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BTREE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TRUE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C2<br><br>CONSTRAINT_NAME CONSTRAINT_TYPE ASSOCIATED_INDEX&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COLUMNS<br>--------------- --------------- ------------------ -------<br>T1_UNIQUE_C2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNIQUE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;T1_UNIQUE_C2_INDEX C2<br><br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 DROP UNIQUE(c2);<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16137 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the CDS database cannot be closed with ABORT option**

<a id="e117a7f82fb51461"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>shutdown abort is not executable in CDS mode.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Use shutdown normal or shutdown transactional in CDS mode.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16138 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the DS database can be closed with NORMAL option - deprecated**

<a id="8008c9ff386664e3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16139 (SQLSTATE: 42000): multiple ORDER BY clauses not allowed**

<a id="25591e17b436454d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16140 (SQLSTATE: 42000): multiple OFFSET clauses not allowed**

<a id="6c8dfef0ceac3725"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>OFFSET and LIMIT can not be used together.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 OFFSET 1 LIMIT 1, 2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16140): multiple OFFSET clauses not allowed :<br>SELECT c1 FROM t1 OFFSET 1 LIMIT 1, 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use OFFSET FETCH statement only or LIMIT only as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 OFFSET 1 FETCH 2;<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;2<br>&nbsp;3<br><br>2 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 LIMIT 1, 2;<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;2<br>&nbsp;3<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16141 (SQLSTATE: 42000): multiple LIMIT clauses not allowed**

<a id="70f627ffe48509d3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16142 (SQLSTATE: 42000): column ambiguously defined**

<a id="312989db1224a800"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is ambiguous to identify the column.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1, t2 WHERE t1.c1 = c1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16142): column ambiguously defined :<br>SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1, t2 WHERE t1.c1 = c1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>If column names are identical, then identify it as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1 AS a1, t2.c1 AS a2 FROM t1, t2 WHERE t1.c1 = t2.c1;<br><br>A1 A2<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16143 (SQLSTATE: 42000): column part of USING clause cannot have qualifier**

<a id="388ada41994e796a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>INNER JOIN which uses USING can not specify the table name.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1 FROM t1 INNER JOIN t2 USING(c1);<br><br>ERR-42000(16143): column part of USING clause cannot have qualifier :<br>SELECT t1.c1 FROM t1 INNER JOIN t2 USING(c1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The join result of natural join_family does not have a table name.<br>Do not describe the table name as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 INNER JOIN t2 USING(c1);<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16144 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid OFFSET option value**

<a id="caff17a9371a0035"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16145 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid LIMIT option value**

<a id="3a3707155fbddc9e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16146 (SQLSTATE: 42000): common column name '%s' appears more than once in %s table**

<a id="d96609b020376852"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Identical column names were used several times during the natural join.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c1, c1 FROM t1 ) v1 NATURAL JOIN ( SELECT c1, c1 FROM t2 ) v2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16146): common column name 'C1' appears more than once in left table :<br>SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c1, c1 FROM t1 ) v1 NATURAL JOIN ( SELECT c1, c1 FROM t2 ) v2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Give different column names as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c1, c1 AS a2 FROM t1 ) v1 NATURAL JOIN ( SELECT c1, c1 AS a2 FROM t2 ) v2;<br><br>C1 A2<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16147 (SQLSTATE: 42000): file is already used in database**

<a id="447ea92e261e9432"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The file is already used as the datafile of the existing tablespace.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE DATA TABLESPACE space1 DATAFILE 'myfile.dbf' SIZE 10M;<br><br>Tablespace created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE DATA TABLESPACE space2 DATAFILE 'myfile.dbf' SIZE 10M REUSE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16147): file is already used in database :<br>CREATE DATA TABLESPACE space2 DATAFILE 'myfile.dbf' SIZE 10M REUSE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the datafile which is not used in other tablespaces, or specify a new datafile as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE DATA TABLESPACE space2 DATAFILE 'other_file.dbf' SIZE 10M REUSE;<br><br>Tablespace created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16148 (SQLSTATE: 42000): tablespace not empty, use INCLUDING CONTENTS option**

<a id="387c9bb37ca90b78"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The tablespace having an object can not be DROPped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) TABLESPACE space1;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP TABLESPACE space1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16148): tablespace not empty, use INCLUDING CONTENTS option</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Drop it by using INCLUDING CONTENTS option.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP TABLESPACE space1 INCLUDING CONTENTS;<br><br>Tablespace dropped.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16149 (SQLSTATE: 42000): datafile does not exist in tablespace**

<a id="30ff5a0b8dc754bd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The datafile of the tablespace does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE space1 RENAME DATAFILE 'file_1.dbf' TO 'file_2.dbf';<br><br>ERR-42000(16149): datafile does not exist in tablespace :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE space1 RENAME DATAFILE 'file_1.dbf' TO 'file_2.dbf'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Rename the datafile as follows.<br><br><ul><li>Shift tablespace to OFFLINE.</li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE space1 OFFLINE;<br><br>Tablespace altered.<br><br><br><ul><li>Modify or copy the file name.</li></ul><br>% cp $GOLDILOCKS_HOME/db/file_1.dbf $GOLDILOCKS_HOME/db/file_2.dbf<br><br><br><ul><li>Execute RENAME DATAFILE</li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE space1 RENAME DATAFILE 'file_1.dbf' TO 'file_2.dbf';<br><br>Tablespace altered.<br><br><br><ul><li>Shift tablespace to ONLINE.</li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE space1 ONLINE;<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16150 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot drop datafile of OFFLINE tablespace**

<a id="29d8243b888f42cf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>OFFLINE datafile can not be dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs DROP DATAFILE 'TEST_TBS2.dbf';<br><br>ERR-42000(16150): cannot drop datafile of OFFLINE tablespace :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs DROP DATAFILE 'TEST_TBS2.dbf'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The datafile can be dropped only when it is ONLINE and not used.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16151 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot drop first datafile of tablespace**

<a id="0038218260e0b619"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The first datafile of TABLESPACE can not be dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLESPACE test_tbs DATAFILE 'file1.dbf' SIZE 10M, 'file2.dbf' SIZE 10M;<br><br>Tablespace created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs DROP DATAFILE 'file1.dbf';<br><br>ERR-42000(16151): cannot drop first datafile of tablespace :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs DROP DATAFILE 'file1.dbf'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>It can be dropped from the second unused datafile as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs DROP DATAFILE 'file2.dbf';<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16152 (SQLSTATE: 42000): memory is already used in database**

<a id="a57186a982ed2485"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The memory name is already in use.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TEMPORARY TABLESPACE temp_tbs MEMORY 'temp1' SIZE 10M;<br><br>Tablespace created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE temp_tbs ADD MEMORY 'temp1' SIZE 10M;<br><br>ERR-42000(16152): memory is already used in database :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE temp_tbs ADD MEMORY 'temp1' SIZE 10M<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a new memory name as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE temp_tbs ADD MEMORY 'temp2' SIZE 10M;<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16153 (SQLSTATE: 42000): memory does not exist in tablespace**

<a id="54cc28099856e24f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The memory name does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TEMPORARY TABLESPACE temp_tbs MEMORY 'temp1' SIZE 10M;<br><br>Tablespace created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE temp_tbs RENAME MEMORY 'invalid' TO 'temp3';<br><br>ERR-42000(16153): memory does not exist in tablespace :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE temp_tbs RENAME MEMORY 'invalid' TO 'temp3'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the existing memory name as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE temp_tbs RENAME MEMORY 'temp2' TO 'temp3';<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16154 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot drop first memory of tablespace**

<a id="3e0fd20962848c21"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The first memory of TABLESPACE can not be dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TEMPORARY TABLESPACE temp_tbs MEMORY 'temp1' SIZE 10M, 'temp2' SIZE 10M;<br><br>Tablespace created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE temp_tbs DROP MEMORY 'temp1';<br><br>ERR-42000(16154): cannot drop first memory of tablespace :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE temp_tbs DROP MEMORY 'temp1'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>It can be dropped from the second unused memory as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE temp_tbs DROP MEMORY 'temp2';<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16155 (SQLSTATE: 42000): tablespace '%s' is not writable for logging index**

<a id="9c3d047f861c0d7e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16156 (SQLSTATE: 42000): tablespace '%s' is not writable for nologging index**

<a id="dca98f0e9a73225c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The index created in the global temporary table can not be created in the data tablespace.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE temp1 ( c1 INTEGER UNIQUE INDEX idx1 TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs );<br><br>ERR-42000(16156): tablespace 'MEM_DATA_TBS' is not writable for nologging index</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The index created in the global temporary table should be created in the global temporary table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE temp1 ( c1 INTEGER UNIQUE INDEX idx1 TABLESPACE mem_temp_tbs );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16157 (SQLSTATE: 42000): ORDER BY item must be the number of a SELECT-list expression**

<a id="c8bc23ac6caf4323"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>ORDER BY number should be a valid location in SELECT list.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1, c2 FROM t1 ORDER BY 3;<br><br>ERR-42000(16157): ORDER BY item must be the number of a SELECT-list expression :<br>SELECT c1, c2 FROM t1 ORDER BY 3<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the number corresponding to SELECT list as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1, c2 FROM t1 ORDER BY 1;<br><br>C1 C2<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;1 A<br>&nbsp;2 B<br>&nbsp;3 C<br><br>3 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16158 (SQLSTATE: 42000): group function is not allowed here**

<a id="4c0cf95b2241bc59"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The grouping function can not be used in WHERE clause.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1, MAX(c2) FROM t1 WHERE MAX(c2) &gt; 'A' GROUP BY c1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16158): group function is not allowed here :<br>SELECT c1, MAX(c2) FROM t1 WHERE MAX(c2) &gt; 'A' GROUP BY c1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use HAVING clause as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1, MAX(c2) FROM t1 GROUP BY c1 HAVING MAX(c2) &gt; 'A' ;<br><br>C1 MAX(C2)<br>-- -------<br>&nbsp;2 B<br>&nbsp;3 C<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16159 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid number of arguments**

<a id="ce4cf6b30377ece0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The argument of IN is used wrong.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE (c1, c2) IN ( 1, 'A' );<br><br>ERR-42000(16159): invalid number of arguments :<br>SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE (c1, c2) IN ( 1, 'A' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>If the left argument of IN is two or more, then they should be enclosed in parentheses as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE (c1, c2) IN ( (1, 'A') );<br><br>C1 C2<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;1 A<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE (c1, c2) IN ( (1, 'A'), (2, 'B') );<br><br>C1 C2<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;1 A<br>&nbsp;2 B<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16160 (SQLSTATE: 42000): group function is nested too deeply**

<a id="15dd8584ab1b1f96"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The group function usage exceeds the depth.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT MAX(c1), MAX( MAX( MAX(c2) ) ) FROM t1 GROUP BY c1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16160): group function is nested too deeply :<br>SELECT MAX(c1), MAX( MAX( MAX(c2) ) ) FROM t1 GROUP BY c1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>It can be used up to 2-depth as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT MAX(c1), MAX( MAX(c2) ) FROM t1 GROUP BY c1;<br><br>MAX(C1) MAX( MAX(C2) )<br>------- --------------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3 C<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16161 (SQLSTATE: 42000): not a single-group group function**

<a id="b662a99e36e5b25f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is not the query creating a single group.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1, MAX(c2) FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16161): not a single-group group function :<br>SELECT c1, MAX(c2) FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Describe GROUP BY, or use the group function only as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1, MAX(c2) FROM t1 GROUP BY c1;<br><br>C1 MAX(C2)<br>-- -------<br>&nbsp;1 A<br>&nbsp;2 B<br>&nbsp;3 C<br><br>3 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT MAX(c2) FROM t1;<br><br>MAX(C2)<br>-------<br>C<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16162 (SQLSTATE: 42000): mismatched datafile pairs**

<a id="acc170512f88dac6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The number of datafiles to RENAME does not match.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs RENAME DATAFILE 'file1.dbf', 'file2.dbf' TO 'file3.dbf';<br><br>ERR-42000(16162): mismatched datafile pairs :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs RENAME DATAFILE 'file1.dbf', 'file2.dbf' TO 'file3.dbf'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Make the number of datafiles to RENAME same as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs OFFLINE;<br><br>Tablespace altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs RENAME DATAFILE 'file1.dbf', 'file2.dbf' TO 'file3.dbf', 'file4.dbf';<br><br>Tablespace altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs ONLINE;<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16163 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot rename datafile of ONLINE tablespace**

<a id="b86a46f32a87f1e0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The datafile of the ONLINE tablespace can not be renamed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs RENAME DATAFILE 'file1.dbf' TO 'file3.dbf';<br><br>ERR-42000(16163): cannot rename datafile of ONLINE tablespace :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs RENAME DATAFILE 'file1.dbf' TO 'file3.dbf'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Shift it to OFFLINE, then RENAME it as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs OFFLINE;<br><br>Tablespace altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs RENAME DATAFILE 'file1.dbf' TO 'file3.dbf';<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16164 (SQLSTATE: 42000): file does not exist**

<a id="e98dc1c6c20e2965"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The file does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 IMPORT 'invalid.stat';<br><br>ERR-42000(16164): file does not exist :<br>ANALYZE TABLE t1 IMPORT 'invalid.stat'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the existing file as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 EXPORT REPLACE 't1.stat';<br><br>Table analyzed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 IMPORT 't1.stat';<br><br>Table analyzed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16165 (SQLSTATE: 42000): tablespace is not online**

<a id="6cc05e4f7164169b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16166 (SQLSTATE: 42000): tablespace is not offline**

<a id="dd454d50799411b0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">If the target tablespace is ONLINE, executing the following statement may fail.<br><br><ul><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#91d87d0b29aa6323">ALTER DATABASE RECOVER DATAFILE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#91d87d0b29aa6323">ALTER DATABASE RECOVER TABLESPACE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#22625d6afdeafdcd">ALTER DATABASE RESTORE</a></li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT is_online FROM v$tablespace WHERE TBS_NAME = 'TEST_TBS';<br><br>IS_ONLINE<br>---------<br>TRUE<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RECOVER DATAFILE 'test.dbf';<br><br>ERR-42000(16166): tablespace is not offline</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Switch the target tablespace to OFFLINE first, then try again.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE test_tbs OFFLINE;<br><br>Tablespace altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT is_online FROM v$tablespace WHERE TBS_NAME = 'TEST_TBS';<br><br>IS_ONLINE<br>---------<br>FALSE<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RECOVER DATAFILE 'test.dbf';<br><br>Database altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16167 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot offline temporary tablespace**

<a id="f3b31492fb0a0aa9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>TEMPORARY TABLESPACE can not be shifted to OFFLINE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE mem_temp_tbs OFFLINE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16167): cannot offline temporary tablespace :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE mem_temp_tbs OFFLINE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the use of TABLESPACE to be shifted to OFFLINE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT tablespace_name, contents FROM dba_tablespaces WHERE tablespace_name = 'MEM_TEMP_TBS';<br><br>TABLESPACE_NAME CONTENTS<br>--------------- ---------<br>MEM_TEMP_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TEMPORARY<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16168 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot offline dictionary tablespace**

<a id="12e2ea89009d1acf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Dictionary TABLESPACE can not be shifted to OFFLINE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE dictionary_tbs OFFLINE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16168): cannot offline dictionary tablespace :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE dictionary_tbs OFFLINE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the use of TABLESPACE to be shifted to OFFLINE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT tablespace_name, contents FROM dba_tablespaces WHERE tablespace_name = 'DICTIONARY_TBS';<br><br>TABLESPACE_NAME CONTENTS<br>--------------- ----------<br>DICTIONARY_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;DICTIONARY<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16169 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot offline undo tablespace**

<a id="b8f31a375afe8bc6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Undo TABLESPACE can not be shifted to OFFLINE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE mem_undo_tbs OFFLINE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16169): cannot offline undo tablespace :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE mem_undo_tbs OFFLINE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the use of TABLESPACE to be shifted to OFFLINE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT tablespace_name, contents FROM dba_tablespaces WHERE tablespace_name = 'MEM_UNDO_TBS';<br><br>TABLESPACE_NAME CONTENTS<br>--------------- --------<br>MEM_UNDO_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNDO<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16170 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid WAIT interval**

<a id="88fcea8b5f942448"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>An invalid WAIT time was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; LOCK TABLE t1 IN EXCLUSIVE MODE WAIT 1000000001;<br><br>ERR-42000(16170): invalid WAIT interval :<br>LOCK TABLE t1 IN EXCLUSIVE MODE WAIT 1000000001<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the valid time (second) within the range of 0 ~ 1000000000.<br><br>gSQL&gt; LOCK TABLE t1 IN EXCLUSIVE MODE WAIT 10;<br><br>Table locked.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16171 (SQLSTATE: 42000): column is not updatable**

<a id="eacd3d09d0bb1406"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is not an updatable column.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, view1.a1 FROM t1, view1 WHERE t1.c1 = view1.a1 FOR UPDATE OF view1.a1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16171): column is not updatable :<br>SELECT t1.c1, view1.a1 FROM t1, view1 WHERE t1.c1 = view1.a1 FOR UPDATE OF view1.a1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the column of the table as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, view1.a1 FROM t1, view1 WHERE t1.c1 = view1.a1 FOR UPDATE OF t1.c1;<br><br>C1 A1<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;2<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16172 (SQLSTATE: 22003): data is outside the range of the data type to which the number is being converted**

<a id="c15130e71a284ef9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16173 (SQLSTATE: 22015): one or more fields of data value were truncated during conversion**

<a id="8a1730c658a37c1b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16174 (SQLSTATE: 42000): system session cannot be killed**

<a id="f095a476ae3e1cfa"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The system session can not be dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM DISCONNECT SESSION 5, 1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16174): system session cannot be killed</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the session information, then drop the user session.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT id, serial, program FROM x$session WHERE program = 'gsql';<br><br>ID SERIAL PROGRAM<br>-- ------ -------<br>28&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;7 gsql<br>29&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4 gsql<br>30&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4 gsql<br><br>3 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM DISCONNECT SESSION 28, 7;<br><br>System altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16175 (SQLSTATE: 42000): hint not allowed in positioned DELETE**

<a id="b70592a69d4dc04d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DELETE WHERE CURRENT OF statement can not use a hint.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE c1 &gt; 0 FOR UPDATE;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; \var v2 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; FETCH cur1 INTO :v1, :v2;<br><br>V1 V2<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row fetched.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DELETE /*+ INDEX(T1, T1_IDX) */ FROM T1 WHERE CURRENT OF cur1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16175): hint not allowed in positioned DELETE</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use it without a hint.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DELETE FROM T1 WHERE CURRENT OF cur1;<br><br>1 row deleted.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16176 (SQLSTATE: 42000): hint not allowed in positioned UPDATE**

<a id="0f5803034f90b065"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>UPDATE WHERE CURRENT OF statement can not use a hint.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE c1 &gt; 0 FOR UPDATE;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; \var v2 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; FETCH cur1 INTO :v1, :v2;<br><br>V1 V2<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;2<br><br>1 row fetched.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE /*+ INDEX(T1, T1_IDX) */ T1 SET c2 = :v1 + :v2 WHERE CURRENT OF cur1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16176): hint not allowed in positioned UPDATE</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use it without a hint.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE T1 SET c2 = :v1 + :v2 WHERE CURRENT OF cur1;<br><br>1 row deleted.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16177 (SQLSTATE: 34000): cursor '%s' is not updatable**

<a id="5986f2bde919d4dc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The cursor is not declared with FOR UPDATE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE c1 &gt; 0;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; \var v2 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; FETCH cur1 INTO :v1, :v2;<br><br>V1 V2<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;2<br><br>1 row fetched.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE T1 SET c2 = :v1 + :v2 WHERE CURRENT OF cur1;<br><br>ERR-34000(16177): cursor 'CUR1' is not updatable :<br>UPDATE T1 SET c2 = :v1 + :v2 WHERE CURRENT OF cur1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use it by declaring the updatable cursor as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE c1 &gt; 0 FOR UPDATE;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; \var v2 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; FETCH cur1 INTO :v1, :v2;<br><br>V1 V2<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;4<br><br>1 row fetched.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE T1 SET c2 = :v1 + :v2 WHERE CURRENT OF cur1;<br><br>1 row updated.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16178 (SQLSTATE: 34000): cursor cannot identify the underlying table**

<a id="60d022a6347c8e7c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The table which was not referenced by a cursor was used in UPDATE WHERE CURRENT OF statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE c1 &gt; 0 FOR UPDATE;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; \var v2 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; FETCH cur1 INTO :v1, :v2;<br><br>V1 V2<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;6<br><br>1 row fetched.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE t2 SET c2 = :v1 + :v2 WHERE CURRENT OF cur1;<br><br>ERR-34000(16178): cursor cannot identify the underlying table :<br>UPDATE t2 SET c2 = :v1 + :v2 WHERE CURRENT OF cur1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the table which is referenced by a cursor as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE t1 SET c2 = :v1 + :v2 WHERE CURRENT OF cur1;<br><br>1 row updated.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16179 (SQLSTATE: HY109): cursor was not positioned on a certain row**

<a id="28717b8cf8ee1c47"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The cursor is not positioned in a certain row.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT c1 FROM t1 WHERE c1 &gt; 0 FOR UPDATE;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE t1 SET c1 = 3 WHERE CURRENT OF cur1;<br><br>ERR-HY109(16179): cursor was not positioned on a certain row</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use it after FETCH cursor as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; FETCH cur1 INTO :v1;<br><br>V1<br>--<br>&nbsp;2<br><br>1 row fetched.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE t1 SET c1 = 3 WHERE CURRENT OF cur1;<br><br>1 row updated.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16180 (SQLSTATE: HY109): cursor was positioned on a row that had been deleted**

<a id="d0f9507c69e65cb8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The row where the cursor was positioned was already deleted.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT c1 FROM t1 FOR UPDATE;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; FETCH cur1 INTO :v1;<br><br>V1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row fetched.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DELETE t1 WHERE CURRENT OF cur1;<br><br>1 row deleted.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DELETE t1 WHERE CURRENT OF cur1;<br><br>ERR-HY109(16180): cursor was positioned on a row that had been deleted</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Delete it after FETCH the row as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; FETCH cur1 INTO :v1;<br><br>V1<br>--<br>&nbsp;2<br><br>1 row fetched.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DELETE t1 WHERE CURRENT OF cur1;<br><br>1 row deleted.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16181 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the CDS database cannot be closed with OPERATIONAL option**

<a id="3791dc4c8ccb2020"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>shutdown operational is not executable in CDS mode.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Use shutdown normal or shutdown transactional in CDS mode.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16182 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid segment identifier**

<a id="10bb86f91d0b336f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">When executing the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#6a1edf86eeec57d6">ALTER DATABASE REGISTER IRRECOVERABLE SEGMENT</a>&nbsp;statement, an invalid segment ID was specified.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">The ALTER DATABASE REGISTER IRRECOVERABLE SEGMENT statement is used to complete recovery while excluding the segment when recovery has failed due to error 14056.<br>Specify the value corresponding to the physical ID shown in the error message as the segment ID, and execute the statement again.<br><br>Error 14056 – Failed to apply redo log (LSN: %ld, LPSN: %d, Physical ID: %ld)</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16183 (SQLSTATE: 42000): FETCH position must be numeric value**

<a id="2f9e52a6e8ba84da"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>FETCH position should be a numeric value.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 SCROLL CURSOR FOR SELECT c1, c2 FROM t1 ORDER BY c1;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; \var v2 VARCHAR(32)<br>gSQL&gt; FETCH ABSOLUTE 'A' FROM cur1 INTO :v1, :v2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16183): FETCH position must be numeric value :<br>FETCH ABSOLUTE 'A' FROM cur1 INTO :v1, :v2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERR-22018(12006): data value is not a numeric literal</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a numeric value for FETCH position value as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; FETCH ABSOLUTE 3 FROM cur1 INTO :v1, :v2;<br><br>V1 V2<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;3 C<br><br>1 row fetched.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16184 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot drop all columns in a table**

<a id="89cbbe803ec1bf4b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It can not drop all columns.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SET UNUSED COLUMN ( c1 );<br><br>ERR-42000(16184): cannot drop all columns in a table</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>At least one or more columns should exist in the table.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16185 (SQLSTATE: 42000): column already has a NOT NULL constraint**

<a id="2511a8353ee0ab3c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>NOT NULL constraint already exists in the column.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER NOT NULL );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER COLUMN c1 SET NOT NULL;<br><br>ERR-42000(16185): column already has a NOT NULL constraint</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the constraint information of the table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \desc t1<br><br>COLUMN_NAME TYPE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS_NULLABLE<br>----------- ------------ -----------<br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NUMBER(10,0) FALSE<br><br>CONSTRAINT_NAME CONSTRAINT_TYPE ASSOCIATED_INDEX COLUMNS<br>--------------- --------------- ---------------- -------<br>T1_NOT_NULL_C1&nbsp;&nbsp;NOT NULL&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16186 (SQLSTATE: 42000): column does not have a NOT NULL constraint**

<a id="d80ab7eb7d52fb03"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>NOT NULL constraint for the column does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER COLUMN c1 DROP NOT NULL;<br><br>ERR-42000(16186): column does not have a NOT NULL constraint</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check if NOT NULL constraint exists in the column.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \desc t1<br><br>COLUMN_NAME TYPE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS_NULLABLE<br>----------- ------------ -----------<br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NUMBER(10,0) TRUE</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16187 (SQLSTATE: 42000): null values found**

<a id="098b648b77b6434e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The column has null value, so NOT NULL constraint can not be set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER COLUMN c1 SET NOT NULL;<br><br>ERR-42000(16187): null values found</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check if the column has NULL value.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE c1 IS NULL;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br>----<br>null<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16188 (SQLSTATE: HY000): result set does not exist**

<a id="4f0951709035bdb8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16189 (SQLSTATE: 42000): column is not an identity column**

<a id="b32d52f0b84ab0c4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is not an identity column.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, c2 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER COLUMN c2 RESTART;<br><br>ERR-42000(16189): column is not an identity column</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the identity column of the table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT column_name, is_identity FROM columns WHERE table_name = 'T1';<br><br>COLUMN_NAME IS_IDENTITY<br>----------- -----------<br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TRUE<br>C2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br><br>2 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER COLUMN c1 RESTART;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16190 (SQLSTATE: 42000): column cannot be cast to incompatible type**

<a id="5121a8da22b752a2"></a>
