> **16235 (SQLSTATE: 2B000): dependent privilege descriptors still exist**

<a id="bc07eb03612cd6de"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The privilege with the dependant relationship exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \connect u1 u1<br>gSQL&gt; GRANT SELECT ON u1.t1 TO u2 WITH GRANT OPTION;<br><br>Grant succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \connect u2 u2<br>gSQL&gt; GRANT SELECT ON u1.t1 TO u3 WITH GRANT OPTION;<br><br>Grant succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \connect u1 u1<br>gSQL&gt; REVOKE SELECT ON u1.t1 FROM u2 RESTRICT;<br><br>ERR-2B000(16235): dependent privilege descriptors still exist</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Do not use RESTRICT option when executing REVOKE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; REVOKE SELECT ON u1.t1 FROM u2;<br><br>Revoke succeeded.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16236 (SQLSTATE: 0A000): not supported query%s**

<a id="3bbbde7840cca979"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This query type is not supported.<br><br>SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN t2 USING(c1);<br><br>ERR-0A000(16236): not supported query (outer join including using clause) :<br>SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN t2 USING(c1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>LEFT OUTER JOIN describes the join condition by using ON clause.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN t2 ON t1.c1 = t2.c1;<br><br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br>-- ----<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;2 null<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16237 (SQLSTATE: 42000): a subquery block has incorrect number of result columns**

<a id="1f9401ad6c75df89"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The numbers of result columns are different each other.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT c1 FROM t1<br>UNION ALL<br>SELECT * FROM t2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16237): a subquery block has incorrect number of result columns :<br>SELECT * FROM t2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Make the numbers of result columns the same as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT c1 FROM t1<br>UNION ALL<br>SELECT c1 FROM t2;<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;2<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>3 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16238 (SQLSTATE: 42000): ORDER BY item must be the number of a SELECT-list expression**

<a id="60be588a3e5e2e1d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The location value of ORDER BY is bigger than the number of result columns.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1, c2 FROM t2 ORDER BY 3;<br><br>ERR-42000(16157): ORDER BY item must be the number of a SELECT-list expression :<br>SELECT c1, c2 FROM t2 ORDER BY 3<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the number which can specify the location of the result column as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1, c2 FROM t2 ORDER BY 1;<br><br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C2<br>-- ----<br>&nbsp;1 null<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16239 (SQLSTATE: 42000): expression must have same datatype as corresponding expression**

<a id="7870bc04db169b27"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16240 (SQLSTATE: 42000): subquery expressions not allowed here**

<a id="16e4488c2b9e2db7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The subquery can not be used as DEFAULT value.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t3 ( c1 INTEGER DEFAULT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 ) );<br><br>ERR-42000(16240): subquery expressions not allowed here :<br>CREATE TABLE t3 ( c1 INTEGER DEFAULT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 ) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the constant value as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t3 ( c1 INTEGER DEFAULT 0 );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16241 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid number of column names specified**

<a id="831e2ead259f5d13"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The number of result columns and the number of view columns are different.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE VIEW v1(a1) AS SELECT * FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16241): invalid number of column names specified :<br>CREATE VIEW v1(a1) AS SELECT * FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Make the number of view columns and the number of result columns the same as follows<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE VIEW v1(a1) AS SELECT c1 FROM t1;<br><br>View created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16242 (SQLSTATE: 42000): must name this expression with a column alias**

<a id="c4ab34633f62fea0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>A name should be given to the view column.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT c1 + 1, c2 FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16242): must name this expression with a column alias :<br>CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT c1 + 1, c2 FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Give the column name as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE VIEW v1(a1, a2) AS SELECT c1 + 1, c2 FROM t1;<br><br>View created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT c1 + 1 AS a1, c2 FROM t1;<br><br>View created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16243 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: View definition has compilation errors**

<a id="74474764b25553e2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The view was created including the compile error.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE FORCE VIEW v1 AS SELECT c1, c2 FROM future_table;<br><br>ERR-01000(16243): Warning: View definition has compilation errors<br>ERR-42000(16040): table or view does not exist :<br>CREATE FORCE VIEW v1 AS SELECT c1, c2 FROM future_table<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>View created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>The view was created, but it can not be viewed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM v1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16245): view "PUBLIC.V1" has errors :<br>SELECT * FROM v1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERR-42000(16040): table or view does not exist :<br>SELECT c1, c2 FROM future_table<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Resolve the compile error of the view, then the view can be normally used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE future_table( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM v1;<br><br>no rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16244 (SQLSTATE: 42000): bind variables not allowed for data definition operations**

<a id="9ba6265784ee7ace"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The host variable can not be used in DDL.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT c1, c2 FROM t1 WHERE c1 &gt; :v1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16244): bind variables not allowed for data definition operations</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Execute CREATE VIEW statement without the host variable.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT c1, c2 FROM t1 WHERE c1 &gt; 1;<br><br>View created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16245 (SQLSTATE: 42000): view "%s.%s" has errors**

<a id="190fefcd313b8330"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The compile error exists in the view.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT c1, c2 FROM t1;<br><br>View created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP TABLE t1;<br><br>Table dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM v1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16245): view "PUBLIC.V1" has errors :<br>SELECT * FROM v1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERR-42000(16040): table or view does not exist :<br>SELECT c1, c2 FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Resolve the compile error of the view, then the view can be queried.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM v1;<br><br>no rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16246 (SQLSTATE: 42000): illegal use of %s data type**

<a id="0ebab70c5e77da37"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>LONG VARCHAR column can not be specified with the index key.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER, c3 LONG VARCHAR );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE INDEX idx1 ON t1(c3);<br><br>ERR-42000(16246): illegal use of LONG VARCHAR data type :<br>CREATE INDEX idx1 ON t1(c3)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The column such as LONG VARCHAR can not be used as a key.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16247 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot BACKUP; noarchivelog mode**

<a id="706d5237934dfc5c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The database and tablespace can not be backed up in the noarchivelog mode.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE BEGIN BACKUP;<br><br>ERR-HY000(16247): cannot BACKUP; noarchivelog mode<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE DISK_DATA_TBS BEGIN BACKUP;<br><br>ERR-HY000(16247): cannot BACKUP; noarchivelog mode</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>For backup, shift the database to archivelog mode (<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#77dbfbbfacf55659">ARCHIVELOG_MODE</a>), then restart it.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16248 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot RECOVER TABLESPACE; tablespace is in use**

<a id="e641863defaf55a6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The tablespace(online) in use can not be recovered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RECOVER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS;<br><br>ERR-HY000(16248): cannot RECOVER TABLESPACE; tablespace is in use :<br>ALTER DATABASE RECOVER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Shift the tablespace to offline, then recover it.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS OFFLINE;<br><br>Tablespace altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RECOVER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS;<br><br>Database altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16249 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot SHUTDOWN; backup in progress**

<a id="1b0075c27472db82"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16250 (SQLSTATE: HY000): RECOVER UNTIL CANCEL can be issued by directly attached session only - deprecated**

<a id="8be7436d02781c28"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16251 (SQLSTATE: 42000): single-row subquery returns more than one row**

<a id="f50607731ee884f7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16252 (SQLSTATE: 42000): circular view definition encountered**

<a id="eacfde8a3923068f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>A cross-referencing view was created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE FORCE VIEW v1 AS SELECT c1 FROM v2;<br><br>ERR-01000(16243): Warning: View definition has compilation errors<br>ERR-42000(16040): table or view does not exist :<br>CREATE FORCE VIEW v1 AS SELECT c1 FROM v2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>View created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE FORCE VIEW v2 AS SELECT c1 FROM v1;<br><br>ERR-01000(16243): Warning: View definition has compilation errors<br>ERR-42000(16245): view "PUBLIC.V1" has errors :<br>CREATE FORCE VIEW v2 AS SELECT c1 FROM v1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERR-42000(16040): table or view does not exist :<br>SELECT c1 FROM v2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERR-01000(16243): Warning: View definition has compilation errors<br>View created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM v1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16245): view "PUBLIC.V1" has errors :<br>SELECT * FROM v1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERR-42000(16252): circular view definition encountered :<br>SELECT c1 FROM v1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Avoid the cross-referencing when creating a view.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16253 (SQLSTATE: 42000): only base table columns are allowed to GRANT/REVOKE**

<a id="5d65e44c0e976a8d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Column privilege can be controlled only for the&nbsp;&nbsp;base table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT SELECT(c1) ON v1 TO u1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16253): only base table columns are allowed to GRANT/REVOKE :<br>GRANT SELECT(c1) ON v1 TO u1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Do not describe the column to control the privilege for the view as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT SELECT ON v1 TO u1;<br><br>Grant succeeded.<br><br>It can control the column privilege for the table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT SELECT(c1) ON t1 TO u1;<br><br>Grant succeeded.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16254 (SQLSTATE: 42000): lacks privilege (%s ON TABLE "%s"."%s")**

<a id="88e66e3c9563efa7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It does not have a privilege to perform SELECT on the table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT current_user FROM dual;<br><br>CURRENT_USER<br>------------<br>U1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM public.t1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16254): lacks privilege (SELECT ON TABLE "PUBLIC"."T1")</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>If the object owner grants the privilege, then it can execute the related statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT SELECT ON public.t1 TO u1;<br><br>Grant succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \connect u1 u1<br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM public.t1;<br><br>no rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16255 (SQLSTATE: 42000): lacks privilege (USAGE ON SEQUENCE "%s"."%s")**

<a id="6d6f680f87e60d9b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It does not have a privilege to use the sequence.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT public.seq1.NEXTVAL FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-42000(16255): lacks privilege (USAGE ON SEQUENCE "PUBLIC"."SEQ1") :<br>SELECT public.seq1.NEXTVAL FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>If the object owner grants the privilege, then it can use the sequence.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT USAGE ON SEQUENCE public.seq1 TO u1;<br><br>Grant succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; connect u1 u1<br>gSQL&gt; SELECT public.seq1.NEXTVAL FROM dual;<br><br>NEXTVAL<br>-------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16256 (SQLSTATE: 07001): wrong number of parameters**

<a id="13472004e95133e7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The number of host variables used in SQL statement is different from the number of host variables used in the application.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the use of the bind parameter of the application.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16257 (SQLSTATE: HY000): argument of CASE/WHEN must be type boolean**

<a id="32fd6caf1d2bad4e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The argument of CASE/WHEN should be a boolean type.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT CASE WHEN ( c1 ) THEN 'GOOD' ELSE 'BAD' END AS result FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16075): inconsistent datatypes : expected BOOLEAN :<br>SELECT CASE WHEN ( c1 ) THEN 'GOOD' ELSE 'BAD' END AS result FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the conditional expression in CASE/WHEN.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT CASE WHEN ( c1 = 1 ) THEN 'GOOD' ELSE 'BAD' END AS result FROM t1;<br><br>RESULT<br>------<br>GOOD<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16258 (SQLSTATE: HY000): the XID does not exist**

<a id="ced4de97498f2a04"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The in-doubt commit/rollback can not be executed for xa transaction which does not exist in the system.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT FORCE '0.3130.00';<br><br>ERR-HY000(16258): the XID does not exist :<br>COMMIT FORCE '0.3130.00'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br><br>gSQL&gt; ROLLBACK FORCE '0.3130.00';<br><br>ERR-HY000(16258): the XID does not exist :<br>ROLLBACK FORCE '0.3130.00'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Inquire V$XA_TRANSACTION (<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/9-database-information.md#4118536ea4d51717">V$XA_TRANSACTION</a>), and check the xa transaction to commit/rollback.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16259 (SQLSTATE: HY000): the XID string is not valid**

<a id="12b4de5c4a14e308"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>xid of the target xa transaction to execute in-doubt commit/rollback is not valid.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT FORCE '0.';<br><br>ERR-HY000(16259): the XID string is not valid:<br>COMMIT FORCE '0.'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERR-HY000(12162): invalid XID string<br><br>gSQL&gt; ROLLBACK FORCE '0.';<br><br>ERR-HY000(16259): the XID string is not valid:<br>ROLLBACK FORCE '0.'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERR-HY000(12162): invalid XID string</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Inquire V$XA_TRANSACTION (<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/9-database-information.md#4118536ea4d51717">V$XA_TRANSACTION</a>) and check the xa transaction to commit/rollback.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16260 (SQLSTATE: HY000): the global transaction is in progress**

<a id="451f8d9d245bdf4e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The target xa transaction to execute in-doubt commit/rollback is associated.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT FORCE '0.3130.00';<br><br>ERR-HY000(16260): the global transaction is in progress :<br>COMMIT FORCE '0.3130.00'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br><br>gSQL&gt; ROLLBACK FORCE '0.3130.00';<br><br>ERR-HY000(16260): the global transaction is in progress :<br>ROLLBACK FORCE '0.3130.00'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Inquire V$XA_TRANSACTION (<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/9-database-information.md#4118536ea4d51717">V$XA_TRANSACTION</a>) and check the xa transaction to commit/rollback.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16261 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid INCREMENTAL BACKUP LEVEL specified : %d**

<a id="80e911f0b846b5ff"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The level of the incremental backup is not valid.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE BACKUP INCREMENTAL LEVEL 5;<br><br>ERR-42000(16261): invalid INCREMENTAL BACKUP LEVEL specified : 5</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>(<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#a9f4f713f7a7547c">ALTER DATABASE BACKUP</a>) The level of the incremental backup can be set from 0 to 4.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16262 (SQLSTATE: 42000): INCREMENTAL BACKUP LEVEL 0 cannot have any BACKUP options**

<a id="0a91770cd9f2f8e5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The level 0 incremental backup does not use the backup option (CUMULATIVE/DIFFERENTIAL).<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE BACKUP INCREMENTAL LEVEL 0 CUMULATIVE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16262): INCREMENTAL BACKUP LEVEL 0 cannot have any BACKUP options<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE BACKUP INCREMENTAL LEVEL 0 DIFFERENTIAL;<br><br>ERR-42000(16262): INCREMENTAL BACKUP LEVEL 0 cannot have any BACKUP options</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Execute the level 0 incremental backup without using the backup option.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16263 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot RESTORE TABLESPACE; tablespace is in use**

<a id="73859e1c0de06b9f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The tablespace (online) in use can not be restored.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RESTORE TABLESPACE TEST_TBS;<br><br>ERR-HY000(16263): cannot RESTORE TABLESPACE; tablespace is in use :<br>ALTER DATABASE RESTORE TABLESPACE TEST_TBS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Switch the tablespace to offline, then restore it.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS OFFLINE;<br><br>Tablespace altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RESTORE TABLESPACE TEST_TBS;<br><br>Database altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16264 (SQLSTATE: HY000): transaction is in progress**

<a id="4b625d7da3e71f13"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16265 (SQLSTATE: 42000): outer join operator (+) cannot be used with ANSI joins**

<a id="f390f1f4de4cc7a5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>outer join operator (+) can not be described together with INNER JOIN.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1 INNER JOIN t2 ON t1.c1 = t2.c1 (+);<br><br>ERR-42000(16265): outer join operator (+) cannot be used with ANSI joins :<br>SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1 INNER JOIN t2 ON t1.c1 = t2.c1 (+)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Delete (+) to execute INNER JOIN.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1 INNER JOIN t2 ON t1.c1 = t2.c1;<br><br>C1 C1<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>Use the SQL standard LEFT OUTER JOIN statement to execute LEFT OUTER JOIN.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN t2 ON t1.c1 = t2.c1;<br><br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br>-- ----<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br><br>&nbsp;2 null<br><br>2 rows selected.<br><br>If (+) is used with the non-standard statement as follows,<br>it can get the same result as LEFT OUTER JOIN above,<br>but it is recommended to use the SQL standard statement LEFT OUTER JOIN.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1, t2 WHERE t1.c1 = t2.c1 (+);<br><br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br>-- ----<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>&nbsp;2 null<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16266 (SQLSTATE: 42000): outer join operator (+) not allowed in %s**

<a id="9b5ecdae4571841d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The outer join operator (+) can not be described in SELECT list.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1(+) FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16266): outer join operator (+) not allowed in select-list :<br>SELECT t1.c1(+) FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The outer join operator, the non-standard operator, (+) can be used in WHERE clause.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1, t2 WHERE t1.c1 = t2.c1 (+);<br><br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br>-- ----<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>&nbsp;2 null<br><br>2 rows selected.<br><br>However, it is recommended to use LEFT OUTER JOIN, the SQL standard, as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN t2 ON t1.c1 = t2.c1;<br><br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br>-- ----<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>&nbsp;2 null<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16267 (SQLSTATE: 42000): an outer join cannot be specified on a correlation column**

<a id="71c14bbb50fda7ff"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The outer join operator (+) can not describe the external column.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM t2 WHERE t2.c1 = t1.c1(+) );<br><br>ERR-42000(16267): an outer join cannot be specified on a correlation column :<br>SELECT c1 FROM t1 WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM t2 WHERE t2.c1 = t1.c1(+) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Drop the outer join operator (+) as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM t2 WHERE t2.c1 = t1.c1 );<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16268 (SQLSTATE: 42000): a predicate may reference only one outer-joined table**

<a id="8383738454cc07a6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The outer join operator (+) can not be used across multiple tables.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1, t3.c1 FROM t1, t2, t3 WHERE t1.c1 = t2.c1(+) + t3.c1(+);<br><br>ERR-42000(16268): a predicate may reference only one outer-joined table :<br>SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1, t3.c1 FROM t1, t2, t3 WHERE t1.c1 = t2.c1(+) + t3.c1(+)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Modify LEFT OUTER JOIN, the SQL standard, accordingly and use it.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2_c1, t3_c1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;( SELECT t2.c1 AS t2_c1, t3.c1 AS t3_c1 FROM t2, t3 ) v1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ON t1.c1 = v1.t2_c1 + v1.t3_c1;<br><br>C1 T2_C1 T3_C1<br>-- ----- -----<br>&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;null&nbsp;&nbsp;null<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16269 (SQLSTATE: 42000): a table may be outer joined to at most one other table**

<a id="bffbf843f29ef9fd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>If it is the outer join relation using the outer join operator (+), then a single table can can describes only the other table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1, t3.c1 FROM t1, t2, t3 WHERE t1.c1 = t3.c1(+) AND t2.c2 = t3.c2(+);<br><br>ERR-42000(16269): a table may be outer joined to at most one other table :<br>SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1, t3.c1 FROM t1, t2, t3 WHERE t1.c1 = t3.c1(+) AND t2.c2 = t3.c2(+)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Modify LEFT OUTER JOIN, the SQL standard, according to the purpose.<br><br>If the data is given as follows,<br><br>gSQL&gt;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT * FROM t1;<br><br>C1 C2<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;2<br><br>2 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT * FROM t2;<br><br>C1 C2<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;3<br><br>2 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT * FROM t3;<br><br>C1 C2<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>The operation sequence should be correct because the result of the LEFT OUTER JOIN for multiple tables depends on the operation sequence.<br><br><ul><li>Case 1 : t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN ( t2 LEFT OUTER JOIN t3 )</li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1, t3.c1 FROM t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN ( t2 LEFT OUTER JOIN t3 ON t2.c2 = t3.c2 ) ON t1.c1 = t3.c1;<br><br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br>-- ---- ----<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>&nbsp;2 null null<br><br>2 rows selected.<br><br><ul><li>Case 2 : t2 LEFT OUTER JOIN ( t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN t3 )</li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1, t3.c1 FROM t2 LEFT OUTER JOIN ( t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN t3 ON t1.c1 = t3.c1 ) ON t1.c2 = t3.c2;<br><br>C1 C1 C1<br>-- -- --<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16270 (SQLSTATE: 42000): two tables cannot be outer-joined to each other**

<a id="386c812a25b8459b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The outer join operator (+) was used in a crossing form.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1, t2 WHERE t1.c1(+) = t2.c1 AND t1.c1 = t2.c1(+);<br><br>ERR-42000(16270): two tables cannot be outer-joined to each other :<br>SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1, t2 WHERE t1.c1(+) = t2.c1 AND t1.c1 = t2.c1(+)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use LEFT OUTER JOIN or FULL OUTER JOIN, the SQL standard, according to the intention of using the outer join operator(+).<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT t1.c1, t2.c1 FROM t1 FULL OUTER JOIN t2 ON t1.c1 = t2.c1;<br><br>C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br>-- ----<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>&nbsp;2 null<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16271 (SQLSTATE: 42000): RESTART value cannot be made to be less than the MINVALUE**

<a id="688ef5fcd31b8d9b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The RESTART value of the sequence is smaller than MINVALUE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 10000000;<br><br>Sequence created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 RESTART WITH 0;<br><br>ERR-42000(16271): RESTART value cannot be made to be less than the MINVALUE :<br>ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 RESTART WITH 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use RESTART value bigger than or equal to MINVALUE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 RESTART WITH 1;<br><br>Sequence altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16272 (SQLSTATE: 42000): RESTART value cannot be made to exceed the MAXVALUE**

<a id="0ff98d6b2253c070"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>RESTART value of the sequence is bigger than MAXVALUE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 RESTART WITH 20000;<br><br>ERR-42000(16272): RESTART value cannot be made to exceed the MAXVALUE :<br>ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 RESTART WITH 20000<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use RESTART value within the range between MINVALUE and MAXVALUE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 RESTART WITH 1;<br><br>Sequence altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16273 (SQLSTATE: 42000): MINVALUE cannot be made to exceed the current value**

<a id="8969ecc14c3e6160"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>MINVALUE can not be altered to the value bigger than the current sequence value.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT seq1.NEXTVAL FROM dual;<br><br>NEXTVAL<br>-------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 MINVALUE 3;<br><br>ERR-42000(16273): MINVALUE cannot be made to exceed the current value :<br>ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 MINVALUE 3<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Alter MINVALUE to the value smaller than the current value.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 MINVALUE 1;<br><br>Sequence altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16274 (SQLSTATE: 42000): MAXVALUE cannot be made to be less than the current value**

<a id="d8e26f1873a79a7b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>MAXVALUE can not be altered to the value smaller than the current sequence value.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT seq1.NEXTVAL FROM dual;<br><br>NEXTVAL<br>-------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;5<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 MAXVALUE 4;<br><br>ERR-42000(16274): MAXVALUE cannot be made to be less than the current value :<br>ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 MAXVALUE 4<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Alter MAXVALUE to the value bigger than the current value.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 MAXVALUE 1000;<br><br>Sequence altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16275 (SQLSTATE: 42000): MINVALUE cannot be made to exceed the START WITH value**

<a id="448ce9d6d1473091"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>MINVALUE of the sequence is bigger than START WITH value.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 START WITH 10;<br><br>Sequence created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 RESTART WITH 100 MINVALUE 20;<br><br>ERR-42000(16275): MINVALUE cannot be made to exceed the START WITH value :<br>ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 RESTART WITH 100 MINVALUE 20<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the value smaller than or equal to START WITH value when altering MINVALUE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 START WITH 10;<br><br>Sequence created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 RESTART WITH 100 MINVALUE 1;<br><br>Sequence altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16276 (SQLSTATE: 42000): MAXVALUE cannot be made to be less than START WITH value**

<a id="359b3e5b57bc5361"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>MAXVALUE value of the sequence is smaller than START WITH value.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1 START WITH 1000 INCREMENT BY -1 MAXVALUE 1000;<br><br>Sequence created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT seq1.NEXTVAL FROM t1;<br><br>NEXTVAL<br>-------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1000<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;999<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;998<br><br>3 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 MAXVALUE 999;<br><br>ERR-42000(16276): MAXVALUE cannot be made to be less than START WITH value :<br>ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 MAXVALUE 999<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use MAXVALUE value bigger than START WITH value.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq1 MAXVALUE 100000;<br><br>Sequence altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16277 (SQLSTATE: 42000): log group id is already used**

<a id="db14657483469826"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td align="left" valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is the log group id which already exists in the system, so a new log group can not be added.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE GROUP 10 ( 'abc.log' ) SIZE 20M;<br><br>Database altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE GROUP 10 ( 'abc2.log' ) SIZE 20M;<br><br>ERR-42000(16277): log group id is already used :<br>ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE GROUP 10 ( 'abc2.log' ) SIZE 20M<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td align="left" valign="middle">Action</td><td>Set a new log group id which does not exist in the system when adding a log group.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16278 (SQLSTATE: 42000): identity column cannot have a default value**

<a id="507db5627b851490"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DEFAULT value can not be specified in an identity column.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, c2 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER COLUMN c1 SET DEFAULT 1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16278): identity column cannot have a default value :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER COLUMN c1 SET DEFAULT 1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the identity column of the table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT table_name, column_name FROM user_tab_identity_cols;<br><br>TABLE_NAME COLUMN_NAME<br>---------- -----------<br>T1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER COLUMN c2 SET DEFAULT 1;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16279 (SQLSTATE: 42000): DEFAULT expression has errors**

<a id="1227a293e02971e9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>An error occurred in DEFAULT value.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SEQUENCE seq1;<br><br>Sequence created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER DEFAULT 1, c2 INTEGER DEFAULT seq1.NEXTVAL );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( DEFAULT, DEFAULT );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP SEQUENCE seq1;<br><br>Sequence dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( DEFAULT, DEFAULT );<br><br>ERR-42000(16279): DEFAULT expression has errors :<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( DEFAULT, DEFAULT )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERR-42000(16036): 'SEQ1.NEXTVAL': invalid identifier :<br>DEFAULT seq1.NEXTVAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Reset DEFAULT of the column.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER COLUMN c2 SET DEFAULT 1;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( DEFAULT, DEFAULT );<br><br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16280 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the statement is disallowed**

<a id="472f0b953c9dfab2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>It is an error used for the specific test during the development phase.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16281 (SQLSTATE: 42000): resource manager doing work outside transaction**

<a id="e0188e749d578fb5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>If the transaction in progress exists in the session, then the in-doubt xa transaction can not be committed or rolled back.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ROLLBACK FORCE '0.3130.00';<br><br>ERR-42000(16281): resource manager doing work outside transaction<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT FORCE '0.3130.00';<br><br><br>ERR-42000(16281): resource manager doing work outside transaction</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Complete the transaction in progress in the session, then complete the in-doubt xa transaction.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT FORCE '0.3130.00';<br><br>Commit complete.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16282 (SQLSTATE: 42000): MEMORY tablespace does not support an AUTOEXTEND option**

<a id="950c76039983f113"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The datafile of the memory tablespace does not support autoextend.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE DATAFILE 'system_data.dbf' AUTOEXTEND ON;<br><br>ERR-42000(16282): MEMORY tablespace does not support an AUTOEXTEND option :<br>ALTER DATABASE DATAFILE 'system_data.dbf' AUTOEXTEND ON<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Only the datafile of the disk tablespace supports autoextend.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE DATAFILE 'system_disk_data.dbf' AUTOEXTEND ON;<br><br>Database altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16283 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid ROWID**

<a id="3d36fb066d1229d7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>An invalid ROWID value was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT rowid FROM t1;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ROWID<br>-----------------------<br>AAAAAAAAYgeAACAAgCAjAAA<br>AAAAAAAAYgeAACAAgCAjAAB<br><br>2 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t2 WHERE ROWID = 'AAAAAAAAYgeAACAAgCAjAAA';<br><br>ERR-HY000(16283): invalid ROWID</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Inquire the table which acquired ROWID.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1 WHERE ROWID = 'AAAAAAAAYgeAACAAgCAjAAA';<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16284 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unable to execute in CDS mode**

<a id="cecc24c29391187c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This statement cannot be executed in CDS mode.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RESTORE TABLESPACE TEST_TBS2;<br>ERR-HY000(16286) unable to execute in CDS mode</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">N/A</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16285 (SQLSTATE: RP000): failed to create system threads**

<a id="e01a5724e32c0c30"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16286 (SQLSTATE: HY000): valid incremental backup does not exist**

<a id="620f5d3f1871798a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when no incremental backup exists while executing the following statements:<br><ul><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#91d87d0b29aa6323">ALTER DATABASE RECOVER DATAFIL</a>E without the USING BACKUP clause</li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#22625d6afdeafdcd">ALTER DATABASE RESTORE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#22625d6afdeafdcd">ALTER DATABASE RESTORE TABLESPACE</a></li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RESTORE;<br><br>ERR-HY000(14092): not exist incremental backup</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Verify that an incremental backup exists and then execute the statement again.<br><br>The following shows how to check for incremental backups.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT backup_name, backup_scope, incremental_level FROM v$incremental_backup;<br><br>BACKUP_NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BACKUP_SCOPE INCREMENTAL_LEVEL<br>--------------------------------------- ------------ -----------------<br>database_D20260304_T133953_L0_Q0_P0.inc database&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0<br>control_D20260304_T133954_L0_Q1.inc&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;control&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16287 (SQLSTATE: 42000): log group id does not exist**

<a id="ac3ba0585da58a9d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when no log group id exists while executing the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#d2062ac468f12d4a">ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE</a>&nbsp;statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE MEMBER 'redo_4_0.log' TO GROUP 4;<br><br>ERR-42000(16287): log group id does not exist :<br>ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE MEMBER 'redo_4_0.log' TO GROUP 4<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Verify that a log group id exists and then execute the statement again.<br><br>The following shows how to check for log group ids.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT group_id, COUNT(group_id) FROM v$logfile GROUP BY group_id;<br><br>GROUP_ID COUNT(GROUP_ID)<br>-------- ---------------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>4 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16288 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid string value specified**

<a id="9144b3f7ecd64de2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16289 (SQLSTATE: 42000): into clause can have only one row**

<a id="e20176d8fcdd58c9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>There are multiple results of SELECT INTO.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 INTO :v1 FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16289): into clause can have only one row</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Make sure that it creates only one result.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 INTO :v1 FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1;<br><br>V1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16290 (SQLSTATE: 42000): SHUTDOWN must be executed in dedicated session**

<a id="c92f295f7cdbaffa"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Shutdown cannot be executed in a shared session.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Execute the shutdown command in a dedicated session.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16291 (SQLSTATE: 40002): transaction rollback: integrity constraint violation**

<a id="cf83908f82f406c4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It was committed while violating the deferrable constraints, so the transaction was rolled back.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER UNIQUE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, c2 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 2 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>ERR-40002(16291): transaction rollback: integrity constraint violation : T1_UNIQUE_C1(1)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>COMMIT it without violating the constraints as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER UNIQUE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, c2 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 2 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE t1 SET c1 = 2 WHERE c2 = 2;<br><br>1 row updated.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16292 (SQLSTATE: 42000): column length specifier is out of range( 1 to %d ) for columnar table**

<a id="173bd71dee344c90"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16293 (SQLSTATE: 42000): columnar table does not support LONG VARCHAR and LONG VARBINARY**

<a id="c4429ff573f07d23"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16294 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot defer a constraint that is not deferrable**

<a id="b180caf19fbf8643"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DEFERRED can not be set in NOT DEFERRABLE constraint.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER UNIQUE );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER UNIQUE(c1) NOT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED;<br><br>ERR-42000(16294): cannot defer a constraint that is not deferrable :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER UNIQUE(c1) NOT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Describe DEFERRABLE as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ALTER UNIQUE(c1) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16295 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid NOT NULL constraint specified on an identity column**

<a id="d1fd43fb1a6f6626"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The deferrable NOT NULL constraint can not be set for the identity column.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL DEFERRABLE );<br><br>ERR-42000(16295): invalid NOT NULL constraint specified on an identity column :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL DEFERRABLE )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Delete the DEFERRABLE as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16296 (SQLSTATE: 42000): constraint '%s' is not deferrable**

<a id="445bc8419776c5df"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is not a deferrable constraint.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_uk UNIQUE );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET CONSTRAINTS t1_uk DEFERRED;<br><br>ERR-42000(16296): constraint 'T1_UK' is not deferrable :<br>SET CONSTRAINTS t1_uk DEFERRED<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>SET CONSTRAINTS statement can be used only for the deferrable constraints.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_uk UNIQUE DEFERRABLE );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET CONSTRAINTS t1_uk DEFERRED;<br><br>Constraints set.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16297 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate constraint name specified**

<a id="6769246ec3f5c138"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The duplicate constraint name was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_uk1 UNIQUE, c2 INTEGER CONSTRAINT t1_uk2 UNIQUE );<br><br>Table created.<br><br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 RENAME CONSTRAINT t1_uk2 TO t1_uk1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16297): duplicate constraint name specified :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 RENAME CONSTRAINT t1_uk2 TO t1_uk1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a new constraint name.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 RENAME CONSTRAINT t1_uk2 TO t1_uk_new;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16298 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot make primary key supplemental log data with primary key constraint violation**

<a id="01b331e6fccb767b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16299 (SQLSTATE: 42000): datafile does not exist in database**

<a id="9828f6754428aa01"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the specified datafile exists on disk but is not a file currently used by the database while executing the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#91d87d0b29aa6323">ALTER DATABASE RECOVER DATAFILE</a>&nbsp;statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RECOVER DATAFILE 'test.dbf';<br><br>ERR-42000(16299): datafile does not exist in database</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Verify that the specified datafile is currently used by the database, and then execute the statement again.<br><br>The following shows how to check the datafiles currently used by the database.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT tbs_name, datafile_name FROM v$datafile;<br><br>TBS_NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DATAFILE_NAME<br>-------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------<br>DICTIONARY_TBS /test/db/system_dict.dbf<br>MEM_UNDO_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;/test/db/system_undo.dbf<br>MEM_DATA_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;/test/db/system_data.dbf<br>MEM_TEMP_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;system_temp<br>DISK_DATA_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;/test/db/system_disk_data.dbf<br>MEM_AUX_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;/test/db/system_aux.dbf<br>MEM_TRANS_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;/test/db/system_trans.dbf<br><br>7 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16300 (SQLSTATE: 42000): too many SQL resource**

<a id="51e5ddc136bfdadf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It exceeds the maximum number of expressions. (2,147,483,648)<br><br>e.g. SELECT 1+2+3+...........+2147483647+2147483648 FROM dual;</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16301 (SQLSTATE: 42000): name '%s' is already used by an existing public synonym**

<a id="d50acd7e866fbe16"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The public synonym with the same name exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE PUBLIC SYNONYM ps1 FOR t1;<br><br>Synonym created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE PUBLIC SYNONYM ps1 FOR t2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16301): name 'PS1' is already used by an existing public synonym :<br>CREATE PUBLIC SYNONYM ps1 FOR t2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the synonym name which has not been used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE PUBLIC SYNONYM ps2 FOR t2;<br><br>Synonym created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16302 (SQLSTATE: 42000): private synonym '%s' to be dropped does not exist**

<a id="4706e47c3755f436"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The private synonym does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP SYNONYM s1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16302): private synonym 'S1' to be dropped does not exist :<br>DROP SYNONYM s1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check if the private synonym exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT synonym_name FROM user_synonyms;<br><br>SYNONYM_NAME<br>------------<br>S2<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP SYNONYM s2;<br><br>Synonym dropped.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16303 (SQLSTATE: 42000): public synonym '%s' to be dropped does not exist**

<a id="ca525b237791372d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The public synonym does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP PUBLIC SYNONYM ps3;<br><br>ERR-42000(16303): public synonym 'PS3' to be dropped does not exist :<br>DROP PUBLIC SYNONYM ps3<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check if the public synonym exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT synonym_name FROM all_synonyms WHERE synonym_schema IS NULL;<br><br>SYNONYM_NAME<br>-------------------<br>DUAL<br>...<br>...<br>PS1<br>PS2<br><br>317 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP PUBLIC SYNONYM ps1;<br><br>Synonym dropped.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16304 (SQLSTATE: 42000): looping chain of synonyms**

<a id="09d12b4eb2c9b7aa"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The looping chain which refers to itself occurred.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SYNONYM s1 FOR s1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16304): looping chain of synonyms :<br>CREATE SYNONYM s1 FOR s1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Make sure that the looping chain does not happen.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SYNONYM s1 FOR t1;<br><br>Synonym created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16305 (SQLSTATE: 42000): synonym translation is no longer valid**

<a id="1c41e8af7bd7e5bd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The object which is referred by the synonym does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SYNONYM s1 FOR invalid;<br><br>Synonym created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM s1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16040): table or view does not exist :<br>SELECT * FROM s1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Create the synonym which has the object referred by it.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE SYNONYM s1 FOR t1;<br><br>Synonym created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM s1;<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16306 (SQLSTATE: 42000): expression is out of iteration time scope**

<a id="3636f80a73acf34f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This is an error code used within the server.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16307 (SQLSTATE: 42000): constant value expression expected**

<a id="5a8a36385fb369c1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16308 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid or redundant resource**

<a id="37c26ac6a225f6f7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The redundant profile parameter was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE PROFILE p1 LIMIT FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS 1 FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS 2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16308): invalid or redundant resource :<br>CREATE PROFILE p1 LIMIT FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS 1 FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Delete the redundant profile parameter.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE PROFILE p1 LIMIT FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS 1;<br><br>Profile created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16309 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the account is locked**

<a id="a45490704af75da8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The account is locked.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER u1 ACCOUNT LOCK;<br><br>User altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \connect u1 u1<br><br>ERR-28000(16309): the account is locked</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Unlock the account.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER u1 ACCOUNT UNLOCK;<br><br>User altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \connect u1 u1<br>gSQL&gt; SELECT current_user FROM dual;<br><br>CURRENT_USER<br>------------<br>U1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16310 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the password will expire in %ld days**

<a id="8d99a8263c5495af"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The password will expire in a certain period.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \connect u1 u1<br><br>ERR-28000(16310): the password will expire in 1 days</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Change the user password.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16311 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the password will expire soon**

<a id="666b7f6f0510bcd9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The user password will expire in a certain period. (GRACE TIME).<br><br>% gsql u1 u1<br><br>ERR-28000(16311): the password will expire soon<br><br>Connected to Database.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Change the user password.<br><br>The status of the user account can be viewed as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT username, account_status, lock_date, expiry_date FROM user_users;<br><br>USERNAME ACCOUNT_STATUS LOCK_DATE EXPIRY_DATE<br>-------- -------------- --------- --------------------------<br>U1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXPIRED(GRACE) null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2024-02-29 14:40:50.140375<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER u1 IDENTIFIED BY u1_new REPLACE u1;<br><br>User altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT username, account_status, lock_date, expiry_date FROM user_users;<br><br>USERNAME ACCOUNT_STATUS LOCK_DATE EXPIRY_DATE<br>-------- -------------- --------- --------------------------<br>U1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2025-02-28 14:51:18.110624<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16312 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the password has expired**

<a id="c94f81aa8dc51a58"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>login was successful, but the password expired.<br><br>% gsql u1 u1<br><br>ERR-28000(16312): the password has expired<br>Changing password for u1<br>New password:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Enter a new password.<br><br>Changing password for u1<br>New password: ******<br>Retype new password: ******<br><br>Connected to Database.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16313 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the password cannot be reused**

<a id="e801fb4c0253a7fa"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It can not be changed to the same password.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER u1 IDENTIFIED BY u1 REPLACE u1;<br><br>ERR-28000(16313): the password cannot be reused</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the password which is different from the existing password.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER u1 IDENTIFIED BY u1_new REPLACE u1;<br><br>User altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16314 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot lock "SYS" account**

<a id="21961340cfb55ded"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The account can not be locked.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER sys ACCOUNT LOCK;<br><br>ERR-42000(16314): cannot lock "SYS" account</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>SYS account can not be locked.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16315 (SQLSTATE: 42000): profile '%s' already exists**

<a id="b5ff130febcf9bf6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The same profile already exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE PROFILE prof1 LIMIT PASSWORD_REUSE_MAX 2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16315): profile 'PROF1' already exists :<br>CREATE PROFILE prof1 LIMIT PASSWORD_REUSE_MAX 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Create the profile which is not an existing profile.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE PROFILE prof2 LIMIT PASSWORD_REUSE_MAX 2;<br><br>Profile created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16316 (SQLSTATE: 42000): function '%s' not found**

<a id="96463b7a24123847"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION which did not exist was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER PROFILE prof1 LIMIT PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION invalid;<br><br>ERR-42000(16316): function 'INVALID' not found :<br>ALTER PROFILE prof1 LIMIT PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION invalid<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use existing PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER PROFILE prof1 LIMIT PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION KISA_VERIFY_FUNCTION;<br><br>Profile altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16317 (SQLSTATE: 42000): profile '%s' has users assigned, cannot drop without CASCADE**

<a id="da5f3359f498291d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The profile has been assigned to the user.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP PROFILE prof1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16317): profile 'PROF1' has users assigned, cannot drop without CASCADE</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use CASCADE option.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP PROFILE prof1 CASCADE;<br><br>Profile dropped.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16318 (SQLSTATE: 42000): profile '%s' does not exist**

<a id="bd5ba6b6799819ba"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The profile does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP PROFILE prof1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16318): profile 'PROF1' does not exist :<br>DROP PROFILE prof1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check if the profile exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT DISTINCT profile_name FROM dba_profiles;<br><br>PROFILE_NAME<br>------------<br>DEFAULT<br>PROF2<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16319 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot assign PROFILE to "SYS" account**

<a id="6a4248d8074e7b31"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The profile can not be assigned to the account.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER sys PROFILE prof2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16319): cannot assign PROFILE to "SYS" account</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>The profile can not be assigned to SYS account.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16320 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot assign DEFAULT parameter value to "DEFAULT" profile**

<a id="06858f056e6a67bc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DEFAULT value can not be assigned to "DEFAULT" profile.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER PROFILE default LIMIT FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS DEFAULT;<br><br>ERR-42000(16320): cannot assign DEFAULT parameter value to "DEFAULT" profile :<br>ALTER PROFILE default LIMIT FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS DEFAULT<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>DEFAULT value to be used in another profile is assigned to "DEFAULT" profile.<br>Therefore, assign the valid value to "DEFAULT" profile.<br><br>gSQL&gt; > **16339 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid hash shard count (must between %d and %d)**

<a id="fbca2dd1f152ed5c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It exceeds the range of the hash shard count.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY (c1) SHARD COUNT 513;<br><br>ERR-42000(16339): invalid hash shard count (must between 1 and 512) :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY (c1) SHARD COUNT 513<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the valid hash shard count ( 1 ~ 512 ).<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY (c1) SHARD COUNT 60;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16340 (SQLSTATE: 42000): not found available sharding key column**

<a id="cf7c7277ec6163b3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The table consisting of LONG VARCHAR columns only can not be sharded with DEFAULT_SHARDING property.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SESSION SET DEFAULT_SHARDING = 1;<br><br>Session altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 LONG VARCHAR );<br><br>ERR-42000(16340): not found available sharding key column</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Create the table consisting of LONG VARCHAR columns only as cloned.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SESSION SET DEFAULT_SHARDING = 1;<br><br>Session altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 LONG VARCHAR ) CLONED;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16344 (SQLSTATE: 42000): database is not local opened**

<a id="bfae13416c45a2b0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The current start-up phase is not local opened.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \startup nomount<br><br>Startup success<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN GLOBAL DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16344): database is not local opened</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the current status, and shift the start-up phase step by step.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \startup nomount<br><br>Startup success<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM MOUNT DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN LOCAL DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN GLOBAL DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16348 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate cluster connection listed**

<a id="0bbdffa19ef9a62c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The duplicate cluster connection was listed.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE CLUSTER GROUP g4<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLUSTER MEMBER g4n1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 10410,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLUSTER MEMBER g4n2 HOST '127.0.0.2' PORT 10410,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLUSTER MEMBER g4n3 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 10410;<br><br>ERR-42000(16348): duplicate cluster connection listed :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLUSTER MEMBER g4n3 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 10410<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 4:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The combination of HOST and PORT should be unique in the cluster system.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16349 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the first cluster group does not contain local cluster member '%s'**

<a id="0f5fc6346f04f8f8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The currently connected cluster member should be included when creating the first cluster group in the cluster system.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT local_member_name FROM x$instance;<br><br>LOCAL_MEMBER_NAME<br>-----------------<br>G1N1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE CLUSTER GROUP G1 CLUSTER MEMBER G1N2 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 12150;<br><br>ERR-42000(16349): the first cluster group does not contain local cluster member 'G1N1'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>When creating the first cluster group, it can consist of only currently connected cluster members.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT local_member_name FROM x$instance;<br><br>LOCAL_MEMBER_NAME<br>-----------------<br>G1N1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE CLUSTER GROUP G1 CLUSTER MEMBER G1N1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 11150;<br><br>Cluster Group created.</td></tr></tbody></table>
