> **16351 (SQLSTATE: HY000): failed to connect to the cluster member '%s'**

<a id="17bad578937cb68a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs if the target node is not running or if the host or port value is incorrectly specified.<br><br>gSQL&gt; alter cluster group g3 add cluster member g3n3 host '127.0.0.1' port 13350;<br><br>ERR-HY000(16351): failed to connect to the cluster member 'G3N3'<br>ERR-HY000(56022): failed to connect to a host<br>ERR-HY000(11067): failed to connect to a host with a socket : poll() - port '13350' : stnConnect() returned errno(111)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the location information of the target node, update the syntax accordingly, and try again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16352 (SQLSTATE: 42000): mismatch local cluster member with location file**

<a id="58be36498e6b82be"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when the location information of the target member does not match the location specified in the syntax while adding a new member or group.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE CLUSTER GROUP g4 CLUSTER MEMBER g4n1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 11111;<br><br>ERR-42000(16352): mismatch local cluster member with location file :<br>CREATE CLUSTER GROUP g4 CLUSTER MEMBER g4n1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 11111<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the location information of the target node, update the syntax accordingly, and try again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16353 (SQLSTATE: 42000): conflict between new cluster member and location file**

<a id="3534b337df2be7a7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when the location specified in the syntax conflicts with the location of an existing running node while adding a new member or group.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE CLUSTER GROUP g4 CLUSTER MEMBER g4n1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 11150;<br><br>ERR-42000(16353): conflict between new cluster member and location file :<br>CREATE CLUSTER GROUP g4 CLUSTER MEMBER g4n1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 11150<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the location information of the existing node, update the syntax accordingly, and try again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16354 (SQLSTATE: HY000): connection of member '%s' is broken**

<a id="2e79245f279771b8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It was disconnected from the specific cluster member.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM x$instance;<br><br>ERR-HY000(16354): connection of member 'G2N2' is broken</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Specify the valid and connectable domain,<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT local_member_name FROM x$instance@LOCAL;<br><br>LOCAL_MEMBER_NAME<br>-----------------<br>G1N1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>Or use CLUSTER_IGNORE_INACTIVE_MEMBER option which processes the error as a warning.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SESSION SET CLUSTER_IGNORE_INACTIVE_MEMBER = ON;<br><br>Session altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT local_member_name FROM x$instance;<br><br>ERR-01000(16394): Warning: connection of member 'G2N2' is broken<br>LOCAL_MEMBER_NAME<br>-----------------<br>G1N1<br>G3N2<br>G3N1<br>G1N2<br>G2N1<br><br>5 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16355 (SQLSTATE: 42000): non-deterministic function not allowed here**

<a id="007cb8b0b3dcee97"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The non-deterministic function which is not constant can not be used.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( RANDOM(1,100) ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( RANDOM(1,200) ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g2,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g3;<br><br>ERR-42000(16374): range shard bound value must be one of: valid constant or MAXVALUE<br>ERR-42000(16355): non-deterministic function not allowed here :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( RANDOM(1,100) ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the constant value as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g2,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g3;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16356 (SQLSTATE: 42000): version conflict**

<a id="7b99d9b4de77ee44"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error is internally controlled in the server.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16357 (SQLSTATE: 42R01): must be accessible to at least one member of group '%s'**

<a id="5a64feb7ba71cf7f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is not accessible to any cluster member configuring the cluster group.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 12, 12 );<br><br>ERR-42R01(16357): must be accessible to at least one member of group 'G4'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Recover at least one cluster member.<br>However, the operation for another cluster group is executable.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE T_RANGE SET I1 = 2 WHERE I1 = 1;<br><br>1 row updated.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16358 (SQLSTATE: 42R01): accessible member does not exist**

<a id="c4677d608e05500b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The cluster member which is accessible to the domain does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_cloned@g1;<br><br>ERR-42R01(16358): accessible member does not exist</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the accessible cluster domain.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_cloned@g3;<br><br>COUNT(*)<br>--------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16359 (SQLSTATE: 42000): no inactive members**

<a id="d4e0a88af174f82c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>All cluster members are connected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE DROP INACTIVE CLUSTER MEMBERS;<br><br>ERR-42000(16359): no inactive members</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Execute it to drop the disconnected cluster member.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16360 (SQLSTATE: 42R02): cloned table "%s"."%s" must have at least one usable replica**

<a id="6e4739d17013383f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>If all inactive cluster members are dropped, then all data in the clone table is lost.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) CLONED AT CLUSTER GROUP g4;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>Afterwards, it is executed after disconnecting all cluster members configuring G4 group.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE DROP INACTIVE CLUSTER MEMBERS;<br><br>ERR-42R02(16360): cloned table "PUBLIC"."T1" must have at least one usable replica</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>DROPping the cluster member causing the data loss is not allowed.<br>At least one cluster member should be recovered to prevent the data loss.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16361 (SQLSTATE: 42R02): sharded table "%s"."%s" must have at least one usable replica of group '%s'**

<a id="f4f7d10c8c232875"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>If all inactive cluster members are dropped, then all data of the specific shard in the sharded table is lost.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY (c1);<br><br>Table created.<br><br>Then, it is executed after all cluster members consisting G4 group where the shard is allocated are disconnected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE DROP INACTIVE CLUSTER MEMBERS;<br><br>ERR-42R02(16361): sharded table "PUBLIC"."T1" must have at least one usable replica of group 'G4'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>DROPping the cluster member causing the data loss is not allowed.<br>At least one cluster member should be recovered to prevent the data loss.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16362 (SQLSTATE: 42000): NODE SHARDED table cannot be rebalanced**

<a id="14fff9218a5b4aab"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This is an error code used within the server.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16363 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the cluster member '%s' does not join in a cluster system**

<a id="f60c00dc277fc08e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is not the cluster member which joined the cluster system.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16363): the cluster member 'G3N3' failed to join the cluster system</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The connected cluster member is not the member which joined the cluster system, so add it to the cluster system and use it.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16364 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cluster group has sharded data**

<a id="834c16bc38300aa8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">A cluster group that contains data in a sharded table cannot be dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP CLUSTER GROUP g4;<br>ERR-42000(16364): cluster group has sharded data</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">DROP CLUSTER GROUP that may cause data loss cannot be performed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16365 (SQLSTATE: 42000): schema name of instant table must be SESSION_SCHEMA**

<a id="b31e9c8b65148590"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16366 (SQLSTATE: 42000): hash shard count smaller than AT CLUSTER GROUP list**

<a id="aa3c1b71a0c390c4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The number of listed cluster groups is smaller than the number of hash shards.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY (c1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD COUNT 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1, g2, g3;<br>ERR-42000(16366): hash shard count smaller than AT CLUSTER GROUP list</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Set SHARD COUNT value bigger than the number of cluster groups.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY (c1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD COUNT 60<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1, g2, g3;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16367 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot drop sharding key column**

<a id="8e91590cdc0bbf94"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The column being used as a sharding key can not be dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER, c3 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY (sk);<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SET UNUSED COLUMN (sk);<br><br>ERR-42000(16367): cannot drop sharding key column</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Only the column which is not included in the sharding key can be dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SET UNUSED COLUMN (c2);<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16368 (SQLSTATE: 42000): not a fixed table**

<a id="8443581ee553e219"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The target table is not a fixed table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER FIXED TABLE t1 RESET;<br><br>ERR-42000(16368): not a fixed table :<br>ALTER FIXED TABLE t1 RESET<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>It is an SQL statement which is executable only for the fixed table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER FIXED TABLE x$sql_system_info RESET;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16369 (SQLSTATE: 42000): not a statistics table**

<a id="4ed3014d7377c1c2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is not the fixed table with cumulative statistical information.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER FIXED TABLE X$AGABLE_INFO RESET;<br><br>ERR-42000(16369): not a statistics table :<br>ALTER FIXED TABLE X$AGABLE_INFO RESET<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>It is an SQL statement which is executable only for the fixed table with cumulative statistical information.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER FIXED TABLE x$sql_system_info RESET;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16370 (SQLSTATE: 42000): have to create one or more datafiles to each member**

<a id="8770a2b73ac016d0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is not allowed to created the tablespace only in the specific cluster member.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLESPACE TEST_TBS DATAFILE 'test_tbs_g1.dbf' SIZE 10M AT G1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16370): MEMBER(G2N1): have to create one or more datafiles to each member :<br>CREATE TABLESPACE TEST_TBS DATAFILE 'test_tbs_g1.dbf' SIZE 10M AT G1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Create the tablespace in all cluster members.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLESPACE TEST_TBS DATAFILE 'test_tbs_g1.dbf' SIZE 10M;<br><br>Tablespace created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16371 (SQLSTATE: 42000): conversion is not applicable**

<a id="6dc5b3ac12676845"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16372 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate shard name**

<a id="e84eafe5a87b89d0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The duplicate shard name was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c1 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c3 INTEGER<br>)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE ( c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br><br>ERR-42000(16372): duplicate shard name :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 10:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a different shard name as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c1 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c3 INTEGER<br>)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE ( c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16373 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the number of elements in shard bound mismatch the sharding key columns**

<a id="e948b3d3d010d35b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The number of shard key columns and the number of values are different.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c1 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c3 INTEGER<br>)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE ( c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200, 300 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br>ERR-42000(16373): the number of elements in the shard bound mismatch the sharding key columns :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200, 300 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 10:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Match the number of values used in the shard bound as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c1 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c3 INTEGER<br>)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE ( c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16374 (SQLSTATE: 42000): range shard bound value must be one of: valid constant or MAXVALUE**

<a id="1c94d715a6b88fe3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>NULL value was used in the shard bound value.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (c1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( NULL ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16374): range shard bound value must be one of: valid constant or MAXVALUE :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( NULL ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 5:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a constant rather than NULL as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c1 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c3 INTEGER<br>)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE ( c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16375 (SQLSTATE: 42000): only MAXVALUE allowed after MAXVALUE**

<a id="22dc1910f807510e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The constant value was used after MAXVALUE.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (c1, c2)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100, MAXVALUE ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE, 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE, MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16375): only MAXVALUE allowed after MAXVALUE :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE, 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 5:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Adjust the location of MAXVALUE as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (c1, c2)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100, MAXVALUE ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200, MAXVALUE ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE, MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16376 (SQLSTATE: 42000): multiple MAX shard defined**

<a id="dd1930eeda4fec6c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>MAX shard was defined multiple times.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16376): multiple MAX shard defined :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 6:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Only a single MAX shard is allowed as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE ( c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16377 (SQLSTATE: 42000): MAX shard not defined**

<a id="9ab0572f87b333f2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>MAX shard was not defined.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 )<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16377): MAX shard not defined :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 4:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Define MAX shard as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE ( c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16378 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate shard bound value**

<a id="db33f98ecb4fc7f5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The duplicate shard bound value was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (c1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16378): duplicate shard bound value :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 5:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a different shard bound value as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE ( c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16379 (SQLSTATE: 42000): of the total '%d' tables, '%d' tables failed to rebalance**

<a id="78cef95b35272cfc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The rebalance of some tables was not normally completed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE REBALANCE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16379): of the total '5' tables, '2' tables failed to rebalance :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;concurrent execution : 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;inactive member&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;replica usablility&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;offline tablespace&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;others&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br><br>Database altered.<br><br><ul><li>concurrent execution<br><ul><li>Failure caused by concurrency issues with other sessions</li></ul></li><li>inactive member<br><ul><li>All replicas of active members are offline and there is at least one inactive member</li></ul></li><li>replica usability<br><ul><li>The local replica is in an unusable state, or</li><li>All replicas of active members are unusable</li></ul></li><li>offline tablespace<br><ul><li>The local replica is created in an offline tablespace</li></ul></li><li>others<br><ul><li>Any cases not covered by the above causes</li></ul></li></ul></td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td><ul><li>concurrent execution<br><ul><li>Stop DDL execution in other sessions due to concurrency issues and retry.</li></ul></li><li>inactive member<br><ul><li>Join the inactive member to the cluster and retry.</li></ul></li><li>replica usability<br><ul><li>Remove replicas in an unusable state and retry.</li><li>An unusable replica can be removed using the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#f6e8b615dd1dc63e">ALTER TABLE name DROP UNUSABLE SEGMENTS</a>&nbsp;statement.</li></ul></li><li>offline tablespace<br><ul><li>Switch the offline tablespace to online and retry.</li><li>Switching can be done with the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#f690c33a6dde5c14">ALTER TABLESPACE name [ONLINE|OFFLINE]</a>&nbsp;statement.</li></ul></li><li>others<br><ul><li>Check the cause in system.trc, take corrective action, and retry.</li></ul></li></ul></td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16380 (SQLSTATE: HYC00): UNIQUE or PRIMARY KEY must include all sharding key columns for cluster system**

<a id="fb94cfd70eb48ab2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>PRIMARY KEY does not include the shard key.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY (sk);<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD PRIMARY KEY (c1);<br><br>ERR-HYC00(16380): UNIQUE or PRIMARY KEY must include all sharding key columns for cluster system</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Create PRIMARY KEY including the shard key as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD PRIMARY KEY (c1, sk);<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16381 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid shard count (must between %d and %d)**

<a id="3cd6e751195e3250"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16382 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cluster member '%s' does not exist**

<a id="df19a7994c151b6f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The cluster member does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMENT ON CLUSTER MEMBER invalid IS 'test comment';<br><br>ERR-42000(16382): cluster member 'INVALID' does not exist :<br>COMMENT ON CLUSTER MEMBER invalid IS 'test comment'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a valid cluster member name.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMENT ON CLUSTER MEMBER g2n1 IS 'test comment';<br><br>Comment created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16383 (SQLSTATE: 42000): domain '%s' is unknown**

<a id="530b11a00135c237"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16384 (SQLSTATE: 42000): multiple DEFAULT shard defined**

<a id="090849cf577cc471"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Multiple DEFAULT shards were defined.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY LIST (c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT )<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16384): multiple DEFAULT shard defined :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 6:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Define only a single DEFAULT shard as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY LIST (c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT )<br>;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16385 (SQLSTATE: 42000): DEFAULT shard not defined**

<a id="0b26dd81fa4bd429"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DEFAULT shard was not defined.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY LIST (c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( 100 )<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16385): DEFAULT shard not defined :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( 100 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 4:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Define DEFAULT shard as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY LIST (c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT )<br>;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16386 (SQLSTATE: 42000): DEFAULT cannot be specified with other values**

<a id="179d8ea6dc7c4749"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DEFAULT can not be used together with another value.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY LIST (c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT, 200 );<br><br>ERR-42000(16386): DEFAULT cannot be specified with other values :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT, 200 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 5:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use DEFAULT alone as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY LIST (c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( 100, 200 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16387 (SQLSTATE: 42000): list shard bound value must be one of: valid constant or NULL or DEFAULT**

<a id="6dfd9dbef986fcc3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>An invalid function was used for the shard bound value.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY LIST (c1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( SUM(200) ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT )<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16387): list shard bound value must be one of: valid constant or NULL or DEFAULT<br>ERR-42000(16158): group function is not allowed here :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( SUM(200) ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 5:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a valid constant, NULL, DEFAULT as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY LIST (c1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( NULL ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT )<br>;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16388 (SQLSTATE: HYC00): does not support deferrable constraints in the cluster system**

<a id="b48f3218eb1c82a2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The deferrable constraint can not be used in the cluster system.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c1 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY DEFERRABLE,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER<br>)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY HASH( c1 );<br><br>ERR-HYC00(16388): does not support deferrable constraints in the cluster system :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c1 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY DEFERRABLE,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Delete DEFERRABLE option as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c1 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER<br>)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY HASH( c1 );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16389 (SQLSTATE: 42000): domain names of the datafile for renaming don't mismatch**

<a id="885c5bbe3fb19919"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Different domain names were used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS RENAME DATAFILE 'TEST_TBS_1.dbf' AT G2N2 TO 'TEST_TBS_111.dbf' AT G2N1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16389): domain names of the datafile for renaming don't mismatch</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the identical domain name or delete it as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS RENAME DATAFILE 'TEST_TBS_1.dbf' AT G2N2 TO 'TEST_TBS_111.dbf' AT G2N2;<br><br>Tablespace altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS RENAME DATAFILE 'TEST_TBS_1.dbf' AT G2N2 TO 'TEST_TBS_111.dbf';<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16390 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid table for sharding strategy and placement specified**

<a id="06ee9c8ef41c7891"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The table used as the function argument is not a sharded table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT SHARD_ID( x$instance, 1 ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-42000(16390): invalid table for sharding strategy and placement specified :<br>SELECT SHARD_ID( x$instance, 1 ) FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the sharded table as an argument as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY (c1);<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT SHARD_ID( t1, 1 ) FROM DUAL;<br><br>SHARD_ID( T1, 1 )<br>-----------------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16391 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the number of sharding key in function is mismatch**

<a id="8b8929b9f7fb832f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The number of shard keys and the number of arguments are different.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE( sk )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g2,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g3<br>;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT SHARD_NAME( t1, 10, 20 ) FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-42000(16391): the number of sharding key in function is mismatch :<br>SELECT SHARD_NAME( t1, 10, 20 ) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the value as many as the number of shard keys as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT SHARD_NAME( t1, 300 ) FROM dual;<br><br>SHARD_NAME( T1, 300 )<br>---------------------<br>S3<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16392 (SQLSTATE: HYC00): the number of sharding key in function is mismatch**

<a id="0d250f814f84c1b4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16393 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: accessible member does not exist**

<a id="ad2249cf6c2092ec"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>IGNORE_INACTIVE_MEMBER option was used together with the domain in VIEW, but the accessible cluster member does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM view1@G4N2[RANDOM_MEMBER, IGNORE_INACTIVE_MEMBER] ORDER BY 1;<br><br>ERR-01000(16393): Warning: accessible member does not exist<br>no rows selected.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Describe the domain including the accessible member.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM view1@G4[RANDOM_MEMBER, IGNORE_INACTIVE_MEMBER] ORDER BY 1;<br><br>C1<br>----<br>G1N1<br>G1N2<br>G2N1<br>G2N2<br>G2N3<br>G3N1<br>G3N2<br>G4N1<br>G4N2<br><br>9 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16394 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: connection of member '%s' is broken**

<a id="ad2af135af5ae588"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The query result was obtained, but the connection error of a specific cluster member was detected.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;table_name,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;blocks<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM ALL_TABLES<br>&nbsp;WHERE table_schema = 'PUBLIC'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AND table_name IN ( 'TAB_CLONED' )<br>&nbsp;ORDER BY 1;<br><br>ERR-01000(16394): Warning: connection of member 'G4N2' is broken<br>TABLE_NAME BLOCKS<br>---------- ------<br>TAB_CLONED&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;448<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Join the cluster member to the cluster system.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16395 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: must be accessible to at least one member of group '%s'**

<a id="c234db9aa4c0361b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The query result was obtained, but it could not access the data of the specific cluster group.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_range@GLOBAL[ IGNORE_INACTIVE_MEMBER ];<br><br>ERR-01000(16395): Warning: must be accessible to at least one member of group 'G1'<br>COUNT(*)<br>--------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Join the cluster group to the cluster system.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16396 (SQLSTATE: 42000): exceeds the maximum number of nodes**

<a id="4a3c03219a62e6a5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It exceeds the maximum number of cluster members to be added to the cluster system.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Add cluster members as many as MAX_NODE_COUNT property value.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16397 (SQLSTATE: 42000): exceeds the maximum number of groups**

<a id="2425a1cebd2abf5a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>It exceeds the maximum number of cluster groups to be added to the cluster system.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Add cluster groups as many as MAX_GROUP_COUNT property value.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16398 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the domain of property does not match with domain '%s'**

<a id="ce940d1d35fdd02a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This property can not be altered only in a specific domain.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM SET NLS_DATE_FORMAT = 'YYYY-MM-DD' DEFERRED AT G1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16398): the domain of property does not match with domain 'G1' :<br>ALTER SYSTEM SET NLS_DATE_FORMAT = 'YYYY-MM-DD' DEFERRED AT G1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Do not use AT clause as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM SET NLS_DATE_FORMAT = 'YYYY-MM-DD' DEFERRED;<br><br>System altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16399 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot insert or update a generated always identity column, value shall be a DEFAULT**

<a id="90d6bda6f543e073"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The value can not be specified in the column created with GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>ERR-42000(16399): cannot insert or update a generated always identity column, value shall be a DEFAULT :<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use DEFAULT as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( DEFAULT );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( DEFAULT );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1;<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;2<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16400 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot RECOVER UNTIL CHANGE SCN; invalid SCN format**

<a id="cfc2213042d64ca0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The scn_format specified for performing recovery up to a specific SCN is invalid.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RECOVER UNTIL CHANGE SCN '10.*.*';<br>ERR-HY000(16400): cannot RECOVER UNTIL CHANGE SCN; invalid SCN format<br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RECOVER UNTIL CHANGE SCN '10.10';<br>ERR-HY000(16400): cannot RECOVER UNTIL CHANGE SCN; invalid SCN format</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Perform incomplete recovery using a valid scn_format as described in the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#91d87d0b29aa6323">ALTER DATABASE RECOVER</a>&nbsp;statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RECOVER UNTIL CHANGE SCN '10.*';<br><br>Database altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RECOVER UNTIL CHANGE SCN '10.10.*';<br><br>Database altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16401 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid SAMPLE size specified**

<a id="de48bedc7646b85e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The SAMPLE size is not valid.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 ESTIMATE STATISTICS SAMPLE 0 ROWS;<br><br>ERR-42000(16401): invalid SAMPLE size specified :<br>ANALYZE TABLE t1 ESTIMATE STATISTICS SAMPLE 0 ROWS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a positive integer for SAMPLE size.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 ESTIMATE STATISTICS SAMPLE 1000000 ROWS;<br><br>Table analyzed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16402 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate index name**

<a id="5c413e5f36086641"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The duplicate index is listed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 COMPUTE STATISTICS FOR INDEXES idx1, idx1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16402): duplicate index name :<br>ANALYZE TABLE t1 COMPUTE STATISTICS FOR INDEXES idx1, idx1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Describe a different index name.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 COMPUTE STATISTICS FOR INDEXES idx1, idx2;<br><br>Table analyzed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16403 (SQLSTATE: 42000): failed to join some of nodes to the global database**

<a id="a109c317e6a46190"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This warning occurs when not all members of the cluster are able to join during the transition to the GLOBAL OPEN phase.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN GLOBAL DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16403): of the total '6' nodes, '3' nodes failed to join the global database<br>ERR-HY000(56022): failed to connect to a host<br>ERR-HY000(11067): failed to connect to a host with a socket : poll() - port '21250' : stnConnect() returned errno(111)<br>System altered.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>After taking the necessary actions, nodes that failed to join can be individually added using the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#530c2222850ccc1c">ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE</a>&nbsp;statement.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16404 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot execute the statement with OS user permissions**

<a id="1ba2054702667a38"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when a file-modifying DDL is executed in DA mode using an account other than the installation account.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>DA mode DDLs that involve file modifications can only be performed by the installation account.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16405 (SQLSTATE: 42000): of the total '%d' tables in the database, '%d' tables need to be rebalanced**

<a id="fee8699e2b214eca"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Failed to switch some tables to online.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16405): of the total '5' tables in the database, '2' tables need to be rebalanced :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;concurrent execution : 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;inactive member&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;replica usablility&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;offline tablespace&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;low table scn&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;others&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br><br>System altered.<br><br><ul><li>concurrent execution<br><ul><li>Failure caused by concurrency issues with other sessions</li></ul></li><li>inactive member<br><ul><li>All replicas of active members are offline and there is at least one inactive member</li></ul></li><li>replica usability<br><ul><li>The local replica is in an unusable state, or</li><li>All replicas of active members are unusable</li></ul></li><li>offline tablespace<br><ul><li>The local replica is created in an offline tablespace</li></ul></li><li>low table scn<br><ul><li>The local replica is not up-to-date</li></ul></li><li>others<br><ul><li>Any cases not covered by the above causes</li></ul></li></ul></td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td><ul><li>concurrent execution<br><ul><li>Stop DDL execution in other sessions due to concurrency issues and retry.</li></ul></li><li>inactive member<br><ul><li>Join the inactive member to the cluster and retry.</li></ul></li><li>replica usability<br><ul><li>Remove replicas in an unusable state and retry.</li><li>An unusable replica can be removed using the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#f6e8b615dd1dc63e">ALTER TABLE name DROP UNUSABLE SEGMENTS</a>&nbsp;statement.</li></ul></li><li>offline tablespace<br><ul><li>Switch the offline tablespace to online and retry.</li><li>Switching can be done with the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#f690c33a6dde5c14">ALTER TABLESPACE name [ONLINE|OFFLINE]</a>&nbsp;statement.</li></ul></li><li>low table scn<br><ul><li>Synchronize the data using the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#f207258645781242">ALTER TABLE name REBALANCE</a>&nbsp;or<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#bc55498003b53106">ALTER TABLE name SYNCHRONIZE</a>&nbsp;statement.</li></ul></li><li>others<br><ul><li>Check the cause in system.trc, take corrective action, and retry.</li></ul></li></ul></td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16406 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid routine name**

<a id="e9e16734c1d962ac"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16407 (SQLSTATE: 42000): procedure or function does not exist**

<a id="479568ae32f4c5a5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>An invalid procedure name was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER PROCEDURE invalid COMPILE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16407): procedure or function does not exist :<br>ALTER PROCEDURE invalid COMPILE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the existing procedure name.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER PROCEDURE proc1 COMPILE;<br><br>Procedure altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16408 (SQLSTATE: 42000): bind variables not allowed for procedures or functions**

<a id="17ad68cf60ae6264"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The bind variable can not be used when creating the procedure.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE PROCEDURE proc1( a1 INTEGER )<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x1 := :v1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-42000(16244): bind variables not allowed for data definition operations</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Do not use the bind variable when creating the procedure.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE PROCEDURE proc1( a1 INTEGER )<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x1 := a1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Procedure created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16409 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: Routine definition has compilation errors**

<a id="883e9360d804457f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The routine(procedure/function) was created, but the compile error exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE PROCEDURE proc1( a1 INTEGER )<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( a1 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-01000(16409): Warning: Routine(PROC1) has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (4:4): ERR-42000(16053): not enough values<br>Procedure created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the compile error and modify it.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1( a1 INTEGER, a2 INTEGER )<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( a1, a2 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Procedure created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16410 (SQLSTATE: 42000): Startup driver node must have the latest data - a suitable startup driver node is '%s' member**

<a id="ae8d292be96f05f2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16411 (SQLSTATE: 42000): maximum number of recursive SQL levels (%d) exceeded.**

<a id="a66d998036d13a72"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The maximum number of recursive calls is exceeds.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1( A1 INTEGER )<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;IF( A1 &gt; 0 ) THEN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'A1 = ' || A1 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROC1( A1 -1 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;END IF;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Procedure created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CALL proc1(100);<br><br>A1 = 100<br>A1 = 99<br>A1 = 98<br>A1 = 97<br>...<br>... (Ellipsis)<br>...<br>A1 = 55<br>A1 = 54<br>A1 = 53<br><br>ERR-42000(16411): maximum number of recursive SQL levels (50) exceeded. : ERROR at PROCEDURE("PUT_LINE")<br><br>ERROR at PROCEDURE("PROC1")</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Modify the recursive call procedure, or do not exceed the maximum number of recursive calls.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CALL proc1(5);<br><br>A1 = 5<br>A1 = 4<br>A1 = 3<br>A1 = 2<br>A1 = 1<br><br>Procedure Call complete.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16412 (SQLSTATE: 42R02): all of shards in a table must be online.**

<a id="25523d63ce9f741d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The offline shard exists in DDL target table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE INDEX tix3 ON t1( i3 );<br><br>ERR-42R02(16412): all of shards in a table 'T1' must be online. :<br>CREATE INDEX t1x3 ON t1( i3 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the offline status of the table, and respond to it.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT MEMBER_NAME, MEMBER_OFFLINE FROM USER_TAB_PLACE WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'T1' ORDER BY MEMBER_NAME;<br><br>ERR-01000(16394): Warning: connection of member 'G3N3' is broken<br>MEMBER_NAME MEMBER_OFFLINE<br>----------- --------------<br>G1N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br>G1N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br>G2N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br>G2N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br>G3N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TRUE<br>G3N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TRUE<br>G3N3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TRUE<br><br>7 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16414 (SQLSTATE: 42000): domain option not allowed here**

<a id="f08ef56f0eafea06"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The domain name and the domain option can not be used together.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1@G1|LOCAL;<br><br>ERR-42000(16414): domain option not allowed here :<br>SELECT c1 FROM t1@G1|LOCAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the domain as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1@G1;<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1@LOCAL;<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT c1 FROM t1@G1|G2;<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16416 (SQLSTATE: 42000): lacks privilege (EXECUTE ON PROCEDURE "%s"."%s")**

<a id="8266f61cb8043f0c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The user does not have the privilege to execute the procedure.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT current_user FROM dual;<br><br>CURRENT_USER<br>------------<br>U1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CALL proc1();<br><br>ERR-42000(16416): lacks privilege (EXECUTE ON PROCEDURE "PUBLIC"."PROC1")</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The procedure owner should grant the privilege to execute the procedure to the user.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT EXECUTE ON PROCEDURE proc1 TO u1;<br><br>Grant succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \connect u1 u1<br><br>gSQL&gt; CALL proc1();<br><br>Procedure Call complete.</td></tr></tbody></table>
