> **16425 (SQLSTATE: 42000): procedure, function, package, or type is not allowed here**

<a id="7d854386a1c1a4f6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The stored function can not be used as DEFAULT value.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER DEFAULT func1 );<br><br>ERR-42000(16425): procedure, function, package, or type is not allowed here :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER DEFAULT func1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a constant as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER DEFAULT 0 );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16426 (SQLSTATE: 42000): does not support ADD COLUMN DEFAULT generating different values in the cluster system**

<a id="c6f709b6446fbabf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16427 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid events (%s)**

<a id="6188f28504c103da"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16428 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cluster system is modified by concurrent cluster DDL execution**

<a id="14c4c42043331ae0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Cluster DDL statements cannot be executed concurrently.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Execute the cluster DDL statements sequentially.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16429 (SQLSTATE: 42000): does not support cursor in the cluster system : global secondary index expected**

<a id="23d1be2b4f636efd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16430 (SQLSTATE: 42000): in the GLOBAL OPEN phase, the cluster database can be closed only with ABORT option**

<a id="c98d83ed209587a6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>In the GLOBAL OPEN phase, only the ABORT option can be used for individual node shutdown.<br><br>gSQL&gt; shutdown<br><br>ERR-42000(16430): in the GLOBAL OPEN phase, the cluster database can be closed only with ABORT option :<br>ALTER SYSTEM CLOSE DATABASE NORMAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Specify the ABORT option and try again.<br><br>gSQL&gt; shutdown abort<br><br>Shutdown success</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16431 (SQLSTATE: 42000): non-deterministic expression not allowed here : may lead to a replica synchronization failure**

<a id="7798320dbbb6ecef"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16432 (SQLSTATE: 42000): global secondary index already exists in table**

<a id="430dd0d76cb154cb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The global secondary index already exists in the table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD GLOBAL SECONDARY INDEX;<br><br>ERR-42000(16432): global secondary index already exists in table</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Retrieve the tables without the global secondary index as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT table_name FROM user_tables<br>EXCEPT<br>SELECT table_name FROM user_global_secondary_indexes;<br><br>TABLE_NAME<br>----------<br>T2<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16433 (SQLSTATE: 42000): global secondary index does not exist in table**

<a id="f4f2b8ec5a83122f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The global secondary index does not exist in the table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t2 DROP GLOBAL SECONDARY INDEX;<br><br>ERR-42000(16433): global secondary index does not exist in table :<br>ALTER TABLE t2 DROP GLOBAL SECONDARY INDEX<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Retrieve the tables with the global secondary index as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT table_name FROM user_global_secondary_indexes;<br><br>TABLE_NAME<br>----------<br>T1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16434 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid grid is prevented in cluster operation, in a function %s**

<a id="fe27a651561dfb96"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This is an error code used within the server.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16435 (SQLSTATE: HY000): duplicate source datafile name**

<a id="cea0068eda95057d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The duplicate source datafile name was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS RENAME DATAFILE 'TEST_TBS_0.dbf', 'TEST_TBS_0.dbf'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TO 'TEST_0.dbf'&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, 'TEST_1.dbf';<br><br>ERR-HY000(16435): duplicate source datafile name :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS RENAME DATAFILE 'TEST_TBS_0.dbf', 'TEST_TBS_0.dbf'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a different source datafile as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS RENAME DATAFILE 'TEST_TBS_0.dbf', 'TEST_TBS_1.dbf'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TO 'TEST_0.dbf'&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, 'TEST_1.dbf';<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16436 (SQLSTATE: HY000): duplicate target datafile name**

<a id="2c3d67f6e73bec33"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The duplicate target datafile name was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS RENAME DATAFILE 'TEST_TBS_0.dbf', 'TEST_TBS_1.dbf'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TO 'TEST_0.dbf'&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, 'TEST_0.dbf';<br><br>ERR-HY000(16436): duplicate target datafile name :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TO 'TEST_0.dbf'&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, 'TEST_0.dbf'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a different target datafile as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>ALTER TABLESPACE TEST_TBS RENAME DATAFILE 'TEST_TBS_0.dbf', 'TEST_TBS_1.dbf'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TO 'TEST_0.dbf'&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, 'TEST_1.dbf';<br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16437 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot execute on cloned tables**

<a id="5ee678bc5b55b8ab"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>RENAME SHARD can not be executed for the cloned table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) CLONED;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 RENAME SHARD s1 TO s2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16437): cannot execute on cloned tables :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 RENAME SHARD s1 TO s2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>RENAME SHARD can be executed for the sharded table.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16438 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid shard name - '%s'**

<a id="f1ebb96aabf3a15d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The shard name which does not exist was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 RENAME SHARD invalid TO s_new;<br><br>ERR-42000(16438): invalid shard name :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 RENAME SHARD invalid TO s_new<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check shard names existing in the table as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT table_name, shard_name FROM user_tab_shards WHERE table_name = 'T1';<br><br>TABLE_NAME SHARD_NAME<br>---------- ----------<br>T1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;S1<br>T1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;S2<br>T1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;S3<br><br>3 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16439 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot move shard to the same group**

<a id="f9a58aa2fe28da50"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The shard can not be moved to the same cluster group.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE MOVE SHARD FROM CLUSTER GROUP G1 TO CLUSTER GROUP G1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16439): cannot move shard to the same group :<br>ALTER DATABASE MOVE SHARD FROM CLUSTER GROUP G1 TO CLUSTER GROUP G1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The shard movement in DATABASE unit is allowed between different cluster groups.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16440 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot execute on cluster wide sharded tables**

<a id="cafb18c854cd1e5e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>MOVE SHARD can not be executed for the sharded table created as cluster wide.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY RANGE ( sk )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 MOVE SHARD FROM CLUSTER GROUP g1 TO CLUSTER GROUP g2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16440): cannot execute on cluster wide sharded tables :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 MOVE SHARD FROM CLUSTER GROUP g1 TO CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>MOVE SHARD is allowed for the sharded table whose cluster group was specified as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g2;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 MOVE SHARD FROM CLUSTER GROUP g2 TO CLUSTER GROUP g3;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16441 (SQLSTATE: 42000): not analyzed table**

<a id="a70c2632c67149c4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The table never has been ANALYZEd.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 EXPORT 't1.stat';<br><br>ERR-42000(16441): not analyzed table :<br>ANALYZE TABLE t1 EXPORT 't1.stat'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Execute it after ANALYZE TABLE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1;<br><br>Table analyzed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 EXPORT 't1.stat';<br><br>Table analyzed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16442 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid analyzed file format (%s)**

<a id="a255f785c20bb705"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The analyzed file format is not valid.<br><br>--# result: error<br>ANALYZE TABLE t1 IMPORT 't2.stat';<br><br>ERR-42000(16442): invalid analyzed file format (table mismatch: T1 and T2)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the valid analyzed file.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 IMPORT 't1.stat';<br><br>Table analyzed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16443 (SQLSTATE: 42000): old plan**

<a id="e0b250a4f3c74e88"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error is internally controlled in the server.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16444 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid cluster group name**

<a id="35c1222c8457c696"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The cluster group name which does not exist was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 MOVE SHARD FROM CLUSTER GROUP invalid TO CLUSTER GROUP g2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16444): invalid cluster group name :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 MOVE SHARD FROM CLUSTER GROUP invalid TO CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the valid cluster group name.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 MOVE SHARD FROM CLUSTER GROUP g3 TO CLUSTER GROUP g2;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16445 (SQLSTATE: 42000): REBALANCE EXCLUDE can be executed only on cluster wide sharded tables**

<a id="7b972858a7aa074a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>REBALANCE EXCLUDE statement can not be executed for the group-specific shard table.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g2;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 REBALANCE EXCLUDE CLUSTER GROUP g2<br><br>ERR-42000(16445): REBALANCE EXCLUDE can be executed only on cluster wide sharded tables :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 REBALANCE EXCLUDE CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>REBALANCE EXCLUDE statement can be executed for the cluster-wide shard table as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t2 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t2 REBALANCE EXCLUDE CLUSTER GROUP g2;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16446 (SQLSTATE: 42000): REBALANCE EXCLUDE target group is empty**

<a id="514ebb126ce02b30"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>REBALANCE EXCLUDE can not be executed for all cluster groups.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t2 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 ),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )<br>;<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t2 REBALANCE EXCLUDE CLUSTER GROUP g1, g2, g3;<br><br>ERR-42000(16446): REBALANCE EXCLUDE target group is empty :<br>ALTER TABLE t2 REBALANCE EXCLUDE CLUSTER GROUP g1, g2, g3<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>REBALANCE EXCLUDE can be executed only for some cluster groups.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t2 REBALANCE EXCLUDE CLUSTER GROUP g2;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16447 (SQLSTATE: HY000): internal error ( %s, %d )**

<a id="7d9b7a9eef7b1d93"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This is an error code used within the server.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16448 (SQLSTATE: 42000): of the total '%d' tables, '%d' tables failed to move shard**

<a id="6da6970bbd505f22"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#ddb148eaa7b01843">ALTER DATABASE MOVE SHARD</a>&nbsp;statement fails to move one or more shards.<br><br>The following is an example where the shard movement fails for 1 out of 7 tables:<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE MOVE SHARD FROM CLUSTER GROUP g1 TO CLUSTER GROUP g2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16448): of the total '7' tables, '1' tables failed to move shard<br>Database altered.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the system trace logs to identify and resolve the cause, then execute the statement again.<br><br>The following shows the error messages recorded in the system trace logs when a shard movement fails.<br><br>[2026-03-04 10:58:27.880218 INSTANCE(G1N1) THREAD(50590,140314313557824)] [WARNING]<br>[MOVE SHARD] failed to move shard table 'PUBLIC.T1 - global transaction id(0.124553461858)<br>(G1N1) ERR-HYT00(14026): resource busy or timeout expired</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16449 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cluster group does not have sharded data**

<a id="7f9e8b8de7550673"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when there are no shards to move in the source group while executing the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#ddb148eaa7b01843">ALTER DATABASE MOVE SHARD</a>&nbsp;statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 MOVE SHARD FROM CLUSTER GROUP g1 TO CLUSTER GROUP g2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16449): cluster group does not have sharded data :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 MOVE SHARD FROM CLUSTER GROUP g1 TO CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check which group stores the table’s shards, and then execute the statement again.<br><br>The following shows how to verify the group where a table’s shards are stored.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT group_name, member_name FROM user_tab_place WHERE table_name = 'T1';<br><br>GROUP_NAME MEMBER_NAME<br>---------- -----------<br>G2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;G2N1<br>G2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;G2N2<br>G3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;G3N1<br>G3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;G3N2<br><br>4 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16450 (SQLSTATE: 42000): exceeded global property lock timeout**

<a id="e1dce3aa1219c742"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when multiple sessions attempt to modify a global property simultaneously and the wait time exceeds the configured limit.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Increase the<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#11daa03bc52629e8">GLOBAL_PROPERTY_LOCK_TIMEOUT</a>&nbsp;value and try again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16451 (SQLSTATE: 42000): rownum not allowed here**

<a id="12b19484b69e5598"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>ROWNUM can not be used as DEFAULT value.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER DEFAULT ROWNUM );<br><br>ERR-42000(16451): rownum not allowed here :<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER DEFAULT ROWNUM )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a constant as DEFAULT value as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER DEFAULT 0 );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16452 (SQLSTATE: 42000): rownum not allowed in sensitive cursor**

<a id="f024c8fbc9ab9ce2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>ROWNUM can not be used in the sensitive cursor.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>DECLARE cur1 SENSITIVE SCROLL CURSOR<br>FOR SELECT ROWNUM<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE c1 &gt; 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FOR UPDATE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16452): rownum not allowed in sensitive cursor</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Do not use ROWNUM as a SELECT target when using the sensitive cursor.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>DECLARE cur1 SENSITIVE SCROLL CURSOR<br>FOR SELECT c1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE c1 &gt; 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FOR UPDATE;<br><br>Cursor declared.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16453 (SQLSTATE: 42000): rownum not allowed in positioned UPDATE**

<a id="f91dea0dff6a1627"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>ROWNUM can not be used in UPDATE CURRENT OF cursor statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v1 INTEGER<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>DECLARE cur1 CURSOR<br>FOR SELECT ROWNUM<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE ROWNUM &lt; 4<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FOR UPDATE;<br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.<br><br>gSQL&gt; FETCH cur1 INTO :v1;<br><br>V1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row fetched.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE t1 SET c1 = ROWNUM WHERE CURRENT OF cur1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16453): rownum not allowed in positioned UPDATE</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Do not use ROWNUM in UPDATE CURRENT OF cursor statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE t1 SET c1 = c1 + 10 WHERE CURRENT OF cur1;</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16454 (SQLSTATE: 42000): function '%s' not allowed here**

<a id="5a8f343a5d006b24"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The function can not be used in INSERT RETURN statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( DEFAULT ) RETURN LAST_IDENTITY_VALUE() INTO :v1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16454): function 'LAST_IDENTITY_VALUE' not allowed here :<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( DEFAULT ) RETURN LAST_IDENTITY_VALUE() INTO :v1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Do not use the function in INSERT RETURN statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( DEFAULT ) RETURN c1 INTO :v1;<br><br>V1<br>--<br>10<br><br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16455 (SQLSTATE: 42000): routine "%s.%s" has errors**

<a id="14037368ebceb256"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16456 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the startup phase '%s' of cluster member '%s' is mismatch with the required startup phase '%s'**

<a id="3f4725adb83d9fe1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The startup phase of the cluster member to add is not OPEN.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE CLUSTER GROUP G4 CLUSTER MEMBER G4N1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 14150;<br><br>ERR-42000(16456): the startup phase 'LOCAL OPEN' of cluster member 'G4N1' is mismatch with the required startup phase 'OPEN'</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Shift the startup phase of the cluster member to OPEN.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16457 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the connection map of cluster member '%s' is mismatch with local connection map**

<a id="6fca4d2f53aedb47"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs during the execution of<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#530c2222850ccc1c">ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE</a>&nbsp;when the connection map of the local node does not match that of the remote node.<br>Although this error does not normally occur, it may happen if a remote node stops while the statement is being executed.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>After failover of the affected remote node is completed, try again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16458 (SQLSTATE: 42000): reserved domain cannot be used with other domains**

<a id="d2573f9468e58075"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16459 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot execute on hash sharded tables**

<a id="11b97f62e69ab72d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>MERGE SHARDS statement can not be used in the hash sharded table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE T1( I1 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY HASH( I1 );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS S1, S2 INTO S1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16459): cannot execute on hash sharded tables :<br>ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS S1, S2 INTO S1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>MERGE SHARDS statement can be used in the range/ list sharded table.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16460 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot execute on range sharded tables**

<a id="0ab85c7a1077d1eb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16461 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid shard values**

<a id="39d7be0013364558"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>IN shard value was used when executing SPLIT SHARD for the range sharded table.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g2;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>ALTER TABLE t1 SPLIT SHARD s2 INTO<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES IN ( 50 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP G3<br>);<br><br>ERR-42000(16461): invalid shard values :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES IN ( 50 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP G3<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use LESS THAN shard value as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SPLIT SHARD s2 INTO<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP G3<br>);<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16462 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot split shard - source shard cannot be empty**

<a id="3ce8ec37a1fd8910"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>IN shard value of the source shard becomes empty when executing SPLIT.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY LIST (sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( 1,2 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g2;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>ALTER TABLE t1 SPLIT SHARD s1 INTO<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD S1_1&nbsp;&nbsp;VALUES IN ( 1 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD S1_2&nbsp;&nbsp;VALUES IN ( 2 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>);<br><br>ERR-42000(16462): cannot split shard - source shard cannot be empty :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 SPLIT SHARD s1 INTO<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>SPLIT as follows so that IN shard value of the source shard exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>ALTER TABLE t1 SPLIT SHARD s1 INTO<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD S1_2&nbsp;&nbsp;VALUES IN ( 2 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>);<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16463 (SQLSTATE: 42000): first CREATE CLUSTER GROUP must include only one cluster member**

<a id="f030e97691303d31"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>When creating the initial cluster group to create the cluster system, it can includes only its own cluster member.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE CLUSTER GROUP g1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLUSTER MEMBER g1n1 HOST '192.168.0.101' PORT 11000,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLUSTER MEMBER g1n2 HOST '192.168.0.102' PORT 12000;<br><br>ERR-42000(16463): first CREATE CLUSTER GROUP must include only one cluster member</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Include only its own cluster member when creating the initial cluster group as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE CLUSTER GROUP g1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLUSTER MEMBER g1n1 HOST '192.168.0.101' PORT 11000;<br><br>Cluster Group created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16464 (SQLSTATE: HY000): unsupported feature with temporary table**

<a id="502abc8bde0829b9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This feature can not be used in the global temporary table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 PCTFREE 100;<br><br>ERR-HY000(16464): unsupported feature with temporary table :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 PCTFREE 100<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>The storage option can not be used for the global temporary table.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16465 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot drop local cluster group**

<a id="0166a1539dbc83b2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The currently connected cluster group can not be DROPped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP CLUSTER GROUP g1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16465): cannot drop local cluster group :<br>DROP CLUSTER GROUP g1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the currently connected cluster group.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT local_group_name() FROM dual;<br><br>LOCAL_GROUP_NAME()<br>------------------<br>G1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16466 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot execute with SERIALIZABLE**

<a id="23e505a27c727511"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>REBALANCE can not be executed in ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE mode.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET SESSION CHARACTERISTICS AS TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE;<br><br>Session set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE T1 REBALANCE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16466): cannot execute with SERIALIZABLE</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Shift ISOLATION LEVEL to READ COMMITTED, then execute it.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET SESSION CHARACTERISTICS AS TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;<br><br>Session set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 REBALANCE;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16467 (SQLSTATE: 42000): table '%s' is READ ONLY**

<a id="7c1259290a26cfc1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DML can not be execute for READ ONLY table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 READ ONLY;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>ERR-42000(16467): table 'T1' is READ ONLY :<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Shift it to READ WRITE, then execute DML.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 READ WRITE;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16468 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot create TEMPORARY object in a NON-TEMPORARY tablespace '%s'**

<a id="ea535b9092613b60"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The global temporary table can not be created in the data tablespace.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs;<br><br>ERR-HY000(16468): cannot create TEMPORARY object in a NON-TEMPORARY tablespace 'MEM_DATA_TBS' :<br>CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) TABLESPACE mem_data_tbs<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The global temporary table should be created in the temporary tablespace.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER ) TABLESPACE mem_temp_tbs;<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16469 (SQLSTATE: 0A000): cannot execute on global connection**

<a id="1f8d610bfd092e82"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The global temporary table can not be used in the global connection environment.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>ERR-0A000(16469): cannot execute on global connection</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>For more information about constraints for the global connection, refer to<a href="../part-05-developer-manual/33-database-connection.md#8ac9a6385910102d">Constraints</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16470 (SQLSTATE: 42000): datafile size specified is smaller than minimum required '%ld'**

<a id="318d5234886bae95"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The size of tablespace datafile is out of the range.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLESPACE TEST_TBS DATAFILE 'TEST_TBS.dbf'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SIZE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1M<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXTSIZE 1048576;<br><br>ERR-RD000(16080): file size is out of range( 4194304 to 32212254720 ) :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SIZE&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1M<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The size of tablespace datafile should be 4M ~ 32G.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16471 (SQLSTATE: 42000): audit policy '%s' does not exists**

<a id="2ce05e0f7dc2cd03"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The audit policy does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; AUDIT POLICY invalid;<br><br>ERR-42000(16471): audit policy 'INVALID' does not exists :<br>AUDIT POLICY invalid<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check if the audit policy exists as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT policy_name FROM audit_policies;<br><br>POLICY_NAME<br>-----------<br>P1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16472 (SQLSTATE: 42000): audit policy cannot be dropped as it is currently enabled**

<a id="d1c4b2b8912cebe6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The currently activated audit policy can not be DROPped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; AUDIT POLICY p1;<br><br>Audit succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP AUDIT POLICY p1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16472): audit policy cannot be dropped as it is currently enabled :<br>DROP AUDIT POLICY p1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Deactivate it, then DROP it as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; NOAUDIT POLICY p1;<br><br>Noaudit succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP AUDIT POLICY p1;<br><br>Audit Policy dropped.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16473 (SQLSTATE: 42000): audit policy '%s' already exists**

<a id="b55c96303c913b74"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The audit policy object already exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE AUDIT POLICY p1 ACTIONS CREATE TABLE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16473): audit policy 'P1' already exists :<br>CREATE AUDIT POLICY p1 ACTIONS CREATE TABLE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check if the audit policy object exists as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT policy_name FROM audit_policies;<br><br>POLICY_NAME<br>-----------<br>P1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16474 (SQLSTATE: 42000): not auditable option**

<a id="e247e8fb38370efa"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The privilege can not be used for the privilege audit.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE AUDIT POLICY p1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PRIVILEGES CREATE SESSION<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16474): not auditable option :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PRIVILEGES CREATE SESSION<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Only the database privilege is allowed as PRIVILEGES audit option as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE AUDIT POLICY p1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PRIVILEGES SELECT ANY TABLE<br>;<br><br>Audit Policy created.<br><br>View the database privilege which can audit as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT privilege_name FROM v$auditable_db_privileges;<br><br>PRIVILEGE_NAME<br>-----------------<br>ADMINISTRATION<br>ALTER DATABASE<br>...<br>...<br>...<br>EXECUTE ANY LIBRARY<br><br>55 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16475 (SQLSTATE: 42000): audit policy already applied with the BY clause**

<a id="50aba93416068a6a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The audit policy is already activated with BY user.<br><br>gSQL&gt; AUDIT POLICY p1 BY u1;<br><br>Audit succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; AUDIT POLICY p1 EXCEPT u1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16475): audit policy already applied with the BY clause</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Deactivate the audit policy with BY user, then activate it with EXCEPT user as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; NOAUDIT POLICY p1 BY u1;<br><br>Noaudit succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; AUDIT POLICY p1 EXCEPT u1;<br><br>Audit succeeded.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16476 (SQLSTATE: 42000): audit policy already applied with the EXCEPT clause**

<a id="95e1cc56e62cd934"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The audit policy is already activated with EXCEPT user.<br><br>gSQL&gt; AUDIT POLICY p1 EXCEPT u1;<br><br>Audit succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; AUDIT POLICY p1 BY u1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16476): audit policy already applied with the EXCEPT clause</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Deactivate the audit policy without BY/EXCEPT option, then activate it with BY user as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; NOAUDIT POLICY p1;<br><br>Noaudit succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; AUDIT POLICY p1 BY u1;<br><br>Audit succeeded.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16477 (SQLSTATE: 42000): not auditable object**

<a id="48077a37572b8e58"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is not an auditable object.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE AUDIT POLICY p1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ACTIONS ALL ON X$SESSION<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16477): not auditable object :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ACTIONS ALL ON X$SESSION<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Only the table created by the user is auditable.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE AUDIT POLICY p1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ACTIONS ALL ON t1<br>;<br><br>Audit Policy created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16478 (SQLSTATE: 42000): tablespace '%s' is not temporary tablespace or data tablespace**

<a id="0d7b801cf0288d54"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The specified tablespace can not be used as INDEX TABLESPACE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER u1 INDEX TABLESPACE mem_undo_tbs;<br><br>ERR-42000(16478): tablespace 'MEM_UNDO_TBS' is not temporary tablespace or data tablespace :<br>ALTER USER u1 INDEX TABLESPACE mem_undo_tbs<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Specify the temporary tablespace or the data tablespace as INDEX TABLESPACE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER USER u1 INDEX TABLESPACE mem_temp_tbs;<br><br>User altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16479 (SQLSTATE: 42000): failed to update system version - %s**

<a id="0017f55081029558"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when the configured wait time is exceeded while multiple sessions attempt to update the system version simultaneously.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The system version is increased to notify clients using global connections of changes to the cluster topology.<br>If global connections are in use, the system version can be manually increased using the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#6d31ea4bd1cf3aeb">ALTER SYSTEM RECONNECT GLOBAL CONNECTION</a>&nbsp;statement.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16480 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot set irrecoverable on the local cluster member**

<a id="f043034860e7e0cb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the specified member name is the same as the local member while executing the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#18dcad89aa3a6231">ALTER SYSTEM IRRECOVERABLE CLUSTER MEMBER</a>&nbsp;statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT local_member_name() FROM dual;<br><br>LOCAL_MEMBER_NAME()<br>-------------------<br>G1N1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM IRRECOVERABLE CLUSTER MEMBER g1n1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16480): cannot set irrecoverable on the local cluster member :<br>ALTER SYSTEM IRRECOVERABLE CLUSTER MEMBER g1n1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Verify the member name to be specified, and then execute the statement again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16481 (SQLSTATE: 42000): global tempoary table segment no longer exists**

<a id="52b3359da37a0345"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16482 (SQLSTATE: 42R02): database is not accessible; '%s' has detached from the cluster**

<a id="a4db56edc3b27e95"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The currently connected member (G3N3) is away from cluster system.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-42R02(16482): database is not accessible; 'G3N3' has detached from the cluster<br>ERR-42R01(16357): must be accessible to at least one member of group 'G1'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Join the cluster member (G3N3) to the cluster system.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16483 (SQLSTATE: 42000): of the total '%d' sequences, '%d' sequences failed to synchronize**

<a id="4f867ead58abf6f2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs during node addition or node join operations and indicates the number of sequence synchronization objects that failed.<br>Most failures are caused by concurrency issues due to locks.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Execute the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#8e0788c3012778c5">ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE SEQUENCE</a>&nbsp;statement repeatedly until all sequences are successfully synchronized.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16484 (SQLSTATE: 42000): of the total '%d' identity columns, '%d' identity columns failed to synchronize**

<a id="0aec130cfc4678ba"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs during node addition or join operations and indicates the number of identity columns that failed to synchronize.<br>Most failures are caused by concurrency issues due to locks.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Execute the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#8e0788c3012778c5">ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE SEQUENCE</a>&nbsp;statement repeatedly until all identity columns are successfully synchronized.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16485 (SQLSTATE: 42000): table '%s' does not have an identity column**

<a id="29258e1f06ce8bf3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The table does not have an identity column.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t2 SYNCHRONIZE IDENTITY COLUMN;<br><br>ERR-42000(16485): table '%s' does not have an identity column :<br>ALTER TABLE t2 SYNCHRONIZE IDENTITY COLUMN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check which table has an identity column as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT table_name, column_name FROM user_tab_identity_cols;<br><br>TABLE_NAME COLUMN_NAME<br>---------- -----------<br>T1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SYNCHRONIZE IDENTITY COLUMN;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16486 (SQLSTATE: RD000): maximum file size is out of range( %ld to %ld )**

<a id="98e303ad0809a8dd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It exceeds the maximum file size.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE DISK TABLESPACE DISK_TBS DATAFILE 'DISK_TBS.dbf' SIZE 10M AUTOEXTEND ON MAXSIZE 31G;<br><br>ERR-RD000(16486): maximum file size is out of range( 4194304 to 32212254720 ) :<br>CREATE DISK TABLESPACE DISK_TBS DATAFILE 'DISK_TBS.dbf' SIZE 10M AUTOEXTEND ON MAXSIZE 31G<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The file size should be set within the range (4M ~ 30G ).</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16487 (SQLSTATE: 42000): only range sharded table is allowed**

<a id="67f3b2ff2b81195a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>MERGE SHARDS start_shard_name TO end_shard_name statement can not be used in the list sharded table.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY LIST(sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES IN ( 101, 201 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES IN ( 102, 202 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES IN ( 103, 203 ) AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s4 VALUES IN ( DEFAULT )&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1 TO s2 INTO s5 AT CLUSTER GROUP g3;<br><br>ERR-42000(16487): only range sharded table is allowed :<br>ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1 TO s2 INTO s5 AT CLUSTER GROUP g3<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>MERGE SHARDS start_shard_name TO end_shard_name statement can be used in the range sharded table.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE(sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( 300 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s4 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1 TO s2 INTO s5 AT CLUSTER GROUP g3;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16488 (SQLSTATE: 42000): shards being merged are not adjacent**

<a id="0cb409ba1c8ce2dc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Shards which are not adjacent can not be merged.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE(sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( 300 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s4 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1, s3 INTO s5 AT CLUSTER GROUP g3;<br><br>ERR-42000(16488): shards being merged are not adjacent :<br>ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1, s3 INTO s5 AT CLUSTER GROUP g3<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Merge shards which are adjacent as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1, s2, s3 INTO s5 AT CLUSTER GROUP g3;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16489 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cluster group name must be specified**

<a id="c6e4217f1da66cd9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The cluster group name is not specified.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE(sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( 300 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s4 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1, s2 INTO s5;<br><br>ERR-42000(16489): cluster group name must be specified :<br>ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1, s2 INTO s5<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Specify the cluster group name as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1, s2 INTO s5 AT CLUSTER GROUP g3;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16490 (SQLSTATE: 42000): mismatch the group name of the source shard '%s'**

<a id="c92e695bf8725400"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>When the identical shards were used in the source shard and the destine shard, the cluster group name of the shard was described differently.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( sk INTEGER, c2 INTEGER )<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE(sk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s1 VALUES LESS THAN ( 100 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s2 VALUES LESS THAN ( 200 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s3 VALUES LESS THAN ( 300 )&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s4 VALUES LESS THAN ( MAXVALUE )&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1, s2 INTO s2 AT CLUSTER GROUP g2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16490): mismatch the group name of the source shard 'S2' :<br>ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1, s2 INTO s2 AT CLUSTER GROUP g2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>If the identical shards were used in the source shard and the destine shard, then cluster group name of the shard should be described.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE T1 MERGE SHARDS s1, s2 INTO s2 AT CLUSTER GROUP g1;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16491 (SQLSTATE: 42000): exceed the maximum number of shards (%d)**

<a id="d4a6f1613b06073c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It exceeds the maximum number of shards.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE TABLE t1<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c1 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER<br>)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARDING BY RANGE (c1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AT CLUSTER WIDE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s0001 VALUES LESS THAN (10001),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s0002 VALUES LESS THAN (10002),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s0003 VALUES LESS THAN (10003),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s0004 VALUES LESS THAN (10004),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;...<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;...<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;...<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s0510 VALUES LESS THAN (10510),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s0511 VALUES LESS THAN (10511),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s0512 VALUES LESS THAN (10512),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s0513 VALUES LESS THAN (MAXVALUE)<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16491): exceed the maximum number of shards (512) :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SHARD s0513 VALUES LESS THAN (MAXVALUE)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 520:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The maximum number of shards to define is 512.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16492 (SQLSTATE: 42000): can not perform DDL/DML over objects in Recycle Bin**

<a id="118d1808a824441b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>gSQL&gt; create table t1 ( c1 integer ) ;<br><br><br>Table created.<br><br><br>gSQL&gt; drop table t1;<br><br><br>Table dropped.<br><br><br>gSQL&gt; select OBJECT_NAME, ORIGINAL_NAME from dba_recyclebin;<br><br><br>OBJECT_NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ORIGINAL_NAME<br>------------------------------------ -------------<br>BIN$A202F0C6E59611EE8E17DF67981EB0BF T1<br><br><br>1 row selected.<br><br><br>gSQL&gt; drop table BIN$A202F0C6E59611EE8E17DF67981EB0BF;<br><br><br>ERR-42000(16492): can not perform DDL/DML over objects in Recycle Bin :<br>drop table BIN$A202F0C6E59611EE8E17DF67981EB0BF<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>OBJECT stored in the recycle bin can not perform DDL/DML. Recover it by using FLASHBACK TABLE statement, then perform DDL/DML.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16493 (SQLSTATE: 42000): object not in Recycle Bin**

<a id="c39baee261f153c7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>gSQL&gt; select OBJECT_NAME, ORIGINAL_NAME from dba_recyclebin;<br><br>OBJECT_NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ORIGINAL_NAME<br>------------------------------------ -------------<br>BIN$A202F0C6E59611EE8E17DF67981EB0BF T1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; purge table t2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16493): object not in Recycle Bin :<br>purge table t2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br><br>gSQL&gt; flashback table t2 to before drop;<br><br>ERR-42000(16493): object not in Recycle Bin :<br>flashback table t2 to before drop<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the correct OBJECT NAME when dropping or recovering OBJECT stored in the recycle bin.<br><br>gSQL&gt; purge table t1;<br><br>Table purged.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16494 (SQLSTATE: 42000): original name is used by an existing object**

<a id="8c939c2bfb962e9f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>gSQL&gt; select OBJECT_NAME, ORIGINAL_NAME from dba_recyclebin;<br><br>OBJECT_NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ORIGINAL_NAME<br>------------------------------------ -------------<br>BIN$9D8ADDDAE59911EE8E17DF67981EB0BF T1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; create table t1 ( c1 integer ) ;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; flashback table t1 to before drop;<br><br>ERR-42000(16494): original name is used by an existing object :<br>flashback table t1 to before drop<br>*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>This error occurs if the duplicate name OBJECT exists when recovering OBJECT stored in the recycle bin.<br>gSQL&gt; flashback table t1 to before drop rename to t2;<br><br>Flashback complete.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16495 (SQLSTATE: HY000): package or package body does not exist**

<a id="eea15366a0bea364"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The package does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP PACKAGE invalid;<br><br>ERR-42000(16495): package or package body does not exist :<br>DROP PACKAGE invalid<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the existing package as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT object_name FROM user_objects WHERE object_type = 'PACKAGE';<br><br>OBJECT_NAME<br>-----------<br>PKG1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16496 (SQLSTATE: 42000): built-in package '%s' is not modifiable**

<a id="a6cb5a2ec1ddc675"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16497 (SQLSTATE: 42000): lacks privilege (EXECUTE ON PACKAGE "%s"."%s")**

<a id="fce66e25cc7e115f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The user does not have EXECUTE ON PACKAGE privilege.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT pkg1.func1(100) FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-42000(16497): lacks privilege (EXECUTE ON PACKAGE "PUBLIC"."PKG1") :<br>SELECT pkg1.func1(100) FROM dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT current_user FROM dual;<br><br>CURRENT_USER<br>------------<br>U1<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The package owner should grant the privilege to the user.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT EXECUTE ON PACKAGE "PUBLIC"."PKG1" TO u1;<br><br>Grant succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \connect u1 u1<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT current_user FROM dual;<br><br>CURRENT_USER<br>------------<br>U1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT pkg1.func1(100) FROM dual;<br><br>PKG1.FUNC1(100)<br>---------------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;100<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16498 (SQLSTATE: 42000): Only Btree indexes can be rebuilt**

<a id="a2b17dc35303dcb2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when the INDEX REBUILD statement is used on a global temporary index.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE INDEX t1_idx ON t1 ( c1 );<br><br>Index created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER INDEX t1_idx REBUILD;<br><br>ERR-42000(16498): Only Btree indexes can be rebuilt :<br>ALTER INDEX t1_idx REBUILD<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Global temporary indexes do not support the REBUILD statement.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16499 (SQLSTATE: 42000): operation is not allowed on immutable table '%s'**

<a id="350277ef11d25b17"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The statement is not executable for the immutable table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE IMMUTABLE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DELETE FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16499): operation is not allowed on immutable table 'T1' :<br>DELETE FROM t1 WHERE c1 = 1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Only INSERT is allowed for the immutable table.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16500 (SQLSTATE: 0A000): cannot execute on global session**

<a id="beab2e19e9f2dbb8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DDL is not executable in the client of the global session.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>ERR-0A000(16500): cannot execute on global session</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>For more information about constraints for the global connection and the global session, refer to<a href="../part-05-developer-manual/33-database-connection.md#8ac9a6385910102d">Constraint</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16501 (SQLSTATE: 42000): size of log file is larger than maximum size of log file(%ld bytes).**

<a id="c78718f6deb1b932"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the value specified in the SIZE clause exceeds 1 terabyte while executing the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#d2062ac468f12d4a">ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE GROUP</a>&nbsp;statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE ADD LOGFILE GROUP 4 ( 'redo_4_0.log' ) SIZE 2T REUSE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16501): size of log file is larger than maximum size of log file(1099511627776 bytes).</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Set the SIZE clause to a value less than 1 terabyte, and then execute the statement again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16502 (SQLSTATE: 42000): recursive WITH clause must reference itself directly in one of the UNION ALL branches**

<a id="1be10eb355c1ae03"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The recursive WITH clause was described wrongly.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>WITH w1 ( w_emp, w_mgr ) AS<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNION<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1, w1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE t1.mgr = w1.w_emp<br>)<br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16502): recursive WITH clause must reference itself directly in one of the UNION ALL branches :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Describe it with UNION ALL as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; WITH w1 ( w_emp, w_mgr ) AS<br><br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNION ALL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1, w1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE t1.mgr = w1.w_emp<br>)<br><br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br><br>W_EMP W_MGR<br>----- -----<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;null<br>park&nbsp;&nbsp;kim<br>choi&nbsp;&nbsp;kim<br>tom&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;park<br><br>4 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16503 (SQLSTATE: 42000): recursive WITH clause must reference itself in the last UNION ALL branch**

<a id="19cc2366c61b0783"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16504 (SQLSTATE: 42000): recursive WITH clause must use UNION ALL operation**

<a id="de474e3f35c7a328"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16505 (SQLSTATE: 42000): recursive WITH clause must have column alias list**

<a id="ec68f2773bab6c70"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>A column alias should be described in the recursive WITH clause.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>WITH w1 AS<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNION ALL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT t1.emp, t1.mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1, w1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE t1.mgr = w1.emp<br>)<br><br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br>ERR-42000(16505): recursive WITH clause must have column alias list :<br>WITH w1 AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Describe the column alias in the query name (w1) as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>WITH w1(emp, mgr) AS<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNION ALL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT t1.emp, t1.mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1, w1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE t1.mgr = w1.emp<br>)<br><br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br><br>EMP&nbsp;&nbsp;MGR<br>---- ----<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;null<br>park kim<br>choi kim<br>tom&nbsp;&nbsp;park<br><br>4 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16506 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unsupported join in recursive WITH query**

<a id="e3984f6e26d3a67e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>LEFT OUTER JOIN can not be used in the recursive query part of the recursive WITH clause.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>WITH w1(emp, mgr) AS<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNION ALL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT t1.emp, t1.mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;w1 ON t1.mgr = w1.emp<br>)<br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16506): unsupported join in recursive WITH query :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;w1 ON t1.mgr = w1.emp<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 9:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use INNER JOIN in the recursive query part of the recursive WITH clause.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>WITH w1(emp, mgr) AS<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNION ALL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT t1.emp, t1.mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1, w1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE t1.mgr = w1.emp<br>)<br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br><br>EMP&nbsp;&nbsp;MGR<br>---- ----<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;null<br>park kim<br>choi kim<br>tom&nbsp;&nbsp;park<br><br>4 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16509 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unsupported operation in recursive branch of recursive WITH clause**

<a id="4ec82ea9455fda70"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>GROUP BY can not be used in the recursive query part of the recursive WITH clause.<br><br>gSQL&gt; WITH w1(emp, mgr) AS<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNION ALL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT t1.emp, MAX(t1.mgr)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1, w1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE t1.mgr = w1.emp<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;GROUP BY t1.emp<br>)<br><br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16509): unsupported operation in recursive branch of recursive WITH clause :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;GROUP BY t1.emp<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 10:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Drop GROUP BY and DISTINCT as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>WITH w1(emp, mgr) AS<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNION ALL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT t1.emp, t1.mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1, w1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE t1.mgr = w1.emp<br>)<br><br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br><br>EMP&nbsp;&nbsp;MGR<br>---- ----<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;null<br>park kim<br>choi kim<br>tom&nbsp;&nbsp;park<br><br>4 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16511 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cycle detected while executing recursive WITH query**

<a id="4699d2a89d7d25e2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>cycle was detected while executing the recursive WITH clause.<br><br>gSQL&gt; WITH w1(emp, mgr) AS<br><br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNION ALL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT t1.emp, t1.mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1, w1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE t1.mgr = w1.emp<br>)<br><br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16511): cycle detected while executing recursive WITH query</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use CYCLE clause as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; WITH w1(emp, mgr) AS<br><br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNION ALL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT t1.emp, t1.mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1, w1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE t1.mgr = w1.emp<br>) CYCLE emp, mgr SET w_cycle TO 'T' DEFAULT 'F'<br><br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br><br>EMP&nbsp;&nbsp;MGR&nbsp;&nbsp;W_CYCLE<br>---- ---- -------<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;null F<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;tom&nbsp;&nbsp;F<br>park kim&nbsp;&nbsp;F<br>choi kim&nbsp;&nbsp;F<br>park kim&nbsp;&nbsp;F<br>choi kim&nbsp;&nbsp;F<br>tom&nbsp;&nbsp;park F<br>tom&nbsp;&nbsp;park F<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;tom&nbsp;&nbsp;F<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;tom&nbsp;&nbsp;T<br>park kim&nbsp;&nbsp;T<br>choi kim&nbsp;&nbsp;F<br><br>12 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16512 (SQLSTATE: 42000): CONNECT BY clause required in this query block**

<a id="dcf62cb3cdc42f7f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>LEVEL is a hierarchy function which is used together with CONNECT BY clause.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT emp, mgr, LEVEL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16512): CONNECT BY clause required in this query block :<br>SELECT emp, mgr, LEVEL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>SELECT emp, mgr, LEVEL<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;START WITH emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;CONNECT BY mgr = PRIOR emp<br>;<br><br>EMP&nbsp;&nbsp;MGR&nbsp;&nbsp;LEVEL<br>---- ---- -----<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>choi kim&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2<br>park kim&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2<br>tom&nbsp;&nbsp;park&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3<br><br>4 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16513 (SQLSTATE: 42000): hierarchy function not allowed here**

<a id="ed1a6681961b2896"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The hierarchy function can not be used in SELECT target together with PRIOR.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT emp, mgr, PRIOR SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH( emp, '/' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;START WITH emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;CONNECT BY mgr = PRIOR emp<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16513): hierarchy function not allowed here :<br>SELECT emp, mgr, PRIOR SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH( emp, '/' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Drop PRIOR as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT emp, mgr, SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH( emp, '/' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;START WITH emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;CONNECT BY mgr = PRIOR emp<br>;<br><br>EMP&nbsp;&nbsp;MGR&nbsp;&nbsp;SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH( EMP, '/' )<br>---- ---- -------------------------------<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;null /kim<br>choi kim&nbsp;&nbsp;/kim/choi<br>park kim&nbsp;&nbsp;/kim/park<br>tom&nbsp;&nbsp;park /kim/park/tom<br><br>4 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16514 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cycle detected while executing CONNECT BY Clause**

<a id="cbb6dec52027cfcc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>cycle was detected while executing CONNECT BY.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;START WITH emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;CONNECT BY mgr = PRIOR emp<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16511): cycle detected while executing recursive WITH query</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use NOCYCLE option as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT emp, mgr<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;START WITH emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;CONNECT BY NOCYCLE mgr = PRIOR emp<br>;<br><br>EMP&nbsp;&nbsp;MGR<br>---- ----<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;null<br>choi kim<br>park kim<br>tom&nbsp;&nbsp;park<br><br>4 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="3a320aa322d7a527"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The global secondary index is required to execute the non-deterministic DML.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( id INTEGER ) SHARDING BY(id) WITHOUT GLOBAL SECONDARY INDEX;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DELETE FROM t1 LIMIT 3;<br><br>ERR-42000(16519): global secondary index expected in cluster DML</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Add a global secondary index, then execute it as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD GLOBAL SECONDARY INDEX;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DELETE FROM t1 LIMIT 3;<br><br>no rows deleted.</td></tr></tbody></table>

9<br>&nbsp;ORDER BY member_position<br>;<br><br>MEMBER_NAME MEMBER_POSITION<br>----------- ---------------<br>G1N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0<br>G1N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>G2N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2<br>G2N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3<br>G3N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4<br>G3N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;5<br>null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;6<br>G4N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;7<br>null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;8<br><br>9 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>ALTER CLUSTER GROUP g4 ADD<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLUSTER MEMBER g4n1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 14150 POSITION 6;<br><br>Cluster Group altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>
