> **16524 (SQLSTATE: 42000): package specification '%s' does not exist. package body requires its package specification**

<a id="848d3f1749190f95"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The package specification is not valid, so the package body can not be compiled.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE PACKAGE pkg1<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 t1.c1%TYPE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FUNCTION f1 RETURN INTEGER;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Package created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE PACKAGE BODY pkg1<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FUNCTION f1 RETURN INTEGER<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN v1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Package created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP TABLE t1;<br><br>Table dropped.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER PACKAGE pkg1 COMPILE BODY;<br><br>ERR-2F000(17102): PACKAGE(PKG1) Body has compilation errors :<br>(1) : ERR-42000(16524): Cannot compile package body of 'PUBLIC.PKG1' without its specification<br>Package altered.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Correct the cause of the package specification error, then compile the package body.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER PACKAGE pkg1 COMPILE BODY;<br><br>Package altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16525 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate name found in WITH name list for WITH clause**

<a id="53276dd40a530106"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The duplicate WITH name was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>WITH w1 AS ( SELECT name FROM t1 WHERE id = 1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, w1 AS ( SELECT name FROM t1 WHERE id = 2 )<br>SELECT name FROM w1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16525): duplicate name found in WITH name list for WITH clause :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, w1 AS ( SELECT name FROM t1 WHERE id = 2 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Modify it so that duplicate WITH names do not exist as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>WITH w1 AS ( SELECT name FROM t1 WHERE id = 1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, w2 AS ( SELECT name FROM t1 WHERE id = 2 )<br>SELECT name FROM w1;<br><br>NAME<br>----<br>kim<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16539 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cycle value for CYCLE clause must be different from the non-cycle value**

<a id="7a938057ba38a82c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The cycle value and the non-cycle value are same.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>WITH w1 ( emp, mgr ) AS<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNION ALL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT t1.emp, t1.mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1, w1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE t1.mgr = w1.emp<br>) CYCLE emp, mgr SET cyc TO 'O' DEFAULT 'O'<br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16539): cycle value for CYCLE clause must be different from the non-cycle value :<br>) CYCLE emp, mgr SET cyc TO 'O' DEFAULT 'O'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 10:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use different mark values as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>WITH w1 ( emp, mgr ) AS<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT emp, mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE emp = 'kim'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UNION ALL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT t1.emp, t1.mgr<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1, w1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE t1.mgr = w1.emp<br>) CYCLE emp, mgr SET cyc TO 'O' DEFAULT 'X'<br>SELECT * FROM w1;<br><br>EMP&nbsp;&nbsp;MGR&nbsp;&nbsp;CYC<br>---- ---- ---<br>kim&nbsp;&nbsp;null X<br>park kim&nbsp;&nbsp;X<br>choi kim&nbsp;&nbsp;X<br>tom&nbsp;&nbsp;park X<br><br>4 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16540 (SQLSTATE: 42000): multiple WITH clauses not allowed**

<a id="fb4bdfedda228484"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>WITH clause can not be used multiple times.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>WITH w1 AS ( SELECT emp, mgr FROM t1 )<br>(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;WITH w2 AS ( SELECT emp, mgr FROM w1 WHERE emp = 'park' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT * FROM w2<br>);<br><br>ERR-42000(16540): multiple WITH clauses not allowed :<br>WITH w1 AS ( SELECT emp, mgr FROM t1 )<br>*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>List query names in order in a single WITH clause as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>WITH w1 AS ( SELECT emp, mgr FROM t1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, w2 AS ( SELECT emp, mgr FROM w1 WHERE emp = 'park' )<br>SELECT * FROM w2;<br><br>EMP&nbsp;&nbsp;MGR<br>---- ---<br>park kim<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16541 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot affect row a second time**

<a id="a568688ec0d3f890"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>A row is UPDATEd twice when upserting.<br><br>DROP TABLE t1;<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER UNIQUE );<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br>COMMIT;<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1;<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 ), ( 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SET c1 = c1 + 1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16541): cannot affect row a second time</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Prevent a row from being affected twice as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SET c1 = c1 + 1;<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SET c1 = c1 + 1;<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1;<br><br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;2<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16542 (SQLSTATE: 42000): upsert not allowed for the row that caused more than one unique constraint violation**

<a id="1d49b3880d8c35b2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>An upsert which causes two or more unique violations is not allowed.<br><br>DROP TABLE t1;<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER UNIQUE , c2 INTEGER UNIQUE );<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 1 );<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 2, 2 );<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 3, 3 );<br>COMMIT;<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1;<br><br>C1 C2<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;2<br>&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;3<br><br>3 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 2 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SET c1 = c1 + 1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16542): upsert not allowed for the row that caused more than one unique constraint violation</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Do not cause two or more unique violations.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 3, 4 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SET c1 = c1 + 1;<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1;<br><br>C1 C2<br>-- --<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;2<br>&nbsp;4&nbsp;&nbsp;3<br><br>3 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16543 (SQLSTATE: 42000): upsert is not allowed for the table with a deferrable constraint (%s.%s)**

<a id="9c977d3bac0ddba5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The upsert statement is not executable while the constraint is set to DEFERRED.<br><br>DROP TABLE t1;<br>CREATE TABLE t1 ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE, cnt INTEGER );<br>INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 1 );<br>COMMIT;<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET CONSTRAINTS ALL DEFERRED;<br><br>Constraints set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SET cnt = cnt + 1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16543): upsert is not allowed for the table with a deferrable constraint (PUBLIC.T1_PRIMARY_KEY)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Set the constraint to IMMEDIATE, then execute it.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET CONSTRAINTS ALL IMMEDIATE;<br><br>Constraints set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1, 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SET cnt = cnt + 1;<br><br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16544 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: Package '%s.%s' has compilation errors**

<a id="a7fc9b9b9cbbfe4f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16545 (SQLSTATE: 42R02): cloned table "%s"."%s" must have at least one online usable replica**

<a id="f6b9402896e1c2f0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs in a table of type CLONED when all replicas are in the OFFLINE state and an inactive member exists. Executing the following statements under this condition results in an error.<br><ul><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#a3601304aac063fd">ALTER DATABASE DROP INACTIVE CLUSTER MEMBERS</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#ced91e1b7d9f491d">ALTER TABLE name DROP OFFLINE SEGMENTS</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#bc55498003b53106">ALTER TABLE name SYNCHRONIZE</a></li></ul><br>The following example shows a case in a 2×2 cluster where all replicas are OFFLINE and an inactive member exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT map.group_id, map.member_id, map.is_offline<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM table_member_map@local map,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;definition_schema.tables@local tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE map.table_id = tbl.table_id AND tbl.table_name = 'T1'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;5&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ORDER BY 1, 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;6 ;<br><br>GROUP_ID MEMBER_ID IS_OFFLINE<br>-------- --------- ----------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 TRUE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 TRUE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3 TRUE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4 TRUE<br><br>4 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT member_id, STATUS FROM v$cluster_member@local;<br><br>MEMBER_ID STATUS<br>--------- --------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4 INACTIVE<br><br>4 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SYNCHRONIZE;<br><br>ERR-42R02(16545): cloned table "PUBLIC"."T1" must have at least one online usable replica</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">The ALTER TABLE name SYNCHRONIZE statement fails because an inactive member is present. Add all inactive members back to the cluster and then try again.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT local_member_id() FROM dual;<br><br>LOCAL_MEMBER_ID()<br>-----------------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT member_id, STATUS FROM v$cluster_member@local;<br><br>MEMBER_ID STATUS<br>--------- ------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4 ACTIVE<br><br>4 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SYNCHRONIZE;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16546 (SQLSTATE: 42R02): sharded table "%s"."%s" must have at least one online usable replica of group '%s'**

<a id="5a07e8284f3780f8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs in a table of type SHARDED when all replicas in a specific group are in the OFFLINE state and an inactive member exists within the group. Executing the following statements under this condition results in an error.<br><ul><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#a3601304aac063fd">ALTER DATABASE DROP INACTIVE CLUSTER MEMBERS</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#ced91e1b7d9f491d">ALTER TABLE name DROP OFFLINE SEGMENTS</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#bc55498003b53106">ALTER TABLE name SYNCHRONIZE</a></li></ul><br>The following example shows a case in a 2×2 cluster where all replicas in g2 are OFFLINE and an inactive member exists in the group.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT map.group_id, map.member_id, map.is_offline<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM table_member_map@local map,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;definition_schema.tables@local tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE map.table_id = tbl.table_id AND tbl.table_name = 'T1'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;5&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ORDER BY 1, 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;6 ;<br><br>GROUP_ID MEMBER_ID IS_OFFLINE<br>-------- --------- ----------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 FALSE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 FALSE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3 TRUE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4 TRUE<br><br>4 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT group_id, member_id, STATUS FROM v$cluster_member@local;<br><br>MEMBER_ID STATUS<br>--------- --------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4 INACTIVE<br><br>4 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SYNCHRONIZE;<br><br>ERR-42R02(16546): sharded table "PUBLIC"."T1" must have at least one online usable replica of group 'G2'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Add all inactive members back to the cluster and then try again.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT local_member_id() FROM dual;<br><br>LOCAL_MEMBER_ID()<br>-----------------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT member_id, STATUS FROM v$cluster_member@local;<br><br>MEMBER_ID STATUS<br>--------- ------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4 ACTIVE<br><br>4 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SYNCHRONIZE;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16547 (SQLSTATE: 01000): of the total '%d' tables in the database, '%d' tables have offline replica**

<a id="fa404d96495692be"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#3a13c91fdabdaa04">ALTER SYSTEM {MOUNT | OPEN} DATABASE</a>&nbsp;statement attempts to change replicas in the OFFLINE state to ONLINE after all members have joined the cluster.<br>This warning message is generated when a table cannot be converted to the ONLINE state.<br>The transition to ONLINE fails when the SCN of an ONLINE replica is greater than the SCN of an OFFLINE replica.<br><br>The following example shows a case where the replica of table t1 could not be converted to the ONLINE state when the ALTER SYSTEM OPEN GLOBAL DATABASE statement was executed in a 1×2 cluster with only the g1 group.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN GLOBAL DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-01000(16547): of the total '4' tables in the database, '1' tables have offline replica<br>System altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT global_scn FROM gv$relation@g1n1 WHERE name = 'T1';<br><br>GLOBAL_SCN<br>----------<br>9.1.0<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT global_scn FROM gv$relation@g1n2 WHERE name = 'T1';<br><br>GLOBAL_SCN<br>----------<br>5.0.0<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Execute the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#bc55498003b53106">ALTER TABLE name SYNCHRONIZE</a>&nbsp;or<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#8e0788c3012778c5">ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE</a>&nbsp;statement to synchronize the table and convert it to the ONLINE state.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT map.group_id, map.member_id, map.is_offline<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM table_member_map@local map,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;definition_schema.tables@local tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE map.table_id = tbl.table_id AND tbl.table_name = 'T1'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;5&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ORDER BY 1, 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;6 ;<br><br>GROUP_ID MEMBER_ID IS_OFFLINE<br>-------- --------- ----------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 FALSE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 TRUE<br><br>2 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SYNCHRONIZE;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT map.group_id, map.member_id, map.is_offline<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM table_member_map@local map,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;definition_schema.tables@local tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE map.table_id = tbl.table_id AND tbl.table_name = 'T1'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;5&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ORDER BY 1, 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;6 ;<br><br>GROUP_ID MEMBER_ID IS_OFFLINE<br>-------- --------- ----------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 FALSE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 FALSE<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16548 (SQLSTATE: 01000): of the total '%d' tables in the member to be dropped, %d' tables have offline replica**

<a id="b158bb89df9a946e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#a3601304aac063fd">ALTER DATABASE DROP FORCE INACTIVE CLUSTER MEMBERS</a>&nbsp;statement drops inactive members and then attempts to change replicas in the OFFLINE state to ONLINE.<br>This warning message is generated when a table cannot be converted to the ONLINE state.<br>The transition to ONLINE fails when the SCN of an ONLINE replica is greater than the SCN of an OFFLINE replica.<br><br>The following example shows a case where an inactive member (g1n3) is forcibly dropped in a 1×3 cluster with only the g1 group.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT member_id, status FROM v$cluster_member@local;<br><br>MEMBER_ID STATUS<br>--------- --------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 ACTIVE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3 INACTIVE<br><br>3 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE DROP FORCE INACTIVE CLUSTER MEMBERS;<br><br>ERR-01000(16548): of the total '4' tables in the member to be dropped, '1' tables have offline replica<br>Database altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT global_scn FROM gv$relation@g1n1 WHERE name = 'T1';<br><br>GLOBAL_SCN<br>----------<br>15.1.0<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT global_scn FROM gv$relation@g1n2 WHERE name = 'T1';<br><br>GLOBAL_SCN<br>----------<br>7.0.0<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Execute the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#bc55498003b53106">ALTER TABLE name SYNCHRONIZE</a>&nbsp;or<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#8e0788c3012778c5">ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE TABLE</a>&nbsp;statement to synchronize the table and convert it to the ONLINE state.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT map.group_id, map.member_id, map.is_offline<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM table_member_map@local map,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;definition_schema.tables@local tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE map.table_id = tbl.table_id AND tbl.table_name = 'T1'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;5&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ORDER BY 1, 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;6 ;<br><br>GROUP_ID MEMBER_ID IS_OFFLINE<br>-------- --------- ----------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 FALSE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 TRUE<br><br>2 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SYNCHRONIZE;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT map.group_id, map.member_id, map.is_offline<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM table_member_map@local map,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;definition_schema.tables@local tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE map.table_id = tbl.table_id AND tbl.table_name = 'T1'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;5&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ORDER BY 1, 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;6 ;<br><br>GROUP_ID MEMBER_ID IS_OFFLINE<br>-------- --------- ----------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 FALSE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 FALSE<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16549 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid bind parameter**

<a id="2a266dd366b6683e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The bind parameter us not valid.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR SELECT id, name FROM t1;<br><br>Cursor declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt; OPEN cur1;<br><br>Cursor is open.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v_id INTEGER<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v_name VARCHAR(32)<br><br>gSQL&gt; FETCH cur1 INTO v_id, :v_name;<br><br>ERR-42000(16549): invalid bind parameter :<br>FETCH cur1 INTO v_id, :v_name<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the host variable together with (:) as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; FETCH cur1 INTO :v_id, :v_name;<br><br>V_ID V_NAME<br>---- ------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 kim<br><br>1 row fetched.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16550 (SQLSTATE: HY000): failed to offline the already dropped cluster member**

<a id="c03a4dd0a8d3600a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This is an error code used within the server.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>No action is required.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16551 (SQLSTATE: HY000): shutdown cannot be performed on ipc**

<a id="83e3a9c0be173a3a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The shutdown is not executable in IPC connection.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Execute the shutdown with TCP connection.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16552 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot execute on NODE SHARDED table**

<a id="0ded565011274bb8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16553 (SQLSTATE: 42000): of the total '%d' tables, '%d' tables failed to drop offline segments**

<a id="09e3ebf700092758"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#5b00c3e3280d2ce9">ALTER DATABASE DROP OFFLINE SEGMENTS</a>&nbsp;statement failed to remove the segment of a specific table.<br>In most cases, the failure occurs because the required lock cannot be acquired during concurrency control.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Increase the value of<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#f7c0066758882150">DDL_LOCK_TIMEOUT</a>&nbsp;and execute the statement again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16554 (SQLSTATE: 42000): NODE SHARDED table cannot be synchronized**

<a id="b672e98a1e0cec15"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16555 (SQLSTATE: 42000): of the total '%d' tables, '%d' tables failed to synchronize**

<a id="2fcf5057b61dac05"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The synchronization of some tables was not normally completed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16379): of the total '5' tables, '2' tables failed to synchronize :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;concurrent execution : 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;inactive member&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;replica usablility&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;offline tablespace&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;others&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;: 0<br><br>Database altered.<br><br><ul><li>concurrent execution<br><ul><li>Failure caused by concurrency issues with other sessions</li></ul></li><li>inactive member<br><ul><li>All replicas of active members are offline and there is at least one inactive member</li></ul></li><li>replica usability<br><ul><li>The local replica is in an unusable state, or</li><li>All replicas of active members are unusable</li></ul></li><li>offline tablespace<br><ul><li>The local replica is created in an offline tablespace</li></ul></li><li>others<br><ul><li>Any cases not covered by the above causes</li></ul></li></ul></td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td><ul><li>concurrent execution<br><ul><li>Stop DDL execution in other sessions due to concurrency issues and retry.</li></ul></li><li>inactive member<br><ul><li>Join the inactive member to the cluster and retry.</li></ul></li><li>replica usability<br><ul><li>Remove replicas in an unusable state and retry.</li><li>An unusable replica can be removed using the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#f6e8b615dd1dc63e">ALTER TABLE name DROP UNUSABLE SEGMENTS</a>&nbsp;statement.</li></ul></li><li>offline tablespace<br><ul><li>Switch the offline tablespace to online and retry.</li><li>Switching can be done with the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#f690c33a6dde5c14">ALTER TABLESPACE name [ONLINE|OFFLINE]</a>&nbsp;statement.</li></ul></li><li>others<br><ul><li>Check the cause in system.trc, take corrective action, and retry.</li></ul></li></ul></td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16556 (SQLSTATE: 42000): scan partition is out of range( 1 to %d )**

<a id="d12730d1c3029925"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">When executing the following statements, the specified SCAN PARTITION value exceeded the maximum allowed value (1000).<br><ul><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#8e0788c3012778c5">ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE TABLE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#ddb148eaa7b01843">ALTER DATABASE MOVE SHARD</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#eba0a85e4ceddd6e">ALTER DATABASE REBALANCE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#bc55498003b53106">ALTER TABLE name SYNCHRONIZE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#b53aef713ebb21be">ALTER TABLE name MOVE SHARD</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#f207258645781242">ALTER TABLE name REBALANCE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#64d12151db2fcee0">ALTER TABLE name REORGANIZE</a></li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 REORGANIZE SCAN PARTITION 1001;<br><br>ERR-42000(16556): scan partition is out of range( 1 to 1000 ) :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 REORGANIZE SCAN PARTITION 1001<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Change the SCAN PARTITION value to 1000 or less, and then execute the statement again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16577 (SQLSTATE: 42000): offset argument is out of range**

<a id="75950b794a63aa40"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>A negative number can not be used as an offset value of LEAD() function.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT s_year<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, s_quarter<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, s_revenue<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, LEAD( s_revenue, -1 ) OVER ( ORDER BY s_revenue ) AS lead_value<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>;<br><br>ERR-42000(16577): offset argument is out of range</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a positive offset value as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT s_year<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, s_quarter<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, s_revenue<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, LEAD( s_revenue, 1 ) OVER ( ORDER BY s_revenue ) AS lead_value<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>;<br><br>S_YEAR S_QUARTER S_REVENUE LEAD_VALUE<br>------ --------- --------- ----------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2010 1/4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;100&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2010 2/4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2010 > **16578 (SQLSTATE: 42000): percentile value should be a number between 0 and 1**

<a id="4b4200b3769016cb"></a>

PERCENTILE_DISC( 0.5 ) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY s_revenue ) OVER ( PARTITION BY s_year ) AS pertile_value<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>;<br><br>S_YEAR S_QUARTER S_REVENUE PERTILE_VALUE<br>------ --------- 3/4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;300&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2011 1/4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;100&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2011 4/4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;200<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;2011 > **16579 (SQLSTATE: 42000): INDEX COALESCE only supports b-tree type index**

<a id="5ddd7a6fb10167b3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when the INDEX COALESCE statement is used on a global temporary index.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE INDEX t1_idx ON t1 ( c1 );<br><br>Index created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER INDEX t1_idx COALESCE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16579): INDEX COALESCE only supports b-tree type index :<br>ALTER INDEX t1_idx COALESCE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Global temporary indexes do not support the COALESCE statement.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16580 (SQLSTATE: 42000): table '%s' is not online on cluster domain '%s'**

<a id="47a94398fc44713c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is already offline in the cluster member.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SET OFFLINE AT g2n2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16580): table 'T1' is not online on cluster domain 'G2N2'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check if the table is offline as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT member_name, member_offline FROM user_tab_place WHERE table_name = 'T1';<br><br>MEMBER_NAME MEMBER_OFFLINE<br>----------- --------------<br>G1N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br>G1N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br>G2N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br>G2N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TRUE<br>G3N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br>G3N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br><br>6 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16581 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot find global transaction logfile**

<a id="a49beaa2f8d23db9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">When executing the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#c3724d69b119c090">ALTER DATABASE RENAME GLOBAL TRANSACTION LOGFILE</a>&nbsp;statement, the specified source TCL (Transaction Commit Log) file is not the log file currently in use.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE RENAME GLOBAL TRANSACTION LOGFILE 'commit_2.log' TO 'new_commit_2.log';<br><br>ERR-42000(16581): cannot find global transaction logfile&nbsp;&nbsp;:<br>ALTER DATABASE RENAME GLOBAL TRANSACTION LOGFILE 'commit_2.log' TO 'new_commit_2.log'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Verify whether the log file to be renamed is the currently active TCL log file. Then specify the correct log file and execute the statement again.<br><br>The following shows how to check the currently active TCL log file.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT group_id, file_name, group_state FROM v$tcl_logfile;<br><br>GROUP_ID FILE_NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;GROUP_STATE<br>-------- ---------------------- -----------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0 /test/wal/commit_0.log CURRENT<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 /test/wal/commit_1.log UNUSED<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16582 (SQLSTATE: 42000): there are active cluster members in the target cluster group '%s'**

<a id="9f879f6469edc49c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>An active cluster member exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP CLUSTER GROUP g4;<br><br>ERR-42000(16582): there are active cluster members in the target cluster group 'G4'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The cluster group which has an active cluster member can not be DROPped.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16583 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot transactional service: %s**

<a id="6a53d21d1ea8f252"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The password should be changed when logging in, but the transaction service for the password change is not available.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Shift the cluster system to the available global open phase.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16584 (SQLSTATE: 42000): index type '%s' exceeds maximum shard sequence**

<a id="b8b08a376eef09cb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error may occur during the execution of the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#b53aef713ebb21be">ALTER TABLE name MOVE SHARD</a>&nbsp;statement. When a shard is moved, the shard stored in the index is logically deleted rather than physically removed.<br>Logical deletion can be performed up to 255 times, and exceeding this limit results in an error.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 MOVE SHARD s2 TO CLUSTER GROUP g1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16584): index 'T1X' exceeds maximum shard sequence</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>After executing<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#5333ab1d309d9a83">ALTER INDEX name COALESCE</a>&nbsp;or<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#2c9ae90a7a32ddcf">ALTER INDEX name REBUILD</a>, retry the MOVE SHARD statement.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16585 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot drop cluster group that includes a global coordinator**

<a id="34649bc150abb7ec"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16586 (SQLSTATE: 42000): role name '%s' conflicts with another user or role name**

<a id="20116164740e0fa5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The duplicate user or role name exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE ROLE r1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16586): role name 'R1' conflicts with another user or role name :<br>CREATE ROLE r1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check if the duplicate user or role name exists as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT role_name, 'ROLE' AS auth FROM dba_roles WHERE role_name = 'R1'<br>&nbsp;UNION ALL<br>SELECT username,&nbsp;&nbsp;'USER' AS auth FROM dba_users WHERE username = 'R1';<br><br>ROLE_NAME AUTH<br>--------- ----<br>R1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ROLE<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16587 (SQLSTATE: 28000): role '%s' does not exists**

<a id="1ce4c059a2bb03aa"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The role does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP ROLE r1;<br><br>ERR-28000(16587): role 'R1' does not exists :<br>DROP ROLE r1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check if the role exists as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT role_name FROM dba_roles WHERE role_name = 'R1';<br><br>no rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16588 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot GRANT to a role/public WITH GRANT OPTION**

<a id="dd35851afae65ee8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The privilege can not be granted to a role or a public with WITH GRANT OPTION.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT SELECT ON t1 TO PUBLIC WITH GRANT OPTION;<br><br>ERR-42000(16588): cannot GRANT to a role/public WITH GRANT OPTION</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Grant the privilege without WITH GRANT OPTION as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT SELECT ON t1 TO PUBLIC;<br><br>Grant succeeded.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16589 (SQLSTATE: 0P000): circular role grant detected**

<a id="baaec9015bb3c29d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The cycle occurred when granting the role..<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT role1 TO role2;<br><br>Grant succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT role2 TO role1;<br><br>ERR-0P000(16589): circular role grant detected</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Prevent the cycle from occurring when granting a role.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16590 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate role name in role granted/revoked list**

<a id="cc0f509ce8504ac3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The duplicate role name was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT role1, role2, role1 TO u1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16590): duplicate role name in role granted/revoked list :<br>GRANT role1, role2, role1 TO u1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Drop the duplicate role name as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT role1, role2 TO u1;<br><br>Grant succeeded.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16591 (SQLSTATE: 28000): cannot GRANT/REVOKE built-in role(SYSDBA, ADMIN) to/from authorization**

<a id="b4fe8d6267f31b18"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>sysdba and admin ROLE can not be granted to another user or role.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT sysdba TO role1;<br><br>ERR-28000(16591): cannot GRANT/REVOKE built-in role(SYSDBA, ADMIN) to/from authorization :<br>GRANT sysdba TO role1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>sysdba and admin ROLE can not be granted to or revoked from another user or role.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16592 (SQLSTATE: 0P000): invalid role specification**

<a id="23dc09c27abf6a40"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The role does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET ROLE invalid;<br><br>ERR-0P000(16592): invalid role specification</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the role name which can be set.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET ROLE dba;<br><br>Session set.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16593 (SQLSTATE: 25001): invalid transaction state: active transaction exists**

<a id="a3e09ebc951fcf67"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>SET ROLE can not be executed while the transaction is in progress.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET ROLE role1;<br><br>ERR-25001(16593): invalid transaction state: active transaction exists</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Terminate the transaction, then execute SET ROLE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET ROLE role1;<br><br>Session set.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16594 (SQLSTATE: 42000): role '%s' not granted or need ADMIN OPTION**

<a id="2f9d5001e415d259"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The role without ADMIN OPTION can not grant the role to another user.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT role1 TO u2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16594): role 'ROLE1' not granted or need ADMIN OPTION</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The given role information can be view as follows and only the role with ADMIN OPTION can be granted to another user.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT username, granted_role, admin_option FROM user_role_privs;<br><br>USERNAME GRANTED_ROLE ADMIN_OPTION<br>-------- ------------ ------------<br>U1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ROLE1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NO<br>U1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ROLE2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;YES<br><br>2 rows selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT role2 TO u2;<br><br>Grant succeeded.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16595 (SQLSTATE: 42000): role '%s' not granted to '%s'**

<a id="79a2dff78d986784"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The role which was not granted by a user can not be revoked.<br><br>gSQL&gt; REVOKE role1 FROM u2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16595): role 'ROLE1' not granted to 'U2'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Revoke the role which was given by a user as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; REVOKE role2 FROM u2;<br><br>Revoke succeeded.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16596 (SQLSTATE: 42000): transactional service temporarily unavailable**

<a id="7141e2e084dbab8d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when a transaction service is requested on a participating node while<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#530c2222850ccc1c">ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE</a>&nbsp;is in progress.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>After<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#530c2222850ccc1c">ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE</a>&nbsp;has completed, try again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

c40,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c41, c42, c43, c44, c45, c46, c47, c48, c49, c50,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c1,&nbsp;&nbsp;c2,&nbsp;&nbsp;c3,&nbsp;&nbsp;c4,&nbsp;&nbsp;c5,&nbsp;&nbsp;c6,&nbsp;&nbsp;c7,&nbsp;&nbsp;c8,&nbsp;&nbsp;c9, c10,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c21, c22, c23, c24, c25, c26, c27, c28, c29, c30,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c31, c32, c33, c34, c35, c36, c37, c38, c39, c40,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c41, c42, c43, c44, c45, c46 );<br><br>ERR-42000(16597): too many grouping sets present (maximum 4096)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Adjust the MAX_GROUPING_SETS_COUNT property and try again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16598 (SQLSTATE: 42000): GROUPING function requires GROUP BY clause**

<a id="9a11232e5218e3c3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>GROUPING function should be used together with GROUP BY.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT GROUPING( c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS RESULT<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16598): GROUPING function requires GROUP BY clause :<br>SELECT GROUPING( c1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT c1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c3,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COUNT(*),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;GROUPING( c1, c2, c3 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>GROUP BY ROLLUP(c1, c2, c3);<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;C1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;C3 COUNT(*) GROUPING( C1, C2, C3 )<br>---- ---- ---- -------- ----------------------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1 null null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2 null null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3<br>null null null&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;5&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;7<br><br>10 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16599 (SQLSTATE: 42000): not a GROUP BY expression**

<a id="a818ec8580c5db37"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The argument of GROUPING() function is not the expression used in GROUP BY.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT c1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COUNT(*)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>HAVING GROUPING(c1) = 0;<br><br>ERR-42000(16599): not a GROUP BY expression :<br>HAVING GROUPING(c1) = 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 4:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the column used in GROUP BY as the argument of GROUPING() function as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>SELECT c1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COUNT(*)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM t1<br>&nbsp;GROUP BY c1<br>HAVING GROUPING(c1) = 0;<br><br>C1 COUNT(*)<br>-- --------<br>&nbsp;1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;4<br>&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16600 (SQLSTATE: 42000): The number of columns in a column group must be in the range (%d ~ %d)**

<a id="7cac0181fb0ec67e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The number of columns listed in COLUMN GROUPS is out of range (2~4) as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 COMPUTE STATISTICS FOR COLUMN GROUPS ( c1, c2, c3, c4, c5 );<br>ERR-42000(16600): The number of columns in a column group must be in the range(2 ~ 4) :</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use 2 ~ 4 columns when listing column groups.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 COMPUTE STATISTICS FOR COLUMN GROUPS ( c1, c2 );<br>Table analyzed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16601 (SQLSTATE: 42000): specified column group statistics already exists**

<a id="7606b324067851df"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The statistics information about the pre-defined column group exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 COMPUTE STATISTICS FOR COLUMN GROUPS ( c1, c2 );<br>ERR-42000(16601): specified column group statistics already exists</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check if the column group already exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT column_groups FROM USER_STAT_COLUMN_GROUP WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'T1';<br>COLUMN_GROUPS<br>-------------<br>( C1, C2 )<br><br>Delete and rebuild it as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 DELETE STATISTICS FOR COLUMN GROUPS ( c1, c2 );</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16602 (SQLSTATE: 42000): specified column group statistics not exists**

<a id="f3e241a957b93292"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The statistics information about the column group does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE TABLE t1 DELETE STATISTICS FOR COLUMN GROUPS ( c1, c2 );<br>ERR-42000(16602): specified column group statistics not exists</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check if the column group exists as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT column_groups FROM USER_STAT_COLUMN_GROUP WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'T1';<br>no rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16603 (SQLSTATE: 42000): system session cannot be canceled**

<a id="d5da1fa77013d03c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">ALTER SYSTEM CANCEL SESSION statement is not applied to a system session nor to a cluster session.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check if the session id and the serial numbers are correct.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16604 (SQLSTATE: 42000): pivot operations are not supported on lateral views**

<a id="a1d0e2d4d4cd1b7a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">It does not support the pivot for the lateral view.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1, LATERAL( SELECT c1 FROM dual) PIVOT( COUNT(*) FOR c1 IN ( 1 ) );<br>ERR-42000(16604): pivot operations are not supported on lateral views :<br>SELECT * FROM t1, LATERAL( SELECT c1 FROM dual) PIVOT( COUNT(*) FOR c1 IN ( 1 ) )<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Do not describe the pivot statement whose target is the lateral view.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16605 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unpivot operations are not supported on lateral views**

<a id="3a4ee43067730f2f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">It does not support the unpivot for the lateral view.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1, LATERAL( SELECT c1 FROM dual) UNPIVOT( col_val FOR col_name IN ( c1 ) );<br>ERR-42000(16605): unpivot operations are not supported on lateral views :<br>SELECT * FROM t1, LATERAL( SELECT c1 FROM dual) UNPIVOT( col_val FOR col_name IN ( c1 ) )<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Do not describe the unpivot statement whose target is the lateral view.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16606 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the number of elements in pivot values mismatch the pivot columns**

<a id="12ae30fb9d45574d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The number of pivot columns and the number of the pivot values described in the pivot statement are different.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1 PIVOT( COUNT(*) FOR ( c1, c2 ) IN ( ( 1, 2 ), ( 3 ) ) );<br>ERR-42000(16606): the number of elements in pivot values mismatch the pivot columns :<br>SELECT * FROM t1 PIVOT( COUNT(*) FOR ( c1, c2 ) IN ( ( 1, 2 ), ( 3 ) ) )<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check if the number of pivot columns and the number of the pivot values described in the pivot statement are same.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16607 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the number of elements in unpivot values mismatch the unpivot columns**

<a id="7e513d49976eeadb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The number of unpivot columns and the number of the unpivot values described in the unpivot statement are different.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1 UNPIVOT( col_val FOR ( col1, col2 ) IN ( ( c1, c2 ), ( c3 ) ) );<br>ERR-42000(16607): the number of elements in unpivot values mismatch the unpivot columns :<br>SELECT * FROM t1 UNPIVOT( col_val FOR ( col1, col2 ) IN ( ( c1, c2 ), ( c3 ) ) )<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check if the number of unpivot columns and the number of the unpivot values described in the unpivot statement are same.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16608 (SQLSTATE: 42000): non-constant expression is not allowed for pivot|unpivot values**

<a id="b938554a6a83e58c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Only the constant expression is allowed for the pivot value or the unpivot value.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1 UNPIVOT( col_ FOR c1 IN ( c1 AS RANDOM( 1, 1 ) ) );<br>ERR-42000(16608): non-constant expression is not allowed for pivot|unpivot values :<br>SELECT * FROM t1 UNPIVOT( col_ FOR c1 IN ( c1 AS RANDOM( 1, 1 ) ) )<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1 UNPIVOT( col_ FOR c1 IN ( c1 AS CLOCK_DATE() ) );<br>ERR-42000(16608): non-constant expression is not allowed for pivot|unpivot values :<br>SELECT * FROM t1 UNPIVOT( col_ FOR c1 IN ( c1 AS CLOCK_DATE() ) )<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Do not use the non-constant expression as the pivot value or the unpivot value.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16609 (SQLSTATE: 42000): lacks privilege (EXECUTE ON LIBRARY \"%s\".\"%s\")**

<a id="0ca4d4fec6469070"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">It does not have EXECUTE ON LIBRARY privilege.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( p1 NATIVE_INTEGER ) RETURN NATIVE_INTEGER AS<br>LANGUAGE C<br>LIBRARY u2.ext_lib1 NAME "sample"<br>PARAMETERS ( p1 INT,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN INT );<br>/<br><br>ERR-01000(16409): Warning: Routine(FUNC1) has compilation errors :<br>(1) : ERR-42000(16609): lacks privilege (EXECUTE ON LIBRARY "U2"."EXT_LIB1")<br>Function created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">The owner should grant the privilege, then execute it as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; GRANT EXECUTE ON LIBRARY u2.ext_lib1 TO u1;<br><br>Grant succeeded.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \connect u1 u1<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( p1 NATIVE_INTEGER ) RETURN NATIVE_INTEGER AS<br>LANGUAGE C<br>LIBRARY u2.ext_lib1 NAME "sample"<br>PARAMETERS ( p1 INT,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN INT );<br>/<br><br>Function created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16610 (SQLSTATE: 42000): library does not exist**

<a id="d1e174779cac4317"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The library does not exist.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1 RETURN NATIVE_INTEGER AS<br>LANGUAGE C<br>LIBRARY invalid NAME "sample"<br>PARAMETERS( RETURN INT );<br>/<br><br>ERR-01000(16409): Warning: Routine(FUNC1) has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (3:9): ERR-42000(16610): library does not exist<br>Function created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use the existing library name as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT library_name FROM user_libraries;<br><br>LIBRARY_NAME<br>------------<br>LIB1<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1 RETURN NATIVE_INTEGER AS<br>LANGUAGE C<br>LIBRARY lib1 NAME "sample"<br>PARAMETERS( RETURN INT );<br>/<br><br>Function created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16611 (SQLSTATE: 42000): the number of pieces is out of range( 1 to %d )**

<a id="878487e048287595"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">When executing the following statements, the specified value in the PIECE clause exceeds the maximum allowed value (1024).<br><ul><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#a9f4f713f7a7547c">ALTER DATABASE BACKUP INCREMENTAL</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#7fe166f588ba7fa5">ALTER TABLESPACE BACKUP INCREMENTAL</a></li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE BACKUP INCREMENTAL LEVEL 0 PIECE 1025;<br><br>ERR-42000(16611): the number of pieces is out of range (1 to 1024)<br>ALTER DATABASE BACKUP INCREMENTAL LEVEL 0 PIECE 1025<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Change the PIECE value to 1024 or less, and then execute the statement again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16612 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid backup format ( %s )**

<a id="15d1666b8a00cdb0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">When executing the following statements, the format of the string specified in the FORMAT clause is invalid.<br><ul><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#a9f4f713f7a7547c">ALTER DATABASE BACKUP INCREMENTAL</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#7fe166f588ba7fa5">ALTER TABLESPACE BACKUP INCREMENTAL</a></li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE BACKUP INCREMENTAL LEVEL 0 FORMAT 'backup_%p%z';<br><br>ERR-42000(16612): invalid backup format ( backup_%p%z ) :<br>ALTER DATABASE BACKUP INCREMENTAL LEVEL 0 FORMAT 'backup_%p%z'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Verify that the FORMAT clause string follows the correct format, and then execute the statement again.<br>For more information, refer to the description of the FORMAT clause in the ALTER DATABASE BACKUP INCREMENTAL statement.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16613 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot backup; tablespace(%s) is temporary**

<a id="0fcbb8a552a7bf3f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#7fe166f588ba7fa5">ALTER TABLESPACE name BACKUP</a>&nbsp;statement was executed on a temporary tablespace.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE mem_temp_tbs BACKUP INCREMENTAL LEVEL 0;<br><br>ERR-42000(16613): cannot backup; tablespace(MEM_TEMP_TBS) is temporary :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE mem_temp_tbs BACKUP INCREMENTAL LEVEL 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">No action is required.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16614 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unreachable WHEN clause specified after unconditional WHEN clause**

<a id="7dca2b08b8780f6c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>• If &lt;merge when matched clause&gt; without &lt;search condition&gt; is described, then no more &lt;merge when matched clause&gt; can be described.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>MERGE INTO t1<br>USING t2<br>ON t1.c1 = t2.c1<br>WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ( c1, c2 ) = ( t2.c1, t2.c2 )<br>WHEN MATCHED AND t1.c1 = 100 THEN DO NOTHING;<br><br>ERR-42000(16614): unreachable WHEN clause specified after unconditional WHEN clause :<br>WHEN MATCHED AND t1.c1 = 100 THEN DO NOTHING<br>*<br>ERROR at line 5:<br><br>• If &lt;merge when not matched clause&gt; without &lt;search condition&gt; is described, then no more &lt;merge when not matched clause&gt; can be described.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>MERGE INTO t1<br>USING t2<br>ON t1.c1 = t2.c1<br>WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT VALUES ( c1, c2 )<br>WHEN NOT MATCHED AND c1 = 4 THEN INSERT DEFAULT VALUES;<br><br>ERR-42000(16614): unreachable WHEN clause specified after unconditional WHEN clause :<br>WHEN NOT MATCHED AND c1 = 4 THEN INSERT DEFAULT VALUES<br>*<br>ERROR at line 5:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>• &lt;merge when matched clause&gt; without &lt;search condition&gt; should be described at the end of &lt;merge when matched clause&gt;.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>MERGE INTO t1<br>USING t2<br>ON t1.c1 = t2.c1<br>WHEN MATCHED AND t1.c1 = 100 THEN DO NOTHING<br>WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ( c1, c2 ) = ( t2.c1, t2.c2 );<br>3 rows merged.<br><br>• &lt;merge when not matched clause&gt; without &lt;search condition&gt; should be described at the end of &lt;merge when not matched clause&gt;.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br><br>MERGE INTO t1<br>USING t2<br>ON t1.c1 = t2.c1<br>WHEN NOT MATCHED AND c1 = 4 THEN INSERT DEFAULT VALUES<br>WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT VALUES ( c1, c2 );<br>3 rows merged.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16615 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: failed to make sequences online**

<a id="650586b46e6bf4d4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs if it fails to shift sequence objects to online.<br>It does not occur in general cases, but it may occur when the resources are insufficient.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#8e0788c3012778c5">ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE</a>&nbsp;statement as follows to shift sequence objects to online.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE SEQUENCE;<br><br>Database altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16616 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: failed to make tables online**

<a id="6044060aa4b13b7d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs if it fails to shift table objects to online.<br>It does not occur in general cases, but it may occur when the resources are insufficient.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#8e0788c3012778c5">ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE</a>&nbsp;statement as follows to shift table objects to online.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE TABLE;<br><br>Database altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16617 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: failed to drop offline segments**

<a id="2360c8605f5c2966"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs if it fails to drop offline segments.<br>It does not occur in general cases, but it may occur when the resources are insufficient.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#5b00c3e3280d2ce9">ALTER DATABASE DROP OFFLINE SEGMENTS</a>&nbsp;statement as follows to drop offline segments.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE DROP OFFLINE SEGMENTS;<br><br>Database altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16618 (SQLSTATE:01000): of the total '%d' members, it was executed only on '%d' members**

<a id="dc182700e21a9696"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This warning occurs for statements that can be executed even if inactive members exist.<br>It indicates that some of the specified members were in an inactive state.<br><br>The following is an example where the statement was executed on only one of the two members in the g2 group.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER DATABASE CLEAR AUDIT TRAIL AT g2;<br><br>ERR-01000(16618): of the total '2' members, it was executed only on '1' members<br>Database altered.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">After changing the inactive member to an active state, retry the statement on that member.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16619 (SQLSTATE: 42000): AT DOMAIN can be specified in the GLOBAL OPEN phase of the cluster database**

<a id="d2193d0dd99e5aff"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">AT domain cannot be specified in phases prior to GLOBAL OPEN.<br><br>The following is an example of specifying the AT domain clause during the LOCAL OPEN phase.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT status FROM x$instance@local;<br><br>STATUS<br>----------<br>LOCAL OPEN<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM CHECKPOINT AT g1n1;<br><br>ERR-42000(16619): AT DOMAIN can be specified in the GLOBAL OPEN phase of<br>the cluster database :<br>ALTER SYSTEM CHECKPOINT AT g1n1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">When executing locally, remove the AT domain and try again.<br>When executing remotely, join the cluster and then try again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16620 (SQLSTATE: 42000): The domain option cannot be specified together with ONLINE, TABLESPACE, or index attributes options**

<a id="d28966b5a850f94a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the AT domain clause is used together with ONLINE, TABLESPACE, or index attributes during ALTER INDEX name REBUILD.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( i1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE INDEX t1x ON t1( i1 );<br><br>Index created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER INDEX t1x REBUILD ONLINE AT g2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16620): The domain option cannot be specified together with<br>ONLINE, TABLESPACE, or index attributes options :<br>ALTER INDEX t1x REBUILD ONLINE AT g2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Remove the AT domain clause and try again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16621 (SQLSTATE: 42000): a transaction can insert into only one table in append manner**

<a id="6d5895a434935492"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error message occurs when attempting to perform append insert into two or more tables within a single transaction.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T2 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>ERR-42000(16621): a transaction can insert into only one table in append manner</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">To add data using append insert to multiple tables, each table must be handled in a separate transaction.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T2 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16622 (SQLSTATE: 42000): append insert attributes mismatch**

<a id="748ab71f6cabca45"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">An append insert statement was executed more than once within a single transaction using different options.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND NOLOGGING */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 2 );<br><br>ERR-42000(16622): append insert attributes mismatch</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">When executing multiple append insert statements within the same transaction, the same options must be used for all statements.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 2 );<br><br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16623 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot execute DDL - append inserts unfinished**

<a id="c81b0f2ec02735e2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">A DDL statement was executed before the transaction that performed an append insert&nbsp;&nbsp;was completed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE T2 ( I1 INTEGER );<br><br>ERR-42000(16623): cannot execute DDL - append inserts unfinished</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Complete the transaction that performed the append insert, and then execute the DDL statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE T2 ( I1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16624 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot execute DML - append inserts unfinished**

<a id="9c68f879552140db"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">A DML statement was executed on the same table before the transaction that performed an append insert was completed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE T1 SET I1 = 2;<br><br>ERR-42000(16624): cannot execute DML - append inserts unfinished</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Complete the transaction that performed the append insert, and then execute the DML statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; UPDATE T1 SET I1 = 2;<br><br>1 row updated.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16625 (SQLSTATE: 42000): segment is unusable in the member with the latest data of table '%s.%s'**

<a id="8988436c3be53ed4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">When executing the following statements, the SCN of a replica in UNUSABLE state is greater than the SCN of the OFFLINE replica on other members.<br><ul><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#8e0788c3012778c5">ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE TABLE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#ddb148eaa7b01843">ALTER DATABASE MOVE SHARD</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#eba0a85e4ceddd6e">ALTER DATABASE REBALANCE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#bc55498003b53106">ALTER TABLE name SYNCHRONIZE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#b53aef713ebb21be">ALTER TABLE name MOVE SHARD</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#f207258645781242">ALTER TABLE name REBALANCE</a></li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SYNCHRONIZE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16625): segment is unusable in the member with the latest data of table 'PUBLIC.T1'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">A replica in UNUSABLE state can no longer be used. Drop the unusable replica using the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#f6e8b615dd1dc63e">ALTER TABLE name DROP UNUSABLE SEGMENTS</a>&nbsp;statement, and then execute the statement again.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 DROP UNUSABLE SEGMENTS;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SYNCHRONIZE;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>※ Note: The table will be synchronized based on the past data held by the OFFLINE replica.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16626 (SQLSTATE: 42000): of the total '%d' tables in the database, failed to modify the offline member map in '%d' tables**

<a id="dd912ae785089690"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#3b5bed89d79fa87c">ALTER DATABASE OFFLINE INACTIVE CLUSTER MEMBERS</a>&nbsp;statement sets inactive members to OFFLINE status in the table member map maintained by active members.<br>This statement is executed sequentially for all tables. This warning message is generated if the OFFLINE operation fails for any table.<br>In most cases, the failure occurs because the required lock cannot be acquired during concurrency control.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Increase the value of<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#f7c0066758882150">DDL_LOCK_TIMEOUT</a>&nbsp;and execute the statement again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16627 (SQLSTATE: 42000): Input to JSON generation function has unsupported data type**

<a id="eb75e03b5dce598d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>An invalid data type was used as an argument for the JSON string constructor function.<br><br>CREATE TABLE test ( col INTEGER );<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT JSON_ARRAY( test.rowid )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM test;<br><br>ERR-42000(16627): Input to JSON generation function has unsupported data type :<br>SELECT JSON_ARRAY( test.rowid )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Convert it to a supported data type.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT JSON_ARRAY( CAST( test.rowid AS VARCHAR(32) ) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM test;<br><br>JSON_ARRAY( CAST( TEST.ROWID AS VARCHAR(32) ) )<br>-----------------------------------------------<br>["AAAAAAAAYeoAACAAAEAkAAA"]<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16628 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unusable replicas in table '%s' must be offline**

<a id="1e38101786018ad7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This is an error code used within the server.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16629 (SQLSTATE: 42000): of the total '%d' tables, '%d' tables failed to drop unusable segments**

<a id="afa80998717cc81d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the deletion of unusable segments fails for some of the tables that contain them.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Since there can be various causes of failure, the exact reason should be identified through the system.trc log.<br>Resolve the issue and try again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16630 (SQLSTATE: 42000): global transactions cannot perform append inserts**

<a id="f9e0386a084e7c0d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>In XA transactions, the APPEND INSERT method cannot be used to add data.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>In XA transactions, data must be inserted using CONVENTIONAL INSERT.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16631 (SQLSTATE: 42000): of the total '%d' tables, '%d' tables failed to offline**

<a id="b7da3374bcd2dda3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the attempt to change some of the tables related to a tablespace to the offline state fails.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Since there can be various causes of failure, the exact reason should be identified through the system.trc log.<br>Resolve the issue and try again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16632 (SQLSTATE: 42000): tables related to tablespace '%s' must be offline**

<a id="3983e9a9e8194470"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the attempt to change some of the tables related to a tablespace to the offline state fails.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE space1 OFFLINE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16632): tables related to tablespace 'SPACE1' must be offline</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">After changing the related tables to the OFFLINE state using the ALTER TABLESPACE ... OFFLINE TABLES statement, try again.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESAPCE space1 OFFLINE TABLES;<br><br>Tablespace altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE space1 OFFLINE;<br><br>Tablespace altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16633 (SQLSTATE: 42000): all tablespaces related to table '%s' must be online**

<a id="00bb342f65296c25"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when executing the following statements on tables related to an OFFLINE tablespace.<br><ul><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#f207258645781242">ALTER TABLE name REBALANCE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#af45593c0739dbf2">ALTER TABLE name REBALANCE EXCLUDE CLUSTER GROUP cluster_group_list</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#bc55498003b53106">ALTER TABLE name SYNCHRONIZE</a></li><li><a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#b53aef713ebb21be">ALTER TABLE name MOVE SHARD</a></li></ul></td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Change the tablespace to ONLINE and then retry the operation.<br>For more information about how to change a tablespace to ONLINE, refer to<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#f690c33a6dde5c14">ALTER TABLESPACE name [ONLINE|OFFLINE]</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16634 (SQLSTATE: 42000): referenced table '%s' does not have a primary key**

<a id="8979fa19e4da84d5"></a>
