<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The parent table does not have a primary key.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent );<br>ERR-42000(16634): referenced table '%s' does not have a primary key :<br>CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Add a primary key constraint to the parent table before creating a foreign key.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE parent ADD CONSTRAINT parent_pk PRIMARY KEY(pk);<br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16635 (SQLSTATE: 42000): number of referencing columns must match referenced columns**

<a id="9e1cd5447d752269"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The number of columns in the foreign key and the primary key are different.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE TABLE parent ( c1 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CONSTRAINT parent_pk PRIMARY KEY (c1, c2) );<br>&nbsp;Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( c1 INTEGER REFERENCES parent );<br>ERR-42000(16635): number of referencing columns must match referenced columns :<br>CREATE TABLE child ( c1 INTEGER REFERENCES parent )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Create a foreign key with the same number of columns as the primary key, as shown below.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE TABLE child ( c1 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c2 INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FOREIGN KEY (c1, c2) REFERENCES parent );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16636 (SQLSTATE: 42000): column type incompatible with referenced column type**

<a id="c2215aeadc938cf4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The data types of the primary key and foreign key are not compatible.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk VARCHAR(10) REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>ERR-42000(16636): column type incompatible with referenced column type :<br>CREATE TABLE child ( fk VARCHAR(10) REFERENCES parent(pk) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Align the foreign key’s data type with that of the primary key.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16637 (SQLSTATE: 42000): no matching unique or primary key for this column list**

<a id="ce41a63552ea9223"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The referenced column does not have a corresponding primary key or unique key.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c1 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(c1) );<br>ERR-42000(16637): no matching unique or primary key for this column list :<br>CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(c1) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Reference a column that has a primary key or unique key.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16638 (SQLSTATE: 23000): referential constraint "%s"."%s" violated : parent keys not found**

<a id="596ffe5afbab36e6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the value specified in a FOREIGN KEY column cannot be found in the corresponding PRIMARY KEY or UNIQUE column of the referenced table.<br><br>This error may occur in the following cases:<br><ul><li>Deleting a value from the parent table that is currently being referenced by the child table</li><li>Inserting a value into the child table that does not exist in the parent table</li></ul></td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">When deleting a record from the parent table, check whether the record is being referenced by the child table.<br>When inserting a record into the child table, ensure that the referenced value exists in the parent table.<br>For more information about FOREIGN KEY constraints, refer to the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/19-sql-references-c-g.md#5ad53eb3db4e69ec">FOREIGN KEY Constraint</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16639 (SQLSTATE: 42000): attempt to reference non-base table '%s' in referential integrity constraint**

<a id="89406177c4dd9e51"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">A global temporary table cannot be referenced by a FOREIGN KEY.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>ERR-42000(16639): attempt to reference non-base table '%s' in referential integrity constraint :<br>CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Only base tables can be referenced by a FOREIGN KEY, as shown below.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16640 (SQLSTATE: 42000): attempt to create referential integrity constraint on non-base table**

<a id="2cd7d6df695f9c5f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">A FOREIGN KEY cannot be created on a global temporary table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE child ( fk INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE child ADD CONSTRAINT child_fk FOREIGN KEY(fk) REFERENCES parent(pk);<br>ERR-42000(16640): attempt to create referential integrity constraint on non-base table</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">A FOREIGN KEY can only be created on a base table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE child ADD CONSTRAINT child_fk FOREIGN KEY(fk) REFERENCES parent(pk);<br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16641 (SQLSTATE: 42000): referenced unique constraint shall not be deferrable**

<a id="6c1f7d447a4ddd6c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">A DEFERRABLE constraint cannot be referenced by a FOREIGN KEY.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY DEFERRABLE );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>ERR-42000(16641): referenced unique constraint shall not be deferrable :<br>CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Create the FOREIGN KEY after changing the constraint to NOT DEFERRABLE, as shown below.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE parent ALTER CONSTRAINT parent_primary_key NOT DEFERRABLE;<br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16642 (SQLSTATE: 42000): for referencing generated column, delete rule shall not specify SET NULL or SET DEFAULT**

<a id="413d0fad21f10ac5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">FOREIGN KEY delete rules such as SET NULL cannot be applied to a generated column.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;REFERENCES parent(pk) ON DELETE SET NULL );<br>ERR-42000(16642): for referencing generated column, delete rule shall not specify SET NULL or SET DEFAULT :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;REFERENCES parent(pk) ON DELETE SET NULL )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use delete rules such as ON DELETE CASCADE instead, as shown below.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;REFERENCES parent(pk) ON DELETE CASCADE );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16643 (SQLSTATE: 42000): for referencing generated column, update rule shall not specify SET NULL or SET DEFAULT or CASCADE**

<a id="fc468caff77794e0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">FOREIGN KEY update rules such as CASCADE cannot be applied to a generated column.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;REFERENCES parent(pk) ON UPDATE CASCADE );<br>ERR-42000(16643): for referencing generated column, update rule shall not specify SET NULL or SET DEFAULT or CASCADE :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;REFERENCES parent(pk) ON UPDATE CASCADE )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use update rules such as ON UPDATE NO ACTION instead, as shown below.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;REFERENCES parent(pk) ON UPDATE NO ACTION );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16644 (SQLSTATE: 42000): constraint schema '%s' shall be equivalent to table schema**

<a id="cad3f85a7690234a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The schema of the constraint is different from the schema of the table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE s1.t1 ( pk INTEGER CONSTRAINT s2.t1_pk PRIMARY KEY );<br><br>ERR-42000(16644): constraint schema '%s' shall be equivalent to table schema :<br>CREATE TABLE s1.t1 ( pk INTEGER CONSTRAINT s2.t1_pk PRIMARY KEY )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Constraints must be created in the same schema as the table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE s1.t1 ( pk INTEGER CONSTRAINT s1.t1_pk PRIMARY KEY );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16645 (SQLSTATE: 42000): such referential constraint already exists in table**

<a id="72c658637fc9b580"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">An identical FOREIGN KEY constraint already exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;uk INTEGER UNIQUE );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE child ADD CONSTRAINT child_fk FOREIGN KEY( fk ) REFERENCES parent(pk);<br>ERR-42000(16645): such referential constraint already exists in table :<br>ALTER TABLE child ADD CONSTRAINT child_fk FOREIGN KEY( fk ) REFERENCES parent(pk)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Create FOREIGN KEYs with different definitions as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE child ADD CONSTRAINT child_fk FOREIGN KEY( fk ) REFERENCES parent(uk);<br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16646 (SQLSTATE: 42000): column definition is not specified**

<a id="f224ecca2bd7b014"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">No column has been defined.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( UNIQUE( c1 ) );<br>ERR-42000(16646): column definition is not specified</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Define the column as shown below.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, UNIQUE( c1 ) );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16647 (SQLSTATE: 42000): column is referenced in a multi-column constraint "%s"."%s"**

<a id="926a429b3bacc550"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The column is included in a constraint defined with multiple columns.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER, c3 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 ADD PRIMARY KEY (c2, c3);<br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SET UNUSED COLUMN c2;<br>ERR-42000(16647): column is referenced in a multi-column constraint "PUBLIC"."T1_PRIMARY_KEY"</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use the CASCADE option to remove the constraint along with the column.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SET UNUSED COLUMN c2 CASCADE;<br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16648 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot drop parent key column : child foreign key "%s"."%s"**

<a id="4c6d0f2678af6b8e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The PRIMARY KEY column cannot be dropped because it is referenced by a FOREIGN KEY.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c1 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE parent SET UNUSED COLUMN pk;<br>ERR-42000(16648): cannot drop parent key column : child foreign key "PUBLIC"."CHILD_FOREIGN_KEY_FK_REFERENCES_PARENT_PK"</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use the CASCADE option as shown below.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE parent SET UNUSED COLUMN pk CASCADE;<br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16649 (SQLSTATE: 42000): trigger does not exist**

<a id="34e3153471e3d8a9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The trigger object name was used incorrectly in statements such as comment, drop, and rename.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TRIGGER trg1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AFTER INSERT ON t1<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TRIGGER trg2 RENAME TO new_trg;<br>ERR-42000(16649): trigger does not exist :<br>ALTER TRIGGER trg2 RENAME TO new_trg<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use the correct trigger object name.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TRIGGER trg1 RENAME TO new_trg;<br>Trigger altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16650 (SQLSTATE: 42000): object "%s" is not %s**

<a id="5161385fc0243e22"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The SQL statement cannot be executed on this object.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP VIEW t1;<br>ERR-42000(16650): object "T1" is not VIEW :<br>DROP VIEW t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use an SQL statement that is compatible with the object, as shown below.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DROP TABLE t1;<br><br>Table dropped.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16651 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate trigger event**

<a id="bae7cc59c2409ff2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The trigger event is defined in duplicate<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON t1<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-42000(16651): duplicate trigger event :<br>AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON t1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Describe the event correctly.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON t1<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16652 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate transition table or variable name**

<a id="708a5fdf1763ff37"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Duplicate table name or variable name found in the trigger's transition.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS t_tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NEW TABLE AS t_tbl<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-42000(16652): duplicate transition table or variable name :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NEW TABLE AS t_tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 4:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use the correct table name or variable name.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS old_t_tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NEW TABLE AS new_t_tbl<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16653 (SQLSTATE: 42000): transition table or variable specified more than once**

<a id="f23920dbd5fc9374"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">OLD and NEW were used redundantly in the trigger's transition.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD ROW AS o_row1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OLD ROW AS o_row2<br>FOR EACH ROW<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-42000(16653): transition table or variable specified more than once :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OLD ROW AS o_row2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 4:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Define the trigger transition correctly.<br><br>gSQL&gt;&nbsp;&nbsp;CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD ROW AS o_row1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NEW ROW AS o_row2<br>FOR EACH ROW<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16654 (SQLSTATE: 42000): transition table can not be specified in multi-event trigger**

<a id="5566dcb8dd63becb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">An error may occur when defining multiple events and using transition tables in a trigger.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE OR DELETE ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS o_tbl<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-42000(16654): transition table can not be specified in multi-event trigger :<br>REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS o_tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">To use trigger transition tables, only a single event must be specified.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS o_tbl<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16655 (SQLSTATE: 42000): transition table can be declared only in AFTER triggers**

<a id="5c666d45a76fc593"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Transition tables were used while the trigger timing was specified as BEFORE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>BEFORE UPDATE ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS o_tbl<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-42000(16655): transition table can be declared only in AFTER triggers :<br>REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS o_tbl<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">To use trigger transition tables, the timing must be specified as AFTER.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS o_tbl<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16656 (SQLSTATE: 42000): transition variable requires FOR EACH ROW syntax**

<a id="97adf4ee7a41591c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Transition variables were used after setting the trigger action to FOR EACH STATEMENT.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD ROW AS o_row<br>FOR EACH STATEMENT<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-42000(16656): transition variable requires FOR EACH ROW syntax :<br>REFERENCING OLD ROW AS o_row<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">To use transition variables, the trigger action must be specified as FOR EACH ROW.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD ROW AS o_row<br>FOR EACH ROW<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16657 (SQLSTATE: 42000): invalid use of %s transition table or variable**

<a id="a3258ff878c85468"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The OLD transition was specified in an INSERT trigger.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER INSERT ON t1<br>REFERENCING OLD ROW AS o_row<br>FOR EACH ROW<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-42000(16657): invalid use of OLD transition table or variable :<br>REFERENCING OLD ROW AS o_row<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">An INSERT trigger must specify the NEW transition.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER INSERT ON t1<br>REFERENCING NEW ROW AS o_row<br>FOR EACH ROW<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16658 (SQLSTATE: 42000): trigger "%s"."%s" already exists on another table and can not be replaced**

<a id="bbe7e8dde5880684"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the base table name differs while replacing an existing trigger with a new one.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t2 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t1<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t2<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-42000(16658): trigger "PUBLIC"."T2" already exists on another table and can not be replaced :<br>CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">If the base table names differ, the existing trigger must be dropped or the new trigger name must be distinct.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri2<br>AFTER UPDATE ON t2<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16659 (SQLSTATE: 01000): Warning: trigger "%s"."%s" has compilation errors**

<a id="62922f92c5b45bff"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The trigger body does not contain objects or contains incorrect content.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER INSERT ON t1<br>FOR EACH ROW<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;var1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT count(*) INTO var1 FROM n_tbl;<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-01000(16659): Warning: trigger "PUBLIC"."TRI1" has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (7:3): ERR-42000(16040): table or view does not exist<br>Trigger created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">The error occurred because a table specified in the trigger body does not exist, so that table must be created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE n_tbl ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER tri1<br>AFTER INSERT ON t1<br>FOR EACH ROW<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;var1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT count(*) INTO var1 FROM n_tbl;<br>END;<br>/<br>Trigger created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16660 (SQLSTATE: 23001): referential constraint "%s"."%s" restriction violated : can not delete or update parent row**

<a id="046b0424bb266252"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when a referenced column with a PRIMARY KEY or UNIQUE constraint, having the same value as a column with a FOREIGN KEY constraint, is modified.<br><br>This happens when the referential triggered action of the FOREIGN KEY constraint is defined as ON UPDATE RESTRICT or ON DELETE RESTRICT.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Attempt to modify the child table’s records first.<br>For more information about FOREIGN KEY constraints, refer to the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/19-sql-references-c-g.md#5ad53eb3db4e69ec">FOREIGN KEY Constraint</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16661 (SQLSTATE: 42000): column is referenced in a update column trigger "%s"."%s"**

<a id="6f6647d73468f420"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">An UPDATE COLUMN TRIGGER referencing the column to be dropped exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE TRIGGER trg1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AFTER UPDATE OF c1 ON t1<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Trigger created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SET UNUSED COLUMN c1;<br>ERR-42000(16661): column is referenced in a update column trigger "PUBLIC"."TRG1"</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use the CASCADE option to remove the trigger along with the column.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SET UNUSED COLUMN c1 CASCADE;<br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16662 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot execute for the disabled index**

<a id="7d51170cce38a879"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The index is currently in a DISABLE state.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE INDEX idx1 ON t1(c1);<br>Index created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER INDEX idx1 DISABLE;<br>Index altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER INDEX idx1 REBUILD;<br>ERR-42000(16662): cannot execute for the disabled index :<br>ALTER INDEX idx1 REBUILD<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Change it to ENABLE as shown below to rebuild the index.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER INDEX idx1 ENABLE;<br>Index altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16663 (SQLSTATE: 42000): referenced unique constraint must be ENFORCED**

<a id="4e849601933671cb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The constraint to be referenced is in a NOT ENFORCED state.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE parent ( pk INTEGER CONSTRAINT parent_pk PRIMARY KEY NOT ENFORCED );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>ERR-42000(16663): referenced unique constraint must be ENFORCED :<br>CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Change the constraint to ENFORCED as shown below before referencing it.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE parent ALTER CONSTRAINT parent_pk ENFORCED;<br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE child ( fk INTEGER REFERENCES parent(pk) );<br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16664 (SQLSTATE: 42000): trigger type mismatch : %s**

<a id="bdbe6b7d0eba6a33"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The order of incompatible triggers cannot be changed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t2 ( c1 INTEGER );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AFTER INSERT ON t1<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Trigger created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AFTER INSERT ON t1<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Trigger created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t2 SET TRIGGER ORDER trg2, trg1;<br>ERR-42000(16664): trigger type mismatch : event object mismatch&nbsp;&nbsp;:<br>ALTER TABLE t2 SET TRIGGER ORDER trg2, trg1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use compatible triggers as shown below.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SET TRIGGER ORDER trg2, trg1;<br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16665 (SQLSTATE: 42000): duplicate trigger name**

<a id="09227d1f66b089ad"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Duplicated trigger names are listed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SET TRIGGER ORDER trg1, trg1;<br>ERR-42000(16665): duplicate trigger name :<br>ALTER TABLE t1 SET TRIGGER ORDER trg1, trg1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use unique trigger names to avoid duplication.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 SET TRIGGER ORDER trg1, trg2;<br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16666 (SQLSTATE: 42000): not analyzed system**

<a id="2eb6c89253a2facf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">ANALYZE SYSTEM has not been executed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE SYSTEM EXPORT 'sys.stat';<br>ERR-42000(16666): not analyzed system</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Run ANALYZE SYSTEM before performing the EXPORT.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE SYSTEM;<br>analyzed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ANALYZE SYSTEM EXPORT 'sys.stat';<br>analyzed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16667 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot append insert - foreign keys are enabled on the table**

<a id="27351422bc81d459"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Tables with FOREIGN KEY constraints do not support append insert using the deferred index maintenance method.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE PARENT ( I1 INTEGER UNIQUE );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE CHILD ( I1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE CHILD ADD CONSTRAINT CHILD_FK FOREIGN KEY( I1 ) REFERENCES PARENT( I1 );<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND DEFERRED_INDEX_MAINTENANCE */ INTO PARENT VALUES ( 2 );<br><br>ERR-42000(16667): cannot append insert - foreign keys are enabled on the table</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Temporarily disable the FOREIGN KEY constraints, perform the append insert operation, and re-enable the constraints after the operation is completed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE CHILD ALTER CONSTRAINT CHILD_FK NOT ENFORCED;<br><br>Table altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND DEFERRED_INDEX_MAINTENANCE */ INTO PARENT VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>Commit complete.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE CHILD ALTER CONSTRAINT CHILD_FK ENFORCED;<br><br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16668 (SQLSTATE: 42000): table sampling can only be performed on a single base table or temporary table**

<a id="db1fff5652781c8c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The sample clause cannot be specified for the following objects.<br><ul><li>join</li><li>viewed table</li><li>inline view</li><li>common table expression (CTE)</li></ul><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT * FROM t1 ) TABLESAMPLE( 10 PERCENT ROWS );<br><br>ERR-42000(16663): table sampling can only be performed on a single base table or temporary table :<br>SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT * FROM t1 ) TABLESAMPLE( 10 PERCENT ROWS )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v1 TABLESAMPLE( 10 PERCENT ROWS );<br><br>ERR-42000(16663): table sampling can only be performed on a single base table or temporary table :<br>SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v1 TABLESAMPLE( 10 PERCENT ROWS )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">The sample clause can only be used with a single base table or a single temporary table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 TABLESAMPLE( 10 PERCENT ROWS );<br><br>COUNT(*)<br>--------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;100549<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 A TABLESAMPLE( 10 PERCENT ROWS ), t1 B TABLESAMPLE( 2 PERCENT ROWS ) WHERE A.c1 = B.c1;<br><br>COUNT(*)<br>--------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;20005<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>For more information about table sampling, refer to the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/20-sql-references-h-z.md#f11bfbfa622bd200">sample clause</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16669 (SQLSTATE: 42000): table sampling rate must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 100**

<a id="d25aa9e8d3922f6f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the table sampling rate is outside the valid range.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 TABLESAMPLE( 0 PERCENT ROWS );<br><br>ERR-42000(16664): table sampling rate must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 100 :<br>SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 TABLESAMPLE( 0 PERCENT ROWS )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 TABLESAMPLE( 200 PERCENT ROWS );<br><br>ERR-42000(16664): table sampling rate must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 100 :<br>SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 TABLESAMPLE( 200 PERCENT ROWS )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Enter a table sampling rate greater than 0 and less than or equal to 100, as shown below.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 TABLESAMPLE( 100 PERCENT ROWS );<br><br>COUNT(*)<br>--------<br>&nbsp;1000000<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 TABLESAMPLE( 10 PERCENT ROWS );<br><br>COUNT(*)<br>--------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;99812<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>For more information about table sampling, refer to the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/20-sql-references-h-z.md#f11bfbfa622bd200">sample clause</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16670 (SQLSTATE: 23000): check constraint "%s"."%s" violated**

<a id="cb7ddad3ed522975"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">A CHECK constraint has been violated.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER CHECK ( c1 &gt; 0 ) );<br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( -1 );<br>ERR-23000(16670): check constraint "PUBLIC"."T1_CHECK_C1" violated</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use values that satisfy the CHECK constraint.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16671 (SQLSTATE: 42000): maximum number of check columns exceeded**

<a id="6e8450063e926a40"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The number of columns specified in the CHECK constraint exceeds the limit.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>ALTER TABLE t1 ADD<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CHECK ( c1&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c2&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c3&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c4&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c5&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c6&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c7&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c8&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c9&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c10 +<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c11 + c12 + c13 + c14 + c15 + c16 + c17 + c18 + c19 + c20 +<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c21 + c22 + c23 + c24 + c25 + c26 + c27 + c28 + c29 + c30 +<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c31 + c32 + c33 &gt; 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;);<br><br>ERR-42000(16671): maximum number of check columns exceeded :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CHECK ( c1&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c2&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c3&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c4&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c5&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c6&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c7&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c8&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c9&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c10 +<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">A CHECK constraint can include up to 32 columns, as shown below.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>ALTER TABLE t1 ADD<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CHECK ( c1&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c2&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c3&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c4&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c5&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c6&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c7&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c8&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c9&nbsp;&nbsp;+ c10 +<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c11 + c12 + c13 + c14 + c15 + c16 + c17 + c18 + c19 + c20 +<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c21 + c22 + c23 + c24 + c25 + c26 + c27 + c28 + c29 + c30 +<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c31 + c32 + c32 &gt; 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;);<br>Table altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16672 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot append insert - triggers are enabled on the table**

<a id="ed6fcdd5bc0abdef"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">If a trigger is enabled on the table to be inserted into, an append insert cannot be performed.<br><br>DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t1;<br>DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t2;<br>CREATE TABLE t1( c1 INTEGER );<br>CREATE TABLE t2( c1 INTEGER );<br>INSERT INTO t2 VALUES ( 1 ), ( 2 ), ( 3 );<br>COMMIT;<br><br>CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg1<br>BEFORE INSERT ON t1<br>FOR EACH STATEMENT<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'BEFORE INSERT ON t1' );<br>END;<br>/<br>COMMIT;<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO t1 SELECT * FROM t2;<br>ERR-42000(16672): cannot append insert - triggers are enabled on the table</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">To perform an append insert, the trigger must be disabled.<br>The trigger status can be checked in the user_triggers view.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TRIGGER trg1 DISABLE;<br>Trigger altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO t1 SELECT * FROM t2;<br>3 rows created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16673 (SQLSTATE: 42000): visible conflict**

<a id="9e307a46eac28089"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This is an error code used within the server.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16674 (SQLSTATE: 42000): A version conflict was detected while synchronizing the replica**

<a id="8b7605b103cdb0c0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">During DML execution, the update on the master node succeeded, but a version conflict occurred while updating the slave node.<br>This error does not occur under normal circumstances and may occur only when the update master node fails and the update slave node is promoted to the new update master.<br>When this error occurs, the corresponding transaction is forcibly rolled back.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Retry the operation at the application level.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16675 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot offline transaction tablespace**

<a id="cce12c5e455e84ea"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Transaction tablespaces cannot be set to OFFLINE.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLESPACE mem_trans_tbs OFFLINE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16675): cannot offline transaction tablespace :<br>ALTER TABLESPACE mem_trans_tbs OFFLINE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Verify the purpose of the tablespace before attempting to set it to OFFLINE, as shown below.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT tablespace_name, contents FROM dba_tablespaces WHERE tablespace_name = 'MEM_TRANS_TBS';<br><br>TABLESPACE_NAME CONTENTS<br>--------------- -----------<br>MEM_TRANS_TBS&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TRANSACTION<br><br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16676 (SQLSTATE: 42000): cannot specify NOLOGGING without the PARALLEL option**

<a id="3fc21cb8fc3f5e1b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error message occurs when the NOLOGGING hint is specified in the INSERT statement without specifying the PARALLEL hint.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND NOLOGGING */ INTO t1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>ERR-42000(16676): cannot specify NOLOGGING without the PARALLEL option</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">To use the NOLOGGING hint, specify the PARALLEL hint as well.<br>If the NOLOGGING method is not required, remove the NOLOGGING hint and execute the statement again.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT /*+ APPEND PARALLEL NOLOGGING */ INTO T1 VALUES ( 1 );<br><br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16677 (SQLSTATE: 42000): unable to set table to 'usable' state due to remaining corrupted pages**

<a id="93a04b29cf843935"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">A table containing an UNUSABLE segment cannot be changed to the usable state because it contains logically corrupted pages. For more information, refer to<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#c49e5eddac666a7d">ALTER TABLE name USABLE</a>.<br>To identify tables containing UNUSABLE segments, check V$RELATION.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT NAME, USABLE FROM V$RELATION WHERE USABLE = FALSE AND TYPE = 'TABLE';<br><br>NAME USABLE<br>---- ------<br>T1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FALSE<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER TABLE t1 USABLE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16677): unable to set table to 'usable' state due to remaining corrupted pages.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">When a segment is added using the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#6a1edf86eeec57d6">ALTER DATABASE REGISTER IRRECOVERABLE SEGMENT</a>&nbsp;statement, the segment is registered as not requiring recovery. Therefore, rebuild the data by truncating the table or drop the table.<br>For UNUSABLE segments caused by NOLOGGING APPEND INSERT, recover the segments using the backup data file created after the NOLOGGING APPEND INSERT operation, and then perform the operation again.<br>If no backup data is available, logically corrupted pages cannot be recovered, and the table cannot be changed to the usable state.<br>To prevent this situation, GOLDILOCKS recommends performing a checkpoint and backup after executing NOLOGGING APPEND INSERT.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **16678 (SQLSTATE: 42000): LOCAL SHARD LIMIT is supported only for sharded tables**

<a id="3b8013865479d7d6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">LOCAL SHARD LIMIT can be used only in a DELETE FROM statement for a sharded table. For more information, refer to the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/19-sql-references-c-g.md#59f650a785d26d85">&lt;local shard limit clause&gt;</a>&nbsp;of DELETE FROM.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t_cloned ( c1 INTEGER ) CLONED;<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DELETE FROM t_cloned LOCAL SHARD LIMIT 10 ROWS;<br><br>ERR-42000(16678): LOCAL SHARD LIMIT is supported only for sharded tables :<br>DELETE FROM t_cloned LOCAL SHARD LIMIT 10 ROWS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">When LOCAL SHARD LIMIT is specified in a DELETE FROM statement, a sharded table must be used in the FROM clause.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t_shard ( c1 INTEGER ) SHARDING BY ( c1 );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; DELETE FROM t_shard&nbsp;&nbsp;LOCAL SHARD LIMIT 10 ROWS;<br><br>no rows deleted.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="74cfd16da62f3b35"></a>
## PSM Related Error

```
Examples of PSM errors are based on the schema below.

gSQL>
CREATE TABLE t1 ( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER, c3 integer);
INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 10, 10 );

CREATE TABLE t2 ( id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(32) );
INSERT INTO t2 VALUES( 101, 'SUNJESOFT' );
INSERT INTO t2 VALUES ( 102, 'GOLDILOCKS' );

CREATE TABLE t3 ( c1 INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, c2 INTEGER );

CREATE LIBRARY lib AS 'add.so';
/

// add.c
// gcc -shared -fPIC -I$GOLDILOCKS_HOME/include -o $GOLDILOCKS_DATA/extlib/add.so add.c
#include <stdio.h>
#include <goldilocks.h>

int addFunc( int a, int b )
{
 return a + b;
}

int addFuncWithCTX( SQLExtProcContext * context, int a, int b )
{
 return a + b;
}
```

> **17000 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): failed to initialize PSM processor layer**

<a id="25af608a7d95b1ef"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17001 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): not implemented feature (%s)**

<a id="4fcb1eb68ee73355"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This feature is either not implemented or not supported.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE taa IS TABLE OF VARCHAR(10) INDEX BY DATE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (2:45): ERR-2F000(17001): not implemented feature (unsupported index type)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">This feature cannot be used.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17002 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): duplicated label name**

<a id="98f050d012392351"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The duplicate label name was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>&lt;&lt;aaa&gt;&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 10;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;aaa&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('1st aaa');<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;aaa&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('2nd aaa');<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (7:5): ERR-2F000(17002): duplicated label name</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use different label names as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>&lt;&lt;aaa&gt;&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 10;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;bbb&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('1st bbb');<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;ccc&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('2nd ccc');<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17003 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): duplicated exception name**

<a id="cccf9faf064f3fdf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The duplicate exception name was used in EXCEPTION clause.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 EXCEPTION;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 EXCEPTION;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXCEPTION WHEN v1 THEN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHEN v1 THEN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (9:18): ERR-2F000(17003): duplicated exception name</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use different exception names as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 EXCEPTION;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 EXCEPTION;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXCEPTION WHEN v1 THEN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHEN v2 THEN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17004 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): duplicated variable name**

<a id="84c0617e3ca85dc5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17005 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): not applicable expression type**

<a id="8ed09f38231997ff"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17006 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): unknown variable or column name (%s)**

<a id="827d029d213b8e4e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The undeclared variable name was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg1<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;var0 INTEGER;<br>END;<br>/<br>Package created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg2<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;var1 var0%TYPE;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17101): PACKAGE(PKG2) Specification has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (3:10): ERR-2F000(17006): unknown variable or column name (VAR0)<br>Package created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Declare the variable as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg2<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;var1 pkg1.var0%TYPE;<br>END;<br>/<br>Package created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17007 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): invalid expression**

<a id="7d082253412c5907"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The invalid expression was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( a1 t1%rowtype )<br>RETURN t1%ROWTYPE<br>IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 t1%ROWTYPE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1.c1 := a1.c1 * 2;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1.c2 := a1.c2 * 2;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN v1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 t1%ROWTYPE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 VARCHAR(20);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2.c1 := 100;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2.c2 := 200;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 := func1(v2);<br>END;<br>/<br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (8:11): ERR-2F000(17007): invalid expression</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the valid expression as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 t1%ROWTYPE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 t1%ROWTYPE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2.c1 := 100;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2.c2 := 200;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 := func1(v2);<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17008 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): wrong number of parameters**

<a id="9dcefc5ba2809174"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The number of argument is wrong.<br><br>gSQL&gt; var v1 integer;<br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1(a1 INTEGER, a2 INTEGER)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN INTEGER<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('A1 = ' || a1);<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN a1 + a2;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; call func1(20) INTO :v1;<br><br>ERR-2F000(17008): wrong number of parameters :<br>call func1(20) INTO :v1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use it correctly in accordance with the definition of the stored function.<br><br>gSQL&gt; call func1(10, 20) INTO :v1;<br><br>A1 = 10<br>Procedure Call complete.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17009 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): NOT NULL constraint violation**

<a id="c4560cc7357af431"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It violated the constraint of the declared NOT NULL.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE rec1 IS RECORD( f1 INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, f2 INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_rec rec1;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1( p1 rec1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('p1.f1 = ' || p1.f1);<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('p1.f2 = ' || p1.f2);<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_rec.f1 := NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_rec.f2 := NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1( v_rec );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17009): NOT NULL constraint violation :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_rec.f1 := NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 12:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Do not use NULL.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE rec1 IS RECORD( f1 INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, f2 INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_rec rec1;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1( p1 rec1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('p1.f1 = ' || p1.f1);<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('p1.f2 = ' || p1.f2);<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_rec.f1 := 30;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_rec.f2 := 50;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1( v_rec );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>p1.f1 = 30<br>p1.f2 = 50<br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17010 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): can not find label name**

<a id="767d0603fc651c49"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The label name which can not be referenced was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 1;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;LABEL_START&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'START TEST' );<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;LABEL_IF&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IF v1 &lt; 5 THEN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;LABEL_LOW&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'LOW' );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;GOTO LABEL_HIGH;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ELSE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;LABEL_HIGH&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'HIGH' );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END IF;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;LABEL_FINISH&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'FINISH TEST' );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (11:10): ERR-2F000(17010): can not find label name</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the referenceable label name as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 1;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;LABEL_START&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'START TEST' );<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;LABEL_IF&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IF v1 &lt; 5 THEN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;LABEL_LOW&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'LOW' );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;GOTO LABEL_FINISH;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ELSE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;LABEL_HIGH&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'HIGH' );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END IF;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;LABEL_FINISH&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'FINISH TEST' );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>START TEST<br>LOW<br>FINISH TEST<br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17011 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): duplicated field name**

<a id="ce0d06c62c34f61e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The duplicate field name was used when declaring the record type.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE my_rec1 IS RECORD<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;( f1 INTEGER NOT NULL := 1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;f2 VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL := 'AAA',<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;f2 VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL := 'AAA'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;);<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 my_rec1;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1.f1 := 1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (5:8): ERR-2F000(17011): duplicated field name<br>(2) at (7:7): ERR-2F000(17012): unknown type name<br>(3) at (9:4): ERR-2F000(17006): unknown variable or column name (V1)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use different field names.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE my_rec1 IS RECORD<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;( f1 INTEGER NOT NULL := 1,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;f2 VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL := 'AAA',<br><br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;f3 VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL := 'AAA'<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;);<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 my_rec1;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1.f1 := 1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17012 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): unknown type name**

<a id="eb1ec8d2453426c4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The unknown type name was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE my_rec1 IS RECORD ( f1 INTEGER, f2 VARCHAR(10) );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 my_rec2;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (3:8): ERR-2F000(17012): unknown type name</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the correct type name.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE my_rec1 IS RECORD ( f1 INTEGER, f2 VARCHAR(10) );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 my_rec1;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17013 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): the type of record field should be scalar**

<a id="5affac6ec910d1ac"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The type declared for the record field is not a scalar type.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE my_rec1 IS RECORD ( f1 INTEGER NOT NULL := 1, f2 VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL := 'AAA' );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE my_rec2 IS RECORD ( f1 INTEGER NOT NULL := 1, f2 my_rec1 );<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (3:57): ERR-2F000(17013): the type of record field should be scalar</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The record field can use only the scalar type.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE my_rec1 IS RECORD ( f1 INTEGER, f2 VARCHAR(10) );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE my_rec2 IS RECORD ( f1 INTEGER, f2 INTEGER );<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17014 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): target host parameter of assignment is not bound in OUT mode**

<a id="68b00d6ca8d837c0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>It does not bind the host variable when using the assignment statement.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Bind the variable corresponding to the host variable when creating an application.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17015 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): cannot set constraint or initial value on non-scalar-type variable**

<a id="ac4ce1a123a1a552"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It can not set the initial value in the non-scalar variable.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE urec IS RECORD (f1 INTEGER);<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 urec := 10;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>(1) at (3:13): ERR-2F000(17015): cannot set constraint or initial value on non-scalar-type variable</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Set the field value as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE urec IS RECORD (f1 INTEGER);<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 urec;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1.f1 := 10;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17016 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): variables which have NOT NULL constraint should have initial values**

<a id="c124776965c71fba"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>If<em>not null constraint</em>&nbsp;exists, then the initial value should exist when declaring the variable.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 NUMBER(5,2) NOT NULL := 100.01;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 v1%TYPE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>(1) at (3:3): ERR-2F000(17016): variables which have NOT NULL constraint should have initial values</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Set the initial value as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 NUMBER(5,2) NOT NULL := 100.01;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 v1%TYPE := 200.02;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17017 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): unhandled user exception (%s)**

<a id="ebf78b0065b895c4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>RAISE exception is not controlled.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;e1 EXCEPTION;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;e2 EXCEPTION;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RAISE e1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXCEPTION WHEN e2 THEN NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17017): Unhandled user exception (E1)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Control RAISE exception as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;e1 EXCEPTION;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;e2 EXCEPTION;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RAISE e1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXCEPTION WHEN e1 THEN NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17018 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): pre-defined exception name not allowed in declare section**

<a id="0a48617174850db1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The pre-defined exception can not be declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ZERO_DIVIDE EXCEPTION;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (2:1): ERR-2F000(17018): Pre-defined-exception name not allowed in declare section</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Define a new name exception.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;e1 EXCEPTION;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17019 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): OTHERS exception must be last among the exceptions of a block**

<a id="bed827e830bb91e1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>OTHERS exception should be described at the end of exception block.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RAISE ZERO_DIVIDE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHEN ZERO_DIVIDE THEN NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (3:19): ERR-2F000(17019): OTHERS-exception must be last among the exceptions of a block</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Describe OTHERS exception at the end as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RAISE ZERO_DIVIDE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXCEPTION WHEN ZERO_DIVIDE THEN NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17020 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): unknown exception**

<a id="de9c643ed9758c66"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17021 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): Invalid error number for PRAGMA EXCEPTION_INIT**

<a id="60c4a76429cdf1bd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It sets the invalid error number.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 EXCEPTION;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PRAGMA EXCEPTION_INIT(v1, 0);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (3:30): ERR-2F000(17021): Invalid error number for PRAGMA EXCEPTION_INIT</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the PSM user defined error code range (-20000 ~ -20999).<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 EXCEPTION;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PRAGMA EXCEPTION_INIT(v1, -20000);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17022 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): A CASE statement must either list all possible cases or have an else clause**

<a id="7d8aaef6bd7ba47e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The value that is not listed in CASE statement was used.<br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 3;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CASE v1 WHEN 1 THEN NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHEN 2 THEN NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END CASE;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17022): A CASE statement must either list all possible cases or have an else clause :<br>&nbsp;CASE V1 WHEN 1 THEN NULL;<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 4:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Add the ELSE clause to the CASE statement as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 3;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CASE v1 WHEN 1 THEN NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHEN 2 THEN NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ELSE NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END CASE;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17023 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): duplicated error-code in same exception handler**

<a id="258fe19bf5eaf53c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Each different exception has the same error code in the exception handler.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;e1 EXCEPTION;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PRAGMA EXCEPTION_INIT(e1, -12122);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RAISE ZERO_DIVIDE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXCEPTION WHEN e1 THEN NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHEN ZERO_DIVIDE THEN NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (7:20): ERR-2F000(17023): duplicated error-code in same exception handler</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Make each different exception have different error code as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;e1 EXCEPTION;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PRAGMA EXCEPTION_INIT(e1, -20000);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RAISE ZERO_DIVIDE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXCEPTION WHEN e1 THEN NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHEN ZERO_DIVIDE THEN NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17024 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): (%s) cannot be used as assignment target**

<a id="8f7f232463c811a2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is the variable which can not be used on the left of the assignment statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FOR i IN 1 .. 10 LOOP<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;i := 1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END LOOP;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (3:5): ERR-2F000(17024): (I) cannot be used as assignment target</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>read only variable can not be changed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17025 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): The command cannot be executed when global transaction is in the ACTIVE state**

<a id="1e4a2a16e22eebba"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The procedure including DDL is not executable in XA environment.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1()<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc2()<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;';<br>END;<br>/<br>Procedure created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \xa start 10<br>XA transaction started<br><br>gSQL&gt; CALL proc1;<br><br>ERR-2F000(17025): The command cannot be executed when global transaction is in the ACTIVE state :<br>&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc2()<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 4:<br>ERROR at PROCEDURE("PROC1")<br><br>gSQL&gt; \xa rollback 10<br>Rollback completed</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Execute it in the environment other than XA environment.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CALL proc1;<br><br>Procedure Call complete.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17026 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): Transaction is READ ONLY**

<a id="513a37e6279a3121"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>DML is not executable in read only transaction.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY;<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;INSERT INTO t1(c1, c2) VALUES ( 1, 1 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COMMIT;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17026): Transaction is READ ONLY :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;INSERT INTO t1(c1, c2) VALUES ( 1, 1 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Swift it to the read write transaction, then execute DML.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SET TRANSACTION READ WRITE;<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;INSERT INTO t1(c1, c2) VALUES ( 1, 1 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COMMIT;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17027 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): duplicated identifier**

<a id="fa18a258699c6a5f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The duplicated variable is declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (3:4): ERR-2F000(17027): duplicated identifier</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Declare the variable whose name is not duplicate.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17028 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): out of scope**

<a id="730e025a6f5369e6"></a>
