<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It approached to the variable of the cope(label) which can not be referenced.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>&lt;&lt;AA&gt;&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 10;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;BB&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 20;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BB.v1 := 1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (12:6): ERR-2F000(17028): out of scope error</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the variable of the referenceable scope(label).<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>&lt;&lt;AA&gt;&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 10;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;&lt;BB&gt;&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 20;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AA.v1 := 1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17029 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): too many depths of scope (limit=%d)**

<a id="ceeecb46b4765193"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It references too deep depth variable<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_sql_text varchar(4000);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;v_sql_text := 'DECLARE v1 integer; {1} v1:= 10; {2}';<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;v_sql_text := REPLACE(v_sql_text, '{1}', REPEAT('BEGIN ', 128));<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;v_sql_text := REPLACE(v_sql_text, '{2}', REPEAT('END; ', 128));<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE v_sql_text;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (1:1): ERR-2F000(17029): too many depths of scope (limit=128)<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE v_sql_text;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 9:</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>It can refer to the variable in the scope less than top 128.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17030 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): invalid reference (%s)**

<a id="4d7b843bc679317b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It can not directly access the field of the type(record) when declaring a variable.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE rec IS RECORD (f1 VARCHAR(20), f2 VARCHAR(20));<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 rec.f1%TYPE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (3:12): ERR-2F000(17030): invalid reference (REC.F1)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Refer to the field after declaring a record variable as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE rec IS RECORD (f1 VARCHAR(20), f2 VARCHAR(20));<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v0 rec;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 v0.f1%TYPE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17031 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): mismatch identifier type**

<a id="1d0360fb5cd9cf73"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The variable type which is not allowed for the statement was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE t_arr IS TABLE OF VARCHAR(32) INDEX BY INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_arr t_arr;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_arr(0) := 'A';<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_arr(1) := v_arr();<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( v_arr(1) );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (6:16): ERR-2F000(17031): mismatch identifier type</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the variable type which is allowed to the statement as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE t_arr IS TABLE OF VARCHAR(32) INDEX BY INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_arr t_arr;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_arr(0) := 'A';<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_arr(1) := v_arr(0);<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( v_arr(1) );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>A<br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17032 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): PSM compilation error**

<a id="81411f38e090c1ad"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is a compile error.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 NUMBER(39);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (2:13): ERR-42000(16024): numeric precision specifier is out of range( 1 to 38 )</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Correct the compile error.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 NUMBER(38);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17033 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): duplicated cursor name**

<a id="20ebf0ea143d31f0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The duplicated cursor is declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CURSOR cur1 IS SELECT * FROM dual;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CURSOR cur1 IS SELECT * FROM dual;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (3:10): ERR-2F000(17033): duplicated cursor name</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Do not declare the duplicated cursor name.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CURSOR cur1 IS SELECT * FROM dual;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CURSOR cur2 IS SELECT * FROM dual;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17034 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): return type of cursor is invalid**

<a id="ebe7a2a5330ccbba"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The SELECT result and the return type of the cursor are not compatible.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CURSOR c1 RETURN t1%ROWTYPE IS SELECT c1 FROM t1;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (2:20): ERR-2F000(17034): return type of cursor is invalid</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Correct the SELECT result and the return type of the cursor to be compatible.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CURSOR c1 RETURN t1%ROWTYPE IS SELECT * FROM t1;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17035 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): invalid expression type**

<a id="db72331456d4750c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17036 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): cursor is not defined**

<a id="89e08cd4aa841115"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The cursor is not declared.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CURSOR cur1 RETURN t1%ROWTYPE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN cur1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (4:8): ERR-2F000(17036): cursor is not defined</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Specify the cursor query.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CURSOR cur1 RETURN t1%ROWTYPE IS SELECT * FROM t1;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN cur1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17037 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): cursor is already open**

<a id="ca8230f1364e4dd1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The cursor is already open.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CURSOR cur1 IS SELECT * FROM t1;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN cur1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN cur1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17037): cursor is already open :<br>&nbsp;OPEN cur1;<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 5:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Close the open cursor, then open it.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CURSOR cur1 IS SELECT * FROM t1;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN cur1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLOSE cur1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN cur1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17038 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): cursor is not open**

<a id="a14bf7732afdad23"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The cursor is not open.<br><br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CURSOR cur1 IS SELECT c1 FROM t1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FETCH cur1 INTO v1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17038): cursor is not open :<br>&nbsp;FETCH cur1 INTO v1;<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 5:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Open the cursor, then FETCH it.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CURSOR cur1 IS SELECT c1 FROM t1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN cur1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FETCH cur1 INTO v1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17040 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): fetch target count mismatch**

<a id="c20b488983273439"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The number of FETCH targets and that of SELECT column are different.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CURSOR cur1 IS SELECT c1, c2 FROM t1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN cur1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FETCH cur1 INTO v1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLOSE cur1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (7:3): ERR-2F000(17040): fetch target count mismatch</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The number of FETCH targets and that of SELECT columns should be same.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CURSOR cur1 IS SELECT c1, c2 FROM t1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN cur1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FETCH cur1 INTO v1, v2;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLOSE cur1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17042 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): bind variables not allowed for data definition operations**

<a id="516ae3eaefc43c26"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The INTO and USING clauses cannot be used in DDL statements.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 := 20;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'CREATE TABLE t10 ( c1 INTEGER DEFAULT 10)' USING v1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17042): bind variables not allowed for data definition operations :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'CREATE TABLE t10 ( c1 INTEGER DEFAULT 10)' USING v1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 5:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Remove the INTO and USING clauses from the DDL statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 := 20;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'CREATE TABLE t10 ( c1 INTEGER DEFAULT 10)';<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ROLLBACK;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17044 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): returning-into need to bind variable with returning-into or using OUT clause**

<a id="5957cf71e307a8d5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The bind variable for RETURNING INTO can not get the result with USING.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'delete from t1 where c1 = 100 returning c2 into ?' USING v1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17044): returning-into need to bind variable with returning-into or using OUT clause :<br>&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'delete from t1 where c1 = 100 returning c2 into ?' USING v1;<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 4:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use USING OUT clause as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'delete from t1 where c1 = 100 returning c2 into ?' USING OUT v1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17045 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): no data found**

<a id="be29e86f0721799c"></a>

> **17048 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): The INTO clause or RETURNING INTO clause cannot be used with a USING clause containing OUT-mode**

<a id="bd1dea50e72223bf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>USING OUT cannot be used with the INTO clause or the RETURNING INTO clause.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;var1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;var2 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;v_str VARCHAR(100);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;v_str := 'INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 3 ,3 ) RETURNING * INTO ? , ?';<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE v_str<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;USING OUT var1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURNING INTO var2;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (8:3): ERR-2F000(17048): INTO clause or RETURNING INTO clause cannot be used with a USING clause that has OUT-mode</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Do not use USING OUT with the INTO clause or the RETURNING INTO clause.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;var1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;var2 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;v_str VARCHAR(100);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;v_str := 'INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 3 ,3 ) RETURNING * INTO ? , ?';<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE v_str<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;USING OUT var1 , OUT var2;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.<br><br>or<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;var1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;var2 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;v_str VARCHAR(100);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;v_str := 'INSERT INTO t1 VALUES ( 3 ,3 ) RETURNING * INTO ? , ?';<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE v_str<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURNING INTO var1 , var2;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17050 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): query need to bind with INTO-clause for targets**

<a id="e1a59d0cddc86eae"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>INTO clause should be used when executing SELECT query with EXECUTE IMMEDIATE.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_name VARCHAR(30);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'select name from t2 where id = 101';<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17050): query need to bind with INTO-clause for targets :<br>&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'select name from t1 where id = 101';<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 4:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use INTO clause in EXECUTE IMMEDIATE statement as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_name VARCHAR(30);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'select name from t2 where id = 101' INTO v_name;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17051 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): invalid statement-type**

<a id="47e828916973de43"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>SQL statement which is not allowed was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FOR rec IN ( insert into t2 values (101, 'leekmo') )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;LOOP<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END LOOP;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (2:16): ERR-2F000(17051): invalid statement-type</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use SELECT query as follows in cursor FOR LOOP statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FOR rec IN ( select * from t2 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;LOOP<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END LOOP;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17052 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): Alias required in list of cursor to avoid duplicated target names**

<a id="2a248acf02960bd3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>SELECT target name is duplicate, so the cursor can not identify them.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CURSOR cur1 IS SELECT id, id FROM t2;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FOR rec IN cur1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;LOOP<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END LOOP;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (4:5): ERR-2F000(17052): Alias required in list of cursor to avoid duplicated target names</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Assign AS alias to SELECT query as follows to avoid the duplicate names.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CURSOR cur1 IS SELECT id, id AS id2 FROM t2;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FOR rec IN cur1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;LOOP<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END LOOP;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17055 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): this cursor must be declared with FOR-UPDATE to use with CURRENT OF**

<a id="c2ac4277fb038373"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It should be FOR UPDATE cursor to use WHERE CURRENT OF cursor.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_rec t2%ROWTYPE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CURSOR cur1 IS SELECT * FROM t2 WHERE id = 102;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN cur1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FETCH cur1 INTO v_rec;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UPDATE t2 SET name = 'xyz' WHERE CURRENT OF cur1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLOSE cur1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (7:4): ERR-2F000(17055): this cursor must be declared with FOR-UPDATE to use with CURRENT OF</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Describe FOR UPDATE as follows when declaring a cursor.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_rec t2%ROWTYPE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CURSOR cur1 IS SELECT * FROM t2 WHERE id = 102 FOR UPDATE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN cur1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FETCH cur1 INTO v_rec;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;UPDATE t2 SET name = 'xyz' WHERE CURRENT OF cur1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLOSE cur1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17056 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): invalid syntax error**

<a id="1224303c35a8e7c9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17057 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): only select-into statement allowed**

<a id="a072e43d30a5f8af"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17058 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): source-name of return-type is not record-type or record-type variable**

<a id="3be3ed18a76b0722"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>RETURN type of REF CURSOR type should be a record type.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE rec IS TABLE OF t1%ROWTYPE INDEX BY VARCHAR(20);<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE cv IS REF CURSOR RETURN rec;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (3:30): ERR-2F000(17058): source-name of return-type is not record-type or record-type variable</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a record type as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE rec IS RECORD (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(30));<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE cv IS REF CURSOR RETURN rec;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17059 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): source-name of rowtype must be a table, view, cursor, cursor-variable**

<a id="dec5c0c390a075e9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The source of ROWTYPE is inappropriate.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE rec IS RECORD (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(30));<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE cv IS REF CURSOR RETURN rec%ROWTYPE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (3:34): ERR-2F000(17059): source-name of rowtype must be a table, view, cursor, cursor-variable</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Specify the table as the source of ROWTYPE as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE rec IS RECORD (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(30));<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE cv IS REF CURSOR RETURN t1%ROWTYPE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17060 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): a cursor-variable with having return-type cannot be used in OPEN FOR dynamic-sql**

<a id="71a4fa8092570bfe"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It should be a weak ref cursor to use the Dynamic in SQL REF CURSOR.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE cv_org IS REF CURSOR RETURN t1%ROWTYPE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cv cv_org;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;sqltext VARCHAR(4000);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;sqltext := 'select * from t1';<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN cv FOR sqltext;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLOSE cv;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (7:3): ERR-2F000(17060): a cursor-variable with having return-type cannot be used in OPEN FOR dynamic-sql</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Omit the RETURN clause when declaring a REF CURSOR type.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE cv_org IS REF CURSOR;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cv cv_org;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;sqltext VARCHAR(4000);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;sqltext := 'select * from t1';<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN cv FOR sqltext;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLOSE cv;<br>END;<br>/</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17061 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): it can be allowed with only IN-Binding type**

<a id="0347a990191a8ca4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>USING OUT was used where in-binding is required.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cur1 SYS_REFCURSOR;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_row t2%ROWTYPE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 := 101;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN cur1 FOR 'SELECT * FROM t2 WHERE id = ?' USING OUT v1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FETCH cur1 INTO v_row;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLOSE cur1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (7:62): ERR-2F000(17061): it can be allowed with only IN-Binding type</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use USING as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cur1 SYS_REFCURSOR;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_row t2%ROWTYPE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 := 101;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN cur1 FOR 'SELECT * FROM t2 WHERE id = ?' USING v1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FETCH cur1 INTO v_row;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLOSE cur1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17062 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): duplicated routine name**

<a id="87aa7a0f1fd61e73"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The procedure with the duplicate name was defined.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1( a1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1( a1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (3:14): ERR-2F000(17062): duplicated routine name<br>(2) at (2:4): ERR-2F000(17081): program body of the routine (PROC1) is not defined</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use different names as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1( a1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc2( a1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17063 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): unknown routine name**

<a id="7ff0044895bacee8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The procedure which does not exist was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1 IS BEGIN NULL; END;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc_invalid;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (4:5): ERR-2F000(17063): unknown routine name</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a valid procedure.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1 IS BEGIN NULL; END;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17065 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): invalid routine object status**

<a id="7b577a59f139160b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17066 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): a RAISE statement with no exception name must be inside an exception handler**

<a id="81ad681848b9655d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The RAISE statement without an exception can be used only within an exception handler.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RAISE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RAISE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (3:7): ERR-2F000(17066): a RAISE statement with no exception name must be inside an exception handler</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Specify RAISE exception as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RAISE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17067 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): return types of Result Set variables or query do not match**

<a id="dc81e34377b966b4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The result set of the cursor and the target of FETCH do not match.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE cur_type IS REF CURSOR;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cur1 cur_type;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 VARCHAR(32);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN cur1 FOR 'SELECT id, name FROM t2';<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FETCH cur1 INTO v1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLOSE cur1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17067): return types of Result Set variables or query do not match :<br>&nbsp;FETCH cur1 INTO v1;<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 8:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Modify the target of FETCH INTO as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE cur_type IS REF CURSOR;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cur1 cur_type;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 VARCHAR(32);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN cur1 FOR 'SELECT id, name FROM t2';<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FETCH cur1 INTO v1, v2;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLOSE cur1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17068 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): wrong number or types of arguments**

<a id="b765dc2a788cc8cb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The parameter settings are wrong when calling the procedure.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE rec_type1 IS RECORD( id INTEGER , name VARCHAR(20));<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE rec_type2 IS RECORD( id INTEGER , name VARCHAR(20));<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;rec1 rec_type1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;rec2 rec_type2;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1( a1 rec_type1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1( rec2 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (13:11): ERR-2F000(17068): wrong number or types of arguments</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Set the parameter whose record type is the same as the procedure.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE rec_type1 IS RECORD( id INTEGER , name VARCHAR(20));<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE rec_type2 IS RECORD( id INTEGER , name VARCHAR(20));<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;rec1 rec_type1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;rec2 rec_type2;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1( a1 rec_type1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1( rec1 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17069 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): invalid variable usage**

<a id="82aba3a4f791d066"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The usage of the record variable was wrong when executing the dynamic SQL.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE rec_type IS RECORD (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(32) );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_rec rec_type;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'select id, name from t2 where id = 101' INTO v_rec, v1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (6:75): ERR-2F000(17069): invalid variable usage</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Describe the correct record variable as follows.<br><br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE rec_type IS RECORD (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(32) );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_rec rec_type;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'select id, name from t2 where id = 101' INTO v_rec;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17070 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): return statement in procedures or anonymous blocks cannot have &lt;value&gt; clause**

<a id="15d9e71c6f467e65"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>RETURN clause is not allowed in the procedure.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN 1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-01000(16409): Warning: Routine(PROC1) has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (5:4): ERR-2F000(17070): return statement in procedures or anonymous blocks cannot have &lt;value&gt; clause<br>Procedure created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Delete RETURN clause as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Procedure created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17071 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): return statement in functions should have &lt;value&gt; clause**

<a id="b8cabe12f16f410d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>RETURN clause of the stored function should specify the value.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-01000(16409): Warning: Routine(FUNC1) has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (5:5): ERR-2F000(17071): return statement in functions should have &lt;value&gt; clause<br>Function created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Specify the value in RETURN clause as follows.<br><br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN 1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Function created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17072 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): existing state of routine has been discarded**

<a id="34ecebf0bb1d2245"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The procedure became inexecutable by DROP PROCEDURE statement as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1 AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Procedure created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_sql VARCHAR(1024);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_sql := 'DROP PROCEDURE proc1;';<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE v_sql;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17072): existing state of routine(PROC1) has been discarded :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 9:<br>ERROR at PROCEDURE("PROC1")</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Do not DROP during the procedure.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1 AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Procedure created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_sql VARCHAR(1024);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_sql := 'DROP PROCEDURE proc1;';<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;-- EXECUTE IMMEDIATE v_sql;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17073 (SQLSTATE: 2F003): DDLs or DCLs cannot be invoked during DMLs or SELECT statements are executing in "%s"."%s"**

<a id="43e1b9f1f6d608da"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The stored function used in SELECT includes DDL as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( a1 INTEGER )<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'DROP TABLE t2';<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN a1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT FUNC1( id ) FROM t2 where id = 101;<br><br>ERR-2F003(17073): DDLs or DCLs cannot be invoked during DMLs or SELECT statements are executing in "PUBLIC"."FUNC1" :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'DROP TABLE t2';<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 5:<br>ERROR at FUNCTION("FUNC1")<br><br>SELECT FUNC1( id ) FROM t2 where id = 101<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The stored function used in SELECT should not include DDL.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( a1 INTEGER )<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN a1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT FUNC1( id ) FROM t2 where id = 101;<br><br>FUNC1( ID )<br>-----------<br>&nbsp;101<br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17074 (SQLSTATE: 2F003): cannot begin transaction inside a query in "%s"."%s"**

<a id="a4235ac456fa7149"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The transaction was started by executing SELECT FOR UPDATE within the stored function used in SELECT as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( a1 INTEGER )<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT id INTO v1 FROM t2 WHERE id = a1 FOR UPDATE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN v1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT FUNC1( id ) FROM t2 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1;<br><br>ERR-2F003(17074): cannot begin transaction inside a query in "PUBLIC"."FUNC1" :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT id INTO v1 FROM t2 WHERE id = a1 FOR UPDATE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 11:<br>ERROR at FUNCTION("FUNC1")<br><br>SELECT FUNC1( id ) FROM t2 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Delete FOR UPDATE as follows to prevent the transaction execution within the stored function.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( a1 INTEGER )<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT id INTO v1 FROM t2 WHERE id = a1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN v1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT FUNC1( id ) FROM t2 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1;<br><br>FUNC1( ID )<br>-----------<br>&nbsp;101<br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17075 (SQLSTATE: 2F003): cannot commit or rollback transaction inside a query or DML in "%s"."%s"**

<a id="243cc6d3bece123f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>COMMIT or ROLLBACK exists within the stored function used in DML.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( a1 INTEGER )<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DELETE FROM t2 WHERE id = a1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COMMIT;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN a1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t2(id, name) VALUES ( func1(102), 'abcd' );<br><br>ERR-2F003(17075): cannot commit or rollback transaction inside a query or DML in "PUBLIC"."FUNC1" :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COMMIT;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 11:<br>ERROR at FUNCTION("FUNC1")<br><br>INSERT INTO t2(id, name) VALUES ( func1(102), 'abcd' )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Delete COMMIT statement within the stored function as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( a1 INTEGER )<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DELETE FROM t2 WHERE id = a1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;--# COMMIT;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN a1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t2(id, name) VALUES ( func1(102), 'abcd' );<br>1 row created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17076 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): application error "%s"**

<a id="484b14c5552bd0e0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The usage of RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR is wrong.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR( -10000, 'user-defined error' );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17076): application error "Invalid Error Code" :<br>&nbsp;RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR( -10000, 'user-defined error' );<br>&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:<br>ERROR at PROCEDURE("RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR")</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>If the appropriate error code is used as follows, then it is able to check the desired operation.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR( -20100, 'user-defined error' );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(20100): user-defined error</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17078 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): a function with OUT-Parameter not allowed in expression**

<a id="b1fc23e3f1a29b4d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The stored function including an OUT parameter is not available in DML or SELECT.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( a1 OUT INTEGER )<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;a1 := 1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN 1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT func1( id ) FROM t2;<br><br>ERR-2F000(17078): a function with OUT-Parameter not allowed in expression :<br>SELECT func1( id ) FROM t2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Do not use the stored function including an OUT parameter in SELECT or DML.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17079 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): a nested function not allowed in executing SQL**

<a id="b41c681ce8b01232"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The nested function is not available in SELECT statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FUNCTION f1 RETURN INTEGER<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN 1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br><br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT f1() INTO v1 FROM dual;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (11:12): ERR-2F000(17079): a nested function not allowed in executing SQL</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Create and use the stored function if needed.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION f1 RETURN INTEGER<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN 1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT f1() INTO v1 FROM dual;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17080 (SQLSTATE: 2F002): cannot execute DML jobs inside a query**

<a id="a2a16a54738ff19d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The stored function used in SELECT query can not execute DML.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1 RETURN INTEGER<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;INSERT INTO t2(id, name) VALUES ( 102, 'leekmo' );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN 1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT func1() FROM t2;<br><br>ERR-2F002(17080): cannot execute DML jobs inside a query :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;INSERT INTO t2(id, name) VALUES ( 102, 'leekmo' );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 7:<br>ERROR at FUNCTION("FUNC1")<br><br>SELECT func1() FROM t2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the stored function which does not include DML.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17081 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): program body of the routine is not defined**

<a id="f2090c4bfa30a072"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The routine body is not defined.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (2:3): ERR-2F000(17081): program body of the routine (PROC1) is not defined</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Define the routine body.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1 AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17083 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): Function "%s" returned without value**

<a id="e38e75c67391a028"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>RETURN value clause does not exist in the stored function.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION FUNC1<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 1;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 := v1 + 1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;-- no return clause<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>SELECT FUNC1 FROM DUAL;<br><br>ERR-2F000(17083): Function "FUNC1" returned without value : ERROR at FUNCTION("FUNC1")<br><br>SELECT FUNC1 FROM DUAL<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Specify RETURN clause as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 1;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 := v1 + 1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN v1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT func1 FROM dual;<br><br>FUNC1<br>-----<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2<br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17084 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): The argument "%s" of routine "%s" is invalid**

<a id="674e965a1d39a4ff"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The invalid parameter value was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP( NULL );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17084): The argument "seconds" of routine "DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP" is invalid :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP( NULL );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP( NULL );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:<br>ERROR at PROCEDURE("SLEEP")</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Input the appropriate value as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP( 1 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17086 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): a cursor or routine (%s) declared in spec must be defined in package body**

<a id="aefcd1192237ec62"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The routine declared in the package spec was not defined in the package body.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg1<br>IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FUNCTION&nbsp;&nbsp;func1 ( a1 INTEGER ) RETURN INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1 ( a1 INTEGER );<br>END;<br>/<br>Package created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY pkg1<br>IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FUNCTION func1 ( a1 INTEGER ) RETURN INTEGER<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN 1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17102): PACKAGE(PKG1) Body has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (1:32): ERR-2F000(17086): a cursor or routine (PROC1) declared in spec must be defined in package body<br>Package created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Define the procedure declared in the package spec as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY pkg1<br>IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FUNCTION func1 ( a1 INTEGER ) RETURN INTEGER<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN 1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1( a1 INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Package created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17087 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): existing state of package has been discarded**

<a id="51c043587a4bbefb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The definition about the package instance in use has changed.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg2<br>IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 0;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Package created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY pkg2<br>IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'DROP PACKAGE pkg2';<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COMMIT;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>END;<br>/<br>Package created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pkg2.v1 := 10;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pkg2.proc1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pkg2.v1 := 10;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17087): existing state of package (PKG2) has been discarded</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Do not execute DDL related to the package while using the package.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17088 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): invalid package object status**

<a id="f10ca7f70d2fa393"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The package status has changed while using the package.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg3<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x1 INTEGER := 1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE procAdd;<br>END;<br>/<br>Package created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY pkg3<br>IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE procAdd<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x1 := x1 + x1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>END;<br>/<br>Package created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'ALTER PACKAGE pkg3 COMPILE';<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COMMIT;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pkg3.procAdd();<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'PKG3.X1 = ' || pkg3.x1 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17088): invalid package (PKG3) object status :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE( 'PKG3.X1 = ' || pkg3.x1 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 6:</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Do not execute DDL related to the package while using the package.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17093 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): unsupported element data type**

> **17094 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): IN cursor cannot be opened**

<a id="e8d827516bdb684e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The cursor used as IN parameter can not be OPENed.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE cursor_type IS REF CURSOR RETURN t1%ROWTYPE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_cur cursor_type;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_row t1%ROWTYPE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1( a_cur IN cursor_type )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN a_cur FOR SELECT * FROM t1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1( v_cur );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FETCH v_cur INTO v_row;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLOSE v_cur;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17094): IN cursor cannot be opened :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN a_cur FOR SELECT * FROM t1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 9:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The cursor parameter for OPEN statement should be defined with OUT parameter as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TYPE cursor_type IS REF CURSOR RETURN t1%ROWTYPE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_cur cursor_type;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_row t1%ROWTYPE;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1( a_cur OUT cursor_type )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN a_cur FOR SELECT * FROM t1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1( v_cur );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FETCH v_cur INTO v_row;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CLOSE v_cur;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17095 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): mismatch parameter count of routine(%s)**

<a id="b536c179323c30c7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The number of procedure parameters has changed while executing the routine.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1( a1 OUT INTEGER )<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;a1 := 1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Procedure created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1( v1 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1( ) ' ||<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'AS '&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;||<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'BEGIN '&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;||<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL; ' ||<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'END; ';<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1( v1 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17095): mismatch parameter count of routine(PROC1) :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1( v1 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 11:<br>ERROR at PROCEDURE("PROC1")</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Do not change the definition of the procedure while executing the routine.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17096 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): mismatch parameter type of routine(%s)**

<a id="b7081933c52bfd50"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The parameter type of the routine has changed while executing the routine.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1( p1 OUT SYS_REFCURSOR ) AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN p1 FOR SELECT 1 FROM DUAL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Procedure created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ref1 SYS_REFCURSOR;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1(p1 OUT INTEGER) AS BEGIN p1 := 1; END;';<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1(ref1);<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17096): mismatch parameter type of routine(PROC1) :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;proc1(ref1);<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 6:<br>ERROR at PROCEDURE("PROC1")</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Do not change the definition of the routine while executing the routine.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17097 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): mismatch return type of function(%s)**

<a id="718c52dfe912e4ed"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The return type of the stored function has changed while executing the routine.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func3<br>RETURN INTEGER<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN 0;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc3<br>IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 VARCHAR(1024);<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 := 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func3 ' ||<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'RETURN TABLE( c1 INTEGER, c2 INTEGER ) ' ||<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'AS ' ||<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'BEGIN ' ||<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'RETURN TABLE( SELECT c1, c2 FROM t1 ); ' ||<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'END;';<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE v2;<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 := func3;<br>end;<br>/<br>Procedure created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; call proc3;<br><br>ERR-2F000(17097): mismatch return type of function(FUNC3) :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 := func3;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 14:<br><br>call proc3<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERROR at PROCEDURE("PROC3")</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Do not change the definition of the stored function while executing the routine.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17098 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): mismatch record field count of routine(%s)**

<a id="7afd62aa00a5dbcd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The number of the record type fields has changed while executing the routine.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( a1 t1%ROWTYPE ) RETURN INTEGER<br>AS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN a1.c1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v2 t1%ROWTYPE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT * INTO v2 FROM t1 LIMIT 1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 := func1(v2);<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'ALTER TABLE t1 ADD COLUMN ( c3 VARCHAR(10) )';<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 := func1(v2);<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17098): mismatch record field count of routine(FUNC1) : ERROR at FUNCTION("FUNC1")<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 := func1(v2);<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 10:</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Do not change the definition of the record type while executing the routine.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17099 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): cycle detected when initialize package instance(%s)**

<a id="9ba3746e79f607c8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Public variables in a package reference one another.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg1<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x INTEGER := pkg2.y + 1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17101): PACKAGE(PKG1) Specification has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (3:18): ERR-42000(16036): 'PKG2.Y': invalid identifier<br>Package created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg2<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;y INTEGER := pkg1.x + 1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17101): PACKAGE(PKG2) Specification has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (3:14): ERR-42000(16036): 'PKG2.Y': invalid identifier<br>Package created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg1<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x INTEGER := pkg2.y + 1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17101): PACKAGE(PKG1) Specification has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (3:14): ERR-2F000(17099): cycle detected when initialize package instance(PKG1)<br>Package created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">During initialization of package public variables, circular dependencies caused by such references must be avoided.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="fc181b3fb35e31b3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17101 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): PACKAGE(%s) Specification has compilation errors**

<a id="139c78f9bbe765cf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The compile error exists in the package specification.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg1 AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 invalid%ROWTYPE;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17101): PACKAGE(PKG1) Specification has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (2:7): ERR-2F000(17012): unknown type name<br>Package created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Fix the related compile error.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg1 AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 t1%ROWTYPE;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Package created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17102 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): PACKAGE(%s) Body has compilation errors**

<a id="912ee56c3b94a36d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The compile error exists in the package body.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg1<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Package created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY pkg1<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pkg1.invalid := 1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17102): PACKAGE(PKG1) Body has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (6:12): ERR-42000(16036): 'INVALID': invalid identifier<br>Package created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Fix the related compile error.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY pkg1<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE proc1<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pkg1.v1 := 1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;END;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Package created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17103 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): cannot use function in the same package**

<a id="471602a3d444cbc4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The function of the same package can not be used when initializing the variable in the package specification.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg3<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FUNCTION func1 RETURN INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := func1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17101): PACKAGE(PKG3) Specification has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (4:19): ERR-2F000(17103): cannot use function in the same package<br>Package created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use a constant or another function when initializing the variable in the package specification.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pkg3<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FUNCTION func1 RETURN INTEGER;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 INTEGER := 0;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Package created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17104 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): invalid REFCURSOR handle**

<a id="39ee01395e772784"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>REFCURSOR information transferred from the client is invalid.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check if the client forcibly changed REFCURSOR information.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17105 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): invalid REFCURSOR binding**

<a id="cddcdce1c89b3852"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>REFCURSOR parameter should be used.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE PROC1( A1 IN OUT SYS_REFCURSOR )<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Procedure created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var V1 INTEGER;<br><br>gSQL&gt; CALL PROC1( :v1 );<br><br>ERR-2F000(17105): invalid REFCURSOR binding :<br>CALL PROC1( :v1 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check if the host variable is REFCURSOR.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v_cur REFCURSOR<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN :v_cur FOR SELECT * FROM t1 ORDER BY c1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CALL proc1( :v_cur );<br><br>Procedure Call complete.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17106 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): unknown field name (%s)**

<a id="a1e7af16792d69c8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>A record field name which does not exist was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 t1%ROWTYPE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1.c1 := 1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1.invalid := 1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (5:8): ERR-2F000(17106): unknown field name (INVALID)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the existing field name.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 t1%ROWTYPE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1.c1 := 1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1.c2 := 1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17107 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): only cursor variable allowed**

<a id="bfeb4041e09790bd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The host variable can not be used as an argument of DBMS_SQL.RETURN_RESULT function.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v_refcur refcursor;<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN :v_refcur FOR SELECT id FROM t2;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_SQL.RETURN_RESULT( :v_refcur );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17107): only cursor variable allowed :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_SQL.RETURN_RESULT( :v_refcur );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_SQL.RETURN_RESULT( :v_refcur );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 3:<br>ERROR at PROCEDURE("RETURN_RESULT")</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use the cursor variable as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>DECLARE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;v_refcur SYS_REFCURSOR;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN v_refcur FOR SELECT id FROM t2;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_SQL.RETURN_RESULT( v_refcur );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Anonymous PL block executed.<br><br>ResultSet #1<br><br>&nbsp;ID<br>---<br>101<br>102</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17108 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): Implicit result cannot be returned through this statement**

<a id="9c3bca56b4ccb65d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The stored function including DBMS_SQL.RETURN_RESULT can not be used in SELECT statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1 RETURN INTEGER<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v_cur SYS_REFCURSOR;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN v_cur FOR SELECT id FROM t2;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_SQL.RETURN_RESULT( v_cur );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN 1;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; select func1 from dual;<br><br>ERR-2F000(17108): Implicit result cannot be returned through this statement :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_SQL.RETURN_RESULT( v_cur );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 6:<br>ERROR at PROCEDURE("RETURN_RESULT")<br><br>select func1 from dual<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use it to transfer REFCURSOR to the client as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt; var v1 INTEGER;<br>gSQL&gt; CALL func1() INTO :v1;<br><br>Procedure Call complete.<br><br>ResultSet #1<br><br>&nbsp;ID<br>---<br>101<br>102</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17109 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): table function need return table statement**

<a id="20461e927ec6d311"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The table function should include RETURN TABLE statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN TABLE( id INTEGER )<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NULL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM TABLE( func1() );<br><br>ERR-2F000(17109): table function need return table statement :<br>SELECT * FROM TABLE( func1() )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:<br>ERROR at FUNCTION("FUNC1")<br><br>SELECT * FROM TABLE( func1() )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Use RETURN TABLE statement as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN TABLE( id INTEGER )<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN TABLE ( SELECT id FROM t2 );<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM TABLE( func1() );<br>&nbsp;ID<br>---<br>101<br>102<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17110 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): return table statement not allowed**

<a id="8bae7744e2314aaf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>RETURN TABLE statement can not be described.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN TABLE ( SELECT id, name FROM t2 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17032): PSM compilation error :<br>(1) at (2:5): ERR-2F000(17110): return table statement not allowed</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>RETURN TABLE statement should be described when creating the table function as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN TABLE ( a1 INTEGER, a2 VARCHAR(32) )<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN TABLE( SELECT id, name FROM t2 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Function created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17111 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): only select statement allowed**

<a id="9185107356332f6b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>SELECT FOR UPDATE statement can not be described in RETURN TABLE clause.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN TABLE( id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(32) )<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN TABLE ( SELECT id, name FROM t2 FOR UPDATE );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-01000(16409): Warning: Routine(FUNC1) has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (5:18): ERR-2F000(17111): only select statement allowed<br>Function created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Only SELECT statement without FOR UPDATE can be described as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN TABLE( id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(32) )<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN TABLE ( SELECT id, name FROM t2 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Function created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17112 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): mismatch field count of function table(%s)**

<a id="fb5b49cb72b54288"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The number of fields in RETURN TABLE clause and that of SELECT statement are different.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN TABLE( id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(32), value INTEGER )<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN TABLE ( SELECT id, name FROM t2 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-01000(16409): Warning: Routine(FUNC1) has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (5:20): ERR-2F000(17112): mismatch field count of function table(FUNC1)<br>Function created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Make the number of fields in RETURN TABLE clause and that of SELECT statement same as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN TABLE( id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(32) )<br>IS<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN TABLE ( SELECT id, name FROM t2 );<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Function created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17113 (SQLSTATE: 2F000): cursor that have never fetched is allowed**

<a id="e0ed8d4fb9b05b8c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The cursor which is being fetched can not be used as an argument of RETURN TABLE.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN TABLE ( id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(32) )<br>IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cur1 SYS_REFCURSOR;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 t2%ROWTYPE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN cur1 FOR SELECT * FROM t2;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FETCH cur1 INTO v1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN TABLE ( cur1 );<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM TABLE ( func1() );<br><br>ERR-2F000(17113): only cursor that have never fetched is allowed :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN TABLE ( cur1 );<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 8:<br>ERROR at FUNCTION("FUNC1")<br><br>SELECT * FROM TABLE ( func1() )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Delete the FETCH clause as follows.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1<br>RETURN TABLE ( id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(32) )<br>IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cur1 SYS_REFCURSOR;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v1 t2%ROWTYPE;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;OPEN cur1 FOR SELECT * FROM t2;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;-- FETCH cur1 INTO v1;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN TABLE ( cur1 );<br>END;<br>/<br>Function created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM TABLE ( func1() );<br><br>&nbsp;ID NAME<br>--- ----------<br>101 SUNJESOFT<br>102 GOLDILOCKS<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17114(SQLSTATE: 39000) function symbol not found for built-in package routine \"%s\".\"%s\"**

<a id="6d64cec5df28e0c9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is not able to find the supported built-in package routine.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BUILTIN_PACKAGE_SCHEMA.DBMS_LOCK<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AUTHID CURRENT_USER<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FUNCTION CONVERT( id IN INTEGER, lockhandle in varchar, lockmode in integer, timeout in number )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN INTEGER<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NOT DETERMINISTIC<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;MODIFIES SQL DATA<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;LANGUAGE C<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;LIBRARY INTERNAL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17101): PACKAGE(DBMS_LOCK) Specification has compilation errors :<br>(1) : ERR-39000(17114): function symbol not found for built-in package routine "DBMS_LOCK"."CONVERT"<br>Package created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the definition of the built-in package routine to use, and input it correctly.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17115(SQLSTATE: 38000) mismatch parameter for built-in package routine \"%s\".\"%s\"**

<a id="1a263f53045b3865"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Parameter mismatch between the built-in package routine and the user-regenerated parameter.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BUILTIN_PACKAGE_SCHEMA.DBMS_LOCK<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AUTHID CURRENT_USER<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE SLEEP( seconds IN NATIVE_SMALLINT )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NOT DETERMINISTIC<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;MODIFIES SQL DATA<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;LANGUAGE C<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;LIBRARY INTERNAL;<br>END;<br>/<br>Package created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP(1);<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-38000(17115): mismatch parameter for built-in package routine "DBMS_LOCK"."SLEEP" :<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP(1);<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP(1);<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 2:<br>ERROR at PROCEDURE("SLEEP")</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the parameter information about the built-in package routine to execute, and input it correctly.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17116(SQLSTATE: 38000) built-in package routine is not allowed**

<a id="dab6df9b30705ff2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The definition of the built-in package routine is not allowed in blocks other than the package specification.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BUILTIN_PACKAGE_SCHEMA.DBMS_LOCK<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AUTHID CURRENT_USER<br>AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE SLEEP( seconds IN NATIVE_INTEGER );<br>END;<br>/<br>Package created.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY BUILTIN_PACKAGE_SCHEMA.DBMS_LOCK<br>IS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PROCEDURE SLEEP( seconds IN NATIVE_INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NOT DETERMINISTIC<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;MODIFIES SQL DATA<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;LANGUAGE C<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;LIBRARY INTERNAL;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-2F000(17102): PACKAGE(DBMS_LOCK) Body has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (3:15): ERR-38000(17116): built-in package routine is not allowed<br>Package created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Define the built-in package routine in the package specification.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **17117(SQLSTATE: 38000) invalid WITH CONTEXT Syntax**

<a id="2163dc24a08b3f48"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>CONTEXT was incorrectly used in WITH CONTEXT or parameter clause.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( p1 NATIVE_INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;p2 NATIVE_INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN NATIVE_INTEGER AS<br>LANGUAGE C<br>LIBRARY lib NAME "addFuncWithCTX"<br>PARAMETERS( CONTEXT,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;p1 INT,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;p2 INT,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN INT );<br>/<br><br>ERR-01000(16409): Warning: Routine(FUNC1) has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (1:1): ERR-38000(17117): invalid WITH CONTEXT Syntax<br>Function created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check if WITH CONTEXT was used without specifying CONTEXT in PARAMETER clause or vice versa. Therefore, if WITH CONTEXT is specified, then CONTEXT should be referenced in PARAMETERS clause.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func1( p1 NATIVE_INTEGER,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;p2 NATIVE_INTEGER )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN NATIVE_INTEGER AS<br>LANGUAGE C<br>LIBRARY lib NAME "addFuncWithCTX"<br>WITH CONTEXT<br>PARAMETERS( CONTEXT,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;p1 INT,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;p2 INT,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;RETURN INT );<br>/<br><br>Function created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is a pl statement which violates the SQL-data access indicator of the routine.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1 CONTAINS SQL AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;var1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT c1 INTO var1 FROM t1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>ERR-01000(16409): Warning: Routine(PROC1) has compilation errors :<br>(1) at (4:3): ERR-2F000(17130): routine sql data access indicator violated<br>Procedure created.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Configure a PL statement which is executable according to the SQL-data access indicator of the routine.<br><br>gSQL&gt;<br>CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE proc1 CONTAINS SQL AS<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;var1 INTEGER;<br>BEGIN<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;var1 := 1;<br>END;<br>/<br><br>Procedure created.</td></tr></tbody></table>
