> **40042 (SQLSTATE: HY000): the sql is empty**

<a id="1911116994d37364"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The bind variable does not contain an SQL statement when executing the \dynamic sql command.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var sql_string VARCHAR(1024)<br>gSQL&gt; \dynamic sql :sql_string<br><br>ERR-HY000(40042): the sql is empty</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Assign the SQL statement to the bind variable as shown below, then run the \dynamic sql command.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \exec :sql_string := 'SELECT c1 FROM t1'<br>gSQL&gt; \dynamic sql :sql_string<br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **40043 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid host variable type**

<a id="00b7af81f8ab9dbd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The bind variable for the \dynamic sql command must be of a string data type.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v_int INTEGER<br>gSQL&gt; \dynamic sql :v_int<br><br>ERR-HY000(40043): invalid host variable type</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use a string-type bind variable as shown below.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \var v_string VARCHAR(1024)<br>gSQL&gt; \exec :v_string := 'SELECT c1 FROM t1'<br>gSQL&gt; \dynamic sql :v_string<br>C1<br>--<br>&nbsp;1<br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **40044 (SQLSTATE: 08003): connection does not exist**

<a id="ab27e8db13111de4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">An SQL statement was executed before the system was started up.<br><br>% gsql --as sysdba<br>Connected to an idle instance.<br>gSQL&gt; select * from dual;<br>ERR-08003(40044): connection does not exist:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Start up the system first, then execute the SQL statement as shown below.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \startup<br>Startup success<br>gSQL&gt; select * from dual;<br>DUMMY<br>-----<br>X<br>1 row selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **40045 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid NUMSIZE value: NUMSIZE must be between %d and %d**

<a id="188c7c974b833918"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The NUMSIZE value is invalid.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \set numsize -1<br>ERR-HY000(40045): invalid NUMSIZE value: NUMSIZE must be between 1 and 50</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use a NUMSIZE value within the valid range.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \set numsize 50</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **40046 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid PAGESIZE value: PAGESIZE must be between %d and %d**

<a id="d4f99175133b3ac7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The PAGESIZE value is invalid.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \set pagesize -1<br>ERR-HY000(40046): invalid PAGESIZE value: PAGESIZE must be between 1 and 100000</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use a PAGESIZE value within the valid range.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \set pagesize 100</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **40047 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid LINESIZE value: LINESIZE must be between %d and %d**

<a id="b00da6db0e40614f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The LINESIZE value is invalid.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \set linesize -1<br>ERR-HY000(40047): invalid LINESIZE value: LINESIZE must be between 1 and 100000</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use a LINESIZE value within the valid range.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \set linesize 100</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **40048 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid COLSIZE value: COLSIZE must be between %d and %d**

<a id="5081f5921bcb0749"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">A COLSIZE value in an invalid range was used.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \set colsize -1<br>ERR-HY000(40048): invalid COLSIZE value: COLSIZE must be between 1 and 104857600</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use a COLSIZE value within the valid range.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **40049 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid HISTORY value: HISTORY must be less equal than %d**

<a id="344608a6cbbb0b22"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The HISTORY value is invalid.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \set history 100000000000<br>ERR-HY000(40049): invalid HISTORY value: HISTORY must be less equal than 100000</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use a HISTORY value within the valid range.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \set history 100</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **40050 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid DDLSIZE value: DDLSIZE must be between %d and %d**

<a id="74bc893a08362c7f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The DDLSIZE value is invalid.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \set ddlsize -1<br>ERR-HY000(40050): invalid DDLSIZE value: DDLSIZE must be between 1 and 10485760</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use a DDLSIZE value within the valid range.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \set ddlsize 10000</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **40051 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid object identifier**

<a id="93a83c99e289d270"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The related object was modified during execution of the command to<a href="../part-06-utility-manual/44-gsql-gsqlnet-interactive-sql-tool.md#692c840ba804d7fc">output the DDL statement of the SQL object</a>.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use the command to<a href="../part-06-utility-manual/44-gsql-gsqlnet-interactive-sql-tool.md#692c840ba804d7fc">output the DDL statement of the SQL object</a>&nbsp;only after the DDL operation has been completed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **40052 (SQLSTATE: HY000): not enough DDLSIZE. use command: \set ddlsize {n}**

<a id="fc930e1d25be0642"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The DDLSIZE value is too small to output the DDL statement.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \set ddlsize 10<br>gSQL&gt; \ddl_table t1<br>ERR-HY000(40052): not enough DDLSIZE.<br>use command: \set ddlsize {n}</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Increase the DDLSIZE value and then execute again.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \set ddlsize 10000<br>gSQL&gt; \ddl_table t1<br><br>SET SESSION AUTHORIZATION "TEST";<br>CREATE TABLE "PUBLIC"."T1"<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;"C1" NUMBER( 10, 0 )<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PCTFREE&nbsp;&nbsp;10<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PCTUSED&nbsp;&nbsp;60<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;INITRANS 4<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;MAXTRANS 32<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;STORAGE<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;INITIAL 524288<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;NEXT&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;262144<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;MINSIZE 524288<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;MAXSIZE 35184372088832<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TABLESPACE "MEM_DATA_TBS"<br>;<br>COMMIT;</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **40053 (SQLSTATE: HY000): confirmation password mismatch**

<a id="a4230d84f70e5ec6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The newly entered passwords do not match after the password expiration.<br><br>% gsql u1 u1_password<br>ERR-28000(16312): the password has expired<br>Changing password for u1<br>New password:<br>Retype new password:<br>ERR-HY000(40053): confirmation password mismatch</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Enter the passwords accurately and ensure they match.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **40054 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid locator ini property - '%s'**

<a id="c16cec21e996fa90"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It tried to get the connection information of the member node from the location file or glocator according to the LOCATOR_DSN settings of the data source, but the connection information was missing.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>HOST or IP of glocator is required and the connection information of the node should exist in glocator, to get the connection information of the member node from glocator. Or, the connection information of each member node is required to get the connection information from the location file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **40055 (SQLSTATE: HY000): not exist member '%s' in file - '%s'**

<a id="6718803dc8fc2292"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The location file does not have the data source name matching the member node name.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Specify the data source which uses the member node name in the location file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **40056 (SQLSTATE: HY000): some of nodes were failed to startup**

<a id="07b89bdf18496aec"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>It tried cstartup, but an arbitrary member node failed.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Find the failed node, then startup it separately.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **40057 (SQLSTATE: HY000): not specified valid location information**

<a id="1f3daa79dc4efe29"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>glocator connection information or location file information does exist in the data source matching LOCATOR_DSN property.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Record the host or port information of glocator, or location file information in the data source matching LOCATOR_DSN property.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **40058 (SQLSTATE: HY000): some of nodes were failed to shutdown**

<a id="bd8bb7104b42a1ba"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>An arbitrary member node failed during the shutdown.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Find the failed node, then startup it separately.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **40059 (SQLSTATE: HY000): failed to connect to original driver node '%s' after startup**

<a id="3c43ece40981436a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The cluster startup process using cstartup was completed, but reconnection to the originally connected node failed.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the status of the original node and the network connection.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **40060 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot execute 'cstartup' or 'cshutdown' command in DA mode**

<a id="3ec075c21cd062fd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>It tried to execute cstartup or cshutdown in DA mode.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Execute cstartup or cshutdown in gsqlnet when it is CS mode.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **40061 (SQLSTATE: HY000): currently connected node is inactive**

<a id="2cd06804564fa63a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This warning message indicates that the cluster startup via the cstartup command has completed, but a previously connected node failed to join the cluster.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Connect to another node that has successfully joined the cluster.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **40062 (SQLSTATE: HY000): file not exist -'%s'**

<a id="d6b4ff4b1bafe831"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The cstartup or cshutdown command was executed in C/S mode, but the locator file specified in the LOCATOR_DSN property of the DSN defined in the odbc.ini file does not exist.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the LOCATOR_DSN property.<br><br>If the .odbc.ini file is configured as shown below, make sure that the corresponding .locator.ini file exists.<br><br>% cat .odbc.ini<br>[GOLDILOCKS]<br>HOST=127.0.0.1<br>PORT = 22581<br>LOCATOR_DSN = LOCATOR<br><br>[LOCATOR]<br>FILE = .locator.ini</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="44241bd93c5d6c2e"></a>
## gloader/ gloadernet Related Error

> **42000 (SQLSTATE: RD000): Service is not available**

<a id="e1f7f43932a39b35"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It failed to allocate the memory while allocating ODBC Env handle, or it failed to read&nbsp;&nbsp;odbc.ini file.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the system memory or odbc.ini file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42001 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid control file format**

<a id="ef50d899dacc1f7d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It failed to analyze the control file. The syntax, or the constraint of a filed terminator, a qualifier, a line terminator is wrong. Otherwise, check the error message.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the syntax, the constraint or the error message of the control file, then modify it.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42002 (SQLSTATE: HY000): buffer exceeded overflow area**

<a id="df4be76643b8383b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">deprecated</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42003 (SQLSTATE: HY000): open same file(%s)**

<a id="18986a869c167e39"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The duplicate name exists among the given data, log, bad files.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Do not used the duplicate name.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42004 (SQLSTATE: HY000): occur invalid handle error**

<a id="0e52e1a7a001eb22"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>SQL_INVALID_HADNLE was returned from ODBC API function.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42005 (SQLSTATE: HY000): occur error while operating SQLGetDiagRec/SQLGetDiagField**

<a id="a5e83613ec6f5db9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>SQL_ERROR was returned from SQLGetDiagRec or SQLGetDiagField function.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42006 (SQLSTATE: HY000): using same character for delimiter and qualifier**

<a id="3c0c7d3186357278"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42007 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid thread unit count.(1~32)**

<a id="72f42372a2db486a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The number of threads specified for the parallel processing exceeds the range.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The range of the number of threads which can be specified for the parallel processing is 1 ~32.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42008 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid array size.(1~65535)**

<a id="91d240905ec87bcc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The array size exceeds the range.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>The valid range of the array size is 1 ~ 65535.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42009 (SQLSTATE: HY000): unavailable multithreading in export mode.**

<a id="912aae464e4cb630"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The parallel option was used in the export mode.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>The parallel option can not be used in the export mode</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42010 (SQLSTATE: 08S01): Communication link failure**

<a id="93da22db68760f0b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The session is disconnected.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the trace log and the server state, then take an action.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42011 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid file size (minimum size : %d)**

<a id="866094091aa44c4e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The given file size option is smaller than the required minimum size when using the binary format.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Modify the file size option.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42012 (SQLSTATE: HY000): unavailable file size in text mode.**

<a id="13f323c60ab55047"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42013 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid column type.**

<a id="5488df8e157a42c8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The data type of the data and the column type of the table do not match when importing in binary format.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Match the column type of the file and that of DB.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42014 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid column count.**

<a id="36a4faad0013139a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The number of columns recorded in a file and the number of columns in the table do not match when importing in binary format.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Match the number of columns in file and that in DB.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42015 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid data size.**

<a id="0c5cb800ebfe15f1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The column data length of the file is bigger than the column size when importing in binary format.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>The column size of the table should be bigger than or equal to the column data of the file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42016 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid binary file.**

<a id="5c16e39029f89e42"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when the input file is invalid during a binary format import. Possible causes are as follows:<br><ul><li>The checksum in the file header does not match.</li><li>The file is truncated, the data area and block information are inconsistent, or an EOF is encountered earlier than expected while processing records.</li><li>The internal processing unit calculated from the column definitions used during the export operation differs from that calculated from the column definitions of the import target.</li></ul></td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the error message, then either transfer the file again or perform the export operation again in binary format.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42017 (SQLSTATE: HY000): file is empty.**

<a id="7a9beb4b3f2cd65f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42018 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Qualifier must be 1 length character.**

<a id="fca284798664cf88"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42019 (SQLSTATE: HY000): LF and CR can not be used for delimiter or qualifier.**

<a id="1b0c8bb1210643ae"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42020 (SQLSTATE: HY000): qualifiers and terminators must not be subsets of each other**

<a id="270ae1f527ee5ad9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Strings of qualifier and other identifiers belong to a subset.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Qualifiers and other identifiers should not be subsets of each other.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42021 (SQLSTATE: HY000): table name must be given in case of absence of control file.**

<a id="31d6d0e1e4c1f4e3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The table name was not given as a control file and an option.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Input the table name.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42022 (SQLSTATE: HY000): can not fetch schema name.**

<a id="8067351848e47ad9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42023 (SQLSTATE: 22001): byte length of data greater than column length.**

<a id="3c3bca80837ceb46"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>When importing in binary format, the character of the data was converted and this converted data is bigger than the column size.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Expand the column size of the table.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42024 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid direct io size**

<a id="94196f9405bf5312"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The number used in Direct Io Size option is wrong. Or, Direct Io Size of the data file used when importing in binary format does not match the option.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Use multiples of 8 bigger than 512.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42025 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Target column is invalid: %s**

<a id="b7d39ff73b8566e4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The target column was specified in the table syntax of the control file, but it does not exist in the table.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the name and number of columns.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42026 (SQLSTATE: HY000): The number of target columns mismatch**

<a id="36b76cf6a6426081"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The number of target columns in the table syntax of the control file is bigger than the number of columns in the table.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the name and number of columns.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42027 (SQLSTATE: HY000): ADD keyword is unusable in export mode**

<a id="4e4c294221f88b56"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>ADD keyword was used while specifying the target column in the table syntax of the control file when exporting.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>The target column can not be used together with ADD keyword when exporting.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42028 (SQLSTATE: HY000): the merge extent option is not available in parallel imports.**

<a id="49c3f00c06480a9f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">When performing a parallel import, only the segment-level storage merge option is supported.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Perform the parallel import without the merge option, or specify the segment option.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **42029 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid arguments**

<a id="f06884838e31aa82"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>An invalid option was used in the arguments when executing gloader.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the detailed error message, and then restart gloader.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="6fcafb6a64eb8062"></a>
## gmaster Related Error

> **44000 (SQLSTATE: HY000): database is already mounted**

<a id="c46b151d58424fc3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when attempting to MOUNT a database that is already in the MOUNT phase.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM MOUNT DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM MOUNT DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16114): database is already mounted</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Change the database to the LOCAL OPEN phase and execute the command again.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN LOCAL DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **44001 (SQLSTATE: HY000): database is already local opened**

<a id="e9c71ed5aabf9bbb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when attempting to LOCAL OPEN a database that is already in the LOCAL OPEN phase.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN LOCAL DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN LOCAL DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16115): database is already local opened</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Change the database to the OPEN phase and execute the command again.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **44002 (SQLSTATE: HY000): database is already opened**

<a id="bf1aa11b3d0c13e7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when attempting to OPEN a database that is already in the OPEN phase.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-42000(16345): database is already opened</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>No action required.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **44003 (SQLSTATE: HY000): system thread is already created**

<a id="a63ad7c41a9629b2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This is an error code used within the server.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **44004 (SQLSTATE: HY000): failed to create system threads (%s)**

<a id="458b6788bdaefa6f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the gmaster system thread fails to be created during startup.<br>The causes may vary, but it usually occurs due to insufficient operating system resources.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Resolve the cause and restart the server.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **44005 (SQLSTATE: HY000): member '%s' does not exist**

<a id="d3000b2e659be890"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs during the startup process while progressing to the MOUNT phase if the local member's location information is missing.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \STARTUP NOMOUNT<br><br>Startup success<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM MOUNT DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-HY000(44004): failed to create system threads (cluster recover)<br>ERR-HY000(44005): member 'G1N1' does not exist</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Add the location information for the local member and try again.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE CLUSTER LOCATION g1n1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 11150;<br><br>Location created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM MOUNT DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **44006 (SQLSTATE: HY000): fail to send packet through communication context**

<a id="ff5084ef18b5adfb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the cluster recover protocol fails to be sent to a remote node during startup.<br>It generally happens when the remote socket connection is lost.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Restart the server.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **44007 (SQLSTATE: HY000): failed to start up a process '%s'**

<a id="5575ca0c8341cd63"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the system process fails to be created during startup.<br>The causes may vary, but it usually occurs due to insufficient operating system resources.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Resolve the cause and restart the server.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **44008 (SQLSTATE: HY000): timeout expired - '%s'**

<a id="002430820651372d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the wait time for a response after sending a message to the RECOVERY socket exceeds the value of<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#0e6e1eb0cbed5739">CLUSTER_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_SEC</a>.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Increase the value of CLUSTER_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_SEC and try again, or start up each member sequentially instead of in parallel.<br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM SET CLUSTER_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_SEC = 10;<br>System altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **44009 (SQLSTATE: HY000): RECOVERY socket is broken**

<a id="2cf4e8238979efaf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the RECOVERY socket connection with the remote server is lost.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">After restoring the network or the remote server to a normal state, retry the startup.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **44010 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid RECOVERY protocol**

<a id="dbc610db4605974a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs when an invalid protocol is transmitted.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the network status.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="529d0c13cb6e0275"></a>
## glsnr Related Error

> **45000 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Listener configuration file "%s" doesn't exist.**

<a id="548fe6dd79cad669"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The glsnr configuration file does not exist at the specified path.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check whether the $GOLDILOCKS_DATA/conf/goldilocks.listener.conf file exists.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **45001 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Environment Variable "%s" is not defined.**

<a id="4dd0a6d758dd28ff"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The environment variable is not defined.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Set the environment variable.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **45002 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Listener is already started.**

<a id="5f521157a54ba556"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>glsnr is already running.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the status of the currently running glsnr.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **45003 (SQLSTATE: HY000): overflow fd**

<a id="fc9314fa77509870"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The system has reached the limit for file descriptors.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Increase the file descriptor limit on the system.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **45004 (SQLSTATE: 08000): Invalid communication protocol**

<a id="ec176266f7d62e05"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The client used an unsupported communication protocol.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Verify the version compatibility between the client and the server.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **45005 (SQLSTATE: 08004): access denied**

<a id="73e7d2627f509b02"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The client's IP address was blocked by the access control list.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the settings in the goldilocks.invited.conf or goldilocks.excluded.conf files.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **45006 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Operation timed out**

<a id="b10c79c30188b9a8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The connection was not completed within the TIMEOUT period specified in the glsnr configuration file.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Increase the TIMEOUT value in the glsnr configuration file or check the network connection status.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **45007 (SQLSTATE: HY000): shared mode inactive**

<a id="859e2eed9f5c8748"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">A client is attempting to connect in shared mode, but no shared server is active.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Connect the client using dedicated mode.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **45008 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid property value [ DEDICATED | SHARED ] : %s**

<a id="426948739cc13cc3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The DEFAULT_CS_MODE value in the glsnr configuration file is incorrectly set.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Set the DEFAULT_CS_MODE value to either DEDICATED or SHARED.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **45009 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid property value [ NO | INVITED | EXCLUDED ] : %s**

<a id="6b5935f4d85c5d34"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The TCP_VALIDNODE_CHECKING value in the glsnr configuration file is incorrectly set.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Correct the TCP_VALIDNODE_CHECKING value to one of the following: NO, INVITED, or EXCLUDED.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **45010 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid property value [ YES | NO | 1 | 0 ]: %s**

<a id="b10bc8e9658aa2b1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>An invalid value is set for a boolean-type property in the glsnr configuration file.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Correct the boolean property value to one of the following: YES, NO, 1, or 0.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **45011 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid property value [ %ld ~ %ld ]: %s**

<a id="c28962f554610aee"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">An integer-type property value in the glsnr configuration file is out of the allowed range.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Adjust the property value in the glsnr configuration file to be within the valid range.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **45012 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid property value [ %ld ~ %ld ]: %s**

<a id="6c344ffb1fc7d899"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The length of a string-type property in the glsnr configuration file exceeds the allowed range.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Adjust the property value in the glsnr configuration file to an appropriate length.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **45013 (SQLSTATE: HY000): buffer over flow %s**

<a id="bdcd5a1acd7f34fa"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The internal buffer size was exceeded while processing the configuration values.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the path-related properties in the glsnr configuration file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **45014 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Unix Domain Socket [%s] does not exist**

<a id="4a1e833bdd00587c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Unix Domain Socket which was created in glsnr does not exist.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Terminate glsnr, and restarts it.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="335b57309535d174"></a>
## cyclone Related Error

> **46000 (SQLSTATE: RD000): Service is not available**

<a id="36e0c86b3f93fa85"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The database to be replicated was not connected properly.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check whether the database is running normally and verify that the connection string in the trace log is correct. If any incorrect information is found, correct the database connection details specified in the environment file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46001 (SQLSTATE: HY000): "%s": file does not exist**

<a id="b843d76e29b29115"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The environment file or other files do not exist in the specified path.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Modify the file path and name correctly, then re-execute.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46002 (SQLSTATE: HY000): configure file processing error**

<a id="ffe117a89c02fa56"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The content specified in the environment file is incorrect.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Modify it based on the output error message.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46003 (SQLSTATE: HY000): "%s": table does not exist**

<a id="5f65d7ae6c6fd295"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The table information specified in the environment file does not exist in the database.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Update the environment file so that its information matches the database.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46004 (SQLSTATE: HY000): "%s": schema does not exist**

<a id="d2d23d64d09bfc28"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The schema information specified in the environment file does not exist in the database.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Update the environment file so that its information matches the database.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46005 (SQLSTATE: HY000): "%s.%s": previously added. maybe duplicated**

<a id="6c17a1a1f3963e4f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The environment file contains duplicate table information.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Remove the duplicate table information from the environment file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46006 (SQLSTATE: HY000): "%s%s": table must have a primary key**

<a id="70a80071f9a4069a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The specified table does not have a primary key set.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Set or add a primary key to the table.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46007 (SQLSTATE: HY000): internal error occurred (%s)**

<a id="c53dc150fcfb203e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs due to an internal failure.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the trace log and contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46008 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid datatype (%ld)**

<a id="031448213883803a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">A data type that does not support replication was used.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Verify that the data type supports replication. When interworking with other vendor databases, refer to<a href="../part-07-replication/55-cyclone.md#8b3c4c8cbdca6ddc">Datatype Compatibility When Interworking with Other DBMS</a>&nbsp;and use the appropriate data type.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46009 (SQLSTATE: HY000): "%s.%s" table must set supplemental log or primary key.**

<a id="583f21109b349c83"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">To perform replication, supplemental logging must be enabled, but it is not enabled on the specified table.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Enable supplemental logging on the table, or set the SUPPLEMENTAL_LOG_DATA_PRIMARY_KEY property in Goldilocks to YES and restart.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46010 (SQLSTATE: HY000): group [%s] is already running**

<a id="fc68ec89b24baa6b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">A replication group with the same name as the one specified in the environment file is already running.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use the --status option to check the running status of Cyclone. If the group is already running, terminate it and restart. When adding a new group, change the group name in the environment file because a group with the same name already exists.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46011 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cyclone is not running**

<a id="5ad77fc7da71c9ef"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Cyclone is not running, or the specified Cyclone replication group name is incorrect.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use the --status option to check whether Cyclone is running and to verify the group name.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46012 (SQLSTATE: HY000): GOLDILOCKS_DATA system environment is invalid**

<a id="a5f4d25b48814ac4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The GOLDILOCKS_DATA system environment argument is not set.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Set GOLDILOCKS_DATA in the environment where replication is executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46013 (SQLSTATE: HY000): "%s" log file reused or invalid. restart cyclone with '--reset' option**

<a id="fa3da6b56c7da07b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Replication cannot proceed because the redo log file specified for obtaining replication data has been reused or the archive log is missing.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check whether ARCHIVELOG_MODE is enabled. To discard the existing replication state and start anew from the current point, restart CYCLONE with the --reset option.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46014 (SQLSTATE: HY000): fail to analyze flow[%s]**

<a id="e586a58e9d947af7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Failed to analyze replication data.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the trace log and contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46015 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid Port Number (1024 ~ 49151) [%s]**

<a id="9e3adf9f55af346c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The PORT value specified in the environment file is incorrect.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Set the PORT value within the range of 1024 to 49151.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46016 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Communication link failure**

<a id="10e99a8f09f8b5dc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The Cyclone replication connection is not functioning correctly.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check whether the network between the master and slave is functioning properly.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46017 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid Protocol value (%s)**

<a id="5aac1161dbd3efa1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">An abnormal protocol was detected during communication between the master and slave.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the trace log and contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46018 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Master disconnect abnormally**

<a id="8a94eb7e6f87f757"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The connection between the slave and master was terminated abnormally.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the master’s trace log.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46019 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Protocol Error Occurred (%s)**

<a id="447c75ceb398416d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The communication protocol is invalid, causing issues between the master and the slave.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the version and compatibility information between the master and the slave.<br>If the same issue continues to occur, check the trace logs and contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46020 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Already Slave Connected**

<a id="b554b7a7254994f1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">A master can be connected to only one slave. This error occurs when the master is already connected to another slave and replication is already in operation.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use the --status option of Cyclone to check whether the slave is already running.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46021 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid Transaction Slot Id**

<a id="047db9467ed314a9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the TRANSACTION_TABLE_SIZE property of GOLDILOCKS is changed after Cyclone has been started.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Restart Cyclone. If TRANSACTION_TABLE_SIZE is changed during replication, Cyclone must be restarted.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46022 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid Supplemental Log (%d)**

<a id="5e510615bb7ce5bb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>An issue occurred while analyzing the redo log.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the trace logs and contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46023 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid operation for DDL**

<a id="6ad52845f76bfd86"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>A DDL operation that CYCLONE cannot handle was executed.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the trace logs and contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46024 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid value to analyze**

<a id="26f1edcb74f0666a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>An unresolvable issue occurred while analyzing the redo log.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the trace logs and contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46025 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid group name**

<a id="48a91983e1f668ae"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>A replication group is not configured in the environment file.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Configure a replication group in the environment file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46026 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Not set master ip**

<a id="81a150a4ab5d836f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The environment file does not have MASTER_IP, which is required for slave operation.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Set MASTER_IP in the environment file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46027 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid capture information**

<a id="6ed9e304cfce1427"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The recovery information is incorrect.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Restart Cyclone using the --reset all option.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="beb597a6b61db891"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>No replication group information is configured in the environment file.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Configure at least one replication group in the environment file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46029 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Duplicate group name (%s)**

<a id="ea380acaf3a036d6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The replication group name is duplicated in the environment file.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Ensure that each replication group name in the environment file is unique.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="d075b7ee4e727c4c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The contents specified in the environment file are incorrect.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Correct the values to valid ones.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="3cd3c990a2e8553c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The value specified in the environment file is too small.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the minimum required value and set it accordingly or higher.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="cf26d5e20d35fd18"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The HOST_PORT value specified in the environment file is incorrect.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Correct the HOST_PORT value in the environment file to a valid value.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="85a40436fbbbfe84"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the wait time exceeds while interworking with LogMirror or reading archive log files. (The error occurs if a required file is not found within 10 seconds.)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check whether the file exists and then restart Cyclone. If the same issue continues to occur, restart Cyclone using the --reset all option.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="53b3d22ab9c1b3db"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>No valid archive log files are available for replication.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the trace logs and contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="9abcc43dbf983f63"></a>

If the same issue continues to occur, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46036 (SQLSTATE: HY000): failed to write file (%s)**

<a id="9fcef295cac0af4a"></a>

If the same issue continues to occur, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46037 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Fail to Update State (%s)**

<a id="24ba95214dce6578"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>An issue occurred while updating the recovery information for replication.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the trace logs and contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="1eb1d610c532fed1"></a>

> **46039 (SQLSTATE: HY000): There is no active redo log file.**

If the same issue continues to occur, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="3eb80fbcd7326965"></a>

<a id="621231c92d7e80bd"></a>

> **46042 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Master database must be started(Open status) for the first time, reset table.**

<a id="75356f506c163b17"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">When Cyclone is run for the first time or with the --reset option, it must connect to Goldilocks. If the connection fails, this error occurs.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the operational status of Goldilocks.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="4c30a8896f72c7fc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The meta file containing operational information is in an invalid state.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Restart Cyclone using the --reset option.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46044 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Redo log file does not exist (%s)**

<a id="aeabf5f13d4a9b2d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The redo log file does not exist.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the trace logs and contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="79a8a171ceae42cb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The USER_ID and USER_PW required to connect to Goldilocks are not set in the environment file.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Specify USER_ID and USER_PW in the environment file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46046 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Slave is not running with --sync option.**

<a id="6df8ad72ea315d92"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The master is running in SYNC mode, but the slave is not.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">To perform SYNC operations, both the master and slave must be running in SYNC mode. Restart the slave using the --sync option.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46047 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid Connect Information for sync (%s)**

<a id="07b97562d5993193"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The connection information for SYNC is invalid.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Verify the specified connection information and correct it as needed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="7653bc904141d779"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The specified information exceeds the maximum allowed length.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the maximum length in the user manual and adjust the information accordingly.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46049 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid encrypt/decrypt key**

<a id="792484ef3b246c09"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The key used to encrypt/decrypt the password is invalid.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Modify the USER_ENCRYPT_PW value in the environment file to a value generated with a valid key.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46050 (SQLSTATE: HY000): no '--key' option**

<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The encrypted password has not been generated, or the key to decrypt USER_ENCRYPT_PW is not set.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Run the command with the --key option.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46051 (SQLSTATE: HY000): password already exists (use one of USER_PW or USER_ENCRYPT_PW)**

<a id="61f721fec70e208f"></a>

<a id="0a820331c748cae7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The --reset and --sync 'Table Name' options were used to initialize a specific table, but the table does not exist or has no replication history.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Since --reset and --sync are critical options for replication and data initialization, the exact table name must be specified. If the table has been newly added, perform the operation without using these options.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46053 (SQLSTATE: HY000): reset or sync argument is invalid (%s)**

<a id="e47916bb4a204dc5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The information specified in --reset and --sync is incorrect.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Verify the specified information, correct it, and then rerun the operation.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46054 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Table meta file has broken. please restart with '--reset all'**

<a id="2200fa07b77645da"></a>

> **46055 (SQLSTATE: HY000): protocol timeout**

<a id="3a810cffdc643893"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Heartbeat timeout has been exceeded.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the connection and network status.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="40c1172d3615b3b1"></a>

<a id="0e51e338344fa9a1"></a>

> **46060 (SQLSTATE: HY000): driver does not support %s function**

<a id="948164aa96723ce7"></a>

> **46061 (SQLSTATE: HY000): data type is not supported.**

<a id="7ce782aff1e75544"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">When interworking with a third-party database, an unsupported data type was used.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the<a href="../part-07-replication/55-cyclone.md#8b3c4c8cbdca6ddc">Datatype Compatibility When Interworking with Other DBMS</a>&nbsp;in the user manual and change to a supported data type.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46062 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Cluster information does not matched( before groupid(%d), memberid(%d)/current groupid(%d), memberid(%d) )**

<a id="48c932b35e8523c8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The cluster information in the existing replication data must not be changed, but it has been modified.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the cluster information in the environment file, or restart Cyclone with the --reset all option to initialize the information.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46063 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid cluster information at configure file( %s )**

<a id="697ecd252d7ee7d0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The CLUSTER information specified in the environment file is incorrect.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">This may occur if ID, PORT, or MASTER_IP are duplicated or recorded incorrectly. Correct the values accordingly.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46064 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Fail to rollback transaction**

<a id="7a4fa8b58f79274d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>During replication termination, the rollback failed due to incomplete transactions.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the trace logs and contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46065 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Slave is running with --sync option**

<a id="8a350e447e492840"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The slave is running in SYNC mode, but the master is not.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check whether SYNC mode is enabled and restart both the master and slave with the same execution options.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46066 (SQLSTATE: HY000): MYSQL_DATABASE configuration must needed to connect MySQL/MariaDB**

<a id="a01748abb7a5d6d3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">When interworking with a third-party database, MySQL or MariaDB must have MYSQL_DATABASE configured. An error occurs if this value is not set.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">When connecting to MySQL or MariaDB, be sure to add the MYSQL_DATABASE setting.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46067 (SQLSTATE: HY000): DB2_DATABASE configuration must needed to connect DB2**

<a id="7a92bd75562c5503"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">When interworking with a third-party database, DB2 must have DB2_DATABASE configured. An error occurs if this value is not set.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">When connecting to DB2, be sure to add the DB2_DATABASE setting.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46068 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Configuration described in an invalid area (Should not be described in a specific group, but in a global group)(%s)**

<a id="f66c33cba1021b75"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the configuration described in the configuration file is located in the wrong position.<br>e.g. If it is described as follows in the configuration file, in other words SEPARATE_CONFLICT_LOG is described within GROUP, then an error occurs.<br><br>USER_ID=test<br>USER_PW=test<br>GROUP_NAME = Group1<br>{<br>&nbsp;...<br>&nbsp;SEPARATE_CONFLICT_LOG = 1<br>&nbsp;...<br>}</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Modify the configuration file so that the configuration caused the error is described outside of GROUP.<br><br>USER_ID=test<br>USER_PW=test<br>SEPARATE_CONFLICT_LOG = 1<br>GROUP_NAME=Group1<br>{<br>&nbsp;...<br>&nbsp;...<br>}</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46069 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Data type is not supported.( %s )**

<a id="1036ab0befdc455b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">A column with the ROWID data type is included in the replication target.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Since the ROWID data type is not supported for replication, either exclude the table from the replication target or remove the column, and then re-execute Cyclone.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46070 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Heartbeat protocol stopped abnormally.**

<a id="138da19d2065b8e1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">During the Heartbeat protocol interworking, the connection between the master and slave was interrupted due to an abnormal condition.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the network status and restart Cyclone. If the same issue continues to occur, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46071 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Failed to set SESSION_IS_CDC_APPLIER at session**

<a id="16d98c7485fab23e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Failed to configure the environment for foreign key or trigger constraints.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the trace logs and contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46072 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Error message count mismatch - server(%d), cyclone(%d)**

<a id="8d1eaebf37a66b73"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The error message information between the Goldilocks DB version and the Cyclone version does not match, making backward compatibility impossible.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check for a compatible Cyclone version and reinstall it.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46073 (SQLSTATE: HY000): mismatched major & minor version - server(%d.%d.%d), cyclone(%d.%d.%d)**

<a id="1f281656049c0527"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Cyclone supports compatibility only when the major and minor versions match. An error occurs if the Goldilocks DB and Cyclone versions are not compatible.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check for a compatible Cyclone version and reinstall it.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46074 (SQLSTATE: HY000): mismatched patch version - server(%d.%d.%d), cyclone(%d.%d.%d)**

<a id="ebf07332436d538e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">If the patch version of Goldilocks DB is higher than that of Cyclone, Cyclone only supports backward compatibility and does not support forward compatibility.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check for a compatible Cyclone version and reinstall it.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46075 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Cyclone is not compatible with Server. Server Compatible Number(%d) Cyclone Compatible Number(%d)**

<a id="ff20d07f067eafbf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the Goldilocks DB version is not supported by CYCLONE.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check for a compatible Cyclone version and reinstall it.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46076 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Failed to set supplemental logging.(SUPPLEMENTAL_LOG_FORCE_MODE)(%s.%s.)**

<a id="28478b0253d262d0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when SUPPLEMENTAL_LOG_FORCE_MODE is enabled, but supplemental logging for the table fails to be activated.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check whether the user has the necessary privileges to enable supplemental logging.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46077 (SQLSTATE: HY000) : Failed to set deadlock_priority.(APPLIER_DEADLOCK_PRIORITY)**

<a id="11da1af9aaf4abe4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the DEADLOCK_PRIORITY setting cannot be applied to the Applier even though APPLIER_DEADLOCK_PRIORITY is configured.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check whether the user has the required privileges to enable deadlock_priority.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46078 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Deferred constraints is not supported.( %s.%s )**

<a id="beb0be420ba2ba04"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when deferred constraints are defined on a table in the replication target.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Remove the deferred constraints from the table and restart replication, or exclude the table from the replication target.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **46079 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Failed to set trace log id.(APPLIER_TRACE_LOG_ID)**

<a id="8a975281df7d4b2b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when an invalid value is set for APPLIER_TRACE_LOG_ID.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#df673da80227954c">the flag information for TRACE_LOG_ID</a>&nbsp;and change it to a valid value.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="926d684508a17121"></a>
## LogMirror Related Error

> **47000 (SQLSTATE: RD000): Service is not available**

<a id="e005cd0ccae16a64"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The database was not connected properly.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check whether the database is running normally and verify that the connection string in the trace log is correct. If any incorrect information is found, correct the database connection details specified in the environment file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47001 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid Protocol value (%s)**

<a id="87b11efc09765dbd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">An abnormal protocol was detected during communication between the master and slave.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the trace logs and contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47002 (SQLSTATE: HY000): "%s": file does not exist**

<a id="a8a0e8006fdb384e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The environment file or other required files do not exist in the specified path.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Modify the file path and name correctly, then re-execute.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47003 (SQLSTATE: HY000): "%s": configure file processing error**

<a id="f79352ce0ca4f465"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The content specified in the environment file is incorrect.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Modify it based on the output error message.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47004 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid Control file**

<a id="29c14c1fa95078ed"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The control file required for operation is not properly configured.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the trace log and contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47005 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Communication link failure**

<a id="3a58d868f28f80e6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The master/slave connection was terminated abnormally.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check whether the network between the master and slave is functioning properly.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47006 (SQLSTATE: HY000): LogMirror is already running**

<a id="5c50fb5ea3726767"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>LogMirror is already running.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the execution status of LogMirror and then re-execute it.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47007 (SQLSTATE: HY000): GOLDILOCKS_DATA system environment is invalid**

<a id="cc93d983838a7e8b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The GOLDILOCKS_DATA system environment variable is not set.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Set GOLDILOCKS_DATA in the environment where replication is executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47008 (SQLSTATE: HY000): There is no Shared Memory Area for LogMirror**

<a id="b784c44e131a48ac"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The environment for Goldilocks to interwork with LogMirror is not configured.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Set LOG_MIRROR_MODE=1 in the Goldilocks properties and then re-execute.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47009 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid Value : %s(%s)**

<a id="ab7f764f05334d56"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The values specified in the environment file are incorrect.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Correct them with the proper values.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47010 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid port : (%d)**

<a id="df97352f766838fe"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The PORT value specified in the environment file is incorrect.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Set the PORT value to 65536 or below.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47011 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Master disconnect abnormally**

<a id="2f31dce5683e20c3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The connection with the master was terminated abnormally.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check whether the network is functioning properly. Check the trace logs and contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47012 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid Log File(%s)**

<a id="bb59d330d1fda6fa"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The log file is invalid.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the trace logs and contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47013 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Archive Log File does not exist**

<a id="83b7a9daa32d7308"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Archive log mode is not enabled.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Enable archive log mode in Goldilocks and then restart.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47014 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Archive Log file Read Timeout (%s)**

<a id="482f555982693f5a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>A new archive log file was not created.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Free up disk space on the operating system and then restart.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47015 (SQLSTATE: HY000): LogMirror is not running**

<a id="34d6c72386163a94"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The --stop command was executed while LogMirror was not running.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the execution status of LogMirror.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47016 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Connection Information does not exist**

<a id="e2ccc52dad5ea775"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Not connected to Goldilocks.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the operational status of Goldilocks.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47017 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Infiniband Receive Fail. (%ld)**

<a id="28eadecd87fead6c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Data could not be received due to an infiniband network issue.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the network status. If the same issue continues to occur, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47018 (SQLSTATE: HY000): GOLDILOCKS Shutdown or Give-up LogMirror Service.**

<a id="5efb527923cabc10"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Goldilocks operation has stopped, causing the LogMirror service to terminate as well.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the operational status.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47019 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid encrypt/decrypt key**

<a id="7210923fd242f35a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The key for encrypting/decrypting the password is invalid.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Update the USER_ENCRYPT_PW value in the environment file with a properly generated key.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47020 (SQLSTATE: HY000): no '--key' option**

<a id="1cb6d77452d448f1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The key for generating the encrypted password or for decrypting USER_ENCRYPT_PW is not specified.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Execute the command with the --key option.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47021 (SQLSTATE: HY000): password already exists(use one of USER_PW or USER_ENCRYPT_PW)**

<a id="63b684eb7023a659"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Both USER_PW and USER_ENCRYPT_PW are specified in the environment file.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Remove the unnecessary entry between USER_PW and USER_ENCRYPT_PW, then re-execute.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **47022 (SQLSTATE: HY000): protocol heartbeat timeout**

<a id="9fcf0f1d49c08081"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>A heartbeat timeout has occurred.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the connection and network status.</td></tr></tbody></table>
