## Cluster Related Error

> **56000 (SQLSTATE: HY000): location information of member '%s' already exists**

<a id="8c8a97aadba8515c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when adding location information if the same member information already exists.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM x$cluster_location;<br><br>MEMBER_NAME HOST&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PORT<br>----------- --------- -----<br>G1N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;127.0.0.1 11150<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE CLUSTER LOCATION g1n1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 12150;<br><br>ERR-HY000(56000): location information of member 'G1N1' already exists :<br>CREATE CLUSTER LOCATION g1n1 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 12150<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">No action required.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56001 (SQLSTATE: HY000): location information of member '%s' does not exist**

<a id="fca6384cf23ae632"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when attempting to modify the location information of a non-existent member.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM x$cluster_location;<br><br>MEMBER_NAME HOST&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;PORT<br>----------- --------- -----<br>G1N1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;127.0.0.1 11150<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER CLUSTER LOCATION g1n2 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 12150;<br><br>ERR-HY000(56001): location information of member 'G1N2' does not exist :<br>ALTER CLUSTER LOCATION g1n2 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 12150<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;*<br>ERROR at line 1:</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Verify that the member exists, and then try again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56002 (SQLSTATE: HY000): location information of member '%s' is modified by concurrent execution**

<a id="fd1cf150c698f7dc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56003 (SQLSTATE: HY000): has inactive member ( %s )**

<a id="f6c7a35acbfde246"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when attempting to execute a DDL that requires all members to be active while there are inactive members.<br><br>The following is an example of a table creation failure when g1n2 is in an inactive state.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( i1 INTEGER );<br><br>ERR-HY000(56003): has inactive member ( G1N2 )</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Add the inactive member to the cluster and then retry the DDL.<br><br>The following is an example of recreating the table after adding the previously inactive g1n2 to the cluster.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT local_member_name() FROM dual;<br><br>LOCAL_MEMBER_NAME()<br>-------------------<br>G1N2<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( i1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56004 (SQLSTATE: HY000): location file is corrupted - '%s'**

<a id="6c9e931d9cac353f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the location file is corrupted during entry into the NOMOUNT phase.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Save an uncorrupted location file to the location specified by the<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#05f219122b42a044">LOCATION_FILE</a>&nbsp;property, and then try again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56005 (SQLSTATE: HY000): connections of some cluster members are broken**

<a id="c411e2668c1c1401"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This is an error code used within the server.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56006 (SQLSTATE: 40000): transaction rollback: failed to prepare global transaction**

<a id="4fff4942bd79a392"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs in the following two cases:<br><ul><li>When a global transaction is being PREPAREd and all members of the group accessed by the transaction are inactive.</li><li>When a transaction that triggers a DDL is being PREPAREd and there are inactive members.</li></ul><br>The following is an example of a PREPARE failure during the COMMIT process after creating a table when g1n2 is inactive.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE TABLE t1 ( i1 INTEGER );<br><br>Table created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; COMMIT;<br><br>ERR-40000(56006): transaction rollback: failed to prepare global transaction</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Add the inactive member to the cluster and then retry the transaction.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56007 (SQLSTATE: HY000): must be accessible to at least one of replicas**

<a id="1420831464b864df"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56008 (SQLSTATE: 40000): transaction rollback: failed to synchronize replicas**

<a id="0dcb39e3b18cc122"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when asynchronous synchronization to a replica fails.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the trace log, resolve the cause, and then try again.<br><br>The following is an example recorded in the trace log, where the error occurred because the transaction’s undo exceeded the allocated space.<br><br>[ASYNC] failed to synchronize replica<br>(G1N1) ERR-40000(56008): transaction rollback: failed to synchronize replicas<br>(G1N1) ERR-HY000(14115): MEMBER(G1N2): transaction undo limit exceeded</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56009 (SQLSTATE: HY000): remote server ( member ID: %ld ) is abnormally terminated**

<a id="4868042176cd4608"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The remote session was terminated abnormally.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56010 (SQLSTATE: 40000): transaction rollback: remote session is abnormally terminated**

<a id="55c5857cda3bb8ee"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56011 (SQLSTATE: HY000): a shared session cannot modify NUMA property**

<a id="3065c0a00be13cbf"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56012 (SQLSTATE: HY000): no connection was established to recover in-doubt transactions**

<a id="868c34b03632cecb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56013 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot resolve in-doubt transaction '%d.%d.%d' because '%d' members of the total '%d' remote cluster members were disconnected - connection map was '%s'**

<a id="b189bc72e7254d51"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs while transitioning to the LOCAL OPEN phase if the system cannot determine whether to COMMIT or ROLLBACK an in-doubt transaction in the PREPARE state.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Bring all members to the MOUNT phase or higher, and then attempt LOCAL OPEN again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56014 (SQLSTATE: HY000): MAX_NODE_COUNT property value '%d' must be equal to or less than '%d'**

<a id="9079867150defcd1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs during startup when the<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#a239b812d73d78fd">MAX_NODE_COUNT</a>&nbsp;property is set to a value smaller than the one specified at database creation.<br><br>The following is an example of an error that occurs when the property was set to 64 at database creation, then changed to 128, and the database was restarted.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \STARTUP<br><br>ERR-HY000(56014): MAX_NODE_COUNT property value '128' must be equal to or less than '64'</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Reset the property to the value specified at database creation or lower, and then restart.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM SET max_node_count = 32 DEFERRED SCOPE = file;<br><br>System altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \SHUTDOWN ABORT<br><br>Shutdown success<br><br>gSQL&gt; \STARTUP<br><br>Startup success</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56015 (SQLSTATE: HY000): '%s' property value must be greater than or equal to '%s' property value '%d'**

<a id="10ee57e560938be6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">During startup, the number of SYNC server processes is smaller than the number of SYNC threads in the cluster dispatcher.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Set the CLUSTER_DATA_SYNC_SERVERS value to be equal to or greater than the CDISPATCHER_SYNC_THREADS value, and then restart.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56016 (SQLSTATE: HY000): all members affected by the transaction are inactive - cannot guarantee durability of the transaction**

<a id="bbb58b761f310d73"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This warning occurs during the COMMIT process of a DOMAIN transaction when all members of the group modified by the transaction are in an inactive state.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">It is a warning only, and no action is required.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56017 (SQLSTATE: 40000): transaction rollback: failed to open remote session**

<a id="1ddd8cb752fbdf51"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>Failed to create a remote session for protocol execution.<br>If this error occurs, the transaction is automatically rolled back.<br><br>The following is an example where an error occurred due to insufficient resources while attempting to create a remote session to insert a record into the t1 table.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES( 1 );<br><br>ERR-40000(56017): transaction rollback: failed to open remote session<br>ERR-HY000(11019): MEMBER(G1N2): Insufficient resource : exceeded maximum number of session environments</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Refer to the error message to resolve the cause, and then retry the operation.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56018 (SQLSTATE: HY000): protocol payload size(%ld) exceed maximum packet size(%ld)**

<a id="19a5e497be2b857b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs during protocol marshalling when the size of a single record exceeds<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#9d62ee0963fa5dda">CLUSTER_MAX_PACKET_SIZE</a>.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Set<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#9d62ee0963fa5dda">CLUSTER_MAX_PACKET_SIZE</a>&nbsp;to a value larger than the size of the single record, and then retry the operation.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56019 (SQLSTATE: HY000): failover busy**

<a id="34b946b6ff61024b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs only in the gmaster failover thread and indicates that failover cannot be performed at this time because another member is currently performing failover.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">No action is required.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56020 (SQLSTATE: HY000): internal error ( %s, %d )**

<a id="50733ea2cf5bffa0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This is an error code used within the server.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56021 (SQLSTATE: HY000): exceeded maximum response timeout**

<a id="d1fb0eddf88d01da"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs only in the failover thread of the gmaster.<br>It happens when the response from the locator protocol used during the failover process is not received within the specified timeout.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">When this error occurs, the failover thread handles it according to the defined failover policy.<br>If the issue is caused by insufficient response wait time, increase the<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#1efe52fc87229d75">LOCATOR_QUERY_TIMEOUT</a>&nbsp;value.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56022 (SQLSTATE: HY000): failed to connect to a host**

<a id="e138ea5a281f2e58"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs when the connection to the target node fails.<br>It typically happens if the target node is down or if the host and port are incorrectly configured.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER CLUSTER GROUP g3 ADD CLUSTER MEMBER g3n3 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 13350;<br><br>ERR-HY000(16351): failed to connect to the cluster member 'G3N3'<br>ERR-HY000(56022): failed to connect to a host<br>ERR-HY000(11067): failed to connect to a host with a socket : poll() - port '13350' : stnConnect() returned errno(111)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Specify the correct host and port for the target node and try again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56023 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid cluster communication protocol**

<a id="9442d5e444c81400"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error can occur on the cserver when an unrecognized command is requested.<br>It typically happens when the driver member has been patched to the latest version, but the remote member is still running an older version.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Update the older version to the latest version and retry the operation.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56024 (SQLSTATE: HY000): sequence '%s' is offline**

<a id="2ae20ef9946c3c6f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs in the following two cases:<br><ul><li>When inactive members exist and the sequences of active members are in an offline state.</li><li>When no inactive members exist and the sequences of active members are in an offline state.</li></ul><br>The following shows the result of executing nextval in a 1×2 environment where g1n1’s sequence is offline and g1n2 is inactive.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT is_online FROM v$sequence@g1n1 WHERE sequence_name = 'SEQ';<br><br>IS_ONLINE<br>---------<br>FALSE<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT cm.member_name, vcm.status<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM v$cluster_member@g1n1 vcm, cluster_member@g1n1 cm<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE vcm.member_id = cm.member_id AND cm.member_name = 'G1N2';<br><br>MEMBER_NAME STATUS<br>----------- --------<br>G1N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;INACTIVE<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT seq.nextval FROM dual;<br><br>ERR-HY000(56024): sequence 'SEQ' is offline</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>If inactive members exist, bring those members back into the cluster and then retry the operation.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT local_member_name() FROM dual;<br><br>LOCAL_MEMBER_NAME()<br>-------------------<br>G1N2<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT seq.nextval FROM dual;<br><br>NEXTVAL<br>-------<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;21<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>If no inactive members exist, repeatedly execute the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#8e0788c3012778c5">ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE SEQUENCE</a>&nbsp;statement until it succeeds.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56025 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot synchronize because some members are inactive**

<a id="b0f29419799a9d38"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This occurs when executing the sequence synchronization statement while inactive members exist and the sequences of active members are in an offline state.<br><br>The following shows the result of executing the sequence synchronization statement in a 1×2 environment where g1n1’s sequence is offline and g1n2 is inactive.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT is_online FROM v$sequence@g1n1 WHERE sequence_name = 'SEQ';<br><br>IS_ONLINE<br>---------<br>FALSE<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SEQUENCE seq SYNCHRONIZE;<br><br>ERR-HY000(56025): cannot synchronize because some members are inactive</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Bring the inactive members back into the cluster, and then retry the operation.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56026 (SQLSTATE: HY000): identity column '%s' of table '%s' is offline**

<a id="599b9a49dd74e13f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>This error occurs in the following two cases:<br><ul><li>When inactive members exist and the identity sequences of active members are in an offline state.</li><li>When no inactive members exist and the identity sequences of active members are in an offline state.</li></ul><br>The following shows the result of executing it in a 1×2 environment, where g1n1’s identity sequence is offline and g1n2 is inactive.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT cm.member_name, vcm.status<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM v$cluster_member@g1n1 vcm, cluster_member@g1n1 cm<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE vcm.member_id = cm.member_id AND cm.member_name = 'G1N2';<br><br>MEMBER_NAME STATUS<br>----------- --------<br>G1N2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;INACTIVE<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES( DEFAULT );<br><br>ERR-HY000(56026): identity column 'I1' of table 'T1' is offline</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>If inactive members exist, bring those members back into the cluster and then retry the operation.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT local_member_name() FROM dual;<br><br>LOCAL_MEMBER_NAME()<br>-------------------<br>G1N2<br><br>1 row selected.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.<br><br>gSQL&gt; INSERT INTO t1 VALUES( DEFAULT );<br><br>1 row created.<br><br>If no inactive members exist, repeatedly execute the<a href="../part-03-sql-manual/18-sql-references-a-b.md#8e0788c3012778c5">ALTER DATABASE SYNCHRONIZE SEQUENCE</a>&nbsp;statement until it succeeds.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56027 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cannot resolve in-doubt transaction '%d.%d.%ld' because the transaction remains unfinished**

<a id="d3232b1e6260eaec"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">When restarting a node, a specific transaction that is in the PREPARE state has not yet been COMMITted or ROLLBACKed.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Commit or rollback the transaction first, and then restart the node.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56028 (SQLSTATE: HY000): the property '%s' is not compatible with the cluster system**

<a id="cc23df24cf561a37"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when entering the GLOBAL OPEN phase if the global property values differ among members.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Ensure that all members have identical property values, and then restart the node.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56029 (SQLSTATE: HY000): unable to open a remote session for read only statement**

<a id="2831a8fa66383e31"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Failed to create a remote session for protocol execution when no transaction exists.<br><br>The following is an example of an error occurring due to insufficient resources while creating a remote session to query the t1 table on g1n2.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT * FROM t1@g1n2;<br><br>ERR-HY000(56029): unable to open a remote session for read only statement<br>ERR-HY000(11019): MEMBER(G1N2): Insufficient resource : exceeded maximum number of session environments</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Refer to the error message to resolve the cause, and then retry the operation.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56030 (SQLSTATE: HY000): total cdispatcher threads '%d' must be equal to or less than '%d'**

<a id="9a59f8f42b68f208"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **56031 (SQLSTATE: HY000): startup of remote database '%s' is in progress**

<a id="40d4f963a636c9bd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs if multiple members simultaneously raise the startup phase to global open.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Only one member must raise the startup phase to global open at a time.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="e6003d0b8d1e4f4d"></a>
## cserver Related Error

> **57000 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid statement**

<a id="de83c8cba0b1b947"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when attempting to re-execute a statement in a remote session after an error has already occurred.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">This is a secondary error caused by a previous error. Resolve the root cause of the initial error first, and then retry the operation.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="f36529df91a698c6"></a>
## cdispatcher Related Error

> **58000 (SQLSTATE: HY000): the sender failed to connect to the member(%d)**

<a id="82b9357b7bcfa517"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **58001 (SQLSTATE: HY000): the socket of target member '%s' is already disconnected**

<a id="08a85582a1f9409c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **58002 (SQLSTATE: HY000): the location information for member '%s' is not found**

<a id="ee1f5c2b462905e9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>During the transition from the MOUNT phase to the LOCAL OPEN phase, the local location information was removed.<br><br>gSQL&gt; \STARTUP MOUNT<br><br>Startup success<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN LOCAL DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-HY000(44004): failed to create system threads (monitor)<br>ERR-HY000(44007): failed to start up a process 'cdispatcher'<br>ERR-HY000(58002): the location information for member 'G1N2' is not found</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Add the local location information again, and then re-enter the LOCAL OPEN phase.<br><br>gSQL&gt; CREATE CLUSTER LOCATION G1N2 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 11250;<br><br>Location created.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM OPEN LOCAL DATABASE;<br><br>System altered.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **58003 (SQLSTATE: HY000): the connection information is invalid; %s %d is either equal to or greater than %d**

<a id="7ef005cc41f94ada"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **58004 (SQLSTATE: HY000): the connection timeout from remote(%d)**

<a id="d3d8563e861d8eb9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **58005 (SQLSTATE: HY000): the disconnection timeout from remote(%d)**

<a id="085d2e543c68fd90"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **58006 (SQLSTATE: HY000): invalid connection state transition**

<a id="fe3818fa30f5762f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs during the cluster join process when the state information of the joining node, as maintained by the active nodes, is already in the CONNECTING state.<br>It may appear when the joining node fails due to an abnormal error during the join process and then attempts to rejoin within a short period of time.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Retry the operation after the active nodes have completed cleaning up the state information for the joining node.<br>If the same issue continues to occur, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **58007 (SQLSTATE: HY000): dispatcher thread counts of two hosts do not match**

<a id="5c04347c44148b89"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The number of cdispatcher threads differs between the active node and the joining node.<br><br>The following is an example of an error that occurs when adding a member while the number of cdispatcher threads is configured differently on g1n1 and g1n2.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER CLUSTER GROUP G1 ADD CLUSTER MEMBER G1N2 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 11250;<br><br>ERR-HY000(16351): failed to connect to the cluster member 'G1N2'<br>ERR-HY000(58007): MEMBER(G1N2): cluster dispatcher thread count does not match</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Set the<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#fdfb51d52a773c11">CDISPATCHER_LOCKABLE_THREADS</a>,<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#c0dd3946921b40ff">CDISPATCHER_LOCKLESS_THREADS</a>, and<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#15afebf99e9aea8c">CDISPATCHER_SYNC_THREADS</a>&nbsp;values on the joining node to match those of the active node. Then, restart the joining node and then retry the operation.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **58008 (SQLSTATE: HY000): failed to start '%s' thread of cluster dispatcher**

<a id="7ca9b422bb2e5588"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error may occur during startup if the cdispatcher fails to create its threads. The cause may vary, but it usually occurs due to insufficient operating system resources.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Resolve the cause and restart the node.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **58009 (SQLSTATE: HY000): internal error ( %s, %d )**

<a id="95984f8794c4dfe3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This is an error code used within the server.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **58010 (SQLSTATE: HY000): broken socket**

<a id="ef2774bbd86670ca"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The socket connection between nodes has been disconnected.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the network status, and then reconnect the node whose connection was lost.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **58011 (SQLSTATE: HY000): old cluster connection is still alive**

<a id="623e89300f1561ea"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">An error occurs if an existing connection to the joining node is still maintained on the active node during the cluster join process.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Retry after the joining node’s state has been fully cleared on the active node.<br>If the same issue continues to occur, contact customer support.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **58012 (SQLSTATE: HY000): failover event is in progress**

<a id="47f0fbb3e9ae2128"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">An attempt was made to rejoin a node to the cluster while the failover process for the disconnected node was still in progress.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Retry after all ongoing failover processes on the active nodes have been completed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **58013 (SQLSTATE: HY000): the connection can be established at LOCAL OPEN or OPEN phase**

<a id="49838c3e3e317a1f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when a node that is still in the startup process is designated as a target node for cluster DDL.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Retry after the startup process has been completed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **58014 (SQLSTATE: HY000): old cluster sessions are still alive**

<a id="0da6574b0e4b80c3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs if a session that was created before the joining node was disconnected still remains on the active node during the cluster join process.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Sessions of the disconnected node are automatically cleaned up by the gmaster cleanup thread. Retry after all sessions have been fully cleared.<br>If the same issue continues to occur, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **58015 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Timeout expired - %s**

<a id="6f79e13bc487ca0e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The connection time to the remote node during the cluster join process exceeded the value configured in<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#0e6e1eb0cbed5739">CLUSTER_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_SEC</a>.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Increase the value of<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#0e6e1eb0cbed5739">CLUSTER_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_SEC</a>&nbsp;and try again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **58016 (SQLSTATE: HY000): cancel dequeue operation - database is going shutdown**

<a id="c30a77ffcf27ba18"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This is an error code used within the server.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>No action is required.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **58017 (SQLSTATE: HY000): join database is in progress**

<a id="a14847cc23be149d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when attempting to join two or more nodes simultaneously from different sessions.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER SYSTEM JOIN DATABASE;<br><br>ERR-HY000(58017): MEMBER(G1N2): join database is in progress</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Join the nodes sequentially.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **58018 (SQLSTATE: HY000): connection request from old cluster**

<a id="fbe9ba9fb21638c1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when attempting to join a node that was disconnected from Cluster A to Cluster B.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Join the node to the correct cluster to which it originally belonged.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **58019 (SQLSTATE: HY000): member position is out of range( 0 to %ld ) - local(%d), remote(%d)**

<a id="084957aba56566fa"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the local member position value exceeds the<a href="../part-02-administration-manual/10-server-property.md#a239b812d73d78fd">MAX_NODE_COUNT</a>&nbsp;value during group creation or member addition.<br><br>This issue typically occurs when the MAX_NODE_COUNT value of the node being added is different from the MAX_NODE_COUNT value of the active nodes.<br><br>The following is an example of an error that occurs when attempting to add g1n2, which has MAX_NODE_COUNT set to 1, to g1n1 where MAX_NODE_COUNT is set to 2.<br><br>gSQL&gt; ALTER CLUSTER GROUP G1 ADD CLUSTER MEMBER G1N2 HOST '127.0.0.1' PORT 11250;<br><br>ERR-HY000(16351): failed to connect to the cluster member 'G1N2'<br>ERR-HY000(58019): MEMBER(G1N2): member position is out of range( 0 to 1 ) - local(1), remote(0)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Set the MAX_NODE_COUNT to the same value as the active nodes, and then try again.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **58020 (SQLSTATE: HY000): the cluster protocol version '%d.%d' of cluster member '%d' is not compatible with the cluster protocol version '%d.%d' of cluster member '%d'**

<a id="678382a919740f05"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The major cluster protocol version of the joining node does not match the major version of the active nodes.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the major protocol version of the joining node and try again with the correct package version.<br><br>The following shows how to check the cluster protocol version of a node.<br><br>gSQL&gt; SELECT stat_name, stat_value<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM v$system_stat@local<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;WHERE stat_name LIKE '%_PROTOCOL_VERSION';<br><br>STAT_NAME&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;STAT_VALUE<br>---------------------- ----------<br>MAJOR_PROTOCOL_VERSION&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2<br>MINOR_PROTOCOL_VERSION&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1<br><br>2 rows selected.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="f4d912c76642d487"></a>
## gtrclogger Related Error

> **59000 (SQLSTATE: HY000): exceeded port cnt**

<a id="9588ba47013a2e04"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">gtrclogger can receive logs from multiple servers through up to 100 ports. This error occurred because the number of ports specified at startup exceeded the maximum allowed limit of 100.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Run gtrclogger with the number of receiving ports set to 100 or fewer.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **59001 (SQLSTATE: HY000): gtrclogger is already running**

<a id="566aec9c1535eb35"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">An attempt was made to start gtrclogger while it was already running.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">To start a new instance of gtrclogger, the currently running instance must be stopped first.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **59002 (SQLSTATE: HY000): gtrclogger is not running**

<a id="fd5e8f6f6f38ed73"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">An attempt was made to stop gtrclogger, but no running instance was found.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Since gtrclogger is not actually running, there is no need to stop it. Start the program again if necessary.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **59003 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Operation timed out**

<a id="8c89f268b281dc9a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">When the stop command is executed, it terminates the currently running gtrclogger process and attempts to acquire a lock on the log file to verify that the shutdown was successful.<br>This error occurs when the lock on the log file cannot be acquired after multiple attempts.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check whether the gtrclogger process is still running.<br>Verify if another process is using the log file.<br>Since there may be system-wide issues related to file locking, also check the file system status and privilege settings.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **59004 (SQLSTATE: 22000): Invalid GOLDILOCKS_DATA directory**

<a id="d0ca6767a663cea2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the directory path specified in the GOLDILOCKS_DATA environment variable does not exist or is not accessible.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Set the GOLDILOCKS_DATA environment variable to a valid directory path.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="0682904af310e9be"></a>
## glocator Related Error

> **60000 (SQLSTATE: HY000): syntax error**

<a id="34d931c42a9e3ea8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60001 (SQLSTATE: HY000): file does not exist - '%s'**

<a id="544c556d0d9e61ad"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>%s file does not exist.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check if the file exist, then modify it.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60002 (SQLSTATE: HY000): GOLDILOCKS_DATA system environment is invalid**

<a id="285cd8bc09f880f7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>GOLDILOCKS_DATA environment variable is not valid.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Set the valid GOLDILOCKS_DATA environment variable.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60003 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid value - %s(%s)**

<a id="8d75697b2cfe55ac"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The SERVICE name exceeds the maximum length in ADD SERVICE statement.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>The identifier name should be shorter than 128 bytes.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60004 (SQLSTATE: HY000): file name is too long - '%s'**

<a id="19a4f1a70eb9634c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The length of the file path exceeds the maximum length.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>It should be shorter than 1024 bytes.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60005 (SQLSTATE: HY000): glocator is already started.**

<a id="1ba46b610ea1c76a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>glocator is already in operation.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Terminate the glocator in operation to execute glocator newly, Or, execute glocator with the home and connection information which are different from glocator in operation to execute another glocator in the same equipment.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60006 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Location file is corrupted - '%s'**

<a id="dd31b37cbaf7ec0a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The location file is corrupted.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Create the new location file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60007 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Property value is out of length - '%s'**

<a id="754415806f32c069"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The length of the given property value exceeds the valid length.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Use the length of the property value within the valid range.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60008 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid property value [ YES | NO | 1 | 0 ] - '%s'**

<a id="314e67852480f820"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The invalid value was used in boolean property.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Use boolean value suggested in the error message.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60009 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid property value [ %ld ~ %ld ] - '%s'**

<a id="f9d54c14355d8870"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The value used in integer property exceeds the range.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Use an integer value within the suggested range in the error message.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60010 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid property value [ %ld ~ %ld ] - '%s'**

<a id="328243d9c3ed48dc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The string used as the string property exceeds the valid length range.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Use a string within the suggested character length in the error message.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60011 (SQLSTATE: HY000): File already exists - '%s'**

<a id="c1e24a02ce9fbfc2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The file already exists.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the file and respond to it.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60012 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Location file exceeded max size(%ld) - over size(%ld)**

<a id="91b016a84835a79a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60013 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Not exist node information - '%s'**

<a id="69293b740c2920be"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The given node information does not exist.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check it in the trace log.<br>If this error occurred during the cluster failover process in the cluster environment, then gagent of the node was already terminated.<br>If the node was inquired for gloctl or the global connection, then add the information about the node through gloctl.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60014 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Exceeded response time for failover.**

<a id="bdf63ad3b4f99ffb"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60015 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Node is on failover - '%s'**

<a id="45129137ff221da1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">ADD, DROP MEMBER statement was executed through gloctl, but the node is in failover process.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">The information about the node in failover process can not be updated, so try it again after finishing failover.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60016 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Need more alternate locator host information.**

<a id="fdafc1b230a24cf3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>sync option was used, but ALTERNATE_LOCATOR information does not exist.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Add the ALTERNATE_LOCATOR property to the configuration file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60017 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid configure file specification - property:[%s]**

<a id="45de7c316994dd91"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">ALTERNATE_LOCATOR property is set, but the string is not a valid form.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">The value of the ALTERNATE_LOCATOR property is the name of the ini object, which must be specified in the configuration file. This ini object must include valid host and port properties.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60018 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Failed to propagate - '%s:%d'**

<a id="46613a9acdb91b05"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The replicated glocator tried to update MEMBER or SERVICE, but failed.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">If the packet is lost due to the protocol communication using UDP, then execute it again or alternate glocator should directly handle it.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60019 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Not exist service information - '%s'**

<a id="9c2e70a1ca37a301"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The information about the given service does not exist.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the information about the service.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60020 (SQLSTATE: HY000): '%s' node is already connected.**

<a id="96e2a1fe9d5ee215"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The node with the same name already exists when connecting to gagent.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">gagent of the same member tried an additional execution. Check the trace log of gagent.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60021 (SQLSTATE: HY000): overflow fd.**

<a id="81eba56ce8c476c7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The system has reached the limit of file descriptors.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Increase the system’s file descriptor limit.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **60022 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Connection is rejected.**

<a id="4ede5078344f6834"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle"><ul><li>gagent: Attempted to connect to the glocator, but the glocator is not a primary.</li><li>glocator: Cannot be used because another alternate glocator is already in use.</li></ul></td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle"><ul><li>gagent: Connect to the primary glocator.</li><li>glocator: Disconnect from the currently connected alternate glocator and connect to a new alternate glocator.</li></ul></td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="4ba1956419b39329"></a>
## gloctl Related Error

> **61000 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Syntax error**

<a id="b5c4175bb70720ab"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The input string violated the syntax.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the grammar.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **61001 (SQLSTATE: HY000): File does not exist - '%s'**

<a id="892d266007d27539"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The file does not exist.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the file path.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **61002 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Can not find any ini object in file - '%s'**

<a id="d4089bc51720cf37"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>INI file used in IMPORT statement does not have any data source.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check INI file used in IMPORT statement.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **61003 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Dsn does not exist - '%s'**

<a id="4324b28f3e29aa7f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It is executable by entering only the member name in ADD MEMBER statement as follows.<br><br>gLoctl&gt; add member g1n1<br><br>It tried to get g1n1 information of the member from odbc.ini file, but g1n1 information does not exist in odbc.ini.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Add the member information to odbc.ini. The location of odbc.ini file is subject to change according to the home directory, ODBCINI or ODBCSYSINI environment variable.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **61004 (SQLSTATE: HY000): ADD MEMBER keyword syntax is error - '%s'**

<a id="b42c6065123023d3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The keyword used in ADD MEMBER statement is wrong.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check ADD MEMBER statement.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **61005 (SQLSTATE: HY000): ADD SERVICE keyword syntax is error - '%s'**

<a id="1e705af0faa9d848"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The keyword used in ADD SERVICE statement is wrong.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check ADD SERVICE statement.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **61006 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid property value [ YES | NO | 1 | 0 ] - '%s'**

<a id="81957f4f82b259dd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>An invalid value was used in boolean property.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Use the boolean value suggested in the error message.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **61007 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid property value [ %ld ~ %ld ] - '%s'**

<a id="717fc4e6baf28329"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The value used in integer property exceeds the range.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Use the integer value in the range suggested in the error message.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **61008 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid property value [ %ld ~ %ld ] - '%s'**

<a id="f957d9f1d6d5c8af"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The string used as the string property exceeds the valid length range.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Use the string within the text length suggested in the error message.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **61009 (SQLSTATE: HY000): STL_ENV_DB_DATA system environment is invalid**

<a id="f11ce484ddcd28df"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It refers to GOLDILOCKS_DATA environment variable to get the location of data configuration file, but the environment variable does not exist or the string length of the result is smaller than 1.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check GOLDILOCKS_DATA environment variable, or directly input the configuration file by using conf option.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **61010 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Keyword syntax is invalid - '%s'**

<a id="1b97dc5655df4318"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The syntax of input keyword is not valid.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the grammar of the used syntax.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **61011 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Data value is invalid - '%s'**

<a id="f3d664f69e14355b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>The information is missing in a specific syntax. IMPORT statement should include HOST and PORT information. Or, if the information of SERVICE member is missing when using ADD SERVICE statement, then an error occurs.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Check the grammar of the used syntax.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="9636b6135431760d"></a>
## gmon Related Error

> **62000 (SQLSTATE: HY000): gmon is already running**

<a id="4f0ec0c2fd92ade5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>gmon is already running.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Clear the previously operated gmon, or respond according to the trace log.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **62001 (SQLSTATE: HY000): process(%ld) did not respond signal**

<a id="2a8378c960999df8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td>It tried to get the process name of gmaster by using the given pid, but it failed. A specific os does not support checking the process name by using pid. In this case, it checks if the process is alive by using the signal, but the process did not respond.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td>Respond according to the trace log.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **62002 (SQLSTATE: HY000): GOLDILOCKS_DATA system environment is invalid**

<a id="eb4d2b2b051bac3a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The environment variable GOLDILOCKS_DATA is not valid.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Set the valid GOLDILOCKS_DATA environment variable.</td></tr></tbody></table>

## gagent Related Error

> **63000 (SQLSTATE: HY000): GOLDILOCKS_DATA system environment is invalid**

<a id="650447f0cfd03e49"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The environment variable GOLDILOCKS_DATA is not valid.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Set the valid GOLDILOCKS_DATA environment variable.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **63001 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Property value is out of length - '%s'**

<a id="856a48842a86c79c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The length of the given property value exceeds the valid length.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Use the length of the property value within the valid range.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **63002 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid property value [ YES | NO | 1 | 0 ] - '%s'**

<a id="e96abd2670f20146"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>An invalid value was used in boolean property.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Use the boolean value suggested in the error message.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **63003 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid property value [ %ld ~ %ld ] - '%s'**

<a id="862e1fb8721e077e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The value used in integer property exceeds the range.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Use the integer value in the range suggested in the error message.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **63004 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid property value [ %ld ~ %ld ] - '%s'**

<a id="e1ed3eaa44029c45"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The string used as the string property exceeds the valid length range.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Clear the previously operated gagent, or respond according to the trace log.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **63005 (SQLSTATE: HY000): gagent is already started.**

<a id="97878d0e21d92cd1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>gagent is already started.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Clear the previously operated gagent, or respond according to the trace log.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **63006 (SQLSTATE: HY000): file name is too long - '%s'**

<a id="2c40055d69fec9c8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The length of the file path is bigger than or equal to 1024.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Use the length smaller than 1024</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **63007 (SQLSTATE: HY000): file does not exist - '%s'**

<a id="e92d83f4a42ad4dd"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The file does not exist.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the file name and the path.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **63008 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Database is not cluster.**

<a id="4329ca3e602bd3ee"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>It is not cluster database.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>It can be operated in cluster database.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **63009 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid configure file specification - property:[%s]**

<a id="2bdd8995a149ad25"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The property is not set in INI file.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the property and how to set the property.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **63010 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid phase(%s): executable phase is between %s and %s**

<a id="f0b1e01beda2e7e0"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The current database is not open.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Start the database to local open or open phase, then execute gagent.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **63011 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Property PORT of dsn(%s) is not set in file 'odbc.ini'**

<a id="ec16d63ee9fac077"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **63012 (SQLSTATE: 08000): Timeout expired.**

<a id="0e9a261e8df3fd70"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **63013 (SQLSTATE: HYT00): Unable to establish connection.**

<a id="9ee5facefa33cdc9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="e712a98d2e7e154c"></a>
## cyfile Related Error

> **64000 (SQLSTATE: RD000): Service is not available**

<a id="e7340bb332246aff"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The database was not connected properly.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check whether the database is running normally and verify that the connection string in the trace log is correct. If any incorrect information is found, correct the database connection details specified in the environment file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64001 (SQLSTATE: HY000): '%s' : file does not exist**

<a id="956254738ab279c8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The environment file or other files do not exist in the specified path.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Modify the file path and name correctly, then re-execute.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64002 (SQLSTATE: HY000): configure file processing error**

<a id="bd4d9db848567e4d"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The content specified in the environment file is incorrect.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Modify it based on the output error message.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **63003 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  '%s': table does not exist**

<a id="1d906d8b4a4e81a4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The table information specified in the environment file does not exist in the database.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Update the environment file so that its information matches the database.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64004 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  '%s': schema does not exist**

<a id="15fcff88ab8fa1ad"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The schema information specified in the environment file does not exist in the database.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Update the environment file so that its information matches the database.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64005 (SQLSTATE: HY000): '%s.%s': previously added. maybe duplicated**

<a id="1b6f459c4ec38aa8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The environment file contains duplicate table information.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Remove the duplicate table information from the environment file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64006 (SQLSTATE: HY000): '%s%s': table must have a primary key**

<a id="5cedf95d01b41ea7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The specified table does not have a primary key set.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Set or add a primary key to the table.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64007 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  internal error occurred (%s)**

<a id="651c1c7d18b76acc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>This error occurs due to an internal failure.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the trace log and contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64008 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  invalid datatype (%ld)**

<a id="2bb8a464b0d5275c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>A data type that does not support Cyfile was used.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Verify that the data type supports Cyfile.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64009 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  '%s.%s': table must set supplemental log or primary key.**

<a id="0bb71f9c4934b58e"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">To perform Cyfile, supplemental logging must be enabled, but it is not enabled on the specified table.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Enable supplemental logging on the table, or set the SUPPLEMENTAL_LOG_DATA_PRIMARY_KEY property in Goldilocks to YES and restart.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64010 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  group [%s] is already running**

<a id="00b7df43e9ec3700"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">A replication group with the same name as the one specified in the environment file is already running.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use the --status option to check the running status of Cyfile. If the group is already running, terminate it and restart. When adding a new group, change the group name in the environment file because a group with the same name already exists.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64011 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  cyfile is not running**

<a id="84b4f7aa10b25f58"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Cyfile is not running, or the specified Cyfile replication group name is incorrect.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Use the --status option to check whether Cyfile is running and to verify the group name.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64012 (SQLSTATE: HY000): GOLDILOCKS_DATA system environment is invalid**

<a id="9031d5dfee366dfc"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The GOLDILOCKS_DATA system environment argument is not set.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Set GOLDILOCKS_DATA in the environment where Cyfile is executed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64013 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  '%s' log file is reused or invalid: restart cyfile with '--reset' option**

<a id="56523841453260f8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Processing cannot continue because the redo log file specified for obtaining Cyfile data has been reused, or the archive log is missing.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check whether ARCHIVELOG_MODE is enabled. To discard the current state and start anew from the current point, restart Cyfile with the --reset option.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64014 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  failed to analyze flow [%s]**

<a id="e8e3d95ae5a82887"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>Failed to analyze data.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the trace log and contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64015 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  Invalid transaction slot ID**

<a id="7f8de7a3514622d7"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the TRANSACTION_TABLE_SIZE property of GOLDILOCKS is changed after Cyfile has been started.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Restart Cyfile. If TRANSACTION_TABLE_SIZE is changed during replication, Cyfile must be restarted.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64016 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid operation for DDL**

<a id="d14a88263655d6f9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>A DDL operation that Cyfile cannot handle was executed.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the trace logs and contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64017 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  Invalid group name (%s)**

<a id="f21fa2d02486d281"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>A group is not configured in the environment file.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Configure a group in the environment file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64018 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid capture information**

<a id="934d6d42525f358f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The recovery information is incorrect.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Restart Cyfile using the --reset all option.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64019 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  There is no group in configure**

<a id="ef263eb7aa307748"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>No group information is configured in the environment file.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Configure at least one group in the environment file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64020 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  Duplicate group name (%s)**

<a id="1ee3c317e3bf7ee1"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The group name is duplicated in the environment file.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Ensure that each group name in the environment file is unique.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64021 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  Invalid Value : %s(%s)**

<a id="609d4fc3f6a83e5f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The contents specified in the environment file are incorrect.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Correct the values to valid ones.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64022 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid host port (%s)**

<a id="81a64f3f0ceb06a3"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The HOST_PORT value specified in the environment file is incorrect.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Correct the HOST_PORT value in the environment file to a valid value.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64023 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  Redo log file read timeout (%s)**

<a id="b269df03c660c97f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs when the wait time exceeds while reading archive log files.<br>(The error occurs if a required file is not found within 10 seconds.)</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check whether the file exists and then restart Cyfile. If the same issue continues to occur, restart Cyfile using the --reset all option.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64024 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  Invalid archive log file (%s)**

<a id="e76a174663b5ebd5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>No valid archive log files are available.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the trace logs and contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64025 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  failed to write file (%s)**

<a id="da3011b4f157ba74"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Failed to save the file.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Free up disk space on the machine where it is running, and then restart. If the same issue continues to occur, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64026 (SQLSTATE: HY000): failed to set propagate mode at session**

<a id="adb1715ad67d2709"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>deprecated</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>If this error occurs, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64027 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  There is no active redo log file**

<a id="2058693eff89c7a9"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">This error occurs if the redo log files being processed by Goldilocks are invalid, or if processing is delayed due to disk bottlenecks during the LogFile switch.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Restart Cyfile. If the same issue continues to occur, contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64028 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  Cannot add new table. master database must be started first. (%s.%s)**

<a id="8dd1712b3b9cd751"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">To process a table specified or added in the environment file, Cyfile must connect to Goldilocks to configure the table information.<br>If Goldilocks is not online or cannot be accessed, the configuration fails and this error occurs.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">If a table was added to the environment file, remove the table and restart Cyfile, or check the operational status of Goldilocks.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64029 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  Master database must be started(Open status) for the first time, reset table.**

<a id="b49a674aee68e3a5"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">When Cyfile is run for the first time or with the --reset option, it must connect to Goldilocks. If the connection fails, this error occurs.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the operational status of Goldilocks.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64030 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  Meta file has broken. please restart with '--reset all'(%s)**

<a id="e7f2b799d7175240"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The metadata file containing the information required for Cyfile is in an invalid state.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Restart Cyfile using the --reset all option.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64031 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  Redo log file does not exist (%s)**

<a id="725681d9631c00b4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The redo log file does not exist.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Check the trace logs and contact our customer service department.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64032 (SQLSTATE: HY000): USER_ID or USER_PW does not exist**

<a id="2e26902bc6aaa80a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The USER_ID and USER_PW required to connect to Goldilocks are not set in the environment file.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Specify USER_ID and USER_PW in the environment file.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64033 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  (%s) value is too long**

<a id="0f5b5b0306d7db48"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The specified information exceeds the maximum allowed length.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the maximum length in the user manual and adjust the information accordingly.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64034 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  Invalid encrypt/decrypt key**

<a id="2e307616a748eef8"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The key used to encrypt/decrypt the password is invalid.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Modify the USER_ENCRYPT_PW value in the environment file to a value generated with a valid key.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64035 (SQLSTATE: HY000): no '--key' option**

<a id="e192b851b2de122c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The encrypted password has not been generated, or the key to decrypt USER_ENCRYPT_PW is not set.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Run the command with the --key option.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64036 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  password already exists (use one of USER_PW or USER_ENCRYPT_PW)**

<a id="61ccdd18739448b6"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">Both USER_PW and USER_ENCRYPT_PW are specified in the environment file.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Remove the unnecessary entry between USER_PW and USER_ENCRYPT_PW, then re-execute.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64037 (SQLSTATE: HY000):   reset or sync table (%s.%s) has never participated in replication**

<a id="92946a9bb23a3487"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The --reset and --sync 'Table Name' options were used to initialize a specific table, but the table does not exist or has no replication history.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Since --reset and --sync are critical options for replication and data initialization, the exact table name must be specified. If the table has been newly added, perform the operation without using these options.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64038 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  reset or sync argument is invalid (%s)**

<a id="e708f2eaa3e4b542"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The information specified in --reset and --sync is incorrect.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Verify the specified information, correct it, and then rerun the operation.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64039 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  Table meta file has broken. please restart with '--reset all'**

<a id="a8db3693b8386a2c"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The meta file containing the required information is invalid.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Restart Cyfile using the --reset all option.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64040 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  (%s.%s) table (%s) column is not acceptable(GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY)**

<a id="150a4635c779323f"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">One or more columns in the target table have the Generated Always As Identity attribute.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">This operation cannot be performed on columns with this attribute, so it must be removed.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64041 (SQLSTATE: HY000): data type is not supported.(%s)**

<a id="51ff8476031a07e2"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">An unsupported data type was used.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Cyfile does not support data types such as Long Varchar and Long Varbinary.<br>Modify the tables containing these data types and restart.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64042 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Cluster information does not matched( before groupid(%d), memberid(%d)/current groupid(%d), memberid(%d) )**

<a id="4fe098a36b7b6381"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The cluster information in the existing data must not be changed, but it has been modified.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Check the cluster information in the environment file, or restart Cyfile with the --reset all option to initialize the information.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64043 (SQLSTATE: HY000): Invalid cluster information at configure file( %s )**

<a id="088c39e8bb4d26d4"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The CLUSTER information specified in the environment file is incorrect.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">This may occur if ID, PORT, or MASTER_IP are duplicated or recorded incorrectly. Correct the values accordingly.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64044 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  Control has broken(CRC Error)( %s )**

<a id="c37a6019c1385198"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The control file required for operation is not properly configured.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Restart Cyfile with the --reset all option to initialize the information.</td></tr></tbody></table>

> **64045 (SQLSTATE: HY000):  Control has broken(internal CRC Error)( %s )**

<a id="7f09bacc04bd2c2a"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td>Cause</td><td>The control file required for operation is not properly configured.</td></tr><tr><td>Action</td><td>Restart Cyfile with the --reset all option to initialize the information.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<a id="29f32f46c86bd315"></a>
## gdump-related Errors

> **67000 (SQLSTATE: HY000): actual file type (%s) does not match the specified type (%s)**

<a id="d37ad8b0c6705d9b"></a>
<table><tbody><tr><td valign="middle">Cause</td><td valign="middle">The file type specified by the user does not match the actual file type.</td></tr><tr><td valign="middle">Action</td><td valign="middle">Change the file type to the actual file type indicated in the error message and try again.</td></tr></tbody></table>
